tei:titleStmt.tei:title: o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa'i ring lugs grol byed khrid kyi rim pa phyogs gcig tu bsdus pa theg mchog rtse mo 'jug pa'i them skas zhes bya ba bzhugs
o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa'i ring lugs grol byed khrid kyi rim pa phyogs gcig tu bsdus pa theg mchog rtse mo 'jug pa'i them skas zhes bya ba bzhugs

tei:div.tei:p: o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa'i ring lugs grol byed khrid kyi rim pa phyogs gcig tu bsdus pa theg mchog rtse mo 'jug pa'i them skas zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ oṃ swa sti/ gter chen rtsa gsum gling pa'i zab mo'i gter/ /bdun cu'i yang snying grol byed khrid rim phal/ dus rlung drag pos khyer ba'i 'thor lus rigs/ 'bad brgyas phyogs bsdus gang nus sri zhu bcas/ theg rtser 'jug pa'i them skas 'dir slong bya/ de la o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa'i zab gter rjes 'brangs dang bcas pa'i phyogs gtogs grol byed khrid kyi rim pa zab pa gter byon skor/ bka' brgyad gsang ba zil gnon las/ phyi rgyud thig pa rim dgu dang*/ rdzogs chen yang gsang bla med/ de yi don khrid dkon seng paṇa ṭi tas mdzad pa dang*/ dga' rgyal gter byon rdzogs chen 'khor 'das rang grol las tshogs cha lag dang bcas pa/ gsang ba ye shes rtsa rlung snyan brgyud gsang mdzod sogs chos sde phal che bar rgyab chos khrid gzhung dang*/ spra khrid man ngag zab khyad mang du bzhugs pa phal cher gangs ljongs spyi mthun bzhin dus 'gyur chu log drag pos khyer nas mi mngon gdod ma'i dbyings su gshegs zin par mngon la/ yang dar chos rigs slar gso'i skabs/ dpe rgyun gang rnyed phyogs bsdus byas pa'i nang*/ padma khrag 'thung gi khrid skor sogs 'thor bu 'ga' rnyed pa dang*/ de dag la kho bos sri zhur dmigs pa'i dgongs 'brel dang zin bris ci rigs pa bcas khrid yig phyogs bsdus kyi them byang 'god pa la/ thog mar/ ka)mkhyen brtse'i dgongs rgyan/ kha)zhi gnas/ ga)sngon 'gro'i lag khrid gnad gzer/ nga)sngon khrid zab don sgron me/ ca)sngon 'gro bsdus pa/ cha)sngags kyi pra khrid/ nya)chos drug ta)bar do/ tha)'pho ba/ da)bla ma ka dag na)gtum mo don khrid/ pa)rdzogs chen don khrid/ pha)bskyed rdzogs dris len/ ba)ka dag phyag rgya/ ma)dus tshigs ngo sprod/

tsa)gcod kyi sa bcad bcas bzhugs pa lags so/ /slar smras pa/ gnubs lugs bka' gter rgya mtsho chen po las/ legs 'ong gter chen gnam lcags rdo rje yi/ /chos sde'i smin khrid cha shas ji rnyaid kun/ /phyogs bsdus theg rtse'i them skas 'di ko rmad/ /de slad dpal mgon bla ma yi/ /thugs kyi dgongs pa rdzogs phyir dang*/ /gang la me tog phog pa yi/ /gnam lcags zab gter gang de'i gtsos/ /rgyun dkon gsung rab bsdu skrun dang*/ /chad nye'i smin grol rgyun spel slad/ /'di yang bkam̐' gtem̐r srim̐ zhum̐ ru/ /em̐ waṃm̐ dpem̐ skrunam̐ kham̐ng nas bsgrubs/ /des kyang snying po'i ring lugs 'di/ /bshad sgrub bstan pa dar zhing rgyas/ /snyigs ma'i rgud pa yongs su zhi/ /rdzogs ldan dpal la spyod par shog /ces pa'ang sgo chen sprul ming pas gnam lcags zab gter yongs rdzogs 'phrul par du drangs shing glegs bam re la brgya phrag lnga'i grangs kyi dpe skrun bgyis skabs rang gi 'dod don gsol ba btab pa bzhin 'grub par gyur cig/ //

ka)༄༅/ /lo gsum bsnyen sgrub mtshams kyi khog dbub mkhyen brtse'i dgongs rgyan sgeg mo'i me long bzhugs so// na mo gu ru mañdzu gho ṣa ya/ mkhyem̐n gnyis ye shes gsal ba'i ā darshar/ /brtsem̐ chen snying rje'i gzugs brnyan rnam bkra bas/ /gdul bya'i khams dbam̐ng dang 'tshams nus pa'i dpal/ /mi zad rtag 'char dang pom̐'i sangs rgyas rgyal/ de yang lo gsum bsnyen sgrub mtshams kyi khog dbub mkhyen brtse'i dgongs rgyan sgeg mo'i me long zhes bya ba dben gnas ri sul du sgrub pa'i dam bca' bzung nas bskyed rdzogs zab mo'i lam la mos pa rtse gcig pas lo gsum phyogs gsum gyi bsnyen sgrub la brtson pa'i rang ltos kyi gang zag pho mo rang dang rgyud tshod mtshungs pa'i dman bu rnams kyi nyams len la phan pa'i ched du cung zad smra bar byed pa la/ de la thog mar lo gsum phyogs gsum gang du nyams su len pa la sgrub pa'i gnas kyang dben zhing rgyal ba gong mas byin gyis brlabs pa sogs mdor na 'gal rkyen nyung zhing yo byad mthun rkyen sogs dgos pa'i nyer mkho tshang ba gal che la/ de dag gi rgyab rten bsod nams kyi dpung bskyed pa'i thabs dang bar chad sel ba'i sna sel du/ dang po ni/ rang rgyud sbyong ba la/ lus kyi sgrib pa sbyang phyir sātstsha gdab pa/ nye'u 'don pa/ srog bslu/ rnam 'joms sme brtsegs kyi khrus bya/ ngag sgrib sbyang phyir/ na rag dong sprugs dang yig brgya bzlas/ yid sgrib sbyang phyir sems bskyed blang bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgom/ zhi ba'i sbyin sreg blugs/ gsum ka'i phyir du phyag skor dang mkha' 'gro chos skyong la tshogs skong rgya cher bya/ de bzhin du sgrub khang gi shar du sher phyin/ lhor stobs po che/ nub tu lang kar gshegs/ byang du tog gzungs dang grwa nga klog par gsungs pa bzhin grub na legs/ thog mar bla gab med pa'i sar bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas rgyag brngan lha bsang sogs mgron bzhi spyi mchod dang chu gtor mdos glud sogs mchod sbyin ci nus bya/

de bzhin dge 'dun gyi sde la bsnyen bkur dang nad pa dbul phongs bya rigs chu gnas sogs la sbyin gtong byas te sgrub pa mthar phyin cing bar chad med pa'i smon lam gdab bo/ sgrub gnas gsar pa yin na sa brtag slong dbang du bya ba/ sbyang zhing bsrung ba rnams sgrub khog ltar shes par bya yis sgrub gnas rnying pa la mi dgos so/ de lta bu'i gnas su bsnyen sgrub nyams su len pa'i skabs/ thog mar stan 'og tu sa dkar gyi g.yung drung bris pa'i steng rtswa ku sha rtse mo mdun bstan du bsnyal ba'i khar mal stan legs par bca' ba sogs sbyor ba'i chos rnams legs par grub pa bya/ nyams len dngos la 'jug pa ni/ tshig bdun gsol 'debs sngon du 'gro bas skyabs sems tshogs bsags kyis rgyud sbyangs/ so so'i sgrub thabs gzhung bsrangs te mchod bstod bzlas pa'i bar la btang*/ bzlas pa grub pa dang gsol kha nas tshogs skong chad brtan rta bro mchod bstod bsdu rim lhar ldang byas te/ bsngo smon bkra shis bar tshang bar brjod rjes/ sngar gyi lhar ldang gi nga rgyal de ka'i mur/ rtsa sngags kyi gsal gdab tsam brjod pa dang chabs cig sgo drung du song la/ mchod gtor rnams/ a mṛ ta sa bsang*/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shuddho3 haṃḥ sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bhrūm̐ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥ sa byin brlab/ bhū mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra badzra sa mā dzaḥ sa spyan drangs/ bhū mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyoḥbi shwa mu khe bhyaḥsarba thā khaṃ utga te spha ra ṇa hi maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swā hā/ zhes nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgyas lan gsum gyis bsngos/ gang dag 'dir gnas lha dang klu/ gnod sbyin srin po'am gzhan dag la/ dkyil 'khor don du sa phyogs 'di/

bdag zhu khyed kyis stsal du gsol/ zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab pas gnang ba byin par bsam/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ /nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*/ /dpal dang grags dang bskal pa bzang*/ /longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing*/ /zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi/ /las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol/ /dam tshig can gyis bdag la srungs/ /dngos grub kun gyi sdong grogs mdzod/ /dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang*/ /gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod/ /rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan/ /bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod/ /'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang*/ /'bru rnams 'phel zhing phyugs 'phel ba/ /dge legs thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas/ /yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub mdzod/ ces ci 'dod pa'i phrin las bcol/ bhū mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra gātstshaḥ sa rang gnas su gshegs par bsam la/ 'jam rol dang bcas gtor ma dang gser skyems phyir 'bul/ gnang ba byin nas rang gnas su gshegs par bsam zhing*/ kun rdzob kyi sbyang ba dang*/ chos thams cad stong nyid du shes pas rang bzhin med par rgyas gdab/ de nas bgegs gtor byin brlab cing sngags kyis bsngo/ las byang gang yin gyis bka' bsgo zhing mtshams bcad/ srung 'khor bsgom/ de nas phyi mtshams bcad pa ni/ sgrub khang gi sgo drung du tho 'dzugs pa la/ rgyal chen bzhi'i sku'am sngags byang rgyal mtshan dang bcas pa btsugs la so so'i mdun du stegs gtsang mar gtor ma dkar zlum mdun mtheb skyu ril bus mtshan pa dang*/ de yi mdun du g.yon phyogs nas brtsam pa'i chu gnyis nyer spyod lnga bcas bshams/ rgyal tho'i mdun du mchod gtor bshams/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐/ rnam dag chos dbyings ngang nyid las: rang byung mchod pa'i phung po ni: kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin lta bus: dpag yas nam mkha' gang bar gyur: om̐ badzra arghaṃ pā dyaṃ puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai wi dye shabda āḥhūm̐/

zhes pas mchod pa dang*/ gtor gzhong ratna'i gzhal yas su: gtor ma 'dod yon phung por spungs: om̐ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum rgya dang bcas pas brlab/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas ri rab kyi phyogs bzhi nas rgyal po chen po sde bzhi 'khor dang bcas pa badzra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sa rten dang dbyer med du bzhugs par bsam/ om̐ dhriṣṭā rāṣṭā ya swā hā: om̐ bi ru ḍha kā ya swā hā: om̐ bi ru pākṣā ya swā hā: om̐ bai shra ma ṇā ya swā hā: sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pā dyaṃ puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai wi dye shabda pra tītstsha swā hāḥ sa mchod/ om̐ dhriṣṭa rāṣṭā ya i daṃ bha lingta kha kha khā hi khā hi: om̐ bi rū dha kā ya i daṃ bha lingta kha kha khā hi khā hi: om̐ bi ru pākṣā ya i daṃ bha lingta kha kha khā hi khā hi: om̐ bai shra ma ṇā ya i daṃ bha lingta kha kha khā hi khā hi: zab cing rgya chen gzigs pa po/ /yul 'khor srung dang 'phags skyes po/ /spyan mi bzang dang rnam thos sras/ /shar lho nub byang phyogs bzhi yi/ /rgyal chen bzhi la phyag 'tshal bstod/ ces bstod/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ /nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*/ /dpal dang grags dang skal pa bzang*/ /longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing*/ /zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi/ /las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol/ /dam tshig can gyi bdag la srungs/ /dngos grub kun gyi sdong grogs mdzod/ /dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang*/ /gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod/ /rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan/ /bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod/ /'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang*/ /'bru rnams 'phel zhing phyugs 'phel ba/ /bde legs phun sum tshogs pa dang*/ /yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub mdzod/ ces phrin las bcol/ om̐ dhriṣṭā rāṣṭā ya swā hā: om̐ bi ru ḍha kā ya swā hā:

om̐ bi ru pākṣā ya swā hā: om̐ bai shra ma ṇā ya swā hā: mthar/ su pra tiṣṭha badzra ye swā hāḥ sa brtan bzhugs bya/ gnas 'dir nyin mo bde legs mtshan bde legs/ /nyi ma'i gung yang bde legs shing*/ /nyin mtshan rtag tu bde legs pa/ /dkon mchog gsum gyis deng 'dir stsol/ bar mtshams dam sri mnan pa sogs spros pa yod med gnyis su snang bas 'dir spro bar mos na/ dang po ni/ rang gzhung las stobs chen ma hā ba la'i lto bar khro zhal nang du liṅga bri ba dang bskyed pa sogs gsungs kyang spyir btang du dug shog la dam sri liṅga bya mchu can yan lag lcags sgrog gis bsdams pa'i snying khar dza tri na tri dza kha sprod mthar mgrin pa nas brtsams te yig mgo phyir bstan pa/ ya ma dam sri ya ma pa ri mā ra dza dzaḥ nan nan/ tri'u tri'u mā ra ya na ma sho dzaḥ khug nan/ zhes dang gzugs kyi mthar yig mgo nang du bstan la/ dus drug dang bcur rgyu ba'i nyul le dam sri rgyal 'gong 'byung po'i tshogs dang bcas pa'i lus ngag yid gsum mthu stobs thams cad non cig bskal pa stong gi bar du ma ldang zhig om̐ lam̐ hūm̐ lam̐ satwaṃ bha ya nan/ zhes pa rnams kyi mthar dza khraṃ gyis bskor ba bris la/ grub na snga nyin lta bu bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro ba'i ling khrus dang 'gugs gzhug drag po byas la/ 'dre lteb tu bcag cing tshon skud kyis bcings/ thod ngan nam khyi thod lta bur bcug phung ras kyis dril la rtsang gis gzir ba'i mnan chas bya/ sgo drung du dong gru gsum brus pa la bkod/ de tsam mi 'grub pa'i skabs liṅga dong nang du btings/ slob dpon gyis gser skyems thogs la/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: om̐ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ lan gsum gyis byin brlabs la/ hūm̐: rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud bla ma dam pa dang : bde gshegs zhi khro rab 'byams dkyil 'khor lha: khyad par skabs gang yin pa'i lha mtshan kha bsgyur la lha tshogs rnams:

gser skyems 'di bzhes rnal 'byor mthu dpung skyed: ma mgon lcam dral dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs: dregs pa'i sde dpon sum cu yab yum sras: bka' gnyan bran g.yog mngag gzhug bcas rnams kyis: gser skyems 'di bzhes rnal 'byor mthu dpung skyed: sngags 'chang bdag gi rigs kyi srung ma dang : sa phyogs 'di yi yul gzhi gnas kyi bdag: lo zla zhag dus tshes la dbang ba'i lha: gser skyems 'di bzhes rnal 'byor mthu dpung skyed: ces pa'i tshig mtshams gsum la gser skyems phul/ 'dir khro bo'i rigs la de'i nga rgyal bzung des 'thus/ zhi ba'i rigs la khro bo'i nga rgyal bzung dgos pas gu ru zhi ba la artsig brjod de bla ma drag po dang thugs rje chen po la rta sngags kyis rta mgrin gsal gdab sogs 'gres sbyar la/ om̐ badzra kro dha ghṛ wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭḥ phaṭḥ e yaṃ raṃ dzwa la raṃ/ mdun du las kyi gshin rje kha tham nag po sa rim pa dgu'i bdag po nag la 'jigs shing srog la rngam tshul can/ 'chi bdag kha shin tu gdangs pa'i nang du na nag po yongs su gyur pa las dug gi rus sbal nag po khang sgrom gyi dbyibs can/ de'i dbus su tri nag po las dam sri pho mo mdog mi sdug cing sngo la ham pa mya ngan gyi gzugs can rid cing nyam thag pa'i gzugs can du gyur/ na mo/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bka' bden pa dang*/ chos nyid rnam par dag pa'i bden pa dang*/ chos can rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa'i? khyad par skabs gang yin pa'i lha mtshan sbyar la/ lha tshogs rnams kyi bden pa dang*/ sprul pa yang sprul phyag brnyan dang bcas pa rnams kyi? bden pa chen po'i byin rlabs kyi dngos grub la bar du gcod pa'i ya ma dam sri mtshan ma rdzas kyi rten 'di la mchis par gyur cig tri yaṃ dzaḥtri badzra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ lan gsum gyis 'gugs gzhug byas la/

de nas thun brdeg cing mnan pa ni/ hūm̐: sa 'og gshin rje'i grong khyer nas: 'chi bdag kha tham nag po bzhengs: nad rlangs dug gzer 'phro zhing bzhengs: za byed gdug pa'i khro zhal gdongs: 'joms byed rno ba'i sgrol mche gtsigs: 'jib byed g.yo ba'i dbal lce rkyongs: snyob byed 'chi bdag lag pa rkyongs: dam nyams dgra bo las ngan dang : sgrub la bar gcod dam sri'i rigs: sgab 'dre yul 'dre rgyal 'gong dang : gson 'dre pho mo shi 'dre'i rigs: grib can la sogs gnod byed rnams: 'chi bdag gnod sbyin khyod la gtad: deng bzung bskal pa ma stong bar: ma shor zungs shig lag ma shor: gal te shor ram btang srid na: bdag nyid gtum drag he ru kas: srid gsum bshig cing stong gsum 'gul: mthu chen drag rtsal rdul du brlag: de bas byang chub mchis kyi bar: gtad do ma shor phrin las mdzod: om̐ tsaṇḍa he ru ka ya ma rā dza kha thaṃ kha thaṃ: dam sri 'byung po waka thaṃ spur thaṃ nan: 'og gi 'don tshig dang bstun te skyer phur sor bzhi pa gdab/ thun rdzas brab/ gu gul bdug /dur rdo la ri rab gling bzhi dang rgya gram bris pas mnan la/ hūm̐: dam sri bya ba'i las ngan 'dis: rdo rje slob dpon sku la bsdos: mched lcam rnams la gnod cing bskyal: rgyal khams kun tu mi dge btang : gsang sngags lam gyi sgo yang bkag: bka' 'das nam yang ma btang bas: da ni khro bo'i phur tshogs gdab: thun tshogs gdab ste dud tshogs gtibs: gtub cing srin po'i zhal du bstab: ri rab brjid pa'i 'og tu mnan: zhes mthar 'bebs ring 'og tu sa chu me rlung rim pa bcu gsum re dang sātstsha nag pos mnan/ hūm̐: gcig ni brjod med nyag gcig rgya: gnyis pa thabs dang shes rab rgya: gsum pa sku gsung thugs kyi rgya: bzhi pa phyag rgya bzhi yi rgya: lnga pa ye shes lnga yi rgya: drug pa pha rol phyin drug rgya: bdun pa yan lag bdun gyi rgya:

brgyad pa rnam thar brgyad kyi rgya: dgu pa theg pa rim dgu'i rgya: bcu pa khro rgyal bcu yi rgya: khyod la rgya bcu bcings te gdab: ri rab brjid pas steng nas mnan: dpa' bo'i bro ra byas te brdungs: bskal pa bye snyed mtha' ru mnan: om̐ laṃ hūm̐ laṃ satwaṃ bha ya nan: 'byung bzhi ri rab dang bcas pa'i steng du khro rgyal 'khor bcas bzhugs par bsams la/ mched lcam rnams srin lag lu gu rgyud du sbrel te las byang so sor 'byung ba'i bro brdung hūm̐ bzhi'i sngags brjod do/ de nas sgo byang gdags pa phyi nang gnyis ni/ phyi'i sgo gong du ra sog gam ro ras la sogs par dbang chen rta mgrin yab yum la/ bya khyung sde lngas bskor ba snying po 'dod gsol bris pa dang skyer phur la snying po bris te rgyab tu btags pa bkod/ dmar gtor dang mchod yon sogs bshams la/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: om̐ āḥhūm̐: om̐ badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍ bsang swa bhā wa sa sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che'i snod du gtor mchod rnams phun sum tshogs pa'i dngos por gyur: om̐ āḥhūm̐: sgrub khang pho brang chen po'i ya them phyi rol du hrīḥlas rta mgrin dbyug pa dang thod khrag 'dzin pa/ sgo'i nang logs su hūm̐ las khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil pa ljang gu/ g.yas rdo rje rgya gram dang g.yon sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ gnyis ka'ang 'bar ba'i khro bo nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi brjid can khro bo'i rgyan cha lugs dang ldan pa'i spyi bor om̐: mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐: de las 'od zer 'phros ye shes pa spyan drangs badzra sa mā ya dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ slar yang thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros dbang lha spyan drangs bdud rtsi'i dbang bskur so so'i rigs bdag gis dbu brgyan par gyur/ om̐ badzra kro dha hya ghṛ wa a mṛ ta kunḍa li bha lingta kha kha khā hi khā hi: puṣpe?

sogs shabda āḥhūm̐: gis mchod/ de nas gtor ma phul zhing phrin las bcol ba ni/ hūm̐: sum cu rtsa gsum dga' ldan lha yul nas: bcom ldan che mchog lha yi bka' stsal ltar: deng 'dir sgrub pa'i mchog la nges bzhugs kyi: dngos grub rgya mtsho bdag gis ma thob par: khro chen 'jigs byed dpal chen rta mgrin gyis: sgrub la bar chad byed pa'i bgegs srungs shig: om̐ badzra kro dha hya ghṛ wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭḥ nyer gcig gam brgya rtsa bzlas/ hūm̐: khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil ba yis: bar chad byed pa'i bgegs srungs shig: sprul pa'i 'od zer dgra bgegs 'dul: dngos grub bdud rtsi rgya mtsho 'khyil: bgegs kyi sbyor ba rgyun chod cig: om̐ a mṛ ta kunḍa li tshindha tshindha dam sri ma rā ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces sngags bzhin bzlas mthar/ bdag cag dpon slob rnams kyi sgrub pa 'di nyid dbu btsugs nas ma rdzogs kyi bar du phyi yi bar chad nang du ma btang zhig: nang gi dngos grub phyi ru ma btang zhig: sgrub pa'i phrin las myur du stsol mdzod cig: ces 'dod don gsol slar yang*/ 'dir ni gzugs dang sogs kyis brtan bzhugs bya/ sgo 'di'i yan chad su yang ma 'da' zhig: ces brjod/ ye dharmā? bdag cag byang chub sgrub? bgegs rigs stong phrag? sogs/ mtshams kyi mgo mjug kun tu sgrub pa la bar chad med cing bkra shis pa'i phyir/ bkra shis brjod pa gal che bar gsungs/ de nas bzung ste phyi nang gi rgyu 'grul bcad de rang gis mi sogs gzhan mthong na mtshams bug pa dang*/ gzhan gyis rang mthong na ral ba yin pas dmigs 'og tu ma chud pa dang mi 'phrad par bya zhing chas ka'i gtong len cing mi byed/ cis kyang dgos na srung 'khor drag tu bsgom dngos chas gtong len sogs kyi rkyen nyams grib sbyang phyir rdor sems sme brtsegs lta bu'i khrus bum bsgrubs te 'thor 'thung bya/ dngos gzhi ni phyi thun dbang gi dus su mgo 'dzugs dgos pa yin pas de la lo dang por sngon 'gro'i skabs kun slong bcos pa nas bzung blo sbyong zhag brgya dang*/

nang gi sngon 'gro 'bum lnga bsags sbyang gi rim pa rnams grub nas lo rim gnyis pa bsnyen pa'i dngos gzhi skabs gong ltar sgrub thabs gang yin gyi gzhung bsrangs te tshogs skong nas bsdu ldang bkra shis bar snga ma ltar dang*/ tho gsol grub nas gtor ma phul la rab gnas bya bkra shis mdor bsdus brjod/ slar dgong mo srod thun gyi skabs thun mtshams lha yi nga rgyal dang ldan pas/ rang nyid skad cig gi rdo rje he ru ka khro gtum bzod par dka' ba'i skur gyur/ de nas bgegs gtor bsang sbyang*/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐/ oṃ swa bhā wa sa sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las/ bhrūm̐ las rin po che snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du lan chags bgegs kyi gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs par gyur/ sarba bhighnān na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bhyo?khaṃ ghṛ hna daṃ ba liṃ dye swā hā/ lan gsum gyis bsngos te gzhung gang yin gyis bgegs bskrad/ gu gul bdug /hūm̐ bzhi'i sngags kyis bskrad/ thun gyis brabs shing bgegs gtor phyir bskyal/ nang du logs pa dang sgrub sgo bsdams te gzhung gi mtshams gcod 'don mthar/ steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad rdo rje'i ra ba drwa ba gur bla re ye shes kyi me dpung rab tu 'bar ba'i srung 'khor yangs shing rgya che ba cis kyang mi chod mi shigs par gyur/ oṃ badzra rakṣa rakṣa swā hā/ rang gi thugs srog nas 'od zer me dpung khro chung gi tshwa tshwa grangs med pa 'phros bgegs tshogs rnams bskal pa'i pha mthar bskrad cing*/ 'od zer tshur 'dus pas rdo rje'i srung gur gzhom zhig dang bral ba cis kyang mi shigs pa'i rang bzhin du gsal btab/ 'di mtshams mgo tshugs nas mthar ma phyin bar mi bsdu zhing nyin re'i thun mjug tu dmigs pa gsal tsam byas pa'i mthar/ mi dmigs pa'i ngang la mnyam par 'jog pa gnad yin no/ /de nas bsam gtan stan la bag phebs par 'khod de thog mar kun slong legs par bcos shing dam bca' bzung*/

tshig bdun gsol 'debs nas skyabs sems tshogs bsags rnams rgyun ltar la/ skabs 'dir bgegs bskrad srung 'khor rnams sngar song zin pas mi dgos shing mchod rlob nas bzlas pa'i bar dkyus ltar bya/ bstod pa'i mthar dngos gzhi gtso bo gsal snang dang nga rgyal sbrel ma cung zad bya zhing bzlas pa la 'jug /grub ma thag dbyangs gsal yig brgya rten snying stong tshig gam/ mchod bstod song nas rjes chog nyer bsdus kyi bar grub nas thun mtshams lha skur ldang la bsngo smon bkra shis brjod/ thun mtshams kyi bya ba dang nyal ba'i rnal 'byor rnams rang lugs chos spyod sa brtol ljon bzang ltar shes par bya'o/ sang zhogs thor thun du sngon 'gro rgyun ldan ltar song nas/ dngos gzhi gsol 'debs nas bsnyen pa'i bar srod thun ltar mtshungs la/ snga thun yang de bzhin skyabs sems kyi rjes bgegs gtor byin rlabs bsngo ba rnams dor nas/ srung 'khor mtshams gcod nas brtsams thor thun bzhin shes par bya/ phyi thun gyi mjug bsnyen bstod grub nas gsol kha la 'jug /phrin bcol sogs mthar dbyung nas gzhung gi rjes chog mchod bstod/ nong bshags brtan bzhugs bsdu ldang bsngo smon bkra shis sogs gong ma rnams dang rigs 'gres/ srod thun ni gong zhus ltar ro/ /de ltar thun bzhi dang thun mtshams kyi las bzhi sogs sbrel tshul thun bzhi rnal 'byor dang 'brel ba'i/ rang lugs thun mtshams chos spyod las ji ltar gsal ba bzhin nyams su len par gsol ba 'debs pa lags so/ /de ltar bsnyen pa grub nas sgrub pa la 'jug pa'i skabs dzapa ྄khang dbye ba ni/ brgyud 'debs nas bstod pa'i bar btang*/ bdag mdun 'jug pa gcig bskyed la/ bhrūm̐ bi shwa bi shuddhe hūm̐ phaṭ dzaḥ sa rten par/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā phaṭ dzaḥ sa brten pa'i lha/ bdag nyid rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor las ye shes kyi 'khor lo logs su phyes te mdun gyi nam mkhar me ri 'dab sbyor gyi tshul du bzhugs par

bsam mo/ zhes se gol gtogs pas gsal gdab la bdag mdun dbyer med du dmigs nas dzap bskul dang bsnyen dmigs mthar bsnyen pa khyug tsam bzlas nas sgrub pa gtso bor bzung*/ grangs ni bsnyen pa'i bcu cha bzla bar gsungs so/ de bzhin las sbyor ni so so'i gzhung ltar sbyar la sgrub pa'i bcu cha bzla/ gzhan thun dang sngon rjes rnams bsnyen pa dang phyogs mtshungs so/ /bsnyen sgrub bzlas pa grangs rtags thems nas dngos grub la 'jug pa'i snga rol du sgrub pa sang grol rgyu'i de ring gi dgong thun mjug tu dngos grub kyi rdzas gsar pa bshams la srod thun bzlas pa'i gsham du/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer dmar po lcags kyu lta bu grangs med pa 'phros/ mdun bskyed kyi lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs kar phog pas sngon gyi thugs dam rjes su dgongs te/ sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kyi dngos grub thams cad 'od zer kha dog sna lnga'i rnam pas/ bdag dang sgrub pa'i rdzas la thim pas ye shes mchog gi gzi byin 'bar bar gyur/ bsnyen sgrub sngags gsham du / kā ya wākka tsitta gu na karma sarba siddhi pha la hūm̐ hūm̐: zhes btags pa brgya rtsa tsam bzla/ phyir nangs thor thun la phrin las gzhung bsrangs te/ bzlas pa kha skong mchod bstod bcas grub nas gsol kha khyug tsam btang nas/ skong bshags tshogs mchod bsgral bstab bar gzhung ltar la/ skabs 'dir dngos grub la mi dbang zhing blta nyan gyi bgegs tshar bcad pa'i phyir bgegs bskrad srung 'khor byin 'bebs bcas bya/ de nas ye shes lha la 'khon gcugs bshags phyir gnong 'gyod drag pos ye shes sku mchog ma/ yig brgya bcas song nas dngos grub blang ba dngos la 'jug pa ni/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer dmar po lcags kyu lta bu grangs med pa 'phros/ mdun bskyed lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs kar phog pas thugs dam rjes su dgongs te/ sku'i gnas dang sbyor mtshams nas sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kyi dngos grub rnams kyang byang sems bdud rtsi 'od zer 'bar ba'i rnam par spyan drangs/

bdag la thim pas mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa thob par bsams la/ bsnyen sgrub sngags kyi sham du/ sarba siddhi pha la hūm̐ hūm̐/ zhes btags pa brgya stong bzlas mthar rang gzhung gi dngos grub blang ba'i tshig brjod la/ sgrub rten lhar gsal ba'i gnas rnams nas 'od zer sna lnga rang gi gnas lngar thim pas/ mi zad rgyan 'khor lnga dang thun mchog rigs kyi dngos grub thams cad thob par bsam la/ sgrub rten rnams gnas lngar gtugs shing bdud rtsi myang*/ dngos grub kyi rdzas cha gsum du bgos pa'i phud dang po dkyil 'khor gyi lhar phul/ cha gcig sbyin sreg gi rdzas la bsre/ cha gcig rang gis longs spyod par bya'o/ de nas chad lhag kha skong rtsa sngags kyi bcu cha me mchod bya bar gsungs pa bzhin nyin 'di rang du dbu 'dzugs par mos na/ skabs 'dir rtsa gsum spyi la 'jug pa'i me mchod phrin las bzhi ldan don gnyis dpal ster ltar zhi ba'i sreg blugs rdzas gtso bo til dkar nag dang*/ rtsa bsnyen kho nas bsnyen pa'i bcu cha sogs nyin grangs ci nus su phul/ lhag gtor man chad dkyus ltar bya'o/ /lo gsum tha ma'i skabs yin na 'dir sngar btson 'dzin byas pa'i lhag ma rnams kyang lhan cig tu spungs la phyir gtong*/ chos skyong gtor 'bul skabs su de dag gi gtor ma rnams yang thog lta bur 'bul/ chad brtan la rgyun bzhag phyir bskyang zhing rta bro brdung*/ gtang rag gi mchod bstod rgyas par byas la nongs pa bshags/ mdun bskyed kyi lha ye shes pa rnams ras bris dang dkyil 'khor la brtan bzhugs bya/ dam tshig pa rang la bsdu/ bdag gi rnal 'byor yang 'od gsal du bsdu zhing rgyun spyod go bgo /de nas mtshams dkrol zhing dkyil 'khor bsdu ba ni/ rgyal chen bzhi dang sgo byang gnyis bcas so so'i mdun du dkar dmar dang*/ nyer spyod bcas bsham/ phyi rol tho rtsar phyin te/ mchod pa byin rlob ni/

ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis bsangs la/ om̐ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum/ rnam dag chos dbyings ngang nyid las: rang byung mchod pa'i phung po ni: kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin lta bus: dpag yas nam mkha' gang bar gyur: om̐ badzra arghaṃ pā dyaṃ puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai wi dye shabda āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas mchod pa dang*/ gtor gzhong ratna'i gzhal yas su: gtor ma 'dod yon phung por spungs: om̐ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum rgya dang bcas pas brlab/ om̐ dhriṣṭā rāṣṭā ya ma hā ba lingta khā hi khā hi: om̐ bi ru ḍha kā ya ma hā ba lingta khā hi khā hi: om̐ bi ru pākṣā ya ma hā ba lingta khā hi khā hi: om̐ bai shra ma ṇā ya ma hā ba lingta khā hi khā hi: arghaṃ pā dyaṃ puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai wi dye shabda pra tītstsha swā hāḥ sa mchod/ zab cing rgya chen gzigs pa po/ /yul 'khor srung dang 'phags skyes po/ /spyan mi bzang dang rnam thos sras/ /shar lho nub byang phyogs bzhi yi/ /rgyal chen bzhi la phyag 'tshal bstod/ ces bstod/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ /nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*/ /dpal dang grags dang skal pa bzang*/ /longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing*/ /zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi/ /las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol/ /dam tshig can gyi bdag la srungs/ /dngos grub kun gyi sdong grogs mdzod/ /dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang*/ /gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod/ /rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan/ /bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod/ /'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang*/ /'bru rnams 'phel zhing phyugs 'phel ba/ /bde legs phun sum tshogs pa dang*/ /yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub mdzod/ ces phrin las bcol/ om̐ dhriṣṭā rāṣṭā ya swā hā: om̐ bi ru ḍha kā ya swā hā: om̐ bi ru pākṣā ya swā hā: om̐ bai shra ma ṇā ya swā hā: mthar/ ma rnyed yongs su ma tshang dang*/ /gang yang nus pa ma mchis pas/

/'dir ni bgyi ba gang nongs pa/ /de kun khyed kyis bzod mdzad rigs/ zhes pas nongs pa bshags/ om̐/ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang*/ /slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ badzra muḥ zhes gshegs gsol bya/ de nas sgo byang phyi nang bkrol ba ni/ phyi sgor mchod gtor bshams/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis bsang*/ om̐ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum/ om̐ badzra kro dha hya ghṛ wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭḥ i daṃ ba lingta kha kha khā hi khā hi: lan gsum gyis gtor ma 'bul/ arghaṃ? sogs kyis mchod/ hūm̐: khro rgyal dbang chen he ru kaḥ yab yum sprul pa 'khor dang bcas: gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: dkyil 'khor bya ba mthar yang phyin: bar gyi sgo mtshams phye ru gsol: rtog med chos dbyings ngang la gshegs: bkra shis dge legs mdzad du gsol: badzra muḥ zhes lha gshegs sgo byang bsdu'o/ de nas nang sgor mchod gtor bshams la/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis bsang*/ om̐ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum/ om̐ badzra kro dha a mṛ ta kunḍa li i daṃ ba lingta kha kha khā hi khā hi: lan gsum/ arghaṃ? sogs mchod/ hūm̐: khro rgyal dam tshig bdud rtsi'i mchog: yab yum sprul pa 'khor bcas rnams: gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: de ring dkyil 'khor mthar phyin pas: nang gi srung 'khor bkrol du gsol: dam tshig ye shes dbyings su gshegs: bkra shis dge legs brtan du gsol: om̐ badzra muḥ sa gshegs/ me tog dang gser skyems dang bcas sgo byang bsdu'o/ gnas 'dir nyin mo bde legs mtshan bde legs/ /nyi ma'i gung yang bde legs shing*/ /nyin mtshan rtag tu bde legs pa/ /dkon mchog gsum gyis deng 'dir stsol/ mthar sgrub khang la g.yas su bskor zhing nang du logs la gtang rag 'bul ba sogs dga' ston la longs spyod/ gzhung gi bsngo smon dang bkra shis brjod/ gzhan yang zhal nas gsungs pa'i bkra shis tshigs su bcad pas thog drangs las so sor 'byung ba'i shis brjod rgyas par spel la/

me tog gi char du bsnyil te/ rol mo snyan par 'khrol ba sogs kyis dge legs rgya cher bya'o/ de nas bsdu rim gyi tshe yang*/ srung 'khor nas bsdu zhing rjes chog tshang bar byas te/ nang mtshams grol ba'o/ de nas zhag gsum dang bdun sogs ji rigs su thun ma chag tsam dang*/ tshogs skong bskang gsol sogs gtang rag gi tshul ci nus dang*/ bsngo smon mtshams sbyar la 'bad/ de nas phyi mtshams grol nas kyang chos dang mthun pa'i grogs dam tshig ldan pa re gnyis dang 'phrad la rim gyis gzhan du 'phrad par bya ba las hur rgyugs mi byed/ sngar bsgrubs zin pa rnams rgyun gyi rnal 'byor du bzung*/ tha na yang rtsa gsum gang yang rung ba'i yi dam gcig gtso bor bzung ste gzhan rnams snying po tsam re ma chag par cis kyang bya dgos so/ de ltar dben gnas ri sul dang sgrub pa'i sde rnams su bskyed rdzogs zab mo'i lam la bsten nas rtse gcig tu/ lo gsum phyogs gsum gyi bsnyen sgrub la brtson pa'i e wam̐ sgrub sde zung sogs/ rang la ltos pa'i gang zag gsar bu ba pho mo rnams kyis nyams len la nye bar mkho ba'i ched bskul ngor/ rang lugs bla ma zhi drag gi sgrub pa chen po'i khog dbub la gzhi bcol/ dam pa rnams kyi phyag bzhes mthong rgyun man ngag gis brgyan te/ zur 'gengs cung zad dgos pa rigs mthun gzhan las kyang bsabs te/ bkod pa 'di'ang ris med bstan pa yongs kyi mnga' bdag padma'i rgyal tshab rigs kun khyab bdag /'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po 'jigs med mkhyen brtse'i 'od zer gyi zhabs rdul spyi bor reg pa'i skal bzang nyams su myong yang*/ skyes sbyangs yon tan gyi nar ma son pa'i rgan bu byis pa'i ngang tshul can o rgyan gsang sngags bstan 'dzin nam/ rab btags sgo chen sprul ming du 'bod pas rab byung bcu bdun pa'i chu lug lo dbo zla'i yar tshes thub pa'i grangs ldan nyin sbyar ba'i/

yi ge pa ni lho 'brong rdo shul gyi bande o rgyan gsang sngags 'gro 'dul gyis bgyis shing zhu dag gi mthun 'gyur/ byang 'brong lci yul gyi rnal 'byor pa gsang sngags ye shes rgya mtshos bgyis pa'i dge bas/ 'gro kun gsang sngags rim gnyis zab mo'i shul ring bsnyegs te rnam grol sku bzhi'i grong la 'jug pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ //

kha)༄༅/ /zhi gnas dang lhag mthong sgrub pa'i tshul 'jam mgon bla ma'i zhal gyi bdud rtsi'i nying khu zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /bla ma bcom ldan 'das 'phags pa 'jam dpal dbyangs dang gnyis su med pa 'jigs med mkhyen brtse'i 'od zer ris med bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhabs kyi pad mor btud de sgo gsum gus pa chen pos phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdag gzhan gyi rgyud byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol/ bstan pa'i bdag po ston mchog mnyam med don kun grub/ /ston pas lung bstan gsang sngags ston pa mtsho 'khrungs rgyal/ /bstan pa mkha' mthar brdal mdzad lo paṇa rje 'bangs rnams/ /bka' drin bsam gyin dad pa'i chu gter mtha' ma dpog /thog med dus nas bar med srid mtsho ru/ /dbang med las nyon 'thor rlung gis bdas shing*/ /zad med rnam rtog rlabs kyis dkrugs pa'i sems/ /g.yo med zhi ba'i gnas 'dir ngal gsos shig /de'ang bdag cag ni thog mtha' mi mngon pa zhig nas rnam par rtog pa sna tshogs rlung dang sprin dang rgya mtsho'i rlabs lta bu rnams kyis nyin mtshan bar med par dkrugs shing nyams par byas pa'i dbang du gyur te/ yon tan phul du byung ba ci yang ma thob pa'i steng du sdug bsngal sna tshogs pas nyam thag par gyur pa yin na/ da ni ci nas kyang nang dang phyi'i rgol ba lta bu rnam rtog sna tshogs kyi gzeb las thar bar bya ba'i phyir zhi gnas dang lhag mthong tshul bzhin du bsgom par bya ste/ theg pa gsum po'i 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i yon tan thams cad de gnyis kyis skyed par byed pa yin te/ ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo thams cad zhi lhag zung 'brel gyis bsdus pa'i phyir ro/ /de'ang zhi gnas brtan par ma gyur pa'i lhag mthong ni rlung dang 'grogs pa'i mar me bzhin mi gsal zhing yun ring du mi gnas pas sgrib pa 'joms mi nus la/ lhag mthong gi dpyad pa ji ltar bzang yang srid pa'i rgyu las 'da' mi nus pas/

theg pa mchog dman kun tu zhi lhag zung 'brel kho na gal che bar gsungs pa'i don/ zhi gnas kyi stobs kyis rlung sems mi g.yo bar byed cing*/ lhag mthong khyad par can gyis rmongs pa'i sgrib pa 'jig tshogs la lta ba sogs drungs nas 'byin par byed pas so/ /yang zhi gnas la ting 'dzin dang lhag mthong la shes rab kyang brjod de/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i mdo las/ nyan thos rnams kyis ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs mi mthong ste/ ting 'dzin shas che ba'i phyir dang*/ shes rab shas chung ba'i phyir ro/ /yang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis mthong mod kyi mi gsal te/ shes rab shas che la ting 'dzin shas chung ba'i phyir/ de bzhin gshegs pas ni gzigs te/ zhi gnas dang lhag mthong mtshungs par ldan pa'i phyir ro zhes gsungs so/ /de'ang theg pa che chung kun gyi lam stegs kyi yon tan ma lus pa 'byung ba'i gzhi ni/ rgyal sras chen po zhi ba lhas/ zhi gnas rab tu ldan pa'i lhag mthong gis/ /nyon mongs rnam par 'joms par shes byas nas/ /thog mar zhi gnas btsal bya de yang ni/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ zhi lhag zung 'jug sgrub pa la/ sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ sbyor ba zhi gnas kyi sngon 'gro bsam gtan gyi rgyu tshogs sgrub pa dang*/ bsam gtan gyi snod rung du sgrub pa'o/ /dang po/ zhi gnas dang bsam gtan ni ngo bo gcig yin la/ de'i rgyu tshogs bsten pa la'ang*/ lus 'du 'dzis dben pa dang*/ sems rnam rtog gis dben par bya dgos pas/ 'du 'dzi ni/ byis dang sdig pa'i grogs po sogs chags sdang gi yul las rgyang ma bsrings na/ rnyed dang bkur sti sogs la chags zhen gyis sems gnas su mi ster bas/ 'du 'dzi de dang bral ba ni dben pa ste/ mdor na rnam g.yeng thams cad spangs te gcig pur gnas na ting 'dzin rgyud la skye bar gsungs so/ /sems rnam rtog gis dben pa ni/ lus ngag gi mi dge ba dang*/ lung ma bstan gyi bya bas sems kyi nyon mongs pa'i rnam rtog sogs 'jig rten pa'i bya byed 'khrul pa'i rjes su 'brang ba'i rtog pa phra rags rnams ma spangs na mi phan te/

ri dwags rnams rtag tu dben par gnas kyang yon tan khyad par can gang yang mi 'thob pa lta bu'o/ /der brten phyi nang gi dngos po la g.yeng ba med pa'i bsam gtan rtse gcig tu gnas na/ der zhi gnas kyi ting 'dzin rgyud la skye bar 'gyur ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ lus gnad rnam snang chos bdun zhes rkang pa g.yon 'og /g.yas steng du byas pa'i rdo rje skyil krung bca'/ lag gnyis mnyam bzhag lhod cha dang bcas dpung 'go cung gyen du 'then/ sgal tshigs gser gyi dong rtse ltar brtsigs/ ltag rtsa bsrangs te/ mgrin pa'i ol mdud mnan/ mig 'bras mi g.yo zhing rdzi ma thib thib mi byed par sna rtse'i thad kyi bar snang la ce re blta/ mgo bo ya yo med par gzengs bstod cing lus kyi cha thams cad hril gyis grim pa la 'jog dgos te/ de'i rgyu mtshan ni/ lus grong khyer dang 'dra/ rtsa lam srang dang 'dra/ rlung rta rgod dang 'dra/ rnam shes mi zha bo dang 'dra bas byed pa bcing na gsang sgo khegs pa'i mi rta nang du tshud de 'gro mi thub pa dang 'dra/ lus kyi gnad la chun cher yong ba'i thabs byas pas ye shes kyi snang ba gong du 'phel bar 'gyur te/ sngar thub pa'i dbang po byang chub shing drung du ting 'dzin la g.yo ba med par bzhugs pa'i dus shig tu/ spre'u'i khyu chen po zhig lto 'tshol du yong ba dag gis khong mthong nas ring du bros/ yang yang bltas kyang g.yo ba ye med par mthong nas tshur tshur sku gam du yong ste/ thog mar mi yin min tshod bgam pa'i ched du rde'u dang shing bus brdegs kyang g.yo ba ma mdzad pas/ khong rnams bag phebs nas sku pang dang dbu la 'dzegs nas dbu skra btogs/ snyan shal nas 'then pa sogs byas kyang glags ma rnyed pas khong rnams ya mtshan skyes/ mtha' skor dang shing gi yal ga rnams su 'dzegs te sangs rgyas kyi lad mo byas nas rnam snang chos bdun du bsdad pas sangs rgyas kyi mthu dang*/

lus gnad gcun pa'i rten 'brel gyis de rnams kyi rgyud la rtogs pa rnyed cing mthar byang chub thob pa'i lo rgyus bzhin/ rten 'brel lus la bsgrigs na/ rtogs pa sems la 'char ba'i dgos pa yod/ ces mkhas grub dam pa rnams kyis gsungs so/ /lus gnad de lta bu'i ngang rlung ro dgu phrugs su bsal ba la/ dang po sna bug g.yas nas gsum/ g.yon nas gsum/ phrugs gcig tu gsum ste dgu phrugs su bya'o/ /dmigs pa g.yas nas zhe sdang*/ g.yon nas 'dod chags/ dbus nas gti mug gis bsags pa'i las nyon dri ma'i tshogs sangs kyis thon/ bsam gtan gyi snod rung du gyur pa'i mos pa bya/ 'di bcud bzang po ma blugs gong du snod bkru bshal byas pa dang mtshungs gsungs/ skabs 'dir blo sbyong nas gsungs pa'i zhi gnas bskyed pa'i don du rtog pa'i gnyen po phyi nang gi dbugs 'byin 'jug sgom par gsungs pa ltar byas na legs pas/ lus gnad snga ma ltar la cung zad lhod cha bton/ dbugs dal bus phyir 'gro ba dang phyi gnas cung zad bya zhing*/ slar nang du dal bus rngub la nang du'ang ci nus su bzhag rlung phyi nang gcig tu bgrang bar khug pa rer rtsis pa'i grangs nyer gcig sogs thun du bcad la zhag 'ga'i bar du bya'o/ /'di'ang bsam gtan gyi snod du rung ba'i dgos pa yod par gsungs la/ de dag gis sbyor ba'i chos rnams grub bo/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi zhi lhag gnyis las/ dang po/ mthong ba'i chos la bde bar gnas pa'i bsam gtan zhes lus sems shin tu sbyang ba'i zhi gnas sgrub pa la/ thog mar pha ma sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang la 'god par bgyi'o/ /de'i ched du byang chub ma thob kyi bar du dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro'o snyam pa'i ngang nas/ sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la/ /byang chub bar du bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /bdag gis sgom sgrub bgyid pa'i bsod nams kyis/

/'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /ces skyabs su 'gro ba dang byang chub tu sems bskyed pa rnams sngon du song nas lus gnad skyil krung sogs chos bdun snga ma ltar bcas la/ sems gnad rten can la bslab pa dang*/ rten med la bslab pa'o/ /dang po rten can la bslab pa ni/ dmigs pa'i yul gang la sems 'dzin pa de gcig pu las/ mi dge ba dang*/ lung ma bstan par smos ci dgos/ dge ba'i dmigs pa gnyis pa la'ang mi gtad par dmigs yul de kho na la sems cha mnyam par bzhag ste rtse gcig tu brtson par bya ba yin la/ de'ang thog mar de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku mtshan dang dpe byad kyis brgyan pa ri mo mkhan gyis tshad ldan bris pa la/ che chung yang mtho gang ba sogs mig lam la blta bde bar rten 'brel snying pos rab tu gnas par byas la/ de rang gi mdun du ha cang mi nye ha cang mi ring bar mig phab ste blta ba'i spyod yul dang ji ltar 'tshams pa zhig tu bzhag nas der blta zhing sems rtse gcig tu 'dzin par bya ste/ 'phags pa ting 'dzin rgyal po las/ gser gyi kha dog lta bu'i sku lus kyis/ /'jig rten mgon po kun nas mdzes pa ste/ /dmigs pa de la gang gi sems 'jog pa/ /byang chub sems dpa' de mnyam bzhag ces bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ sku'i rnam pa la sems ha cang mi grim/ ha cang mi lhod par dal bu'i tshul gyis dran pa dang shes bzhin ma nyams par/ mig kyang gdang zum ran par bltas la sems rgyun chags par gzung bar bya ste/ gang du dmigs pa de ma yin pa'i rnam rtog thams cad las rang gi sems rgyang bsring la de kho na la 'jog par bya'o/ /gzhan du sems bzhag pa'i thabs dgu bshad pa sogs yod kyang 'dir 'du la/ gal te cung zad spro bar mos na/ yum mdo las sems gnas par byed pa'i thabs dgus 'dod sems rtse gcig pa sgrub par gsungs pa ni/ sems 'jog go mnyam par 'jog go /rgyun du 'jog go

/blan nas 'jog go /nye bar 'jog go /'dul bar byed do/ /zhi bar byed do/ /rnam par zhi bar byed do/ /rtse gcig tu byed do/ /zhes par/ 1 dmigs rten la sems nang du gtad de 'jog pa/ 2 dmigs pa de la rgyun du bar ma chad par 'jog pa/ 3 sems gzhan du 'phro na yang yang nang du bkug ste dmigs pa la blan te 'jog pa/ 4 phyir 'phros na yul du mi 'jog par nye bar nang du dmigs pa la 'jog pa/ 5 sems rgyud rab tu ma zhi ba dul bar byed pa/ 6 rnam rtog gi rba rlabs zhi bar byed pa/ 7 rnam rtog phra mo tsam yang zhi bar byed pa/ 8 rtsol ba chung ngus sems la dmigs pa tha dad med par rtse gcig tu byed pa/ 9 bying rgod bsal nas rtsol ba med par lhun grub tu mnyam par 'jog pa ste dgus ting 'dzin grub na/ lus sems shin sbyangs kyi bde ba 'dren pas khyab la/ shin sbyangs ldan pa'i ting 'dzin grub na 'jig rten lam gyi zhi gnas mtshan nyid par 'dod do/ /zhes so/ /yang rje btsun sgrol ma lta bu'i sku yang rung ste/ rtsa ba rang gi yi dam gang la byas kyang dmigs rten de la 'dzin/ dmigs rten du sku lta bu ma 'byor na'ang rang gi mdun gyi bar snang la sgom pas chog go /gang ltar rten de dag la las dang po pa'i sems 'dzin gzhi tsam yin pas de la gsal mi gsal dang*/ gnas mi gnas sogs re dogs thams cad spangs te bsgom par bya'o/ /de'i tshe sems bying rgod cha mnyam na thugs kar sems gtad la lta stangs mnyam par bzhag bying rmugs 'thibs gsum byung na smin mtshams kyi mdzod spu'am gtsug tor bltar mi mngon pa la sems gtad de lta stangs gyen du gtod/ 'phro rgod che na lte bar thig le sngon po la sems bzung nas lta stangs thur du phab/ thams cad la yid mig rlung gsum chig dril mdung tshugs su gtad cing khab mig tu skud pa 'dzud pa ltar/ rtse gcig pa'i sems gzhan du mi g.yeng bar yun thung la grangs mang bar bya/

yengs na de ma thag tu dran pas bzung la rang mal du bzhag de ltar yang nas yang du gsal gdab la sems bzung*/ zin pa na ma yengs tsam gyi ngang rang babs su glod la ci gnas su bskyang*/ thun mthar mdun gyi dmigs rten sangs rgyas dang byang sems sogs gang bsgoms pa'i lha 'od du zhu nas rang la thim/ rang gi sems bla ma'i thugs dang dbyer med ro mnyam du gyur par mos la mnyam par bzhag go /gnyis pa rten med la bslab pa ni/ lus gnad bca'/ rlung ro bsal/ sems dus gsum du spros pa'i rtog pa bcad de/ sngar byung ba dang byas zin gyi rjes mi gcod/ ma 'ongs par 'di bya 'di 'byung gi mdun mi bsu/ da lta'i shes pa la dgag sgrub gang yang mi byed par ma yengs pa'i ngang du rig pa dwangs seng nger bzhag bying rgod byung na lta stangs sogs gong ltar 'gre/ gsal dwangs lhan ner gnas pa'i tshe 'phro bcad la/ slar mnyam par bzhag pa yang yang bya zhing sgom gyis sna mi sun par bya/ yang mig yul du gzugs/ rna bar sgra/ sna la dri/ lce la ro/ lus la reg bya sogs tshogs drug gi rtog pa shar na'ang de ka'i thog tu sems 'dzin gyi rten byas la bzhag 'phro rgod che bas sun par byung na nang du bkugs te/ gcun pa ltar mi byed par gang 'gyu 'gyu ru bcug nas de thog bskyang*/ thog mar grim lhod spel/ cung zad goms na grim drags pa dang lhod drags pa'i skyon dang bral ba'i grim lhod ran pa la bslab par bya ste/ mdor na rje btsun brtan pa'i 'khor lo 'jam dpal dgyes pa'i gros 'debs zhal gdams 'di ltar bdog go /legs par soms dang blo ldan skal bzang tshogs rnams/ /byas byas zin med g.yo ba chu yi ri mo/ /smras smras dgos pa med pa'i dar lce rlung bskyod/ /bsam bsam 'bras bu med pa'i bar snang bser bu/ /'di dang 'di'i ngang yang dang yang 'phyan 'di 'dra/ /thog mtha' med par gyur kyang sdug bsngal 'khor lo/

/sha thang chad chad bskor las ci yang mi 'dug /de phyir gtan bde zhi ba'i 'dun ma sgrub dus/ /las dang smra ba spros pa'i nyes pa soms la/ /thams cad thams cad chabs cig rbad kyis bskyur nas/ /ma rnyogs yid kyi rdzing bur dran pa'i shes rab/ /rgyun chags bskor bar gyis la ting 'dzin sgoms shig /thog med ngan goms bag chags shog dril 'dra bas/ /thog mar rtse gcig bsgrims shing bsgrim pa'i rtsol ba/ /cis kyang bar ma chad pa'i zhe rus med na/ /rnam rtog langs shor thul ba'i dus tshod mi gda'/ /cung zad goms shing goms bzhin gong nas gong du/ /'du 'dzi'i rnam g.yeng bcad de ting 'dzin nor bu/ /nam zhig rnyed snyam spro bas rgyun chags 'bad na/ /zhi gnas yid kyi chu ngogs je bas je nye/ /dben par lo mang sgom lo sgrub lo byas kyang*/ /mi srun sems kyi glang po yan par btang na/ /brgya phrag lo zla 'das kyang bzang skyed med la/ /ci byas 'bras bu mi mthong yi chad rgyu yin/ /dpung tshogs bzhi ldan 'jigs rung g.yul gyi ngo las/ /gcig pus rgyal ba gang de dpa' bor grags kyang*/ /rtog pa'i dgra 'dis de dag bran bzhin byas slad/ /'di ga chom na yang dag dpa' bor bsngags 'os/ /dus kyi rlung dang rgya mtsho chen po'i rba rlabs/ /ji bzhin bzlog par dka' ba'i ngang tshul ngoms pa/ /rang sems kun rtog gya gyu'i sgyu can 'di ga /'dul thabs mi mkhas pa la 'jigs 'jigs 'dra yang*/ /zhe dam brtan pos lo nas lo ru brtson na/ /dngos po stobs med ngan goms tsam gyi khong shed/ /rang gis rang tshod rang mtshang nang nas rig dus/ /spro ba'i rang nyams mi rnyed rang dbang mi gda'/ /gang zhig thul na rgud pa'i phyogs kun thul ba/ /dul ba'i bde gnas thob tshe yon tan kun rten/ /'di 'dra'i don chen btang nas don med bya bas/ /rang mgo bskor rnams kye ma rmongs pas bslus so/ /gal te dga' ba'i yid kyis g.yeng bar gyur na/

/don chen gnas las bslu bar rtogs nas spongs shig /sdug bsngal nyon mongs brgya yis rang rgyud mnar tshe/ /de yis des rkyen byas lhag par brtson pa skyed cig /bgyi bar 'os pa kun gyi rtse mor gyur pa/ /rang sems 'dul ba'i thabs 'di kho nar shes nas/ /rten bzang ma dor ring la 'di 'dra'i brtson pa/ /ji ltar mi bskyed snyam du zhe dam chos shig /lag par nor bu thogs pas 'dod rgu 'byin dang*/ /gshog zung rgyas pas gang 'dod mkha' la 'phur ltar/ /zhi gnas grub na mdo sngags lam gyi nyams len/ /gang 'dod ci dgar zhugs pas don chen 'grub bo/ /kun rtog rims nad byang ba'i rang sems gzhon nu/ /rang dbang bde ba'i lang tsho mchog tu dar tshe/ /gnas skabs zhi sogs rab 'byams las kyi tshogs dang*/ /mthar thug bde ba'i smin legs grogs su khug yong*/ /'dod 'dod mang ste thob thob nyung bar 'dug gi /bsgrim brtson lhag par skyed cig snying gi bu rnams/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin nyams len la brtson par bya'o/ /de ltar brtson pa las gnas pa'i nyams gsum mam/ nyams lnga rim gyis 'char bar 'gyur la/ 1 de'ang sems 'dzin pa na thog ma nyid du sbrul la bzung ba ltar/ shin tu mi srun zhing rgod pa'i rnam pa can du gyur tshe nyams dang po ri gzar gyi 'bab chu lta bu g.yo ba'i nyams zhes bya ste/ dpung bzang gis zhus pa las/ sems ni glog dang rlung dang sprin dang 'dra/ /rgya mtsho chen po yi ni rlabs dang mtshungs/ /sgyu can 'dod rgur yul la mngon dga' ba/ /g.yo zhing 'phyan pas nges par gdul bar bya/ /zhes gsungs pa'i tshul dang mthun par 'byung yang de tshe 'di snyam du sems te/ brtson pa bskyed na mi 'grub pa gang yang med do snyam du sems bskyed nas yun ring por dmigs pa la ji gnas su brtson par bya'o/ / 2 de ltar brtson pas re zhig na sngar gyi rnam rtog che zhing rags pa rgod cing dbal tsha ba rnams cung zhi yang*/

rnam rtog sna tshogs kyis brel te mang po lang long du 'khrigs pa rgyun du yod pa'i skabs der nyams gnyis pa rong khung dog mo'i chu lta bu thob pa'i nyams zhes bya ste/ rong khung dog mo'i chu de brel ba dang sgra che'ang ri gzar gyi 'bab chu las cung dal ba la dper byas pa'o/ / 3 da dung brtson pa ma btang bar sngar gyi mu la gnas nas sems kyi rtog pa khong dal zhing dmigs pa la gnas pa lta bu 'byung yang*/ zhib tu brtag na rnam rtog phra ba mang po rgyun chags su 'jug pa yod pa ni/ nyams gsum pa chu klung dal gyis 'babs pa lta bu goms pa'i nyams zhes bya ste/ rgyang nas bltas na chu de lhun chags shing 'gro ba mi mngon yang*/ drung du song na cung zad mi sdod par 'gro zhing g.yo ba de lta bu 'byung ngo*/ /4 de phan chad brtson pa ma btang bar 'bad na sngar tsam dka' tshegs dang gdung ba cher mi 'byung bas shin tu'ang brtson pa rgyun chags par bya'o/ /de ltar byas pas rnam rtog phra mos g.yo ba'ang zhi ste dmigs pa la 'du byed pa dang bcas na ji srid du gnas nus kyang*/ rkyen cis kyang g.yo mi nus pa ni ma yin pa de/ nyams bzhi pa rgya mtsho rlabs dang bral ba lta bu brtan pa'i nyams zhes bya ste/ sems gnas shing brtan pa'i phyir ro/ / 5 de thob nas de'i ngang la yun du goms par byas na nyams lnga pa 'dod sems rtse gcig pa mthar phyin pa ri bo lta bu'i nyams zhes bya ste/ de ni rtsol ba med pa'i 'du byed dang don gnad gcig pa yin zhing*/ dmigs pa gang la gtad pa de la sems ngang gis 'dres shing rtsol ba mi dgos par lhan ner ji 'dod du gnas pa la rnam rtog gis g.yo mi nus pa 'byung ste/ 'dod pa'i sems rtse gcig pa zhes bya ba de grub pa yin no/ /skabs der sems gnas pa las byung ba'i nyams sna tshogs kyang 'byung ngo*/ /de'i ngang du goms par byas na sems dang lus shin tu sbyangs pa zhes bya ba lus dang sems las su rung nas dmigs pa gang dang gang du 'jog pa de la zhag du mar gnas par byas na yang*/

lus kyis mi lcogs pa dang*/ sems kyis mi lcogs pa gang yang med par lus shing bal ltar yang ba dang*/ sems mngon par dwangs pa'i bde bas khyab pa zhig 'byung ste/ shin sbyangs de'ang dang por rags pas lci zhing brtan pa'i tshul can dang*/ de nas goms pas snga ma de zad de grib ma ltar shin tu srab cing dwangs pas zhi gnas mi g.yo ba bsam gtan gyi sems gzhi dang rjes su mthun pa 'byung la/ de lta bu'i sgom pa la ni zhi gnas zhes bya ba'i ming 'thob ste/ shin tu sbyangs pa dang ldan pa'i sems yin pa'i phyir ro/ /'di ni bsam gtan dang po'i nyer bsdogs mi lcogs med ces bya ba'i char yang gtogs pa yin no/ /'dis mtshan ma'i dmigs pa dang mtshan med stong pa nyid sogs ci bsgoms kyang go mi chod pa med do/ /de la zhi gnas sgrub pa'i yan lag yid byed bzhi dang stobs drug la sogs pa'i rnam grangs mang du yod kyang*/ don du sems ci gnas su dmigs pa la dran pa dang shes bzhin gyis rab tu bzung ste goms par byas pa las nyams lnga skye bas der 'du'o/ /de lta bu'i zhi gnas grub pa'i tshe na sems las su rung ba'i stobs kyis lus zo mdog bzang zhing bde la stobs dang ldan pa dang*/ sems gsal zhing dwangs pas spyod yul ci rigs la 'jug pa dang*/ lus sems la dga' bde tshad med pa'i rlan gyis khyab par yang 'gyur la/ nyon mongs pa chung zhing nang gi dben pa'i dga' ba khyad par can dang rjes su mthun pa nyams su myong bar 'gyur ro/ /der zhi gnas de lta bus sangs rgyas kyi sku la dmigs pas bsod nams kyi stobs dang sangs rgyas kyi byin gyis brlabs kyis dngos sam/ rmi lam du'ang sangs rgyas mthong zhing chos thos pa sogs yon tan gyi rnam pa sna tshogs pa rang gi rgyud la skyed par byed do/ /de ltar zhi gnas mtshan nyid pa rgyud la skyes na ting nge 'dzin dang lhag mthong sogs yon tan thams cad kyi rtsa ba tshugs pa yin no/

/de ltar zhi gnas grub pa na lhag mthong gi rnal 'byor la 'jug par bya ste/ de ci lta bu zhe na/ dang po zhi gnas sgrub pa'i skabs su sangs rgyas kyi sku ri mor bris pa de nyid dmigs rten du byas pa la sems bzhag pa dang*/ dmigs rten med kyang yid yul du 'char ba la sems bzhag pa sogs ci 'dod du byas pa'i mthar zhi gnas grub pa'i dus su rten med par yang rang gi sems kyi yul du sangs rgyas kyi sku gzugs legs par gsal snang gi tshul du ting 'dzin gyis mtshan ma'i gzugs snang bar 'gyur te/ de'ang dang po yid yul du me long la gzugs brnyan ltar lhang nge lhan ner gsal zhing*/ de la cher goms pas rang gi dbang po'i yul du'ang mngon sum lta bur gsal bar 'gyur la/ da dung goms na gzhan pa dag gi dbang po'i yul du'ang rang gis ji ltar dmigs pa'i snang ba de nyid mthong nus par 'gyur te/ dper na rgan mos rang lus stag mor bsgoms pas gzhan gyis stag dngos su mthong ba lta bu'o/ /gsal ba dang po yid kyi yul dang*/ gnyis pa dbang po'i yul dang*/ gsum pa reg pa'i yul du snang ba zhes snga 'gyur ba'i bsnyen sgrub kyi yig cha rnams su gsungs pa bzhin no/ /de'i nang gi gsal ba dang po tsam zhig grub pa'i dus nas kyang lhag mthong la 'jug par bya'o/ /lhag mthong gi ngo bo ni/ mdo dgongs pa nges 'grel las/ bcom ldan 'das du zhig zhi gnas kyi dmigs pa lags/ bka' bstsal pa/ gcig ste rnam par mi rtog pa'i gzugs brnyan no/ /du zhig lhag mthong gi dmigs pa lags/ bka' bstsal pa/ gcig ste rnam par rtog pa dang bcas pa'i gzugs brnyan no/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ 'dir bsgom par bya ba'i shes rab lhag mthong gi ye shes skyed par byed pa la/ dpyod pa'i shes rab kyis gtan la 'bebs pa dang*/ gnas lugs kyi ngang du 'jog pa'o/ /dang po ni/ 'di ltar rang gi yid kyi yul du sangs rgyas kyi sku mtshan dang dpe byad ldan pa mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba lhang nge lhan ner mngon sum lta bur gyur pa/

'di'ang rang gi sems la goms pa'i bag chags kyi snang ba tsam ste/ gang nas kyang ma 'ongs/ gang du'ang mi 'gro/ brtags na dben pa/ phyi dang nang gang du'ang mi rnyed pa/ sems la rag las shing goms pa'i rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba tsam las rab tu snang ba ste/ 'di gang la snang ba'i sems de yang brtags na phyi dang nang gang du'ang mi rnyed de/ gzhi dang rtsa ba bral ba yin pas na de la snang ba 'di lta ci smos/ des na snang ba 'di la ngo bo nyid cung zad kyang med de/ ye shes snang ba rgyan gyi mdo las/ de bzhin gshegs pa zad med dge ba yis/ /chos kyi gzugs brnyan yin te 'di la ni/ /de bzhin nyid med de bzhin gshegs pa'ang med/ /'jig rten kun na gzugs brnyan kun tu snang*/ /zhes dang*/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems kyis brtags pa yin/ /sems kyang rnam dag rang bzhin 'od gsal zhing*/ /rnyogs med 'gro ba kun dang ma 'dres par/ /gang gis shes pa byang chub mchog 'tshang rgya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar shes rab kyis brtags shing shes par byas nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa ji lta ba de bzhin du phung po dang khams dang skye mched kyis bsdus pa'i snang zhing srid pa'i chos thams cad kyang*/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i dbang gis 'jig rten na 'di ltar snang zhing nyams su myong ba yod mod kyi/ de thams cad rang rang gi rgyu rkyen rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i dbang gis snang ba tsam ma gtogs par/ de la legs par brtags na chos gang dang gang yang rang gi ngo bo nyid kyis rdul phra rab tsam yang rnyed par mi 'gyur te/ dper na sgyu ma'i snang ba dang rmi lam gyi snang ba la sogs pa'i spyod yul bzhin du don la 'gro 'ong dang skye 'gag la sogs pa ci'ang med mod kyi/ ji ltar snang ba la snang ba ltar du zhen cing so sor brtag pa spangs pa'i byis pa so so'i skye bo rnams kyis skye ba dang 'gag pa la sogs pa yod par 'dzin pa ni/

rab rib can gyis skra shad kyi snang ba la de bsal ba'i 'du shes byed pa ltar/ thog ma med pa nas ma rig pa'i rab rib kyis sems bslad pa rnams kyis yang dag pa'i gnas lugs mi shes pa'i phyir ro/ /yang dag pa'i gnas lugs rtogs pa rnams kyi ngor ni/ snang ba 'di rnams med dgos pa ma yin te/ snang ba 'di nyid snang bzhin du cir yang ma grub par mthong nas chos de dag rang gi ngo bo gdod nas ma skyes par rtogs pa yin te/ rgyal ba'i yum las/ chos thams cad ni sgyu ma dang rmi lam lta bu/ mya ngan las 'das pa'ang sgyu ma dang rmi lam lta bu/ gal te mya ngan 'das pa las lhag pa'i chos shig yod na de'ang sgyu ma dang rmi lam lta bu'o/ /zhes dang*/ mdo ting 'dzin rgyal po las/ ji ltar smig sgyu dri za'i grong khyer dang*/ /sgyu ma ji bzhin rmi lam ji lta bur/ /mtshan ma sgom pa ngo bo nyid kyis stong*/ /chos rnams thams cad de bzhin shes par gyis/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar sgyu ma sogs sangs rgyas kyi sku yid ngor de ltar snang yang don la de'i ngo bo nyid du dmigs par bya ba thams cad ye nas med pa ltar/ chos thams cad kyang de dang 'dra la/ bdag kyang de dang 'dra ste/ bdag gi rang bzhin gang yin pa de ni sangs rgyas kyi rang bzhin no/ /sangs rgyas kyi rang bzhin gang yin pa de'ang chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin te/ sdud pa las/ bdag ji 'dra ba de 'drar sems can thams cad shes/ /sems can thams cad ci 'dra de 'drar chos kun shes/ /skye ba med dang skye ba gnyis kar mi rtog pa/ /'di ni shes rab pha rol phyin mchog spyod pa yin/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa gnas lugs kyi ngang du 'jog pa ni/ lhag mthong zhes bya ba'ang rtog pa mi 'gog par gang shar ba de ngo shes pa tsam gyi thog tu 'jog pa yin la/ de las lhag pa'i sgom zhig logs su med de/ karma pa rang byung rdo rjes kyang*/ bltar med sems la yang yang bltas pa'i tshe/

/mthong med don ni ji bzhin lhag ger mthong*/ /yin min don la the tshom med pa yi/ /zhes pa ltar rnam rtog gang shar ba de la cer re bltas pas/ rang grol du stong phyam gyis 'gro ba la blta bya dang lta byed gnyis su med kyang de nyid ngo shes pa tsam byas nas 'jog pa yin la/ dper na rkun ma ngo shes na ma bskrad kyang rang log tu 'gro ba ltar ro/ /mdor na gang bsgom par bya ba'i dge ba'i dmigs pa de la sems rtse gcig tu 'jog pa ni zhi gnas dang*/ de la ma zhen pa ni lhag mthong ste zhi lhag zung 'jug yin la/ 'dir spros pa dang bral lo zhes pa sogs rtog dpyod cig med na so sor rtog pa'i shes rab dang bral bas de 'dra'i lhag mthong gi cha de 'dor mi rung snyam du rnam shes kyi spyod yul tsam kho na la blo rtse gtod par mi bya ste/ ting 'dzin rgyal po las/ yod dang med ces bya ba gnyis ka mtha'/ /gtsang dang mi gtsang 'di yang mtha' yin te/ /de phyir gnyis ka'i mtha' ni rnam spangs nas/ /mkhas pas dbus la'ang gnas par yong mi byed/ /ces so/ /der mthar thug zhi gnas kyi sems rtse gcig pa dang rang bzhin yongs shes kyi lhag mthong ste/ zhi lhag zung 'jug gi don la ji ltar mnyam par 'jog pa'i tshul yang rje btsun 'jam dpal rdo rjes/ mi dran dgu dran mi 'gyu dgu 'gyu 'di gar/ /ma thul lam gyi yon tan rgya cher mi 'byung*/ /bzung na sbrul gdug gtses 'dra je bas je rtsub/ /de phyir sems kyi gshis su rang babs lhod nas/ /ci yang yid la ma byed phyam gyis skyur thong*/ /chu rnyogs mi bsgul 'jog pa'i thabs yin e go /dang por gnas cha bzang po skye ba'i thabs su/ /sgo lnga yid shes ma phyed cham mer skyur thong*/ /yul dang yul can 'jog pa'i thabs yin e go /'das dang ma 'ongs ma phyed cham mer skyur thong*/ /bde ba sdug bsngal 'jog pa'i thabs yin e go /zhi gnas lhag mthong ma phyed cham mer skyur thong*/

/blang bya dor bya 'jog pa'i thabs yin e go /kun gzhi chos sku ma phyed cham mer skyur thong*/ /rnam shes ye shes 'jog pa'i thabs yin e go /rtog dpyod ci yang ma byed cham mer skyur thong*/ /sgo lnga'i shes pa ma bkag ha rer skyur thong*/ /lus dang shes pa ma bsgul cog ger skyur thong*/ /ci byas gang byung ma blta rang bab skyur thong*/ /byung tshor ched du ma bkag rtsis med skyur thong*/ /rtog med rtsol bas ma bsgrubs rang babs zhog thong*/ /gnas par ched 'dzin mi gzhag gang dgar skyur thong*/ /'gyu ba rjes 'thung ma byed rjes med skyur thong*/ /mkha' la pra yas song na dga' ba lags te/ /dmigs bsam ched 'dzin ngo thag rtsad nas bcad tshe/ /ma bzung rang gar bskyur ba'i shes pa kho rang*/ /bzo bcos dran bsam med par lhug par zhog thong*/ /bya byed 'khris thag chod pa'i rang babs gshis 'di/ /gsal le me re ye re ba zhig 'dug gi /sems med mun pa'i go skabs gtan nas mi gda'/ /'di'i ngang 'di'i ngang bzhag na kun rtog thams cad/ /je dwangs je dwangs zhi gnas ngang gis skye bas/ /'di nyid kho na sems gnas man ngag dam pa/ /gal te rtsol bas dmigs pa 'ba' zhig sgom yang*/ /skabs su ngal gso'i tshul gyis 'di 'dra spel na/ zhi gnas bskyed pa'i thabs su ches cher bzang ngo*/ /gnas pa'i ngang na gnas bya'i rig pa de nyid/ /zang thal bden med kho thag nang nas chod pas/ /ye nas skye med 'gag med mnyam nyid ngang du/ /gnas dang mi gnas bsam brjod blo dang bral na/ /gnyug ma chos sku'i rang zhal rjen par der mthong*/ /'di bas sla ba ci yang med la/ /'di bas don chen gang yang mi 'dug /'di bas bde ba'i lam mchog mi gda'/ /'di nyid kho na bde myur grol lam/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar nyams su blang skabs/ rlung ro bsal/ lus gnad rnam snang chos bdun bca'/ sngar gyi bde gsal mi rtog pa la sogs pa'i mtshan nyid de'i steng*/

yod med yin min blang dor 'dzin stangs thams cad cham gyis skyur la gang la'ang mi rtog ci la'ang mi bsam par/ spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba'i gnas lugs blo yis bzo ma 'chos par rang babs nam mkha' lta bur bskyangs pa ni lhag mthong gi khrid rim ste/ smra bsam brjod med shes rab pha rol phyin/ /ma skyes mi 'gag nam mkha'i ngo bo nyid/ /ces bya ba'i don te/ mnyam bzhag dang rjes thob kyi skabs su snang ba thams cad sgyu ma dang rmi lam ltar blta zhing*/ gnas lugs ma rtogs pa'i sems can la snying rje bsgom par bya la/ de'ang sa ra has/ snying rje dang bral stong pa nyid zhugs gang*/ /de ni lam mchog rnyed pa ma yin no/ /gal te snying rje 'ba' zhig bsgom na yang*/ /'khor ba 'dir gnas thar pa thob mi 'gyur/ /gang la gnyis po sbyor bar nus pa des/ /'khor bar mi gnas mya ngan 'das mi gnas/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin nyams su blang bar bya'au/ /de ltar bsgoms pa'i phan yon yang tshad med de/ de kho na nyid bstan pa'i mdo las/ shā ri'i bu/ gang gis bskal pa gcig gi bar nyan pa las/ gang gis se gol gyi yun la de kho na nyid sgom pa bsod nams che'o/ /shā ri'i bu/ de lta bas na de kho na nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin gzhan la nan gyis gdams par bya'o/ /zhes dang*/ gtsug tor chen mo'i mdor/ bskal pa mang por thos bsam byas pa bas/ nyin gcig la chos nyid kyi don sgom pa bsod nams che'o/ /ci'i phyir zhe na/ des ni skye shi ring du byed pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes dpal gyi mgul nas gsungs pa'i don yang yid la gzhol nas spro ba bskyed par bya'o/ /gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba'ang*/ gzhan don bla med byang chub tu dge rtsa bsngo ba dang smon lam gyis zin par bya dgos la/ de'ang 'khor gsum rnam par mi rtog pa'i ngang la bzhag go /mdo rgyud rgya mtsho'i snying bcud ni/ /'jam mgon yab sras zhi lhag khrid/ /blo dman 'jug pa bde ba'i ched/

/grong pa'i tshig gis lhug por bkral/ /thos bsam dben pa'i phyi gling gi /slob bu dag la sman sems kyang*/ /tshul bzhin ma gyur nongs pa gang*/ /chos spyan ldan pa'i spyan sngar 'chags/ /dge des yid can pha ma kun/ /rnam mkhyen ye shes thob par shog /ces pa 'di'ang thams cad mkhyen gzigs mi pham 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi thub chog rgyab chos padma dkar po las zhi lhag sgom tshul 'khor lo'i mgon po mkhyen brtse rin po ches khol phyung mdzad pa nyid la gtso bor khungs bcol cing*/ 'di ga'i tshig tshogs sgrim che zhing go dka' ba dang*/ mdo rgyud lung sbyor mang po dag bdag 'dra'i skyes sbyangs yon tan phra ba rnams kyis tshul bzhin 'chad par dka' zhing*/ de bzhin thos bsam dben pa'i phyi rgyal gyi slob tshogs gsar bu pa rnams mgo 'khrug pa'i rkyen du gyur pa mang bas phal cher phris shing*/ brjod tshig go bde ba gtso bor byas la/ yon tan rin po che'i mdzod sogs gzhung gzhan dang*/ bla ma'i man ngag las kyang kha bsnan byas te cung zad spros pa 'di'ang*/ phyi gling rang slob nang pa gsar bu rnams la phan phyir lhag bsam gyis mtshams sbyar te/ 'dzam gling zhi ba'i bsti gnas a ri'i yul gyi cha shas mong kran nar/ e wam̐ gsang sngags gling du sgo chen sprul ming gsang sngags bstan 'dzin gyis rab byung 17 lcags 'brug lo'i gro zhun nya ba'i yar gyi tshes bzang por grub par bgyis pa'o/ /slar yang gcung gnam lcags mkhan po ngag dbang dge legs mchog dang mchog sprul thub bstan rnam gnyis la tshig don gyi char zhus dag gsol ba btab pa bzhin legs par gnang bar thugs rje che zhu ba dang 'brel mtha' don gtan 'bebs grub par bgyis pa lags sau// //ga)༄༅/ /thun mong phyi yi sngon 'gro'i lag khrid gdab pa man ngag gnad kyi gzer bu zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /

rig stong gdod ma'i mgon po 'jam pa'i dpal/ /sangasam̐ rgyam̐s kun gyi yem̐ shem̐s gcig bsdus mchog /dbyer med rtsam̐ gsum̐m kun 'dus padma rgyal/ /'gro 'dul gling pa spyi bo'i rgyan du mchod/ /bla ma'i bka' las 'gong par ma nus nas/ /rang blos ji dpog dam pa'i man ngag las/ /rgya mtsho'i chu las skra rtse'i thigs pa ltar/ /cung zad 'god la bkas gnang byin gyis rlobs/ /de yang thun mong phyi'i sngon 'gro'i lag len nyams khrid du gdab pa'i man ngag rang mtshang gi gnad la 'bigs pa'i gzer bu bstan par bya ba la/ thog mar tho rangs ldang ba'i rnal 'byor ni/ tho rangs mal nas gnyid sad pa dang mnyam du dran shes dang ldan pa'i ngang la/ mdang gnyid du song nas da nangs sad kyi bar/ rmi lam tshun du sdig pa mthong na 'phral du bshags pa dang*/ dge ba la dga' ba sgom/ de nas gnyid rmugs dang le lo'i dbang du mi btang bar/ lus gnad rnam snang chos bdun legs par bsrang ba'am tsog pur 'dug de ma thag tu snying padma 'dab brgyad kha phye ba'i dbus su bla ma gu ru rin po che o rgyan rdo rje 'chang yab yum bum sku'i rnam par bzhugs pa nyid/ skad cig gis dbu ma'i lam brgyud nas yar 'phags te/ rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar pad zla'i gdan la zhal sprod kyi rnam par dgyes ye re bzhugs pa las/ rang 'od kyi mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs sprin phung 'khrigs pa bzhin sku mtshan dpe'i gzi mdangs ya le/ gsung badzra gu ru'i sngags dbyangs kyi snyan 'gyur 'ur re/ phyag ḍā dril gyi rang sgra khrol le/ zhabs brkyang bskum dang gar thabs khrig ger bsgyur bas/ sil g.yer ḍā dril sngags kyi sgras 'gro kun gti mug gnyid las bslangs par bsam la/ mos gus drag pos mchi ma 'khrugs pa'i gdung dbyangs dang bcas/ bla ma mkhyen no: bla ma mkhyen no: bla ma mkhyen no: kye ma kyi hud gu ru rin po che: bdag 'dra blun rmongs 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i 'gror:

mkhyen rab thugs rje'i 'od stong rab bkyes nas: smag 'thug 'khor ba'i btson las bsgral du gsol: zhes gsol ba rtse gcig tu btab pas gu ru dgyes pa'i zhal gyis phyogs/ brtse ba'i spyan gyis gzigs/ thugs rjes rjes su bzung*/ 'dzum pa'i zhal nas 'di ltar/ kyai/ skal ldan rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo zhes bos te/ gdod ma'i gzhi la khyod dang nga gnyis dbye ba med de/ sangs rgyas sems can thams cad gzhi dbyings su mnyam mod kyang*/ ma rig pa'i dbang gis gzhi snang rang snang du ngo ma shes pas/ gzung 'dzin du gol te thog ma med pa nas da lta'i bar 'khrul snang rmi lam lta bur bden par bzung ba'i srid pa'i duḥkha mu med par myong ba yin la/ da lta'ang rmongs par gyur na nam yang thar ba'i skabs med/ de'i phyir na dus 'dir gti mug gis gnyid ma log par rang rig 'od gsal ngo shes par gyis la/ sgo gsum dge bar bkol cing brtson 'grus rtsom pa'i dus la bab pa yin no/ khyad par du da lta tho rangs dus su bla ma spyi bor bsgoms nas/ dkon mchog gsum 'dus kyi ngo bo ru shes par gyis la snying nas gsol ba thob/ sems can thams cad pha mar shes pa'i snying rjes 'di rnams gtan gyi sdug bsngal las bral te/ sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa zhig bdag gis bya'o snyam pa'i mgron gyi mchog tu gnyer/ phyi nang gsang ba'i sdom dang dam tshig srog ltar zungs la/ lhag par lam thams cad kyi gzhi ma yin pas sngon 'gro bsags sbyang spel ba'i tshul gyis nyams su longs/ sgo gsum gyi gnad rnams su yang dag bsnun pa gal che bas/ de phyir skal ldan snying gi bu'am bu mo/ kyai brtson 'grus ma zhan ang zhes gdams pa'i mod la/ rang nas kyang mos gus bzod mi thub pa lta bu skye zhing*/ gu ru'i bka' bzhin 'chi ba srog la bab kyang dam bca' 'dor re she bsam zhing sems la go cha bgos pa'i mos pa dang bcas/

ngag tu yang snang ba 'gyur ba'i gdang snyan pos 'di skad brjod par bya'o/ /legs par soms dang skal ldan rigs kyi bu: sangs rgyas sems can dbyings su mnyam mod kyang : da lta rmongs pa'i dus 'dir gnyid ma log: tho rangs dus su bla ma spyi bor sgoms: dkon mchog gsum la snying nas gsol ba thob: sems can thams cad mgron gyi mchog tu gnyer: phyi nang gsang ba'i sdom dang dam tshig zungs: bsags sbyang spel ba'i gnad rnams yang dag bsnun: de phyir skal ldan brtson 'grus ma zhan ang : zhes brjod la yid kyis kyang de ltar bsam par bya'o/ /de nas gter gzhung rtsa bar/ dug gsum rlung bus rdo rje'i bzlas pa bya: de ni sgo gsum spyi yi byin rlabs mchog: ces gsungs pa bzhin lus gnad rnam snang chos bdun drang por bsrang*/ lag pa g.yas g.yon mthe bong gis so so'i srin mdzub rtsa ba nas mnan la/ gung mo bsgrengs pa'i rdo rje'i khu tshur g.yas g.yon brla rtsar bzhag la dpung pa gzengs bstod/ de nas khu tshur nang bskor gyi g.yon pa'i srin mdzub kyis sna bug g.yon ma bkag ste sna bug g.yas nas rlung ro lan gcig bsal/ de bzhin g.yas phyogs bkag ste g.yon nas gong ltar rlung ro lan gcig de ltar g.yas g.yon spel mar gsum gsum song rjes lag pa snga ma bzhin bzhag la sna bug gnyis ka nas gsum ste dgu phrug tu bsal/ dmigs pa ni/ g.yas nas rlung ro bsal skabs/ ngo bo nyon mongs pa zhe sdang la/ des bskyed pa'i nad khrag dang mkhris pa/ gdon pho gdon dang rgyal 'gong*/ zhe sdang dang phrag dog gtsor gyur gyi sdig sgrib dang bcas pa/ rnam pa ni rlung dkar mog dang por 'bud skabs nag shas che ba/ gnyis par dkar skya/ gsum pa'i mthar dug rnams thon nas dkar seng nger song bar bsam/ de bzhin g.yon phyogs gong ltar rlung ro bsal skabs/ ngo bo nyon mongs pa 'dod chags la/ des bskyed pa'i nad rlung dang grang ba/

gdon mo gdon dang bsen mo/ 'dod sred dang ser sna gtsor gyur gyi sdig sgrib dang bcas pa/ rnam pa rlung dmar nag dang por 'bud skabs nag shas che ba/ gnyis par dmar skya/ gsum pa'i mthar dug rnams thon nas dmar sang nger song bar bsam/ de ltar g.yas g.yon spel mar gsum gsum song nas cha mnyam zhes lag pa khu tshur snga ma bzhin brla rtsar bzhag la sna bug gnyis ka nas rlung ro bsal skabs/ ngo bo nyon mongs pa gti mug la/ des bskyed pa'i nad bad kan/ gdon klu gdon/ ma rig pa gtsor gyur gyi sdig sgrib dang bcas pa/ rnam pa rlung sngo nag dang por 'bud skabs nag shas che ba/ gnyis par sngo skya/ gsum pa'i mthar dug rnams thon nas sngo bsangs nam mkha' ltar song bar bsam la/ mthar ha zhes kha nas dal bur 'don zhing lhod de shig ger bzhag go /de ni bcud ma blugs gong snod bkru bshal byas pa dang mtshungs/ yang pho mo gnyis nyon mongs gtso che chung*/ rtsa dang khams kyi khyad par la brten nas g.yas g.yon go ldog srol kyang yod mod ma byas kyang mi 'gal/ de nas ngag sgrib sbyang zhing ngag byin gyis brlabs pa ni/ rang gi lce'i dbang po zla ba kha bkas pa lta bu'i steng du/ ngo bo ye shes kyi gtum mo la rnam pa raṃ yig dmar po padma rā ga'i mdangs can gsal ba las me 'bar/ rang gi lce dbang las dang bag chags bcas pa bsregs te stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las lce ye shes 'od kyi rang bzhin rnam pa gser gyi rdo rje rtse lnga pa phyed pa zhig sgom/ de'ang gzhan du rtse mo lce rtse gtad phyogs su gtad par snang yang 'dir rtse mo gyen bstan du byas na sku sgom bde la/ de'i lte ba zlum po'i dbus su zla ba nya gang ba'i steng dhīḥ las 'jam dbyangs dmar ser ral pod can/ pang du yum dbyangs can ma dmar skya yab yum bde stong mnyam par sbyor ba/ g.yas g.yon mtheb srin pad sdong la 'khril ba'i ral pod 'dzin pa/

thugs srog dhi' yig dmar po'i mthar/ om̐ a ra pa tsa na dhī hrīḥ zhes shes rab rang byung gi dpa' bo 'bru brgyad dang*/ de'i phyi rol nas yi ge shes rab kyi rang bzhin ā li bcu drug om̐ gyis mgo mnan pa/ a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ ā/ gnyis ka dmar gsal padma rā ga'i mdangs dang ldan zhing spus bris pa ltar phyi nang rim pa can rang sgra dang bcas g.yon du 'khor bar bsam la lan bdun nam gsum bzlas/ de'i mthar snang ba thabs kyi rang bzhin yi ge'i rnam pa ni/ kā li 'bru so bzhi oṃ gyis mgo mnan pa/ om̐ ka kha ga gha nga*/ tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha kṣa/ zhes dkar po shel dkar phreng ba bzhin rang sgra dang bcas g.yas su 'khor bar bsam la lan bdun brjod/ de'i phyi rol mthar mi 'gyur ba rab tu gnas bya'i yi ge gsung mchog chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong gi rtsa ba rten 'brel snying po/ om̐ ye dharmā he tu pra bha wā he tunte ṣānta thā ga to hya wa data/ teṣāñtsa yo ni ro dha e waṃ bā dī ma hā shrā ma ṇaḥswā hā/ zhes pa'i sngags phreng dkar po mu tig phreng ba ltar 'od zer mdangs ldan rang sgra dang bcas g.yas su 'khor bar bsam la lan bdun brjod/ slar yang thabs shes kyi gsang sngags yig 'bru ā li kā li rten snying 'di dag las sna tshogs mdog can 'od zer dpag tu med pa nam mkha' gang bar 'phros/ phyogs bcu dus bzhi'i rgyal ba thams cad mnyes par byas/ 'od zer tshur 'dus pa las de kun gyi byin rlabs dngos grub ma lus pa dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi gsung rdo rje 'jam dbyangs dmar po'i ye shes kyi sku dang*/ gsung gsang sngags yi ge 'bru brgyad dam dhīḥ yig thugs phyag mtshan ral gri dang po ti'i rnam par drangs te/ rang gi lce steng dam tshig sems dpa' 'jam dpal yab yum la bstims pas gsung gi rdo rje 'grub par bsam la/

om̐ a ra pa tsa na dhī hrīḥ zhes gsang sngags yi ge brgyad pa brgya rtsa bzla bar bya'o/ /de nas 'jam dbyangs yab yum nyid 'od du zhu nas rang gi ljags la thim pas ye shes kyi rdo rje'i ljags mchog thob nas shes bya'i gnas thams cad la mkhas shing chos smra bar chags thogs med pa dang*/ khyad par mi brjed pa'i gzungs dang spobs pa la dbang bsgyur zhing gsang sngags zab mo'i bzlas brjod myur du 'grub par shog cig snyam du bya'o/ /ngag tu yang*/ rang gi lce dbang raṃ las ye shes kyi: gtum mo'i me yis bsregs te stong par sbyangs: stong pa'i ngang las gser gyi rdo rje ni: phyed pa'i mtshan pa rtse lnga'i lte ba ru: zla steng dhīḥ las 'jam dbyangs dmar po ni: longs spyod rdzogs sku ral pod dbyangs can ma: dmar skya bde stong gnyis su med par sbyor: gnas gsum rdo rje'i yi ge 'bru gsum mtshan: thugs kar nya gang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la: gnas pa'i thugs srog dhi'aḥyig dmar po'i mthar: shes rab rang byung dpa' bo 'bru brgyad dmar: shes rab rang bzhin yi ge ā li dmar: rā ga'i mdangs ldan sgra bcas g.yon du 'khor: om̐ a ra pa tsa na dhī hrīḥ om̐ a ā: i ī: u ū: ṛ ṝ: l̥ l̥̄: e ai: o au: aṃ ā: lan grangs gsum mam bdun gyi bar du brjod: de mthar snang ba thabs kyi yi ge ni: kā li dkar po shel dkar phreng ba bzhin: rang sgra dang bcas g.yas su 'khor bar bsam: lan grangs gsum mam bdun gyi bar du brjod: de mthar snang ba thabs kyi yi ge ni: kā li dkar po shel dkar phreng ba bzhin: rang sgra dang bcas g.yas su 'khor bar bsam: om̐ ka kha ga gha nga : tsa tsha dza dzha nya: ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa: ta tha da dha na: pa pha ba bha ma: ya ra la wa: sha ṣa sa ha kṣaḥ lan bdun brjod/ de mthar mi 'gyur gnas bya'i yi ge mchog: rten snying dkar po mu tig phreng ba ltar: 'od ldan rang sgra dang bcas g.yas su 'khor: om̐ ye dharmā he tu pra bha wā he tunte ṣānta thā ga to hya wa data:

teṣāñtsa yo ni ro dha e waṃ bā dī ma hā shrā ma ṇaḥswā hā: lan bdun brjod/ slar yang gsang sngags yig 'bru de dag las: sna tshogs 'od zer nam mkha' gang bar 'phros: phyogs dus rgyal ba kun gyi gsung rdo rje: 'jam dbyangs dmar po'i ye shes sku dang ni: gsang sngags yig 'bru phyag mtshan ral gri dang : po ti'i rnam par lce steng dam tshig par: bstims pas gsung gi rdo rje 'grub par bsam: gsang sngags yi ge brgyad pa brgya rtsa bzla: de nyid 'od du zhu ba'i ye shes kyi: rdo rje'i ljags mchog shes bya'i chos smra bar: chags thogs med par gzungs spobs dbang bsgyur zhing : gsang sngags zab mo'i bzlas brjod 'grub par shog: ces ngag byin gyis brlabs pa ste/ 'di yan thor thun kho nar bya ba yin no/ /thun bzhi gzhan gyi skabs ngag byin rlabs sogs dor nas thun gyi sngon 'gro zhes lus gnad bca' ba/ ngag gnad rlung ro bsal ba sogs snga ma thor thun ji bzhin 'gro dgos pas so sor skabs phye shes par bya'o/ /gang ltar yang de nas sems kyi gnad 'di kun la gal che bas kun slong gang yin legs par brtags nas/ phrag dog dang 'gran sems sogs ma dag pa'i kun slong dang*/ bzang ngan ci yang ma yin pa lung ma bstan gyi kun slong du 'dug na bcos shing*/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad sangs rgyas gyi go 'phang 'thob par bya/ de'i ched du lam zab mo nyams su blang bar bgyi snyam pa'i bsam pa bzang po byang chub sems kyis rtsis zin par bya/ khyad par du bla ma rgyang 'bod kyi rigs rnams/ ngag dal bus snyan pa'i dbyangs la sbyar nas mos gus kyis lus ba spu g.yo/ mig mchi ma 'khrugs/ rnam rtog rang 'gags su 'gro nus pa'i gsol 'debs rtsal du ma bton na/ kha ton dkyus ma lta bus byin rlabs 'jug par dka' bas dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo bla ma rin po che mkhyen no/ /bdag la dbang bskur byin gyis brlab tu gsol/

zab lam gyi rtogs pa khyad par can rgyud la skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes ngag tu yang snang ba 'gyur ba'i dbyangs dang bcas/ bla ma mkhyen no: lan gsum/ dang pos gsol ba 'debs/ gnyis pas ci mdzad khyed shes kyis mos gus bskyed/ gsum pas thugs yid bsre la mnyam par bzhag de nas sngon 'gro dngos la thun mong phyi'i sngon 'gro dang*/ thun min nang gi sngon 'gro gnyis yod pa las/ dang po phyi'i sngon 'gro blo sbyong gi rim pa la'ang*/ dal 'byor rnyed dka'/ tshe mi rtag las rgyu 'bras/ 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs dang bzhi'o/ /dang po dal 'byor gyi rang bzhin ngos bzung ba ni/ dal ba brgyad dang 'byor ba bcu ste dal 'byor gyi chos bco brgyad do/ /gnyis pa/ sgom tshul ni/ dal ba sgom pa/ 'byor ba sgom pa/ rnyed dka' ba sgom pa gsum las/ dang po la'ang thun gyi sngon 'gro gong ltar song nas/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo bla ma rin po che mkhyen no/ /bdag la dbang bskur byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ dal 'byor rnyed dka' ba'i zab don khyad par can rgyud la skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ sogs 'og tu skabs so sor kha bsgyur la/ kye rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo rnams gsan 'tshal/ rang re rnams kyi rgyud la gzhi bde gshegs snying po zhes sangs rgyas kyi sa bon yod de/ rgyud brtag gnyis las/ sems can thams cad sangs rgyas yin/ /'on kyang glo bur dri mas bsgribs/ /dri ma de bsal sangs rgyas dngos/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin nyi ma la sprin gyis bsgribs pa bzhin/ sgrib byed kyi dri ma glo bur ba zad na ye ldan du yod pa'i gzhi yi yon tan nyi ma dang 'od zer bzhin mngon du mi 'gyur ba'i thabs med do/ /de yang dbul po'i sgyed rdo nor bu yin yang ngo ma shes na dbul ba mi sel ba ltar rgyu rang la yod kyang ngo ma shes na mi phan te/ sangs rgyas dang sems can yang rtogs dang ma rtogs kyi grol 'khrul khyad par byung bar gsungs so/

/des na khams ky-i dri ma sbyong byed ni dam pa'i chos kho na yin la chos gsha' ma zhig byed pa la snod dam rten phun sum tshogs pa zhig dgos/ de'ang dal ba brgyad dang 'byor ba bcu ste dal 'byor bco brgyad dang ldan pa'i mi lus rin po che kho na yin gyi gzhan min/ de las dal ba brgyad ci la zer na/ mi khom pa'i gnas brgyad du ma skyes pas dal ba brgyad bya ste/ de'ang da lta rang nyid mi khom pa brgyad kyi nang gses dmyal ba yi dwags dud 'gro ste ngan song gsum du skyes na ci tsug yong bar 'dug tsha grang bkres skom bkol spyod sogs bar gseng cung zad med par sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal dos drags shing dbal tsha ba la spyod pas chos sgrub khom mam/ legs par soms dang*/ de bzhin du lha tshe ring po la skyes na 'du shes med pas ra ro ba lta bu'i ngang dus gron nas 'phen byed kyi las rdzogs te slar ngan song du skye bas chos sgrub e khom/ mi ru skyes kyang dge sdig go ldog tu spyod pa'i kla klo/ dkon mchog dang las 'bras med par lta ba'i log lta can/ dkon mchog gi sgra tsam yang mi thos pa'i mtha' 'khob sangs rgyas kyis stong pa/ dbang po las su mi rung ba'i lkugs pa sogs su skyes na chos sgrub pa'i skal pa 'dug gam/ khom par 'dug gam ltos dang*/ de rnams su skyes na chos bsgrub par mi nus pas rang bzhin gyis mi khom pa'i gnas brgyad bya la/ rang nyid de dang der ma skyes pas dal ba brgyad tshang ba'i lus thob pa ni bsod nams nga re che snyam dga' ba sgom/ mthar bsngo ba smon lam bya'o/ /de nas 'byor ba bcu sgom pa ni/ thun gyi sngon 'gro snga ma ltar bya/ de nas/ kye rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo rnams/ da dung 'byor ba bcu tshang min ltos shig de'ang rang 'byor dang gzhan 'byor gnyis kyi dang po rang 'byor lnga ni/ mi nyid dbus skyes dbang po tshang*/

/las mtha' ma log gnas la dad/ /ces gsungs pa bzhin/ mi lus ma thob na chos byar med la mir skyes pas rten gyi 'byor ba dang*/ de'ang chos dar ba'i yul du ma skyes na chos byar med la der skyes pas yul gyi 'byor ba dang/ thos bsam gyi rten dbang shes ma tshang na chos bya ba'i gegs su 'gyur bas dbang po tshang ba'i 'byor ba dang*/ tshe 'dir mtshams med byas pa lta bu rang gi las mtha' log na chos byar med pas las kyi mtha' ma log pas dge bar mos pa bsam pa khyad par gyi 'byor ba dang*/ dad pa'i gnas rgyal ba'i bstan pa la ma dad na chos byar med la bstan pa la dad pas/ rang nyid chos kyi 'byor ba ste rang 'byor rnams tshang bar 'dug gam brtags la tshang na dga' ba sgom/ ma tshang na tshang ba'i thabs la 'bad par bya/ sbyor dngos rjes gsum snga ma bzhin kun la 'grai shes par bya'o/ /yang gzhan 'byor lnga ni/ sangs rgyas byon dang des chos gsungs/ /bstan pa gnas dang de'i rjes 'jug /gzhan phyir snying nas brtse ba'o/ /zhes pas spyir 'jig rten 'dir sangs rgyas ma byon na bstan pa'i snang ba med la sangs rgyas byon pas ston pa khyad par can gyi 'byor ba/ des chos ma gsungs na mi phan pas chos 'khor gsum bskor bas bstan pa dam pa'i chos kyi 'byor ba/ chos gsungs kyang bstan pa nub na mi phan pas bstan pa gnas pa dus kyi 'byor ba/ bstan pa gnas kyang de'i rjes su ma zhugs na mi phan pas bstan pa la zhugs pa rang gi skal ba'i 'byor ba/ bstan pa la zhugs kyang mthun rkyen dge ba'i bshes gnyen med na blang dor gyi gnad mi shes pas da res yang dag pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen/ snying brtse ba'i thugs rjes yongs su 'dzin mkhan yod pas lhag pa'i thugs rje'i 'byor ba ste lnga po de rnams rang la 'byor min brtags la tshang na dga' ba sgom la/ ma tshang na tshang ba'i thabs la 'bad/ dal 'byor don dang ldan pa zhig bya'o snyam pas dam bca' drag po bzung*/
