de de bzhin nus pa bla ma dang gu ru rin po che khyed mkhyen snyam pa'i gsol ba btab/ de bzhin 'byung bar shog snyam pa'i smon lam dang dge ba gzhan don du bsngo ba sogs sbyor dngos rjes gsum tshang bar bya'o/ /gsum pa rnyed dka' ba bsam pa ni/ kye rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo rnams/ da dung de ltar 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las brgal bar byed pa'i thar pa'i gru gzings lta bu'i dal 'byor bco brgyad dang ldan pa'i mi lus rin po che 'di bzhin/ da res tsam las phyis nas rnyed par dka' ba'i tshul la ltos shig de yang rgyu'i sgo nas bsam pas kyang rnyed dka'/ dpe yi sgo nas bsams kyang rnyed dka'/ grangs kyi sgo nas kyang rnyed dka' la/ dang po rgyu'i sgo nas bsam na rnyed dka' ste/ skye ba mang por mi dge bcu srog brdos kyis spangs/ le lo spangs nas dge ba bcu po dang du blangs pa'i mthu kho na las byung ba yin gyi/ stabs legs dang stes dbang lta bus rnyed pa ma yin pas rgyu'i sgo nas bsams kyang rnyed dka' bar bsam mo/ /gnyis pa dpe yi sgo nas kyang gyang logs la sran ma spar gang gtor bas re tsam chags pa srid mtha' ma bkag tsam las kyang shin tu rnyed dka' bar bsam/ gsum pa grangs kyi sgo nas kyang rnyed dka' ste/ dmyal ba ni sa chen po'i rdul dang mnyam/ yi dwags ni gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma dang mnyam/ dud 'gro ni chang 'gag gi sbang ma dang mnyam zhes gsungs na/ da lta rang re'i mthong chos su yod pa'i mi dang dud 'gro'i mang nyung la ltos dang*/ sa gzhi bar snang rgya mtsho'i gnas su srog chags ji tsam 'dug gam/ tha na rgya grog gi tshang dang mi gcig gi lus la gnas pa'i srin 'bu gcig pu'i grangs la brtags kyang rnyed dka' ba shes par 'gyur ro/ /de ltar ngan 'gro'i srid pa la ltos na/ mi lus ni thob srid pa tsam yin la de las kyang dal 'byor ldan pa nyung*/ de las kyang chos rnam dag byed pa ches dkon pa'i tshul la brtags na srid mtha' ma bkag tsam du zad do/

/de yi phyir kun mkhyen gyis/ rin chen mi lus rnyed pa ni 'khor los sgyur rgyal rnyed pa dang 'dra/ zhes gsungs pa bzhin rgyal srid lan gcig thob pa 'di don med chud zos su btang ba ni/ srog ma chad kyang ro/ 'dres ma khyer kyang smyon pa/ nor bu'i gling du phyin nas lag stong du log pa bas kyang ches blun pas rang sems rang la dkar na/ rang dbang rang la yod pa'i dus 'dir nam zhag gtan gyi 'dun ma dam pa'i lha chos shig e 'grub blta dgos/ de lta bu'i dal 'byor 'di nyid rnyed dka' la rnyed na don che ste/ tha ma mngon mtho lha mi'i go 'phang*/ 'bring nyan rang gi thar pa/ rab sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob thub pa ma zad/ tshe gcig lus gcig la zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang brnyes nas da lta'ang 'ja' lus su deng bzhin pa 'di dag la ltos dang*/ zhes brtag bcug la dal 'byor rnyed dka' ba'i tshul la nges shes nang nas rnyed pa zhig gal che/ de yi phyir na dal 'byor lus kyi gru chen 'di lta bu la bsdad nas/ sdug bsngal 'khor ba'i mtsho las da lta nyid nas bsgral thub pa zhig dang*/ de'ang zhi ba phyogs gcig pa lta bu ma yin par yang dag thar pa'i gling*/ ye shes bla ma'i sa mchog nyams dga' ba ga la ba der/ kun tu bzang po'i rgyal srid tshe 'dir thob pa zhig bdag gis bya'o snyam pa'i dam bca' dang*/ de ltar nus pa'i ched du gsol ba snying nas 'debs so/ /bla ma dang gnyis su med pa o rgyan gu ru rin po che/ dus da lta nyid du byin gyis rlobs shig bka' drin mtshungs med rje btsun dam pa khyed las re ltos gzhan du mi 'dug na/ yid bzhin nor bu lta bu'i mi lus rin chen 'di don med chud zos su mi 'gro bar/ don dang ldan pa'i chos gsha' ma zhig 'grub par thugs rjes gzung du gsol snyam du bsam la ngag tu'ang*/ bla ma mkhyen no: lan gsum dang/ thar pa'i gru gzings dal 'byor rin chen 'di:

da res tsam las phyis nas rnyed dka' bas: gru 'di la bzhon sdug bsngal mtsho bsgral nas: yang dag thar pa'i gling mchog nyams dga' bar: kun tu bzang po'i rgyal srid thob pa zhig: gsol ba 'debs so gu ru rin po che: byin gyis rlobs shig bka' drin mtshungs med rje: mi lus don ldan 'grub par thugs rjes zungs: zhes tshig tha ma lan gsum brjod par bya'o/ /gnyis pa tshe mi rtag pa la bsam pa ni/ kye/ rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo rnams legs par gsan 'tshal/ de'ang rang re rnams yid bzhin nor bu lta bu'i mi lus rin po che 'di nyid thob zin pas mi phan te sangs rgyas pa ni min/ 'di lta bu'i lus de thob dka' la 'jig sla ba/ mi rtag 'gyur ba'i chos can/ nam zhig 'chi rgyu yin pa tsam ma yin par skad cig kyang yid rton mi rung ba ste/ tshoms las/ sang dang 'jig rten phyi ma gnyis/ /sngon la gang yong cha med pas/ /sang gi tshis la mi 'bad par/ /phyi ma'i don la 'bad par rigs/ /zhes pa ltar chos rnam par dag pa zhig bsgrub dgos/ de yang nam zhig bsgrub 'dun yod pa tsam gyis mi chog da lta nyid du ma bsgrubs na sang tsam shi na ci tsug yong bar 'dug bsam par bya'o/ /de yang phyi snod kyi 'jig rten bsam na mi rtag pa dang*/ nang bcud kyi sems can la bsam na mi rtag pa dang*/ 'chi rkyen nges med la bsam na mi rtag pa sgom pa dang gsum las/ dang po/ phyi snod kyi 'jig rten la bsam na mi rtag ste/ snod kyi 'jig rten mi rtag me chus 'jig /gsungs pa bzhin rgyu rkyen la brten nas chags shing gnas pa 'di kun/ rgyu rkyen la brten nas 'jig c-ing mthar ming tsam yang med par stong pa'i tshul la ltos/ de bzhin dus mi rtag ste nam zla dus bzhi'i 'gyur lugs/ nyin mtshan skad cig thengs gcig re la bsam yang rtag pa e 'dug bsam blo thong zhes yang yang brtag bcug pas/ rtag 'dzin gyi blo de ldog nas blo sna thung bud de song na thebs pa'i tshad do/

/gnyis pa nang bcud kyi sems can skye gnas bzhi dang rgyud lngas bsdus pa'i skye 'gro la bsam na mi rtag ste/ skyes mtha' 'chi ba las ma 'das/ grub pa thob pa'i rig 'dzin dang*/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi rdo rje'i sku yang 'jig tshul ston na rang re'i lus rten ston ka'i grog sbur lta bu 'di la/ rtag brtan dang snying po ci zhig yod de/ kha sang kha nyin gyi gsar 'gyur/ de ring nyi ma'i mthong thos/ rnam rtog skad cig gi 'pho 'gyur/ bde sdug ci la bsam yang mi rtag pa dang 'gyur ba'i rang bzhin 'di la yid rton du rung ba zhig 'dug gam/ da lta bde ba yod 'phral sdug bsngal la 'gyur ba/ mthon po dma' por lhung ba/ dman pa mthon por 'gyur ba/ phyug po dbul por 'gyur ba/ dbul po phyug por 'gro ba/ dgra gnyen du 'gyur ba/ gnyen dgrar 'gyur ba sogs 'gyur ldog 'di la ltos shig gsum pa 'chi rkyen nges pa med pas kyang mi rtag ste/ rang gis shes pa'i grong yul gcig gam/ lung pa gcig khyim tshang gcig la sngar mi du tsam shi de dag kyang rgan gzhon bar ma'i go rim dang*/ 'chi lugs 'chi rkyen nges med ji byung la ltos/ der ma tshad da lta sa steng gi mi yod tshad lo brgya yi phan chod du re shas las mi lhag pa sogs/ mdor na skye ba'i mtha' ma 'chi ba'i rang bzhin las ma 'das te/ 'jig rten khams 'di na sngar nas ma shi gnyug mar gnas pa su zhig yod pa thos sam/ yang na rang gis mthong ngam/ soms shig de'ang nam 'chi la cha med de rlung nang gi mar me dang 'dra/ der 'chi dang 'dir 'chi zhes rang dbang med de bya spu rlung khyer dang 'dra/ 'chi ba'i rkyen la nges pa med pas rgan gzhon gyi go rim dang*/ na nad yod med sogs la mi ltos par byi'u'i khyu la khras rgol ba dang 'dra/ 'chi ba'i tshe gang gis kyang mi phan pa'i tshul la soms dang*/ de'ang 'chi ba'i tshe rgyu zas nor/ gnyen nye 'brel/ thob go sa/

grogs dga' mdza' lta ci/ tha na zas kham gang*/ gos lus gang yang khyer dbang med pa ma zad/ gces pa'i lus kyang rmi lam bzhin shul du dor te mar dkyil nas spu bton pa bzhin gcig pu gcer bu lag stong du phyi ma'i lam po cher skyes chen po 'degs pa'i dus shig 'ong nges la/ de yang nam yong cha ma mchis te sang zhig byung na rang la mi 'jigs pa'i gdeng zhig yod dam/ de bas da lta rang dbang yod dus chos gsha' ma zhig sgrub ma thub tshe bdag nyid chos med shi ba'i 'og tu gshin rje'i yul nas 'gyod dus 'phyis drags la/ skabs der ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal dos drags pa la bsam na su yis bzod par nus snyam pa'i snying dung nger bsgom mo/ /des na da res dkon mchog gi thugs rje'i dpyang thag gis zin nas 'gro kun 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las sgrol thub pa zhig bdag gis bya'o snyam pa'i dam bca' dang*/ de ltar nus pa'i ched du gsol ba snying nas 'debs so/ /bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i o rgyan gu ru rin po che khyed mkhyen/ dus da lta nyid du byin gyis rlobs shig bka' drin mtshungs med/ rje btsun dam pa khyed las re ltos gzhan su yang mi 'dug na/ khyed kyis bdag 'chi ba snying nas dran te chos gsha' ma zhig 'grub par thugs rjes gzung du gsol snyam la ngag tu'ang brjod par bya'o/ /bla ma mkhyen no: lan gsum/ skye 'chi'i rang bzhin 'jig rten khams 'di na: ma shi gnyug mar gnas pa su zhig yod: de bas bdag nyid chos med shi ba'i 'og: gshin rje'i yul na sdug bsngal su yis bzod: dkon mchog thugs rje'i dpyang thag zin pa zhig: gsol ba 'debs so gu ru rin po che: byin gyis rlobs shig bka' drin mtshungs med rje: 'chi ba snying nas dran par thugs rjes zungs: bla ma mkhyen no: lan gsum: gsum pa las rgyu 'bras bsam pa la spyi dang bye brag gnyis/ dang po ni/ thun gyi sngon 'gro snga ma ltar bya/

de nas kye rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo rnams gsan 'tshal/ de ltar shi ba gcig pus mi chog da dung las kyi dbang gis skye ba len dgos/ gang du skye ba blang tshun chad 'gro ba rigs drug gi gnas ris gang rung las ma 'das te/ rin chen phreng ba las/ lam gsum thog mtha' dbus med pa/ /'khor ba'i dkyil 'khor 'gal me bzhin/ /dkyil 'khor lta bu phan tshun gyis/ /rgyu rkyen 'di ni 'khor bar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin gang du skyes kyang sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin yin la/ de yi rgyu ni las nyon mi dge ba ste/ skye ba'i zhing la dkar nag gi sa bon btab pas bslu ba med par 'bras bu smin pa bzhin/ kun rdzob rgyu dge sdig gnyis las/ 'bras bu bde sdug gi chos mi bslu ba smin par 'gyur te/ snod bcud kyi bde sdug ji snyed pa de thams cad rgyu med pa las byung ba min la/ rgyu ma yin pa las byung ba yang min/ 'o na gang yin zhe na/ thog med nas bsags pa'i dkar nag las kyi 'bras bu kho na yin pa ma zad/ rgyu kun 'byung nyon mongs la brten nas las bsags pa nyid/ rkyen sred len gyis gsos btab pa la brten nas 'bras bu srid par 'du byed pa ste/ de'ang 'phen byed kyi las mthun par bsags pas snang gyur thun mong ba mi yi 'gro ba lta bur skyes kyang*/ myong gyur thun min rdzogs byed rten so sor bde sdug ma nges par byung ba/ dper na pha ma gcig gi bu rgyud la'ang nad yod med/ gzugs mdzes min/ blo rno rtul/ tshe ring thung*/ bsod nams che chung sogs bde sdug mi 'dra ba dang*/ 'ga' zhig dge ba la spro/ 'ga' zhig mi dge bar mos/ 'ga' zhig snying rje che la gshis bzang*/ 'ga' zhig khong khro che zhing spyod pa sdug pa sogs bsam spyod mi 'dra ba sna tshogs kun gyis mthong chos su gyur pa 'di sngon las kyi 'bras bu nyid las gzhan ma yin la/ des na/ snga ma ci byas da lta'i lus la ltos/

/phyi ma gar skye da lta'i lus las shes/ /zhes pa ltar/ tshe 'dir na tsha sdug bsngal/ rkyen bar chad/ dgra gyod kha mchu/ gyong bub kha sogs gang byung sngon gyi sdig 'bras las ngan gyi mtshon cha rang la 'khor ba yin pas yi chad dang*/ 'khang ra mi byed par las 'bras la yid ches dang*/ dad pa brtan pos sngar rang gis gzhan la de ltar byas pa'i 'bras bu rang la 'khor ba yin snyam pa'i le lan rang la bda'/ phyi ma'i bu lon ma gyur par nga re dga' snyam du sgom/ zag bcas la gnyen po stobs bskyed de 'jug ldog ma nor bar bya'o/ /de nas rgyu 'bras bye brag tu bshad pa la/ rgyu bshad pa dang 'bras bu bshad pa'o/ /dang po la'ang lus ngag yid gsum gyi las lam bcu zhes lus kyi las srog gcod pa/ ma byin len pa/ log g.yem ste gsum/ ngag gi rdzun/ phra ma/ tshig rtsub/ ngag 'chal te bzhi/ yid kyi brnab sems/ gnod sems/ log lta ste gsum bcas de dag rgyu 'dod khams kyi sdug bsngal myong byed zag bcas kyi mi dge ba bcu zhes bya la/ de las ldog pa bcu po sems bskyed dang thabs shes khyad par can gyis rtsis ma zin pa ni/ bde ba myong byed bsod nams cha mthun zag bcas kyi dge ba bcu dang*/ khams gong ma bsam gzugs gnyis 'thob byed kyi dge ba ting 'dzin dang 'brel ba'i mi g.yo ba'i las te zag bcas gsum mo/ /thar pa cha mthun gyi dge ba ni gong bzhin snang bcas bsod nams kyi tshogs dge ba bcu dang pha rol du phyin pa lnga la sogs pa kun rdzob pa rnams yin la/ snang med ye shes kyi tshogs ni shes rab dang*/ stong nyid kyis rtsis zin pa ste/ klus/ dge ba 'di yi skye bo kun/ /bsod nams ye shes tshogs rdzogs shing*/ /bsod nams ye shes las byung ba'i/ /dam pa sku gnyis thob par shog /ces gsungs pa bzhin/ bsod nams dang ye shes zung du 'brel ba'o/ /de ltar rgyu sngon du song na 'bras bu mi 'dod kyang mi myong ba'i thabs med do/

/gnyis pa 'bras bu bshad pa ni/ de yang rgyu mi dge ba dang dge ba bcu sogs re rer yang 'bras bu bzhi bzhi 'byung bar gsungs pas/ srog gcod pa lta bu la kun slong dug gsum dang lci yang gi khyad par las rnam smin gyi 'bras bu ngan song gsum du 'phen pa'o/ /rgyu mthun gyi 'bras bu la/ byed pa dang myong ba gnyis las/ byed pa rgyu mthun ni/ rten gzhan rnyed kyang gsod pa la dga'/ myong ba rgyu mthun rten der tshe thung ba'o/ /dbang gi 'bras bu yul 'tshe ba can du skye'o/ /bdag po'i 'bras bu slar 'phel bar 'gyur ba nyid do/ /de ltar dge sdig gi las gzhan la yang 'gre shes par bya'o/ /de'ang rgyu dus su gdam ka yod kyi 'bras dus su de ltar ma yin te myong stobs kyis zad pa'am/ gnyen po'i stobs kyis bcom nas zad par 'gyur ba kho na las dus min du las 'bras bar ma dor chud za ba ni med de/ mdo las/ ngas ni khyod la thar pa'i thabs bstan gyi/ /thar pa rang la rag las shes par gyis/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin dus min rgyal bas kyang ni bcos su med de/ rang la rag las na rang gis rang nyid bslu ba zhig ga la rigs par 'gyur te/ des na bslu med rgyu 'bras kyi gnad la yid ches dang*/ spang blang gi tshul la 'jug ldog ma nor ba'i mkhas pa zhig bdag gis bya'o snyam pa'i dam bca' dang*/ de ltar nus pa'i ched du gsol ba snying nas 'debs so/ /bla ma dang gnyis su med pa o rgyan gu ru rin po che/ dus da lta nyid du byin gyis rlobs shig bka' drin mtshungs med/ rje btsun dam pa khyed las re ltos gzhan du mi 'dug na/ blang dor tshul bzhin nus par thugs rjes bzung du gsol snyam la ngag tu'ang*/ bla ma mkhyen no: lan gsum brjod par bya'o/ /bslu ba med pa kun rdzob rgyu 'bras chos: thog med nas bsags dkar nag las kyi 'bras: dus min rgyal bas kyang ni bcos su med: rang gis rang nyid bslu ba ga la 'gyur:

bslu med rgyu 'bras spang blang mkhas pa zhig: gsol ba 'debs so gu ru rin po che: byin gyis rlobs shig bka' drin mtshungs med rje: blang dor tshul bzhin nus par thugs rjes zungs: bzhi pa 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal la bsam pa ni/ thun gyi sngon 'gro snga ma ltar bya/ de nas/ kyai/ rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo rnams gsan 'tshal/ de ltar rang re rnams las kyi dbang gis thog ma med pa nas skye shi grangs med duḥkha brgyud nas da bar 'khyams pa yin la/ da dung las kyi dbang gis skye ba len dgos/ gang du skye ba blang tshun chad 'khor ba'i rang bzhin 'gro ba rigs drug gi gnas ris mtho dman gang rung dang*/ de dag so so'i sdug bsngal las ma 'das te/ 'gro lnga dag la bde ba med/ /mi gtsang khang par dri zhim med/ /ces gsungs pa bzhin gang du skyes kyang sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin/ sdug bsngal gyi yo lang 'ba' zhig ste/ dper na/ zo chun gyi 'khyud mo bzhin sdug bsngal gsum la mtha' dang mu med par khor mo yug tu spyod pa'i tshul la bsam na bzod thub par 'dug gam/ dper na da lta'i lus la me stag cig phog pa'am/ khab rtse zhig zug pa la yang mi bzod par a tsha tsha zhes brjod na/ lo grangs 'bum phrag du mar mes bsregs/ khro chus 'tshod/ mtshon chas btub/ sog les gshags na ci tsug yong bar 'dug gam/ de bzhin du dgun dus skar cha gcig gi grang ngar yang mi theg na/ lo grangs stong phrag du mar 'khyag rom du tshud de lus chu bur rdol ba dang*/ bcu tshal du gas pa nas brgya stong grangs med du gas pa'i bar la bsam zhing sdug bsngal rang thog tu blang*/ de lta bu'i sdug bsngal myong bzhin pa'i sems can la bsam zhing de rnams bdag gi pha ma yin/ pha ma sems can de rnams sdug bsngal de dang bral na ci ma rung snyam pa'i snying rje dung nger sgoms/ de bzhin dgong zas gcig gam/ smyung gnas lan gcig srung ba la yang 'di 'dra'i ltogs skom zer zhing dmus thag chad pa gda' ste/

lo grangs stong phrag du mar chu'i ming tsam yang mi thos pa'i yi dwags su skyes nas bkres skom nyams su myong na ci ltar byed/ yang dud 'gro bdag tu ma bzung ba rnams gcig gis gcig za ba dang*/ bdag tu bzung ba rnams bkol spyod blun rmongs sogs sdug bsngal ji tsam 'dug gong bzhin brtag bcug mdor na ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal ni sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal zhes bar med la dos drags pa brjod las 'das pa yin yang bde 'gro ni de ltar ma yin no snyam na/ mtho ris gsum po ngan song gsum la ltos na cung zad bde bar snang yang*/ 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal gyi chos can te/ lha ma yin rnams 'thab pa dang rtsod pa/ 'dod lha rnams 'pho ltung dang khams gong ma gnyis po so sor 'phen byed kyi las rdzogs nas 'og mar ltung ba sogs khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal gtso che'o/ /mi la rtsa ba'i sdug bsngal skye rga na 'chi bzhi dang*/ yan lag gi sdug bsngal bsam las 'das pa kun gyis mthong snang du grub pa 'di bzhin/ 'gro ba rigs drug po so sor soms la/ mthar de dag gi sdug bsngal rang thog tu blang*/ de lta bu'i sdug bsngal myong bzhin pa'i sems can gcig gam/ yang na sems can bsad kha ma lta bur gcig dmigs yul du byas nas/ de gzhan zhig yin par mi bsams nas bdag gi ma rgan mo de yin/ nga'i ma rgan mo de nyes pa med par bzung la yan lag zhags thag gis bsdams/ zhu sa bshad sa med par ske gris bcad/ dbugs chad long med par sha gtor khrag gtor byas/ mer bsregs chur btsos nas ngan bsad btang na sdug bsngal ci 'dra yong bar 'dug gam snyam pa dang*/ yang na de nga rang yin na ci 'dra yong bar 'dug bsams nas sdug bsngal rang thog tu blang*/ de lta bu'i sdug bsngal myong bzhin pa'i sems can la bsams shing*/ de rnams bdag gi pha ma yin/ pha ma sems can de rnams sdug bsngal de dang bral na ci ma rung snyam pa'i snying rje dung nger sgoms/

yang ngas lam zab rdzogs pa chen po nyams su blangs nas/ 'gro kun sdug bsngal dang bral ba zhig bya'o snyam pa'i dam bca' drag po bzung*/ de de bzhin nus pa bla ma dang gu ru rin po che khyed mkhyen snyam pa'i gsol ba btab/ de bzhin 'byung bar shog snyam pa'i smon lam dang dge ba gzhan don du bsngo ba sogs sbyor dngos rjes gsum tshang bar bya'o/ khrid gzhan du thar pa'i phan yon dang bshes gnyen bsten pa gnyis po sa bcad so sor bstan pa yod mod/ 'dir sa bcad tha ma'i khongs su tshang bar ston par mdzad pa las/ de yang zhus ma thag pa'i sdug bsngal gyi rgyu kun 'byung las nyon gnyis lam bden gyis spang ba'i mthus sdug bsngal gyi rtsa ba chod/ 'gog pa'i bden pa mngon du byas shing nyan rang dgra bcom pa'i go 'phang ste 'khor bar slar mi ldog pa'i zhi ba bsil ba bde ba dam pa brnyes mod/ gzod theg chen la zhugs te spang bya phra ba spang zhing rtogs bya mthar thug rtogs dgos pas da dung bde ba'i mthar son pa ni min no/ /gang zhig shes rab bdag med rtogs pas srid mtha' spangs nas snying rje chen pos zhi mthar mi lhung bar gnyis la mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa ni mthar thug bde chen thar pa'i gling mchog kho na yin pas/ ga la ba der 'gro kun 'dren par nus pa'i ded dpon dam par bdag 'gyur ba zhig bya'o snyam pa'i dam bca' gnang ba gal che yang*/ de ltar byed nus pa'i rang stobs med de/ rang yang 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las ma brgal na gzhan thar pa'i skam sar ji ltar 'khrid/ des na thog mar rang nyid bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen la bsten dgos te/ gzhan don 'ba' zhig dgongs pa'i dus gsum rgyal ba rnams kyi spyi gzugs/ rang re snyigs ma'i 'gro ba 'dren pa'i ded dpon dam par dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi tshul du 'byon par gsungs pa yang*/ mdo las/ mya ngan ma byed kun dga' bo/ /smre sngags ma 'don kun dga' bo/

/nga nyid phyi ma'i dus kyi tshe/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen nyid sprul nas/ khyod la sogs par don byed 'gyur/ /gsungs pa des na mos gus drag pos gsol ba nga yis mi 'debs na su yis 'debs/ de'i phyir na snying nas gsol ba 'debs so bla ma dang gnyis su med pa o rgyan gu ru rin po che/ byin rlabs khyed la med na su la yod/ bdag gsol 'debs bu la da lta nyid du byin gyis rlobs shig dus gsum rgyal ba kun las kyang bka' drin mtshungs pa med pa rje btsun bla ma dam pa khyed las re ltos gzhan du bcol sa mi 'dug na/ khams gsum 'khor ba stongs nus par thugs rjes gzung du gsol snyam la ngag tu'ang*/ bla ma mkhyen no: lan gsum/ 'khor ba'i rang bzhin sdug bsngal khor mo yug: ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal brjod las 'das: mtho ris cung zad bde yang 'gyur ba'i chos: bde ba'i mthar son bde chen thar pa'i gling : 'gro kun 'dren pa'i ded dpon bdag 'gyur bar: gsol ba 'debs so gu ru rin po che: byin gyis rlobs shig bka' drin mtshungs med rje: khams gsum 'khor ba stongs par thugs rjes zungs: zhes brjod par bya'o/ /de ltar sbyor ba sems bskyed/ dngos gzhi nyams len/ rjes bsngo smon sogs zhib par sngar zhus pa bzhin rang rgyud la 'byor nges su blo sbyong zhun thar bcad pas/ 'khor bar nges 'byung dang sems can la snying rje bcos ma ma yin pa zhig rgyud du skye la/ de skyes phyin chad rtsol med kyi mos gus dang brtson 'grus ngam ngam shugs kyis 'byung ba ni nyams len gnad la song ba'i 'bras rtags ma nor ba yin la/ 'di ni skyes bu gsum sogs thun mong gi gzhi rten gal che bas gces spras chen pos nyams su blang bar mdzad 'tshal/ zhes thun mong phyi yi sngon 'gro'i lag khrid gdab pa man ngag gnad kyi gzer bu zhes bya ba rdzogs so/ /de nas thun min nang gi sngon 'gro gter kha gong ma las byung ba bzhin lam thams cad kyi rmang gzhi skyabs su 'gro ba/

theg chen lam gyi rtsa ba sems bskyed/ 'gal rkyen sdig sgrib sbyong ba rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas/ mthun rkyen tshogs gnyis bsag pa sku gsum zhing khams 'bul ba/ rtogs pa'i ye shes rgyud la btsan thabs su skyed par byed pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor sogs rje grub pa'i dbang phyug rig 'dzin hūm̐ chen 'gro 'dul lam/ bsam yas pa skyid grong thugs mchog rdo rjes mdzad par zhib gsal bzhugs pa bzhin bya dgos pas der gzigs par zhu'o/ /lag len bya srol yang gang gi gsung las skyes pa'i sras kyi thu bo padma dbang chen 'jigs med mkhyen brtse'i 'od zer brgyud pa dang bcas pa'i phyag bzhes/ kun mkhyen ngag gi dbang po'i man ngag zhag brgya ltar bgyis na thos bsam nyams len phrugs gcig tu 'gyur zhing*/ yangs dog gi mthar ma lhungs pa sogs khyad chos gzhan zla dang bral ba yin pa ma zad/ rigs bdag bla ma nas kyang de ltar bgyis na legs tshul bkas gnang ba mdzad pa de ltar/ 'dir sa bcad tsam smos na thun gyi cha gsum du byas pa'i cha gnyis phyi yi blo sbyong grangs bcad ltar bsgom/ cha gcig skyabs 'gro bsag pa yin la/ tshogs zhing kun 'dus nor bu'i lugs ltar bsgom zhing sngon 'gro 'dir yan lag bdun pa zur du med pas skyabs phyag sbrel la phyag gis grangs bzung*/ thun re'i mthar tshogs zhing rang la bsdus te bsngo smon dang bcas mi dmigs pa'i ngang la gzhag par bya'o/ /de nas sems bskyed skabs tshogs zhing dang thun gyi cha sogs gong zhus ltar cha snga mar tshad med bzhi dang bdag gzhan mnyam pa/ bdag gzhan brje ba/ bdag las gzhan gces sogs smon sems dang*/ 'jug pa'i sems phyin drug la rim gyis bslab/ cha rjes mar sems bskyed bsags/ mthar tshogs zhing rang la bsdus te mjug tu zhi lhag gi ting 'dzin ci nus bsgom/ bsngo smon sogs gong dang mtshungs/ sems bskyed khri bzhi tsam gyis chog

'di dag gi tshul rgyas pa zhal lung dang de'i zin bris sogs la zhib par gzigs 'tshal/ de nas bsags sbyang gi rim pa la/ rdor sems sgom bzlas skabs sngon 'gro phal che ba la rang tha mal du gsal la spyi bor bla ma rdor sems ye shes pa'i rnam par bsgom zhing stobs bzhi tshang ba'i bshags sdom dang bdud rtsi 'bebs sbyong gis sdig sgrib dag par byas te 'od zhu rnam pas rang rdor sems la gnas 'gyur bar sgom pa yin mod/ rang lugs khyad par ni/ gter gzhung las/ sngon 'gro 'dir theg pa rim dgu 'dus par bstan pa ltar na/ thun mong blo sbyong nyan rang theg pa dang*/ byang chub sems bskyed theg chen dang*/ rdor sems skabs rdo rje theg pa'i bskyed rdzogs dang*/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor skabs rtsol med rdzogs chen gyi don tshang bar gsungs pa bzhin skabs don bstan tshul dgongs pa mi 'dra ba'i khyad par shes par bya'o/ /de la 'dir dkyil 'khor gsum gyis gzhi 'cha' ba/ sems dpa' sum brtsegs su sgom pa/ khyer so gsum gyis 'gag sdom pa ni/ khrid gzhung na ches gsal bas de ltar bskyed rdzogs dang*/ yang snying yig drug dang*/ yig brgya gdam ka ru bstan 'dug pa bzhin snga ma ltar na 'bum drug phyi ma 'bum gcig kha skong bcas 'gro nges bya/ maṇḍal 'bul yul skyabs 'gro dang 'dra/ dmigs rnam gzhung du ches gsal ba bzhin no/ /lag len sprul sku'i maṇḍal tshom bu bdun/ longs sku la tshom bu lnga/ chos sku la gcig te thengs gcig la rdzogs par 'bul ba ci nus bya/ mthar mi dmigs par bsdu zhing*/ dge ba 'di yis skye bo kun/ /sogs bsngo smon dang bcas gong dang mtshungs/ grangs tshad 'bum gcig long bar bya/ khyad par zab lam bla ma'i rnal 'byor ni/ dmigs pa gzhung ltar gsal la mos gus kho nar rtsal 'don/ rdzogs chen 'khor 'das rang grol gter gzhung du/ gsol 'debs grangs bsags dang thugs yid bsres la dbang bzhi blang ba tsam las ma gsungs/

'on kyang gter chen rin po che pad rgyal gling pa'i zhal snga nas gsol 'debs 'gor/ tshig bdun gsol 'debs dang rjes su rdo rje 'bru bcu gnyis pa gsang ba spyi dang mthun par brgyan na/ byin rlabs kyi babs che la 'brel zab pas de ltar bya gsungs pa bzhin dkyus su bkod pa ltar siddhi phreng bskor re'i mtshams su gsol 'debs tshar re dang sbrag la gang nus bsags/ dbang bzhi blang ba dang thugs yid bsres la spros med rig pa'i ngang bskyang*/ de ltar nyung mthar siddhi 'bum bcu gsum 'grub par bya/ rjes su bsngo smon spyi dang sku gsum zhing sbyong smon lam grub mthar nyal ba'i rnal 'byor ni/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor rgyas bsdus gang rung bsgoms te gnyid 'od gsal du thim pa'i gsol ba drag tu btab pas bla ma spyi bor byon/ snying dbus padma dmar po 'dab brgyad kha phye ba'i nang du rdo rje 'chang gi sku shin tu phra bar bzhugs pa'i 'od zer gyis lus kyi nang gsal bar mos pa'i ngang nas gnyid log de'ang mi bde na thugs ka'i 'od zer snod bcud la phog pas lan tshwa chur zhu ba bzhin 'od du zhu nas rang lus la thim/ de thugs ka'i bla ma la thim/ de yang 'od lnga'i gong bu tshon gang ba zhig tu gyur par bsams te de la sems bzung*/ mthar de'ang mi dmigs pa'i ngang la bsdus nas gnyid du 'gro bar bya'o/ /des rmi lam dang gnyid 'od gsal du 'char ba'i dgos pa yod do/ /gal te btsan thabs 'chi ba sogs byung na bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgoms te gsol ba drag tu btab la/ bla ma mar mi bsdu bar rang sems bla ma'i thugs dang bsres/ bla ma spyi bo nas mda' 'phangs pa bzhin bde ba can du gshegs par mos shing*/ rang rig spro bsdu dang bral ba'i ngang la sa le seng nger gzhag par bya ba ni 'pho ba'i zab gnad kyang yin no/ /gzhan du za 'chag 'gro 'dug spyod lam thams cad bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang ma bral bar rgyun gyi nyams len la 'jug par bya'o/

/zhes pa 'di yang 'jam dpal dbyangs dngos 7chos kyi blo gros dang*/ 7'khor lo'i mgon po 'jigs med mkhyen rtse'i 'od zer sogs dam pa rnams kyis tshad ma'i gter chen du bsngags pa/ gnubs chen sangs rgyas ye shes kyi rnam 'phrul padma rgyal po 'gro 'dul gling pas gnas mchog padma bkod nas bzhes pa'i zab gter sku gsum dgongs 'dus kyi cha shas yin la/ phyis gter zhal thog mar phyes nas gtad rgya bka' gtad dang bcas smin grol chig rdzogs su bka' drin thob pa'i skal bzang nyams su myong ba'i skabs/ gter kha gong ma'i thun min sngon 'gro dang*/ phyi ma'i thun mong sngon 'gro gnyis ma bu gab sprod dgos tshul bka' phebs gnang ba bzhin/ rje nyid la de bzhin chog khrigs shig mdzad par gsol ba btab pas zhal bzhes thob/ de nas smin grol grub ma thag mon spa gro brag dkar dang nye ba'i spa gro cang du zhag bzhugs skabs/ phyag dpe rnams kha phyes te 'di ltar dgos par 'dug ces bka' stsal zhib mo dang bcas/ da khyod kyis 'di la 'grel pa zhib rgyas shig bris zhes gsungs pa'i skabs der*/ bu mo zhig bla ma la mjal dar dang shing tog sder ma gang phul song bas rten 'brel bzang gsungs/ kha stong pas zhu mi rung bas 'di maṇḍal yin gsungs te phran la mar gnang nas de ring min ma gsungs dang rten 'brel gyi babs shig yod ces gsungs pas ci zhu ma nus/ de nas mi ring bar rje nyid zhi bar gshegs pas phyi mthar gzigs te kho bo'i bgo skal du gdams par go yang*/ deng sang dam pa'i gsung rab rin chen thang mar brdal ba la spyan ras g.yo ba lhod na/ bdag 'dras 'bri ba la don gyis dben snyam yun ring rnam g.yeng du lus pa'i mthar/ rdo rje 'chang gi bka' las 'gong pa'i nyes pa mi bzad pa'i khur gyis non pa mthong nas gnong 'gyod dang bcas/ rtsa ba rdo rje'i tshig la nyung ngus 'grel pa thun mong phyi yi sngon 'gro'i lag khrid gdab pa man ngag gnad kyi gzer bu zhes bya ba 'di'ang*/

gter chen bla ma'i zhal snga nas chos bdag gu hyas mtshan can zhes ming gi cod pan dpyangs shing*/ da lta nyam chung yang slad nas gter kha gong 'og gcig gyur gyi phrin las gsar pa'i sgo 'phar kha ba'i ljongs su dbye ba'i byed po ru rdo rje'i lung gis zin tshul 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i dbus su bka' stsal pas mtshon/ thun min thugs brtses bskyangs kyang don la 'phags pa'i nor gyis dbul la/ bgrang bya'i khur gyis dud cing skyes sbyang yon tan gyi nar ma son pa'i rgan bu byis pa'i ngang tshul can/ o rgyan gsang sngags bstan 'dzin nam sgo chen sprul ming du 'bod pas/ rab gnas chu lug lo bod zla bcu pa'i tshes brgyad la grub par bgyis shing*/ slar gcung mkhan po ngag dbang dge legs mchog nas dag zhus legs par gnang ba thugs rje che zhu rgyu dang*/ 'di ltar bgyis pa'i dge bas dpal ldan bla ma'i thugs dgongs yongs su rdzogs pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ //

nga)༄༅/ /rdzogs pa chen po 'khor 'das rang grol gyi/ sngon 'gro zab don rin po che'i sgron me bzhugs so/ / gdod nas rnam dag zag med kun tu bzang*/ /rang bzhin thugs rje'i rnam rol mtha' yas gar/ /zhing 'di'i 'gro mgon o rgyan padma la/ /mi phyed gdung ba'i yid kyis phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /'dir rdzogs chen 'khor 'das rang grol gyi thun mong ma yin pa nang gi sngon 'gro'i lag khrid bkod pa la bdun/ 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho las skyob par byed pa skyabs 'gro'i khrid/ theg chen byang chub mchog la sbyor ba sems bskyed kyi khrid/ 'gal rkyen sdig sgrib sbyong ba rdor sems kyi khrid/ mthun rkyen tshogs gnyis bsag pa maṇḍal gyi khrid/ byin rlabs myur du 'jug pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi khrid/ mtha' rten sngon 'gro'i dgos ched/ thun mthar smon lam gyis bsdu ba dang bdun no/ /dang po chos thams cad kyi gzhi rten lam log pa las khyad par gyur pa skyabs su 'gro ba'i khrid la lnga/ gang la skyabs su 'gro ba'i yul/ 'gro ba po'i gang zag tshul ji ltar 'gro ba/ skyabs 'og tu tshud pa'i rtags tshad/ bslab bya'i phan yon bstan pa'o/ /dang po thun mong phyi yi skyabs yul dkon mchog gsum/ khyad par nang gi skyabs yul rtsa ba gsum/ bla med gsang ba'i skyabs yul sku gsum/ de kho na nyid kyi skyabs yul rig pa sku bzhi'i bdag nyid do/ /de ltar rgyu'i skyabs 'gro dang 'bras bu skyob byed zung du 'jug pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs rje sprul pa sku bzhi ye shes lnga'i bdag nyid gdul bya'i snang ngor rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma de kho na skyabs gnas kun 'dus kyi ngo bo yin te/ thugs yang dag pa sangs rgyas/ gsung 'gag med chos dbyings su sgrog pa dam pa'i chos/ sku snang la rang bzhin med pa dge 'dun/ de bzhin du rtsa khams bla ma/ rlung khams yi dam/ thig le mkha' 'gro dang*/

thugs chos sku/ gsung longs sku/ sku sprul sku ste gang la ci 'dul gyi thugs rje'i rol pa mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i rang bzhin can/ de yang rang shes rig pa'i ngo bo las logs su ma grub pas/ phyi nang gsang ba dbyer med de bzhin nyid du gsal gdab pa ni/ rnam dag mdun gyi nam mkhar 'ja' 'od klong : bde gshegs kun 'dus rtsa ba'i bla ma rje: rdo rje thod phreng mthing gsal rdor dril bsnol: lha lcam dmar mo rdo rje tshe bum bsnams: gnyis med 'khyud sbyor bdai chen longs spyod rdzogs: rtsa gsum lha tshogs rab 'byams rgyal kun gtibs: nam mkhas gar khyab thugs rje'i 'od zer 'bar: bdag dang 'gro kun byang chub ma thob bar: rtse gcig mos gus gdung bas skyabs su 'gro: zhes pas rang tha mal du gnas pa'i mdun gyi nam mkhar chos dbyings rnam par dag pa'i rang mdangs/ thugs rje ye shes lnga'i 'od zer mtha' dang mu med par 'byams klas pa'i dbus su/ 'ja' 'od las grub pa'i padma'i gdan yangs shing rgya che ba zhig gi khar/ zla ba'i gdan de dang rgya khyon mnyam pa bde zhing 'jam pa dpag tshad kyi khyon tsam pa'i steng du/ drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma de nyid bde gshegs kun 'dus rdo rje thod phreng gi cha byad can sku mdog mthing gsal nam mkha'i mdog ltar dwangs pa/ zhal mdzes 'dzum lta bas chog mi shes pa/ dar zab sna tshogs kyi stod g.yogs dang sham thabs/ rin po che'i dbu rgyan/ snyan rgyan/ mgul rgyan/ do shal/ dpung rgyan/ se mo do/ phyag gdub/ zhabs gdub sogs longs spyod rdzogs sku'i cha lugs yongs su rdzogs pa/ phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu thugs kar bsnol ba/ zhabs rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'i pang du bde chen 'du 'bral med pa'i yum mchog manda ra ba dmar mo rdo rje dang tshe bum 'dzin pas mgul nas 'khyud cing*/ yab yum gnyis ka snang la rang bzhin ma grub pa ye shes kyi bkrag dang gzi mdangs ltar mi bzod pa'i rang mdangs/

thugs rje'i rol pa ma 'gags pa'i snang cha brgyud gsum gyi bla ma rgya mtsho/ yi dam zhi khro rab 'byams/ mkha' 'gro bka' srung dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa ngo bo gcig gi sgyu 'phrul nyi ma la zer 'phro ba ltar/ nam mkhas gar khyab tu thugs rje'i 'od zer 'bar bas khams gsum gyi sems can ma rig pa'i bag chags shugs la sangs te/ mos gus kyi gdung ba lhang gis skye bar bsam mo/ /gnyis pa skyabs su 'gro ba po'i gang zag ni/ phyi ltar du nyan rang*/ nang ltar du byang sems/ gsang ba ltar du sngags kyi rig 'dzin/ de kho na nyid la a ti'i rnal 'byor te/ rig pas gar khyab 'byung bas khyab cing*/ 'byung bas khyab tshad las dang nyon mongs pa'i sems kyis khyab pa thams cad do/ /gsum pa ji ltar skyabs su 'gro tshul ni/ bdag dang mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad bde ba 'ba' zhig 'dod pa la/ ma rig pa'i dbang gis lag len go ldog tu spyad pas sdug bsngal 'ba' zhig la spyod dgos pa 'di dag me 'obs sam btson dong du tshud pa lta bu'i 'khor ba 'di las skyabs gnas dam pa khyed kyi thugs rje'i brtse ba chen pos rnam mkhyen sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang la 'god par mdzad du gsol snyam pas/ dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po ma thob kyi bar du skyid sdug legs nyes ci ltar byung yang khyed shes kyi blo ling bskyur du bkal la gsal stong dbyer med kyi ngang nas/ na mo: dbyings rig dbyer med rtsa ba gsum: ye nas mchog gsum sku gsum bdag: phyi nang mi dmigs zang thal sku: 'bad rtsol bral bar skyabs su mchi: zhes bdag gzhan sems can thams cad kyi kha tsam tshig tsam ma yin par snying thag pa nas gsol ba phur tshugs su gdab cing*/ thun bsdu khar skyabs yul las 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis sems can rnams kyi sdig sgrib dag nas byang chub thob/ skyabs yul 'od du zhu ba rang la thim pas rang yang 'od phung du yal te/

bdag dang skyabs gnas sems can gsum ka byed po gnyis med blo bral bde ba chen por gnas pa ni don gyi skyabs 'gro byed do/ /nyal ba'i tshe yang skyabs yul gsal btab cing nyal bas gnyid 'od gsal du 'char/ 'gro ba'i tshe g.yas su yod par bsam pas bskor bar 'gro'o/ /bzhi pa skyabs 'og tu tshud pa'i rtags tshad ni/ gzhung las/ yid ches nges shes tshad du long bar bya: zhes dang*/ phur pa thugs thig gi gter sgrub las/ nyin mtshan kha zhe med par rtse gcig tu: de ltar yang dang yang du gus btud de: skyabs 'gro bgyis pas skyabs 'og tshud pa'i rtags: phyi nang gsang ba gsum las dang po ni: phyi ltar bya ba gang bsam thams cad 'grub: nad ro rnying pa byang zhing khams bde la: zhe sdang dgra bo rnams kyang rang bzhin yal: rims nad gseb tu phyin kyang nad mi 'go: gzhan la byin rlabs byas pa tsam gyis phan: nang rtags skyabs gnas dkon mchog dran tsam la: khyed shes blo 'khel shes pa bde 'bol 'gro: snang ba dga' yal gsal stong 'dzin med ngang : mthong tshad gzugs sdug grags tshad sgra snyan dang : tshor ba'i dri zhim myong ba'i ro bda' zhing : reg 'jam bde ba'i tshogs drug longs spyod rnams: 'byor tshad dkon mchog gsum la 'bul blo skye: gsang rtags rang nyid chu dang rbab g.yang sogs: lhung la khad la gzhan gyis thon pa dang : pha rol dgra 'dud rang gi dpung rogs 'byung : rdzong btsan bzung dang go gyon mtshon thogs sogs: de ltar phyi nang gsang ba'i rtags: ma byung bar du yang yang bskyar: skyabs 'gro tshad du long bar bya: zhes so/ /lnga pa bslab bya dang phan yon gnyis las/ dang po bslab bya la dgag sgrub gnyis te/ dgag bya sangs rgyas la skyabs su song nas gu lang khyab 'jug sogs 'jig rten pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal na sdom pa nyams/ skyabs su song na yongs su 'chor/ chos la skyabs su song nas sems can la rnam par 'tshe ba gtan nas ma spangs na sdom pa nyams shing*/

srog bcad na yongs su 'chor/ dge 'dun la skyabs su song nas las 'bras la mi rtsi ba'i log lta mu stegs can dang 'grogs na sdom pa nyams shing*/ de dang lta spyod mthun na yongs su 'chor/ bla ma la skyabs su song nas log lta skad cig tsam yang ma shor bar bya/ yi dam la skyabs su song nas snod bcud thams cad tha mal a 'thas su mi blta/ mkha' 'gro la skyabs su song nas 'dod chags rang kha la mi btang*/ chos sku la skyabs su song nas lta ba rtag chad du mi blta/ longs sku la skyabs su song nas sgom pa bying rgod du mi btang*/ sprul sku la skyabs su song nas spyod pa sdig dang ma 'dres pa gal che'o/ /sgrub pa'i bslab bya ni/ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs bcol nas rgyal ba'i sku gzugs bris 'bur sātstsha yan chad la phyag mchod bkur sti'i gnas su byed/ lung gi chos sde snod gsum rgyud sde bzhi rdzogs chen rgyud 'bum phrag drug cu rtsa bzhi sogs mdor na yi ge na gcig tsam la'ang gus par bya ba dang*/ dgra bcom pa rang rgyal la sogs te gos ser por gyon pa tsam la'ang bdag gi sangs rgyas kyi nyan thos yin snyam pas phyag dang bkur sti bya'o/ /rtsa ba gsum la skyabs bcol nas bla ma spyi bo dang snying khar bsgom zhing sangs rgyas dngos las lhag pa'i 'du shes rgyun chad med pa dang*/ yi dam gyi bskyed rim bzlas brjod kyi thun mi bcag mkha' 'gro lus dang grib bzhin mi 'bral bar bde stong tshogs gtor rgyun mi bcad/ sku gsum la skyabs bcol nas/ lta ba 'khor 'das ro mnyam/ sgom pa gtad med lhug pa/ spyod pa nyams myong rgyun chad med par spyod lam kun tu 'dres par bya'o/ /gnyis pa phan yon ni/ de ltar dkon mchog la kha zhe ngo lkog med par skyabs su song nas blo khel na/ gnas skabs su me chu dug mtshon/ rgyal po'i chad pa/ lha srin sde brgyad kyi gnod pa/ dus min du 'chi ba sogs rkyen ngan thams cad dang ngan song gi sdug bsngal las skyob cing*/

tshe dpal stobs 'byor legs dgu bskyed de ci bsam don du 'grub/ mthar thug sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa'i bgrod lam du 'gyur ba sogs phan yon dpag tu med de/ gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i mdo las/ skyabs song 'di la gzugs mchis na/ /nam mkha' 'di yang snod du chung*/ /rgya mtsho chen po chu yi gter/ /phud la gzhal bas zad mi shes/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi thugs rje'i sprul bsgyur gyis rgya mtsho'i chu de nyid phud la gzhal na zad par 'gyur la/ gang la skyabs su song ba'i phan yon ni/ de dag rnams kyis kyang gzhal bar mi nus pas skyabs su 'gro ba ci nas kyang gal che'o/ /gnyis pa lam dman pa las khyad par du gyur pa byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa ni/ gzhung las/ gnyis pa theg chen byang chub mchog sems bskyed: bdag pas gzhan gces stong nyid snying rje ldan: ma rig 'khor ba'i sems can ma lus pa: yang dag mchog tu 'god phyir smon 'jug sems: don dam gnyis med blo bral bde bar gnas: zhes pas theg chen gyi rtsa ba sems bskyed kho na la rag las shing*/ de la smon 'jug don dam gsum las/ smon pa ni/ padma brtsegs pa'i rgyud las/ sems can don la smon byed pa/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas myur lam yin/ /zhes pa'o/ /'jug pa dang don dam sems bskyed ni/ mngon rtogs rgyan las/ sems bskyed pa ni gzhan don phyir/ /yang dag rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'dod/ /ces dang*/ 'od srung gis zhus pa/ bcom ldan 'das sems bskyed chen po zhes pa gang lags/ bka' stsal pa/ dmigs pa dang bral ba ni sems bskyed chen po'o/ /zhes gsungs pas/ 'di la bzhi/ sems bskyed rgyud la blang ba/ nyams su longs pa'i rtags tshad/ mi nyams pa brten phyir srung mtshams/ bden 'bras phan yon no/ /dang po ni/ dman pa zhes rang nyid kho na zhi bde don du mi gnyer bar/ khyad par du gyur pa gzhan don lhur blang ba la/

kun rdzob smon 'jug dang don dam dbyer med zung du 'jug pa ste/ skyabs yul sngar ltar dpang por dmigs la/ nam mkhas gar khyab kyi sems can thams cad bdag gi tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas da lta'i bar du pha mar ma gyur pa ni gcig kyang med la/ tshe 'di'i pha mas ji ltar bskyangs pa bzhin/ skye ba gzhan gyi pha mas kyang bskyangs pa gzhir bcas pa/ tshe 'di'i pha ma dang skye ba gzhan gyi pha mar nye ring byed pa ci nas kyang mi 'os te/ kun la mnyam zhing snyoms pas sems sgom pa ni btam̐ng snyomam̐s so/ /bdag gi pha ma 'di rnams 'khrul snang 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las da lta nyid du thar na snyam pas gdung ba ni byam̐ms pam̐/ 'di rnams 'dod pa bde ba kho na 'dod kyang bzang po'i bag chags shas chung bas/ dge ba'i las phra mo tsam yang 'grub par dka' zhing*/ nyon mongs pa'i bag chags ni goms pa klong du gyur pa'i mthus nag po sdig pa'i las zhor la bsags shing*/ zhe 'dod dang lag len go ldog tu gyur pas sdug bsngal zad mtha' med par myong ba 'di rnams 'dor ba phod dam snyam pa shas mi bzod pa ni snyingam̐ rjem̐/ sems can la phan na rang srog kyang 'dor nus pa'i gtong phod kyis sems can thams cad bde ba dang ldan/ sdug bsngal dang bral ba ni dgam̐' bam̐ ste tshig tsam min par rgyud la skye bar bya ste/ 'di rnams sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang la 'god phyir/ bdag gis rdzogs pa chen po nyams su blang bar bya snyam pa ni smom̐n pam̐ ste/ da lta bdag la 'gro ba 'dren pa'i nus pa med kyang rdzogs pa chen po'i nyams len gyi sgo nas rang nyid sangs rgyas bsgrub ste/ sems can thams cad 'dren par byed pa'i blos nyin mtshan ris med du brtson 'grus mgo la me shor ba ltar/ skad cig kyang mi dal bar rdo rje snying po nyams su len pa ni 'jum̐g pam̐ sems bskyed de/ stong pa'i rang rtsal sems can thams cad la snying rje'i zer gyis khyab pa ni dom̐n dam̐m sem̐ms bskyedam̐ do/

/smon 'jug don dam zung du 'jug pas/ hoḥ gdod nas dag pa chos dbyings klong : ma rtogs sems can rgyud drug rnams: rnam thar byang chub lam 'god phyir: blo 'das de bzhin sems bskyed do: zhes ci nus su brjod cing rlung phyir btang ba'i tshe rang gi bde dga'i dpal thams cad thon nas 'gro drug gi sems can thams cad la thim pas bde ba dang ldan par bsam/ rlung tshur rngub pa'i tshe sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib nad gdon sdug bsngal ma lus pa tshur byung ste rang la thim pas sems can sdug bsngal dang bral cing bdag gi tshe rabs kyi lan chags byang*/ mthar tshogs zhing las 'od 'phros pas sems can thams cad la phog pas las dang bag chags kyi snang ba skad cig la dag ste/ bya khyu la 'ur rdo brgyab pa ltar dag pa'i zhing la 'ur dir gyis 'phur nas/ sems can gcig kyang ma lus par 'khor ba rtsad nas stongs pa'i 'jug pa dang*/ mthar skyabs yul rang la thim pas/ skyabs gnas kyi thugs rje ye shes dang*/ bdag gi byang chub kyi sems dang*/ yul sems can gnyis su med pa'i sems nyid cir yang ma grub mtha' bral dmigs med du 'jog pa ni btang snyoms don dam pa'o/ /gnyis pa sems bskyed 'byongs pa'i rtags tshad ni/ gter sgrub las/ sems bskyed tshad du 'byongs pa'i rtags: bdag 'dzin mngon zhen snang ba nub: gang dag dbul phongs dman mthong na: sbyin dang dpung gnyen 'bangs blo 'char: rmi lam du yang 'phrang chu sogs: rbab g.yang 'jigs pa'i rkyen rnams la: gzhan gyi skyabs dang dpung gnyen byed: byin rlabs thod rgal 'byung ba'i rtags: mi mang 'du zhing kun gyis bkur: gru grol mnyan pa byed pa dang : gnag phyugs khyu chen 'tsho ba dang : kun gyi ded dpon byed pa sogs: 'gro ba mang po 'dren pa'i rtags: rang lus rdul phran gtong ba ni: bdag tu 'dzin pa spangs pa'i rtags: rang las byung ba'i rdzas rnams la: sems can mang po'i spyod pa ni:

snying po'i 'gro don mthar phyin rtags: glegs bam phyogs bcur gtor ba ni: 'gro don bstan pa rgyas pa'i rtags: mchod rten brtsigs dang sku dkar gsol: sgrub brgyud bstan pa tshugs pa'i rtags: 'gro ba mang po'i snying khrag 'thung : srog dbugs rngub dang dmag dpung bkye: 'brel tshad don dang ldan pa'i rtags: de ltar rang rtags rnams gang rung : ma byung bar du 'bad par brtsam: mdor na bdag pas gzhan gces kyi: bsam pa gting nas skyes pa na: 'gro don phrin las thogs med 'byung : de min stong nyid don rtogs kyang : gzhan don rgya chen mi 'byung bas: sems bskyed smon lam rgya chen 'bad: stong nyid snying rje zung 'brel bas: dus gsum rgyal ba'i gdung brgyud 'dzin: zhes gsungs so/ /gsum pa sems bskyed kyi bslab bya ni/ spyir mi dge bcu spang zhing*/ dge bcu phar phyin bcu la spyod pa sogs rgyas par dbye na mtha' yas kyang*/ mdor na rab sems can re'i don du yang phan par 'dug na rang gi lus srog phangs med du gtong ba dang*/ 'bring bdag pas gzhan gces kyi blos rang 'dod bor la gzhan don gsal bar spyod/ tha mas kyang rang gzhan mnyam pa'i 'du shes tsam zhig ma byas na sems bskyed kyi dam tshig 'pho ba yin no/ /bzhi pa bden 'bras ni/ de lta bu'i sngar sems ma bskyed pa bskyed pa'i phan yon ni/ spyod 'jug las/ sems 'di yang dag blangs gyur na/ /de nas bzung ste gnyid log gam/ /bag med gyur kyang bsod nams shugs/ /rgyun ma'i chad pa du ma zhig /nam mkha' mnyam pa rab tu 'byung*/ /zhes dang*/ phyag chen ye shes mthong grol las/ de ltar sems bskyed bslabs pa'i phan yon ni/ nyan rang las ni ches lhag

byang sems bskyed ma thag pa'i yon tan gyi sgo nas nyan rang sogs zil gyis mi non yang*/ rigs kyi sgo nas zil gyis gnon par 'gyur te/ dper na rgyal po'i bu btsas ma thag pas kyang yon tan gyis mi non yang rigs kyi sgo nas blon po sogs chen po rnams zil gyis gnon par 'gyur ba bzhin no/ */mchan/ theg chen tshud: nyon mongs sdig sgrib ma lus rtsad nas gcod: sgo gsum bya las thams cad don ldan pas: bsod nams tshogs chen rdzogs par 'gyur ba dang : skyabs gyur kun gyis rtag tu dgongs pa dang : sems can kun gyis brtse zhing yid du 'ong : sangs rgyas yon tan yid bzhin myur du 'grub: mngon par rdzogs sangs rgyas sogs bsam mi khyab: ces gsungs so/ /gsum pa 'gal rkyen sdig sgrib sbyong ba rdor sems sgom bzlas ni/ gzhung las/ gsum pa sgrib sbyong bdag nyid rdo rje sems: thugs srog sngags phreng 'od kyis sdig ltung sbyangs: slar yang 'od 'phros snang srid sems dpar gsal: om̐ badzra sa twa āḥ brgya stong khri 'bum bye ba rtags tshad bstun: 'khor 'das 'ub chud ka dag ngang du'o: zhes nyams rtogs khyad par can skye ba la bar du gcod pa sdig sgrib yin te/ de nyid sbyong ba la dkyil 'khor gsum gyis gzhi bca' ba/ 'khyer so gsum gyis 'gag bsdam pa/ sgrib pa sbyangs pa'i rtags tshad ldan 'bras phan yon no/ /dang po ni/ sna tshogs padma dang zla ba'i steng du bdag nyid dpal rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar gsal 'od kyi phung po zhal gcig phyag gnyis zhi tshul dgu ldan/ phyag g.yas gser gyi rdo rje rtse lnga pa thugs kar 'degs pa'i tshul gyis 'dzin pa/ g.yon dngul dkar gyi dril bu dkur brten pa/ gser g.yu mu tig sogs rin po che'i dbu rgyan/ snyan rgyan/ mgul rgyan/ dpung rgyan/ phyag gdub/ zhabs gdub/ do shal/ se mo do sogs rin po che'i rgyan bdun/

sku yi stod g.yogs dar dkar/ gsung gi chos dar dmar gyi ga shal/ thugs kyi zi ldir mthing ka yon tan ska rags gser mdog phrin las gsang gos mar gad/ gar gyi phu dung ljang khu dang drug ste zhi rgyan bcu gsum gyis mdzes shing*/ dbu skra zur phud thor cog gsum la nor bu'i tog gis spras pa/ lhag ma zur bu lnga dpung pa g.yas g.yon gyi steng du 'phyang ba/ zhabs rdo rje skyil mo krung gis 'ja' tshon 'od lnga'i klong na bkra gsal ler bzhugs pa/ de'i thugs kar dwangs ma lnga ldan gyi 'od dpung 'khrigs pa'i klong du drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma de nyid mtsho skyes rdo rje lo brgyad gzhon nu'i rnam pa/ gcer bu rus rgyan skyil krung mnyam bzhag can/ zla zhun 'bum gyi lhun po ltar bkra gsal gzi brjid bltar mi bzod pa'i thugs kar/ ye shes kyi snying po skye med āḥyig dkar po 'od lnga 'khrugs pa'i mtha' bskor du yi ge brgya pa'am/ 'bru lnga rang sgra dang bcas te g.yas su 'khor ba la ting 'dzin gsal brtan du gyur pa dang*/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba thams cad mchod/ de dag gi byin rlabs ma lus pa sku dang yig 'bru phyag mtshan gyi rnam pa mkha' dbyings gang bar byung ba thugs srog sngags phreng la thim pas/ bde gshegs kun gyi mthu stobs nus rtsal ma lus pa bdag nyid la rdzogs te/ sngags phreng gi 'od zer gyis lus kyi nang khengs/ nad gdon sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa ba spu'i bu ga nas sangs kyis dag rang lus sgrib bral snang stong rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor/ ngag grags stong sngags kyi dkyil 'khor/ sems gsal stong chos nyid kyi dkyil 'khor te/ dkyil 'khor gsum gyi ngang nas yig brgya dang 'bru lnga ci rigs par bzla ba ni bdag don byin rlabs kyi bsnyen pa'o/ /gnyis pa 'khyer so gsum gyis 'gag bsdam pa ni/ thugs ka'i rtsa ba'i bla ma la dang ba'i mos gus tshad med bskyed cing*/

thugs dam bskul ba'i tshul du 'dzab bzlas pas thugs rje'i dpung g.yos te/ thugs srog sngags phreng las 'od zer gyi phung po cher 'bar te/ sku yongs su rdzogs pa 'od kyi phung po gcig tu gyur pa las 'od zer stobs cher bskyed pas/ bdag nyid rdo rje sems dpa'i sku yang 'od phung du 'khyil ba'i zer gyis khams gsum gyi gnas thams cad cig car du khyab pas/ rigs drug gi sdug bsngal thams cad bde bar sbyangs te rang rig ye shes kyi dran pa lhang gis rtogs nas/ kun kyang rdo rje sems dpa'i skur gyur te stong gsum thams cad yig brgya'i sngags sgra di ri ri bsgrags shing 'od zer cher 'bar bas/ phyi snod kyi 'jig rten thams cad 'ja' 'od lnga ldan gyi gzhal yas khang du gyur/ mdor na gzugs su snang tshad thams cad rdo rje sems dpa'i sku ru shig shig sgra ru grags tshad thams cad badzra sa twa'i rang sgra 'ur 'ur/ dran rtog thams cad chos nyid kyi rol pa chen por lam du 'khyer ba ste 'khyer so gsum gyi 'gag bsdam pa'o/ /de ltar gsal gdab pa'i tshig gzhan du gsal bar mi snang yang*/ gter sgrub las/ āḥ bdag lus snang stong rdo rje sems dpa'i sku: dkar gsal 'od phung rdo rje dril bu 'dzin: longs spyod rdzogs sku pad zlar skyil krung bzhugs: thugs mchog dwangs ma lnga ldan 'od dpung klong : rtsa ba'i bla ma o rgyan rin po che: gcer bu rus rgyan zla zhun 'bum gyi lhun: skyil krung mnyam bzhag thugs kar zla ba'i steng : skye med āḥyig mtha' mar yig brgyas bskor: de las 'od 'phros phyogs bcu'i zhing kun mchod: thugs rje'i byin bsdus nus stobs tshad med bskyed: nad gdon sdig sgrib bag chags bcas par sbyangs: 'od zer mar 'phros khams gsum rigs drug gi: duḥkha kun bsal phan bde'i stobs bskyed de: dran snang rang rig rgyal ba'i dgongs pa rtogs:

snod kyi 'jig rten mngon par dga' ba'i zhing : bcud kyi gzugs snang rdo rje sems dpa'i sku: sgra grags thams cad rang byung snying po'i gdangs: dran rtog thams cad chos dbyings skye 'gag bral: rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs su lhun grub gyur: zhes yig brgya dang yang snying 'bru lnga sogs ci nus su bzla'o/ /thun mtshams su snod bcud gzhal yas lha dang bcas pa bdag gi thugs ka'i āḥl bsdu zhing dran rig mi rtog pa'i ngang la bzhag go /gsum pa sdig sgrib sbyangs pa'i rtags tshad ni: gter sgrub las/ de ltar rtse gcig 'bad pa yis: phyi nang gsang ba'i rtags gsum 'byung : phyi rtags lus yangs gnyid chung zhing : khams bde dwangs spro shes pa gsal: lus kyi mngon zhen bdag 'dzin chung : phyi nang 'bu srin nad rnams sbyangs: yang na shi nad drag po thebs: nad gdon gsar rnying 'thab pas mnar: ma nyes kha yog drag po phog: slong ba'i rtags te 'bad pas bsnyen: nang rtags khrus byas gos gsar gyon: chu bo sgrol dang gru zam bgrod: gcer bu bud dang lus bsregs gtor: ma he glang rgod mi nag thul: sdig sgrib mngon zhen dag pa'i rtags: lus las rnag khrag 'dzag pa dang : ngan skyug bshal sogs nad thon rtags: sbal sbrul sdom sdig nya lcong sogs: srog chags thon sogs gdon thon rtags: ri rtse mthon por bud pa dang : mthong snang yangs la rgya cher bltas: chos la go ba skyes pa'i rtags: gsang rtags me tog sna tshogs 'thu: ro bda' bza' btung longs spyod pa: nyams myong bzang po 'phel ba'i rtags: nam mkha'i skas la 'dzegs pa dang : bar snang 'phur sogs sa non rtags: gter rnyed shel rdo po ti blangs: ma bslabs chos mdzod rdol ba'i rtags: rgyan gos gzab dang mi mang 'du: khrir 'dug dung 'bud skad chen sgrog: dngos grub myur du thob pa'i rtags: de ltar rtags gsum gang rung re: ma byung bar du 'bad pa bskyed:

ces so/ /bzhi pa bden 'bras phan yon bstan pa ni/ ka wa tsi gharba bstan pa'i rgyud las/ sangs rgyas ma lus thams cad kyi/ /re re'i bskyed rdzogs bsam las 'das/ /ma lus kun 'grub 'di ltar bya/ /hūm̐ las bla ma rdo rje sems/ /zhes sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus par bstan pa dang*/ yi ge brgya pa yang*/ rdo rje sems dpa'i glu yi rgyud las/ rang byung thig le yi ge brgya/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi sa bon te/ /nyon mongs thams cad 'joms par byed/ /ces dang*/ me long bkod pa'i rgyud las/ bla ma rdo rje sems bsgoms nas/ /rang byung yi ge brgya yi mthus/ /sgrib pa rnam gnyis byang bar 'gyur/ /zhes so/ /de ltar sgrib pa ma sbyangs na mi 'dag ste/ las brgya pa'i mdo las/ lus can rnams kyi las rnams ni/ /bskal pa brgya yang chud mi za/ /tshogs shing dus la bab pa na/ /'bras bu nyid du smin par 'gyur/ /zhes dang*/ bskal par bsags pa'i sdig ltung yang bskyed rdzogs zab mos sbyangs na skad cig la zad par 'gyur te/ don dam gsal ba'i tshigs su bcad pa las/ sgrib pa kun rdzob nyid yin phyir/ /sbyangs na 'dag par gdon mi za/ /zhes gsungs so/ /bzhi pa mthun rkyen tshogs gnyis rdzogs par byed pa maṇḍal ni/ gzhung las/ bzhi pa tshogs bsags maṇḍal 'byor tshogs kun: dngos bshams blos sprul sku gsum zhing ma luus: rgyal kun 'dus pa bla ma'i 'khor lor 'bul: zhes pas/ 'di la bzhi/ sgrub pa rten gyi maṇḍal/ 'bul ba mchod pa'i maṇḍal/ tshogs rdzogs pa drod rtags kyi mtshan ma/ dgos ched phan yon bstan pa'o/ /dang po ni/ tshogs gsog gi dpang por skyabs yul gsal btab pa gong ltar ro/ /gnyis pa mchod pa'i maṇḍal ni/ rin po che dang rdo shing rdza sogs gang rung ba'i maṇḍal la/ rin chen 'bru sman ci 'byor gyis tshom bu so bdun ma spyi ltar bkod la ji ltar 'bul tshul la/ phyi nang gsang gsum las/ dang po phyi yi maṇḍal ni/

rang gis yongs su bzung ba'i zang zing dngos po gang yod kyis mtshon/ gling bzhi ri rab lcags ri mu khyud lha mi'i 'dod yon ji snyed dang bcas pa/ stong gsum bye ba phrag brgya'i zhing khams rab 'byams rgya mtsho ma lus shing lus pa med pa bsam 'phel dgos 'byung gi phung po 'bar ba/ yul 'gro ba gang 'dul der ston gyi sprul pa'i sku rtsa ba'i bla ma thugs rje can la 'bul ba'o/ /gnyis pa longs sku'i maṇḍal ni/ 'byung bzhi 'dus pa rang gzugs kyi phung po/ rnam shes kyi phung po/ tshor ba'i phung po/ 'du shes kyi phung po/ 'du byed kyi phung po ste lnga'i byed po yan lag lnga'i maṇḍal la/ snying gi dbang po lce/ glo ba'i dbang po sna/ mchin pa'i dbang po mig /mkhal ma'i dbang po rna ba/ mtsher pa'i dbang po mchu ste dbang po lngas brgyan zhing*/ mig gi sgo gzugs kyi me tog /rna ba'i sgo sgra yi me tog /sna yi sgo dri yi me tog /lce yi sgo ro yi me tog /lus kyi sgo reg bya'i me tog ste 'ja' 'od sna lnga'i tshom bu'am/ sa chu me rlung nam mkha' lnga'i mdangs las sha khrag drod dbugs rnams dang*/ mgo lus ri rab/ yan lag gling bzhi/ mig gnyis nyi zla/ kha dog bkrag mdangs gzi brjid kyi tshom bu shig ge yul tshangs pa rnga sgra'i zhing dang*/ rang snang bla ma sku lnga rigs 'dus kyi dkyil 'khor la/ tshul rang lus kyi bdag 'dzin btang ste ltos med du 'bul ba'o/ /gsum pa chos sku'i maṇḍal ni/ snang srid snod bcud yod med rtag chad kyi chos thams cad ye nas rnam par dag pa gzung 'dzin gyi dri mas ma gos shing*/ gdos gzhi thams cad dang bral ba/ chos kyi dbyings kun la khyab cing brdal ba khor yug yangs pa'i maṇḍal kun nas zlum pa'i klong du rig pa rdo rje luu gu rgyud kyi skus brgyan cing*/ ka dag brjod bral 'dus ma byas kyi tshom bu shig ge yul bla ma chos sku nam mkha' bzhin dbye ba med par/

tshul stong pa nyid la stong pa nyid thim pa ste/ bdag 'bul ba po gang zag dang 'bul rdzas 'bul yul gsum ka dmigs med 'khor gsum yongs su dag pa kun bzang gi mchod sprin chen po stai/ om̐ āḥhūm̐: sprul sku'i zhing khams stong gsum bye ba brgya: longs sku'i bkod pa phung khams dbang po bcas: chos sku khyab brdal rig stong 'dzin med 'di: skyabs gnas kun 'dus bla ma rje la 'bul: tshogs gnyis rdzogs nas yon tan mthar phyin shog: ces phyi snod kyi 'jig rten/ nang rang lus kyi gzugs 'dzin/ gsang ba sems kyi rang mdangs bcas kun khyab ris med kyi klong du bsdus te 'bul la/ thun mthar snang srid dngos po'i maṇḍal thams cad 'od du zhu ste skyabs yul la thim/ mthar bdag gzhan chos dbyings mnyam pa chen por bzhag go /gsum pa drod rtags kyi mtshan ma ni/ gter sgrub las/ de ltar sku gsum maṇḍal ni: sems bskyed thabs ldan smon lam gyis: brgya stong khri 'bum la sogs pa: phul bas tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa'i rtags: khams bde nyams dga' dbang po dwangs: bza' btung la sogs ma byas kyang : ltogs snang yid la med pa dang : tshogs drug yul la zhen pa chung : bde gsal mi rtog lhug par 'char: shes rab phye zhing rig rtsal rdol: dag snang 'char zhing rmi lam du: nyi zla shar dang gyen la 'dzeg: me tog thang ljongs skyed tshal sleb: bud med du mas zas skom byin: nu ma blud dang me long blta: 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal srid thob: de dag dngos nyams rmi lam du: gang rung re re ma byung bar: 'bad pas brtsam pa yang dag gnad: ces so/ /bzhi pa phan yon bstan pa ni/ me long bkod pa'i rgyud las/ sangs rgyas zhing khams thams cad la/ /stong gsum zhing rnams ma lus pa/ /'dod pa'i yon tan brgyan pa yis/ /mchod na bsod nams ye shes rdzogs/ /zhes pa dang*/ mtshan brjod las/ bsod nams ldan pa bsod nams tshogs/ /ye shes ye shes 'byung gnas che/

/ye shes ldan pa yod med shes/ /tshogs gnyis tshogs ni bsags pa po/ /zhes dang*/ bkod pa chen po las/ rnam dag sems ldan maṇḍal ni/ /phul bas bsod nams gzhal du med/ /ces dang*/ gter sgrub las/ thabs kyis tshogs chen smin pa yis/ /shes rab rang rtsal rdzogs par 'gyur/ /dpag med phrin las thogs med 'byung*/ /zhes gsungs shing*/ der ma zad bsod nams kyi tshogs phran bus kyang gnas skabs dang mthar thug bde ba dpag tu med pa longs spyod de/ khye'u lung bstan pa'i mdo las/ bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod du byon pa'i tshe/ byis pa zhig gis sa snyim pa gang sangs rgyas la phul ba'i mthus/ sangs rgyas kyi zhal nas 'di yi bsod nams la brten nas 'dzam bu gling la dbang ba'i rgyal por 'gyur zhing*/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung gi mchod rten bye ba byas te sangs rgyas par 'gyur ro/ /zhes lung bstan pa bzhin no/ /lnga pa byin rlabs rtogs pa rgyud la spor phyir zab mo bla ma'i rnal 'byor ni/ gzhung las/ lnga pa byin rlabs bla ma'i rnal 'byor ni: rang lus snang stong yi dam lha yi sku: spyi bor padma stong ldan nyi zla'i steng : sangs rgyas kun 'dus bla ma rdo rje 'chang : mtshan dpe'i dpal 'bar thugs rjes byin 'od gtibs: mos gus gdung shugs drag pos rtse gcig gsal: zhes pa dang*/ 'di la lnga ste/ yul gsal gdab pa/ gsol ba ji ltar gdab pa/ dbang bzhi blang ba/ nyams myong phebs pa'i drod tshad/ sgrub 'bras phan yon no/ /dang po ni/ rang sems sangs rgyas kyi rang zhal mthong bar byed pa la/ bla ma sangs rgyas su mthong ba'i dad mos gdung shugs kyis kha zhe ngo lkog med par gsol ba gdab dgos so/ /dad gus med pa'i gang zag la thugs rjes byin rlabs 'jug pa'i yul med/ thugs rjes byin rlabs ma zhugs na nyams len ci bgyis kyang lam du mi 'gro zhing 'bras bu mi 'byung bas ngal ba don med las ma mchis pas/

thog mar bla ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa zhig bsten/ de la blo snying brang gsum gtad la blo ling gis bkal/ bla mas mdzad spyod bzang ngan ci ston yang rang gi snang ngor mthong ba yin pas ci mdzad legs par bltas/ ci gsungs dang du blangs/ log lta skad cig kyang ma shor bar sangs rgyas thams cad bla ma 'dir sprul nas bdag gi don du byon/ sangs rgyas dngos kyi gdul byar ma gyur pa bla ma'i skur bstan dgos pas/ sangs rgyas las kyang bla ma thugs rje che ba'i yon tan mnga' ba/ bdud rtsi 'byung ba'i rgyud las/ lha sku 'bum phrag bsgoms pa bas/ /bla ma'i sku gcig bsgom pa mchog /ces dang*/ de bzhin sgyu 'phrul dra ba las/ bla ma sangs rgyas kun gyi rje/ /rgyal ba'i man ngag gsang chen rnams/ /ston pa rdo rje'i thugs la gnas/ /gtso ru rdo rje 'dzin pa sgoms/ /zhes pas bla ma sgom pa la mtho brtsegs su sgom pa/ dkyil 'khor ltar sgom pa/ gral thabs su sgom pa/ khrom tshogs su sgom pa/ lus dkyil ltar sgom pa sogs rnam pa mang du mchis kyang*/ 'dir kun 'dus nor bu lugs su sgom pa ste/ de yang rang lus tha mal ma yin par lhag pa'i lhar gsal ba dbang bzhi'i snod du rung ba'i khyad par yod phyir/ rang nyid skad cig gis gu ru zhi rgyas dbang drag rgyun gyi yi dam gang la byed pa de'i sku lam gyis bskyed pa'i spyi bor khru gang tsam gyi bar snang la 'ja' 'od las grub pa'i snod sna tshogs padma stong ldan nyi zla brtsegs pa'i steng du/ rang gi drin can bla ma de nyid rnam pa khyab bdag rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang chen po thod phreng rtsal/ sku mdog mthing gsal zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu thugs kar bsnol te 'dzin pa/ zhabs rdo rje skyil krung gi pang du lha lcam dmar mo rdo rje dang tshe bum 'dzin pas gnyis med du sbyor ba/ sku mdzes shing lta bas chog mi shes pa rin po che'ie rgyan brgya phrag du mas mdzes pa/

longs spyod rdzogs sku'i cha lugs can/ ye shes 'od lnga'i 'ja' gur 'khyil ba'i klong na/ bag gro lhun chags gzi brjid kyi dpal du 'bar ba dran pa tsam gyis 'khrul pa a 'thas kyi snang ba 'gags nus pa zhig tu bsgom/ gnyis pa gsol ba gdab pa ni/ chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong gcig tu bsdoms pa bas kyang bla ma la gsol ba 'debs pa gnad zab ste/ ci'i phyir zhe na/ tshe gcig lus gcig la sangs rgyas thob nus pa'i khyad par yod phyir/ bdag sogs khams gsum sems can thams cad kyi re ba'i yul du gyur pa/ skyabs gnas kyi dam pa/ mgon med kyi mgon gyur/ dmus long gi lam sna/ thar lam gyi ded dpon/ ngan 'gro sgrol ba'i skyel ma/ sdug bsngal gyi gdung sel/ gsol ba btab na dgos 'dod kun 'byung ba'i yid bzhin nor bu yin par nges shes thag chod blo ling gis bkal la/ kha zhe ngo lkog med par lus gus pas thal mo sbyar/ ngag gus pas gsol 'debs kyi gdung dbyangs/ yid mos gus kyi phar la thim la khad/ tshur 'bral mi phod pa lta bur rtse gcig phur tshugs su/ om̐ āḥhūm̐: ngo bo rang bzhin thugs rje mngon du gyur: sku gsum dbyer med bla ma rin po che: gsol 'debs so thugs rgyud byin rlabs stsol: sku gsung thugs ldan dkon mchog gsum gyi ngang : rgyal ba kun 'dus bla ma rin po che: gsol ba 'debs so dgongs rgyud rtogs grol stsol: rtsa gsum dbyer med yid bzhin nor bu'i sku: mkhyen brtse nus ldan bla ma rin po che: gsol ba 'debs so rtogs pa mthar phyin stsol: rje btsun khyed rang lta bur byin gyis rlobs: zhes kha zhe med par snying khung rus pa'i gting nas mchi ma 'khrugs nus pa'i gsol 'debs lan brgya stong mang por bya/ dper na yid bzhin nor bu la gsol ba ma btab na dgos 'dod mi 'byung ba ltar/ byin rlabs 'byung ba'i gnas mtshan ldan gyi bla ma yin yang*/

dad gus kyis gsol 'debs la rag las pa'i phyir/ gang zag phal pa spyi ltar gnas skabs tshe ring nad med sogs thun mong gi dngos grub tsam zhu rgyu min te/ mthar thug mchog gi dngos grub tshe gcig sangs rgyas thob nas nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad rnam mkhyen sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang la 'god nus par gsol ba 'debs pa yin pas/ 'di skabs sems skad cig kyang ma yengs par mos gus rtse gcig ba spu g.yo nus pa'i gal chen ma byas par/ deng sang gi kha ton bcos ma ltar sems rgya yan du gtong ba'i gsol 'debs rab rib 'don pa tsam gyis rgyud mi thul zhing byin rlabs 'jug mi nus pas/ sgo gsum gcig dril du 'bad pa gal che ba yin no/ /

snying po rdo rje'i 'bru bcu gnyis pa gsol 'debs kyi tshul du bzla'o/ / de ltar gsol 'debs byed pa'i skabs su bla ma'i gnas gsum las 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems nyan thos rang rgyal sogs/ dkon mchog rin po che'i rnam par spyan drangs nas spyi bo'i bla ma la thim/ res 'ga' dgongs brda snyan brgyud bka' gter bshad sgrub man ngag lag len sogs kyis bla ma dang*/ chos lugs phyogs med kyi skyes chen dam pa rnams dang*/ zhal mjal gsung thos dad pa thob pa'i bla ma thams cad spyan drangs te spyi bo'i bla ma la thim/ res 'ga' gsang sngags phyi nang gi yi dam lha tshogs dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i rigs thams cad spyan drangs te spyi bo'i bla ma la thim par bsam zhing gsol ba gdab bo/ /mdor na rtsa ba'i bla ma de nyid sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i bdag nyid yin bzhin du de dag yang yang bstims pas byin rlabs dang dngos grub myur ba yin no/ /gsum pa thun mthar dbang bzhi blang ba ni/ gzhung las/ dbang bzhi blang zhing bdag dang dbyer med bsre: zhes pas/ de ltar bla ma rgyal kun 'dus pa'i bdag nyid can gyi sku las ye shes lnga yi bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas rang gi spyi bo bde chen 'khor lo gang*/ bum dbang thob/ lus sgrib dag lam bskyed rim sgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu sprul sku thob/ yang mgrin par byon/ gsang dbang thob/ ngag sgrib dag lam rdzogs rim sgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu longs sku thob/ snying khar byon/ sher dbang thob/ yid sgrib dag lam zung 'jug sgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu chos sku thob/ yang lte bar byon/ dbang bzhi thob/ sgrib bzhi dag lam a ti rdzogs pa chen po sgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu sku bzhi ye shes thob/ slar yang mos gus kyi rang phar la thim la khad/ bla ma yang dgyes pa mi bzod pa lta bus rang la tshur thim la khad pa'i ngang der 'od du zhu nas rang la thim pas/

rang gi lus ngag yid gsum bla ma'i sku gsung thugs gsum dang dbyer med du chu dang 'o ma 'dres pa bzhin khra khrug gi 'dres pa'i ngang la 'dzin med du rjen ne/ rang grol du lhod de/ rang babs su shig ge cog bzhag tu 'bol ler bzhag go /bzhi pa/ nyams myong drod rtags ni/ gter sgrub las/ thugs rje byin rlabs zhugs pa'i rtags: rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma de: sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bo ru: bcos ma min par rtogs pa dang : dad pa mos gus dbang med skye: skad cig tsam yang 'bral mi phod: gces 'dzin longs spyod ci yod dang : bla ma'i phyogs su srog 'dor nus: bka' stsal zur yang blos mi bcos: ci mnyes zhabs tog ngoms med sgrub: zhal mthong mjal ba tsam gyis kyang : 'jig rten tshe 'di'i snang ba nub: dus dang rnam pa thams cad du: ma bsams pa yang lhang lhang dran: bla ma nyid las gzhan mi sems: gsol 'debs chog shes med par 'byung : zas gos bzang 'dod mi skye bar: gang byung bzod thob chog shes pa: de dag dngos snang phyi yi rtags: nang rtags bla ma dran tsam la: nyams 'bar snang ba ban bun 'gro: shes pa gsal stong rjen ne 'bar: rnam rtog 'khrul pa'i rgyun chad nas: rang byung ye shes ngang gnas gyur: gsang rtags rmi lam bla ma mjal: dbang bskur chos bshad gdams pa byin: 'od zer spro bsdu byas sogs rmis: de ltar phyi rtags mngon gyur na: nang gsang rtags ni shugs las 'byung : sngon 'gro nyid la ngo sprod pas: nges shes gdeng dang ldan par 'gyur: zhes so/ /lnga pa/ sgrub 'bras phan yon ni/ gzhung las/ rjes thob nyams bskyang byin rlabs cig car 'bebs: sgrib dag bar chad sel zhing dngos grub thob: rtogs pa btsan thabs 'bar zhing srol du tshud: ces dang*/ sangs rgyas 'dus pa las/ gang gi gdul bya'i yid bzhin du/ /bla ma sgrub pa'i thabs brtsams te/ /de nyid don du sus gnyer ba/ /theg chen bla ma'i sa non te/

/kun gyi bdag nyid chen por 'gyur/ /zhes dang*/ nam mkha' che'i rgyud las kyang*/ tshogs gnyis myur rdzogs snying po yi/ /don rtogs 'dod na bla ma sgrub/ zhes so/ /gter sgrub las/ bskyed rdzogs gdams pa thams cad la: bla ma'i rten 'brel 'grigs pa na: byin rlabs dngos grub shugs las 'byung : lam gyi mthar thug mos gus te: bla ma 'bral med bsten gyur na: thugs rje yon tan dgongs pa rnams: rtsol med 'byung ba chos nyid yin: sbyang bgrod mang po mi 'tshol bar: cig car dgongs pa mtha' ru phyin: sangs rgyas kun dang gnyis med 'grub: ces gsungs so/ /de lta bu'i bla ma de nyid sangs rgyas kun las lhag pas khog pa'i snying bzhin btsa' dgos te/ dgongs pa gcig 'dus las/ bskal pa stong gi sangs rgyas pas: bla ma gnyan par shes par bya: ci phyir bskal pa'i sangs rgyas rnams: bla ma dag la bsten nas byung : zhes so/ /drug pa sngon 'gro de dag mtha' rten dgos ched bstan pa ni/ gzhung las/ de ltar sngon du 'gro ba'i dgos ched ni: bla mas zin cing gdams ngag thob pa dang : nges par chos dran lam mchog rnyed pa dang : theg pa kun gyi nyams len byang chub mngon: sgrib dag tshogs gnyis rdzogs nas grol rkyen 'gyur: dge sbyor kun gyi mgo drangs srol du tshud: bar chad kun sel nyams rtogs yon tan 'phel: de ltar skyabs 'gro nas bzung ste: bsags sbyang skyabs yul ma lus pa: thugs rje chen pos rjes bzung ba'i: bla ma'i sku gsung thugs la 'dus: dad gus gdung shugs ldan pa la: dgongs klong rin chen brdol nas kyang : brgyud pa yongs rdzogs bka' bab 'gyur: brgyud pa'i phreng ba bgrang mi 'tshal: dad gus med pa'i gsol 'debs de: brgyud pa dgu phrugs brdal gyur kyang : drang don tshig gi na yam yin: rtogs pa nang nas 'bar tsa na: bla ma phyi nas btsal mi dgos: zhes so/ /bdun pa smon lam gyis rgyas gdab pa ni/

de ltar thun mtshams thams cad kyi mthar phyag chen las/ hoḥ kun gzhi mkha' ltar yangs pa'i klong : ka dag rang byung ye shes de: rang la yod kyang ngo ma shes: 'khor ba'i sems can snying re rje: byams mgon rgyal ba sras dang bcas: 'od gsal chen po'i dgongs pa yis: bdag la sangs rgyas yon tan kun: rdzogs nas thugs rjes stobs bskyed de: rtsol med 'gro don mthar phyin shog: ji srid nam mkha' ma zhig bar: mkhyen brtse ye shes rgyas pa yi: gang 'dul thogs med phrin las kyis: 'gro ba sangs rgyas sa thob shog: ces smon lam bya'o/ /de ltar chos sgor zhugs so cog dang*/ khyad par nges don sgom gyi nyams len la zhugs phyin chad 'jig rten blos btang*/ nam 'chi cha med la rdog gtad bya/ tshe 'di'i skyid 'dod dang chos brgyad khe grags lo 'dod ky-i bsam pa gtan nas spangs/ dman pa'i sa bzung zhing ma ltogs ma 'khyags tsam la chog shes bya/ bla ma la mos gus/ mched grogs la dag snang*/ sems can la snying rje/ rgyu 'bras la zhib tshags/ bslab sdom la mig 'bras/ dam tshig la srog bsdos kyis gzhan skyon la mi blta bar rang skyon kho na la brtag cing*/ rang rgyud 'dul ba la nan tan chen pos bla ma'i zhabs tog chos kyis 'grub par bya'o/ /gter smyon chos rgyal rtsa gsum gling pa yi/ /chos smyon kun bzang dgongs pa'i klong rdol ba/ khrid smyon sbyor dngos cig car grub thob srol/ /'gro smyon blo chen mchog tu sbyor ba'i lam/ /tshig smyon ma bcos rang shar thol byung 'di/ /dbus smyon mchog dga' gtsang smyon ngag dbang 'bar/ /mchims smyon sbyin pa kong smyon phrin las pa/ /spang ston smyon pa karma mthar phyin sogs/ /skal ldan smyon pa'i tshogs kyis bskul ba'i ngor/ /phyogs med kun tu rgyu ba'i skyid smyon gyis/ /yongs rdzogs smyon pa 'du ba'i bsti gnas su/ /gang dran smyon pa'i lugs su bkod pa'i dges/

/gang yang ris med smyon pa 'phyo ba ltar/ /phyogs dus kun tu smyon chos dar gyur nas/ /'gro kun gtad med rgya yan la gnas shog /dge'o/ dge'o/ dge 'o/ sarba maṅga laṃ// ca) rdzogs chen 'khor 'das rang grol gyi sngon 'gro bsdus pa bzhugs so/ thun gyi sngon 'gro spyi ltar bya/ sngon 'gro dngos thun mong dang dang thun min gnyis las/ thog mar thun mong sngon 'gro blo ldog rnams bzhi ni/ bla ma mkhyen no/ lan gsum: dal 'byor mi lus lan gcig thob dus 'dir/ /'chi ba snying nas dran no bla ma mkhyen/ /las 'bras bslu ba med pa'i don rtogs nas/ /ngan 'gro'i g.yang las thar bar byin gyis rlob/ /gsol ba 'debs so bla ma rin po che/ /gdung bas 'bod do drin chen chos kyi rje/ /skal med bdag la re sa gzhan na med/ /thugs yid dbyer med 'dres par byin gyis rlobs/ /gnyis pa thun min sngon 'gro la lnga/ dang po chos thams cad kyi gzhi rten skyabs su 'gro ba la/ thog mar tshogs zhing gsal gdab la skyabs 'gro dngos ni/ na mo: dbyings rig dbyer med rtsa ba gsum: ye nas mchog gsum sku gsum bdag: phyi nang mi dmigs zang thal sku: 'bad rtsol bral bar skyabs su mchi: zhes skyabs 'gro ci 'grub bya zhing mthar tshogs zhing 'od zhu rang la bstims te mi dmigs pa'i ngang du mnyam par bzhag /gnyis pa theg chen byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa ni/ smon 'jug don dam zung du 'jug pas/ hoḥ gdod nas dag pa chos dbyings klong : ma rtogs sems can rgyud drug rnams: rnam thar byang chub lam 'god phyir: blo 'das de bzhin sems bskyed do: ci nus brjod cing gtong len gyi dmigs pa'ang bya zhing mthar dmigs med ngang du mnyam par bzhag /gsum pa sgrib sbyong rdor sems sgom bzlas ni/ āḥ bdag lus snang stong rdo rje sems dpa'i sku: dkar gsal 'od phung rdo rje dril bu 'dzin: thugs srog sngags phreng 'od kyi sdig ltung sbyang :

slar yang 'od 'phros snang srid sems dpar gyur: oṃ badzra sa twa aḥ zhes yig brgya dang yang snying 'bru drug ci nus bzlas/ mthar snod bcud dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo rang gi thugs srog āḥyig la bsdu zhing dran rig mi rtog pa'i ngang la bzhag go /bzhi pa mthun rkyen tshogs gnyis rdzogs byed maṇḍal ni/ tshogs zhing sngar ltar/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: sprul sku'i zhing khams stong gsum bye ba brgya: longs sku'i bkod pa phung khams dbang po bcas: chos sku'i khyab brdal rig stong 'dzin med 'di: skyabs gnas kun 'dus bla ma rje la 'bul: tshogs gnyis rdzogs nas yon tan mthar phyin shog: brgya stong grangs ma rdzogs bar 'bul zhing mthar chos dbyings mnyam pa chen por bzhag go /lnga pa byin rlabs bla ma'i rnal 'byor ni/ skad cig la gzhi lus zhing khams kyi bkod pa wal gyi gsal btab la/ rang lus snang stong yi dam lha yi sku: spyi bor padma stong ldan nyi zla'i steng : sangs rgyas kun 'dus bla ma rdo rje 'chang : mtshan dpe dpal 'bar thugs rje'i byin 'od gtibs: mos gus gdung shugs drag pos rtse gcig gsal: de nas sgo gsum gcig tu bsgril nas gsol ba phur tshugs su gdab la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: ngo bo rang bzhin thugs rje mngon du gyur: sku gsum dbyer med bla ma rin po che: gsol ba 'debs so thugs rgyud byin rlabs stsol: sku gsung thugs ldan dkon mchog gsum gyi ngang : rgyal ba kun 'dus bla ma rin po che: gsol ba 'debs so dgongs pa rtogs grol stsol: rtsa gsum dbyer med yid bzhin nor bu'i sku: mkhyen brtse nus ldan bla ma rin po che: gsol ba 'debs so rtogs pa mthar phyin stsol: rje btsun khyed rang lta bur byin gyis rlobs: zhes kha zhe med par snying khung rus pa'i gting nas mchi ma 'khrugs nus pa'i gsol 'debs brgya stong grangs med bya/ snying po/ om̐ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru padma siddhi hūm̐:

kho na la 'bad/ de nas dbang bzhi len zhing dbyer med bsre ba ni/ bla ma'i sku las ye shes bdud rtsi'i rgyun: babs pas lus gang sgrib dag dbang bzhi thob: bla ma 'od zhu rang dang dbyer med pa: bdag gzhan rtog med chos dbyings chen por bzhag: thugs yid bsres la ci nus su mnyam par bzhag mthar bsngo smon ni/ dge ba 'di yi myur du bdag /o rgyan bla ma 'grub gyur nas/ /'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa/ /de yi sa la 'god par shog / ces bsngo smon bya'o/ zhes o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pas zab gter 'khor 'das rang grol gyi sngon 'gro rig 'dzin thugs mchog rdo rjes khrid gzhung las/ ngag 'don khol du phyung zhing thun mong sngon 'gro gter chen rnam 'phrul pad rgyal gling pa'i gsung las bsnan te nyer mkho'i ched du gu hya'i ming gis spel ba dge'o// // gsur mchod longs spyod gter mdzod 'byed pa'i rin chen lde mig bzhugs sa/ོ snying rje'i dbang phyug dbyer med drin chen bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ gong gnon gzhan dang ma 'brel ba'i rgyun gsur btang skabs/ theg chen byang chub sems kyi kun slong dang ldan pa'i skyabs sems bdag bskyed sogs sngon du 'gro dgos pas/ des na dang po skyabs 'gro ni/ na moḥ bla ma bde gshegs rtsa ba gsum: dkon mchog rnam gsum skyabs yul lha yi tshogs: rtse gcig 'du 'bral med pa'i mos gus kyis: bla med byang chub thob phyir skyabs su gsol: gnyis pa sems bskyed ni: hoḥ snang srid ye nas zang thal gzhal yas khang : snod bcud rang gsal rig pa'i dkyil 'khor lha: 'dzin med ma bcos lhun grub de bzhin ngang : brda don rtogs phyir gnas lugs sems bskyed do: gsum pa rang nyid lha bskyed ni: hūm̐: stong pa'i ngang las skad cig pad zla'i steng : rang nyid thugs rje chen po sku mdog dkar: zhi 'dzum mdangs ldan longs sku'i rgyan gyis spras:

phyag g.yas mchog sbyin bdud rtsi na ra ra: g.yon pas skyabs sbyin rigs drug sdug bsngal sel: zhabs gnyis phyed skyil 'gro ba'i mgon gyur gsal: oṃ lo ki shwa ra ya a wa lo ki te hri da ya swā hā: oṃ āḥhūm̐: om̐ ma ṇi padme hūm̐: ci nus bzlas/ gsur rdzas me thab dang bcas pa chab kyis bran nas byin gyis brlab pa ni/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: gis ma dag pa bsreg gtor bkru/ oṃ āḥham̐'u gis byin gyis brlabs zhing nam mkha' mdzod gyi sngags rgya'i rgya cher spel/ dri gsur 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan par gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐ a hu ti su ru bhu pa ye swā hā: hūm̐: stong pa'i ngang las ye shes me thab tu: sreg rdzas 'dod yon longs spyod nam mkha'i mdzod: byin gyis brlabs pa'i mchod sprin rgya mtsho 'di: sangs rgyas byang sems 'phags tshogs dge 'dun tshogs: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong dang : dam can nor lha gter bdag srung ma la: 'bul lo thugs dam bskangs shing nyams chag sol: oṃ āḥhūm̐/ ci nus dang*/ sri zhu'i mgron du gyur pa'i mchod yul skyabs gnas dkon mchog rin po che rnams la 'bul lo/ de ltar phul ba'i rang gzhan sems can thams cad rgyu tshogs gnyis rdzogs/ 'bras bu sku gnyis kyi go 'phangs myur du thob par gyur cig / hūm̐: phyi rgyud dpal mgon bdun cu rtsa lnga'i tshogs: lha klu sde brgyad gza' chen rgyu skar bdag: rgyal chen bzhi dang phyogs skyong gzhi bdag bcas: lo zla zhag dus sa bdag yul lha la: 'bul lo phyi nang rkyen ngan bar chad sol: oṃ āḥhūm̐/

ci nus dang*/ mgon po yon tan gyi mgron du gyur pa'i dam can chos skyong ba'i srung ma dkar phyogs skyong ba'i tshogs rnams la mchod do/ 'bul lo/ de ltar phul ba'i dgyes shing bskang la bdag sogs byang chub sgrub pa po'i 'gal rkyen bar chad zhi/ mthun rkyen don gnyis bsam don ma lus pa lhun gyi 'grub par mdzod cig / hūm̐: dri za gsur bdag bgegs rigs lan chags mgron: pha ma rigs drug bar do'i sems can dang : tshe rabs bu lon sha 'khon ma 'khor ba'i: sngon las 'phral rkyen khas zhan dbang chung la: bsngo'o sbyin no lan chags 'khor gyur cig: oṃ āḥhūm̐/ ci nus dang*/ lan chags snying rje'i mgron du gyur pa'i pha ma rigs drug gi sems can dang*/ bgegs rigs lan chags kyi bdag po bdag mo rnams la 'bul lo/ bsngo'o/ bsngos pa bzhin du tshims shing lan chags bu lon byang*/ sha 'khon sdig sgrib dag /so so'i las snang sdug bsngal las grol zhing myur du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phangs rin po che thob par gyur cig / oṃ āḥhūm̐/ ci nus dang*/ bye brag gshin bsngo ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ a hu ti hā sa bha dra su ru bhu pa ye swā hā: dri gsur 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan pa 'di nyid 'bul zhing bsngo ba'i gnas su gyur pa ni: mdang da nangs shi ba lus snga lus bor zhing phyi lus ma thob pa rig pa gtad med du 'khyams pa'i bar do'i sems can rnams la 'bul lo: mig gi yul du gzugs mdzes par gyur cig: rna ba'i yul du sgra snyan par ? sna yi yul du dri zhim par? lce yi yul du ro mngar bar? lus kyi yul du reg bya 'jam par gyur cig: yid kyi yul du rig shes dgos 'dod phun sum tshogs par gyur cig: hoḥ ma rig srid pa'i nang tshan bar do yi: yid lus la sogs rigs drug sems can rnams: bdag gis sbyin tshogs bsngo smon dge ba yis: bla med byang chub 'bras bu myur thob shog:

om̐ḥhūm̐ḥtrām̐ḥhrīḥ.āḥ mūm̐ḥlām̐ḥmām̐ḥpām̐ḥtām̐ḥ om̐ bo dhi sa twa sa ma ya: dharma dzñā na ma ma pā paṃ bi shwa dha na pa ri wā re swā hā: om̐ ma ṇi padme hūm̐: na mo ratna tra yā ya/ oṃ kaṃ ka ni kaṃ ka ni sogs? oṃ na mo bha ga wa te sarba durga te pa ri sho dha ni rā dza ya/ ta thā ga ta ya/ arha te samyaksaṃ buddha ya/ tadya thā/ oṃ sho dha ni sho dha ni sarba pā paṃ sho dha ni shuddhe bi shuddhe sarba karma ā wa ra ṇa bi sho dha ne swā hā/ oṃ badzra sa twa sa ma ya/ sogs? om̐ padmo uṣṇi ṣa bi ma le hūm̐ phaṭḥ 'aḥ.aḥshaḥsaḥmaḥhaḥ ma ma ko ling sa manta/ a su nri tri pre duḥsarba duḥkha shāntiṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ na mo ratna tra ya ya/ na mo buddhā ya/ na mo dharma ya/ na ma saṅgā ya/ oṃ ye dharmā he tu pra bha sogs? sdig pa ci yang mi bya zhing sogs/ mgron rnams rang gnas su gshegs pa ni: oṃ: 'jig rten 'das dang ma 'das kyi: āḥ mgron du gyur pa ma lus kun: hūm̐: dmigs med rang dbyings klong du gshegs: oṃ badzra muḥ bsngo smon gang rung gis rgyas gdab kyang chog: hoḥ bdag gzhan dus gsum kun bsags rnam dkar dge: 'khor gsum yongs dag dbyings su bsngos pa'i mthus: khams gsum 'khor ba'i sems can ma lus pa: kun bzang gdod ma'i gzhi la sangs rgyas shog: sbyin pa rgya chen gyur pa 'di yi mthus/ 'gro ba'i don du rang byung sangs rgyas shing*/ sngon tshe rgyal ba rnams kyis ma bsgral pa'i/ skye dgu'i tshogs rnams sbyin pas sgrol gyur cig /thams cad nam mkha' mdzod bzhin du/ /longs spyod zad pa med pa dang*/ rtsod pa med cing tshad med pa/ /rang dbang du ni spyod par shog /sman rnams mthu dang ldan pa dang*/ /gsang sngags bzlas brjod 'grub pa dang*/ /mkha' 'gro srin po la sogs pa/ /snying rje'i sems dang ldan gyur cig /tshe 'di'i pha ma shi gson 'brel thogs dang*/ sha khrag 'o zho bkol spyod dud 'gro sogs/
