/bzang ngan las kyis 'brel ba'i sems can rnams/ /myur du sangs rgyas sa la 'god par shog /snang srid rnam dag ri bo po tā lar/ /rten dang brten pa'i 'khor lo ye nas rdzogs/ /grags stong 'gag med yi ge drug ma'i sngags/ /rig stong 'phags pa'i rang zhal 'du 'bral med/ /oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ hrīḥ man dbyangs gyer la dge bsngo sogs mtha' rgyas bya'o/ gu ru'i zhal gsung mu tig phreng ba la/ /sna tshogs 'ching bu'i rgyan 'di mi mdzes kyang*/ /byis pa'i rang bzhin dang po'i rigs can dag /tshig rjes don dran 'jug pa bde phyir spel/ /de yang sgo chen bdud 'dul sngags gling gi /byang 'dren sgrub bla tshe dbang bdud 'dul gyis/ /zhu rten bdud 'dul dngul phur lha regs bcas/ /bskul ngor bdud 'dul rol pa rtsal gyi sdebs/ /des kyang 'brel thog yid can pha ma rnams/ /kun rdzob dri gsur mchod pa'i tshems shing mnyes/ /don dam chos kyi sbyin pa'i rgyud grol nas/ /mthar thug rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par shog /ces pa 'di'ang phur gling gnam lcags sgrub sde'i dgos mkho 'di bzhin gyis zhes rten bcas nan bskul ngor/ sa byi lo'i khrum zla'i bcu gnyis la/ sku gsum mkha' 'gro gling gi sgrub sder thun mtshams su sprul ming gsang sngags nas so// // cha)༄༅/ /bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: bzlas pa sngags kyi pra khrid bzhugs: gsang ba zil gnon lha la 'dud: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: bdag 'dra padma 'byung gnas kyis: snying po sngags phreng rnam dbye bshad: dbyangs can mtsho rgyal gzungs kyis zungs: rin chen gsang ba'i gter du sbos: las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: phyi nang bskyed rdzogs kyi rnam dbye mang yang : gzhi chos dbyings dang lam spro bsdu'o: dang po gzhi chos dbyings kyi rnam dbye ni: 'khor 'das kyi byed po rang sems gcig gi rtsal las sna tshogs grub cing :

mtha' dbus bral bas khyab brdal: ma 'gags pas zang thal: dngos po ma grub pas stong pa: sna tshogs 'char bas rgya yan: 'khor 'das mnyam pas ro gcig: dbye ba mi phyed pas zung 'jug: sgrib pa med pas ka dag: kun tu mi gnas pas khregs chod: de phyir gzhi yi rig pa: a ti bya bral gyi ngang du gnas pas: rnal 'byor pa lta ba mngon du gyur: sgom pa mtha' ru phyin: spyod pa 'dzin gzhi dang bral: 'bras bu gdeng dang ldan te: 'khor 'das ris med rnams la: lam bskyed rim mi dgos kyang : 'bring po lam pa nam zla ston ka'i so nam 'dra ba rnams: bsnyen sgrub dang bskyed rim gtso che ste: de yang rdzogs rim bral bas bskyed rim kho na ru gyur na: chu rdo dar gyis btums pa lta bu'am: bye ma la so nam du re ba: g.ya' spang phub g.yogs kyis btums pa lta bu'o: ci'i phyir zhe na gzhi mi g.yo ba'i ting nge 'dzin: lam bzod pa gsum gyi go cha: grogs brtson 'grus can gyi dpa' bo gcig dgos so: de la gzhi ting nge 'dzin: lam bskyed rim: 'bras bu rdzogs pa'i rim pa gsum dang ldan par bya'o: de yang phyi nang rten 'brel dang ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pas: yi dam lha'i bskyed rdzogs sgrub pa nyams su len pa'i tshe lus yi dam lha yi rnal 'byor ni: ༈ skad cig stong pa'i ngang las lha gang rung gsal gdab: de yang stong pa chu zla'am: 'ja' tshon lta bur snang la rang bzhin bral ba phyi nang zang thal can: zhal phyag dang rgyan rdzogs pa: zhi drag gang ltar bsgoms kyang snying tsitta rang byung gsal ba'i sgron me'i nang du zhi bar gdan skyon gyis ma gos padma: drag po la nyi zla kha sbyor: zhi ma khro la sum brtsegs: de'i steng du lha zhi ba rnams la hrī'am hūm̐: khro bo la hūm̐: khro mo la bhyoḥ de yang sa bon lha'i thugs rgyud dang bstun: srog yig gi mdun sna rtse'i gdong la gtad: drang po ma yo ba 'grengs thabs kyis bsgoms:

khyad par ni: phra zhing phra ba ba spus bris pa tsam: res 'ga' spro ba'i tshe: snod bcud khyab pa'i stong gzugs: res 'ga' yul tshad dang spus bris pa tsam: dbyibs de lta bu'i lha'i sku mdog la: zhi ba rnams 'od zer 'phro zhing mdangs dang ldan pa: drag po rnams tsha tshwa me ri 'bar zhing pheṃ sgra dang ldan pa: mkha' 'gro rnams 'jam mnyen 'khyugs pa la: dwangs cha che ba 'od zer gyi rnam pa lta bu gsal gdab: gnyis pa sngags phreng ni: lha zhi ba'i sngags dal zhing lhod pa: gaṅgā dal 'bab ltar 'khor: drag po'i rigs rnams gcong rong zab mo'i chu ltar si li li 'khor: mkha' 'gro rnams wa so'i chu 'gyu ba ltar myur la 'jam par 'khor: srog yig yab kyi mdangs dang : sngags phreng yum gyi mdangs: pho rgyud g.yas su 'khor: mo rgyud g.yon du 'khor: sngags phreng lug rgyud chad pa ltar la: sngags phreng ba'i rnam pa: 'od zer phreng thag gi rnam pa: 'od zer yang phal cher dmar sngo dkar ljang ngo : bros ded kyi tshul du 'khoraḥ srog yig gdan la khab 'dzugs pa ltar mi 'khor: yab yum spro bsdu'i sngags ni: yab kyi zhal nas yum gyi zhal du zhugs: dbu ma'i lam brgyud nas: gsang ba'i gnas nas yar drangs te 'gal me 'khor ba ltar 'gul bar bsgom: de yang srog yig mi 'gul zhing sngags phreng 'khor bar bya: ci'i phyir zhe na mig 'bras 'gul tshe lug rgyud byer ba ltar 'gyur ro: de bzhin du lta stangs lus gnad gsum yang bya: lta stangs ni: mig sna rtser phab ste rang babs su bzhag: lus gnad drang zhing blo lhod par bya: rlung sems gcig tu dril la: ma yengs pa'i dran rdzi dang bcas nas bzhag: sngags kyi skyon bdun ni: sgra che na ral ba'i skyon: chung na nyams pa'i skyon: yengs na byer ba'i skyon: rmugs na mi gsal ba'i skyon: brel na ma dag pa'i skyon: thang lhod le lo'i skyon: 'chal gtam tshig bar chod pa'i skyon: de ltar skyon bdun gyis ma gos par bya:

sngags gtsang ba dag pa sgra ring thung snyoms pa gsal ba: phal cher grogs kyis go tsam bzlas: rbad bskul dmod pa'i sngags ni: lcags zhun gyi tsha tshwa khol ba ltar tho ro ro bzlas: phrin las bzhi yi sngags ni: zhi ba'i sngags 'jam la ring ba: rgyas pa brjid la rngam pa: dbang myur la gtsang ba: drag po rno la 'gyu ba'o: sngags sgra yang bung bas rtsi myong ba'i sgra ltar snyan pa rang sgra can du bzlas so: gsum pa spro bsdu ni: sngags bzlas pa'i tshe: gcig las gnyis mched kyi tshul du gyur nas: lus kyi nang thams cad gang : rim bzhin ba spu'i bu ga nas 'phros pas: snod bcud thams cad sngags kyi rang sgra di ri ri sgrog par bsam: sngags sgra las spros pa'i lha mo mchod 'dzin ma dpag tu med pa spros pas: phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang sems thams cad la mnyes pa'i mchod pa phul: tshur bsdus pas sangs rgyas byang sems kyi byin rlabs thams cad 'ub kyis bsdus nas rang la thim par bsam: zil gyis gnon pa na: sngags phreng sngar ltar 'phros pa las: rang 'dra ba'i khro bo'am zhi ba dpag tu med par gyur nas: pha rol gyi gzi brjid thams cad zil gyis mnan pas pha rol zhum ste dbang du 'dus par bsam: dbang du sdud pa ni: rang gi thugs ka nas sngags phreng spros pas rang 'dra ba'i khro bo dang mkha' 'gro sogs las bzhi'i phyag mtshan dpag tu med pa 'phros nas: pha rol gyi bsod nams stobs thams cad shog skya rlung gis bskyod pa ltar bsdus nas rang la thim: gzhan yang phyi snod kyi bcud thams cad rang la thim pas gzi brjid bkrag mdangs rgyas te kun gyis phyag 'tshal zhing mchod bstod phul bar bsam: sgrib sbyong ni: rang nyid lhar gsal ba'i spyi bor ye shes sems dpa' rigs bdag gi rnam par bzhugs pa'i sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs: lus gang zhing nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad dud khu sol khu'i rnam pa 'og sgo nas thon te:

sa rim pa dgu'i 'og tu song nas 'chi bdag las kyi gshin rje'i khar song bas ngoms shing tshims te bla med byang chub thob par bsam: tshar gcod pa'i sngags phreng ni: sngar ltar drag tu 'khor bas: sngags phreng las rang 'dra ba'i khro bo dang phyag mtshan rdul ltar 'khrigs nas pha rol gnod byed thams cad dum bur gtub cing rab tu bsregs nas ming yang med par bsam: 'gug pa'i sngags phreng ni: sngags phreng 'khor bas sngags la 'gug byed kyi las mkhan dpag tu med par 'phros: dgra bo'i bla srog rnam shes thams cad byi'u chung khras khyer ba ltar bkug nas gzugs byang la gnyis su med par bsam: bdag mdun yod na: bdag bskyed kyi sngags phreng 'khor ba las 'od zer mang du spros pa mdun bskyed la phog nas: mdun bskyed kyi lha thams cad kyi thugs rgyud bskul ba ltar gyur nas dgra bo bkug cing bsgral bas: sha khrag gis yi dam lha tshogs dgyes par bsam: yang bdag mdun zhi ba yin na: sngags 'gal me ltar 'khor kyang rung ngo: yang pha rol mnan pa ni: sa rim pa gsum gyi mtshams lcags kyi khang sgrom nag po rngam la 'thug pa zhig gsal gdab: sngags phreng las spros pa'i pho nya rnams kyis de yi steng du gnam lcags kyi mchod rten bye ba sa ya spros pas mnan te: bskal pa stong du yang mi thar bar bsgom: gtad pa ni: gang la bcol ba'i yul lha srin sde brgyad des rang gzugs: sa yin na sa rim pa dgu yi mtshams su yod pa'i khar gtad pas: kha bsdams pa dang nam yang 'bros sa med par bsgom: chu yin na klur sngar ltar gtad: sgab 'dre dam sri sogs spyi la: sa rim pa gsum gyi mtshams su las kyi chu srin gyi khar gtad: bzlog pa dang zor dmigs la: sngags bzlas pa'i tshe: mdun bskyed dang chos skyong la phog pas de rnams kyi lha rang rang gi phyag mtshan rnams me dpung gnam lcags kyi sgyogs thogs nas: sngags drag tu 'khor ba'i tshe 'phangs pas dgra yul phye mar bshig par bsam:

srung ba'i sngags phreng rnams ni sngags 'khor bas phyi yi lha thams cad zhal nang du 'gyus nas bsrungs par bsgom: bzlog pa'i sngags bzlas pa'i tshe: khro bo rnams phyi la gzigs te bzlog pa'i las mdzad par bsam: lha dpa' gcig yin na sngar ltar bsgom: 'khor mang yin na gtso bo'i sngags bzlas tshe gzhan rnams kyang 'khor rnams kyi rang mdog sngags phreng 'khor bar bsam: mthu gtad smad las kyi sngags bzlas tshe rang gi thugs kar yi dam sngags: pho nya'i thugs kar kho rang srog sngags: rbad sngags rnams 'gugs 'dren gyi tshul du 'phros: bsad sngags rnams thun khang phyi nang la rang sgra grags par bsam: gzhan yang yi dam che rgyud ma gtogs dregs pa'i sngags rang gi snying khar mi 'khor mdun bskyed rang la 'khor: rang nyid yi dam rtsa sngags srog yig ma bral bar bya: phrin las bzhi'i sngags phreng gong ltar ro: yig 'bru mi bsgom na sgra stong nyid rang byung du shes pa rtsol bral a ti'i rnal 'byor bya: de'i tshe yig 'bru dang sngags phreng mi bsgom ste: sgra 'ong ba yang stong pa: gnas pa yang stong pa: 'gags pa yang stong pa: dper na rnga'i sgra yang mi'i lag pa'i 'khrul 'khor ltar shes par bya'o: spro ba yang rang sems nas spro: bsdu ba yang rang sems su bsdu ba'i phyir: bskyed rim sgyu ma'i rnal 'byor bya'o: rdzogs rim yang sgyu ma 'khor 'das sgyu ma'i rang bzhin thams cad sgyu ma las ma 'das pas rdzogs rim sgyu ma lta bu'o: rmi lam ltar gsal ba'i lha rnams kyang gcig las gnyis su gyur nas bdag sgyu ma'i rang bzhin no: gzhi'i sgyu rtsal de ltar rtogs na: yi dam gyi lha ma bsgrubs kyang zhal mjal lo: rjes su dbang bzhi'i ngang bsre ba ni: bdag mdun gnyis yin na: mdun bskyed kyi dpral pa nas oṃ dkar po'i rang bzhin spros nas rang gi spyi bor thim pas lus bdud rtsi dkar pos gang*/ des sku'i dbang thob:

mgrin pa nas āḥdamar po spros pa rang gi lce la thim pas bdud rtsis longs spyod 'khor lo ltem gyis gang : des gsung gi dbang thob: thugs ka nas yi ge hūm̐ sngon po 'phros: rang gi snying gar thim: bdud rtsi mthing gas ltem gyis gang : des thugs kyi dbang thob: lte ba nas yi ge swā ser po 'phros pa rang gi lte bar thim: bdud rtsi dmar ser gyis sprul pa'i 'khor lo gang : des yon tan gyi dbang thob: gsang ba nas yi ge hā ljang gu 'phros pa rang gi gsang bar thim: bdud rtsi ljang sngon gyis bde skyong 'khor lo ltem gyis gang : des phrin las kyi dbang thob: de nas mdun bskyed 'od du zhu nas rang la thim: rang yang rim bzhin mi dmigs hūm̐ nas dkyil 'khor bsdu bar bya: yab yum yin na yab yum gyi gnas lnga nas sngar ltar dbang blangs: yum yang rang la bsdu: nyin re bzhin rim gyis dmigs pa spro bsdu bya: rjes kyi rtags tshad grub rtags ni: dngos su yi dam lha mjal ba dang : lung ston pa dang : chos 'chad pa sogs dang nyams 'bar zhing bskyed rim spro ba: lus bde zhing yang ba: nad zhi ba: bkrag mdangs dang ldan pa: longs spyod 'du ba: gzhan gyis byams pa bkra shis pa'i rtags 'byung : rmi lam du nyi zla shar ba: chos 'chad pa: dung 'bud pa: dar baphyar ba: rnga brdung ba: gzhan yang rol mo sna tshogs 'khrol zhing sgra skad cher g.yos pa: gzhan gyis zas dang longs spyod ster ba: lus la 'ja' shar ba: khrus bya zhing gos dkar gyon pa: rgyan gos gsar bu phun sum tshogs pas brgyan pa: khri'i khar bsdad pa: dbang bskur ba: thams cad rang la dad cing gus pa: rta nor lug sogs mang ba dang lo thog phun tshogs skye ba: zhing bzang po la chu 'gyed pa: sa bon btab pa: klu rgyal me tog gling la slebs pa: lha'i sku mdog ltar gyi me tog mang po 'thu ba dang : dkar gsum gyi zas ro myong ba: gyen la 'dzegs pa: lus che zhing stong gsum khyab pa:

rkang pa gyad 'dor gyis gling bzhi brdzis pa: stong gsum la hūm̐ sgra sgrogs pa: ri bsnyil ba: mtsho dkrugs pa: brag gshig pa: chu brgal ba: zam 'dzugs pa: khye'u mang po'i dpon byas pa: khang pa brtsegs pa: tshogs kyi 'khor lo bskor ba: bud med rgyan can mang pos dga' ba'i tshul gyis zas ster ba: rin chen sna tshogs rnyed pa sogs ni grub pa'i rtags: khyad par drag po rbad bsad dus su: ral gri'i khang khyim du slebs pa: lus la go mtshon brgyan pa: dgra la dmag drangs shing thub pa: gzhan gyi mgo snying nang rol gtor ba: rngon bkye ba: sha khrag 'gyed pa: ging dmar nag gis 'o dod 'bod pa: gcan gzan sna tshogs kyis ro za ba: pha rol btson la bcug pa: gzhan la mtshon btab pa: zor 'phang ba: ri bo 'go mjug ldog pa: lus la me 'bar ba: ri la me btang ba: drag po'i thun brdeg pa sogs rmis pa ni: drag po bsgrubs pas mngon spyod kyi las grub pa'i rtags yin: gzhan yang 'khrul zhing rang nyid thugs dam mi ldan na: pha rol dmag drangs shing rang pham pa: gzhan gyis mtshon bsnun pa: rdo rbab kyis ded pa: g.yang la lhung ba: chur bying ba: mgo la me 'bar ba: skra tshig pa: skra bregs pa: gos hrul po gyon pa: khrag dang dug sogs bshang gci 'thung ba: sha khrag ngan pa'i gling du slebs pa: sbra nag dang rlung nag gis g.yogs pa: sgrub khang zhig cing bgrang phreng 'thor ba: rang gi spyad cha chag yal grug por song ba: brang rdung zhing ngu 'bod ldir ba: gtor ma dang mchod rdzas zhig cing log pa: bud med ngu ba: thur du 'gro ba: mun rub pa: nyi zla zad pa: ser ba drag pos brdung ba: gcan gzan sna tshogs kyis ded pa: 'gong po ser gzugs la dbang zhus pa: rang gi ma sring mched dang lcam dral 'khu ba: kun gyis sdang ba byed pa: khang pa'i tog dang rgyal mtshan zhig pa: thog babs pa: bande: bud med: a tsa ras ded pa: lus la 'bu srin zhugs pa sogs rmis na yi dam chos skyong 'khu ba dang pha rol gyi byad ltas yin:

skong bshags tshogs brgya 'bung dgos: spyir yang sgrub pa la snying rus brtson dgos pa'i rtags yin: gzhan yang yi dam gyi lha phyi nang gsang gsum gang bsgrubs kyang gtso bo ting nge 'dzin la rag las shing : rten 'brel mdun sa 'dun dang dmigs pa dam tshig gtsang dgos: sgrub pa'i tshe gdong mi la mi bstan: rab na mtshams g.yog pas mi mthong bar bya: phyi la lha 'di sgrub pa yin zhes gtam mi smra: sgrub pa ma grol gyi bar du gzhan la gos dang kha phor pa mi bsre: rigs ldan ma yin pa'i bud med mtshams g.yog mi bzhag: dam med la dkyil 'khor 'go tsam yang mi bstan: gtor ma bya khyi dang dbul pos mthong sar mi dor: mi gri bo dang slob ma nyams grib can sgrub khang du mi bzhag: mtshams g.yog mi brje: gzhan yang zas grib can mi bza': tshwa dang la phug sgog skya gsum sngags kyi nus pa nyams pa'i skyon yod pas spang : sgrub khang gi phyi ru ku co dang gtam mi smra: nang du 'thab 'khon mi bya: sha dang mi gtsang ba'i rigs zhag gsum ma song bar nang du mi blang : dam tshig mi gtsang ba'i mi la chas lag len mi bcug: rten 'brel ngan pa'i gtam mi smra: sgrub pa ma grol ba'i bar la: rgyal tho brgal nas gtor ma mi 'bul: nang gi sgrub pa grol nas zhag gsum ma song bar du mi grib can la mi 'phrad: sgrub pa la bzhugs nas bzung : khyim du gad mi gtong : mal sa mi spo: gdan mi sprugs: nang chas ri la mi bskyel: gos phyi nang bslogs shing mi brje: pha ma spun zla dang bral kyang : dam bca' ma grol bar du mi 'phrad: steng nas ri nyil: 'og nas mtsho lud kyang : na shog shi shog ma gtogs yang yang 'gro ba dang grol ba sogs mi bya: ci tsam sgrub pa chos skyong la: dmod pa dang dam bzhag byas nas bsdad: dkyil 'khor la kha sprod tshul du mal sa bca': nang gi dbang bzhi dngos grub len chog ma zin bar gzhan la dbang mi bskur: gtor 'bul dang rjes kyi bya ba ma rdzogs bar:

nang gi rgyal tho dang srung 'khor mi bsdu: snod min la rdul tshon dang byin rlabs mi sbyin: sgrub pa'i tshe pha rol nad pa sogs la bka' bsgo dang dmigs pa mi bya: thugs dam btags pa mi gnang : mngon mkhyen lnga ldan du shar yang : gzhan la lung mi ston: rang nyid yi dam gyi lha dngos su gyur kyang : grub rtags mi la mi bshad: sgrub pa'i dam bca' ring thung gang yang pha rol la dus mi bgo: phyi nang gi lhong tshad dang tshar tshad grub rtags rkyen ngan gang byung yang : thams cad rang sems gcig po'i cho 'phrul yin par shes pa'i ngang la dga' sdug gang gis kyang re dogs med par bya: na ba yon tan yin: shi ba dngos grub yin bsams te rten 'brel legs nyes gang la yang 'dzin pa med par bya: spyir sgrub pa gang la yang mgo ma grim mjug ma lhod par sngon skyabs yul nas bzung : rjes mi dmigs pas dkyil 'khor ma bsdus bar shi ba srog la bab kyang mjug mi bzhag par kha tshang la gting grim par bya: bogs skyed med par zhag mang zhig sgrub pa las: ting 'dzin gsal la dus thung ba yon tan che: lus ngag rgya yan bag med can gyis bskal pa stong du bzlas kyang mchog thun gyi 'bras bu mi 'grub: snying rje phan sems med pa rnams kyis: lha drag po bsgrub na skye ba bdun phrag la srin po dang shan pa'i lus su skye: spyir yang zhe sdang can gyi ban bon sngags pa rnams kyis 'jig rten lha drag po sgrub pa na: 'gro ba kun la gnod pa'i gdug 'drer skye: de bzhin

shog lhe gcig ma tshang*/ sgyogs rdo: rang mgo la lhung ba yang mang : de bzhin du phyis 'byung gi skal ldan sgrub pa nyams su len pa rnams: bla ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa la bsten la: lag khrid phra zhib kyis rgyas btab: bsnyen sgrub bzang pos mtshams sbyar: yi dam gyi lha mnyes par mdzod: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: bdag 'dra padma 'byung gnas kyis: spyi chings zhal shes gdams pa mchog: pra khrid gsal ba'i me long bzhag: dbyangs can mtsho rgyal gzungs kyis zungs: las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: kho bo gter bdag gling pas lcags byi lor sbas tshal nas gdan drangs shing gsang sngags chos gling du shog ser las zhal bshus so/ / maṅga laṃ// ja)༄༅/ /mtshams la bzhugs pa'i skabs su blang dor ji ltar byed dgos pa ni/ padma khrag 'thung bum dbang don khrid las/ thun min stong thun shes pa bcu yi gnad: sgrub thabs thams cad sgyu ma ltar shes pas: gzugs brnyan du mar snang yang rang bzhin med: ming tshig thams cad sgyu ma ltar shes pas: mtshan ma'i tshig dang tha snyad gnyis su med: spyod lam thams cad rmi lam ltar shes pas: bde sdug ci snang ci spyod ngo bos stong : dngos po thams cad gzugs brnyan ltar shes pas: rdzas sngags ting 'dzin spang thob grub mtha' stong : gnas yul thams cad dri za'i grong khyer ltar: gzhal yas khang sogs dngos kun 'dus pa bral: sngags sgra thams cad grags stong brag cha ltar: brag ri'i rkyen zhig brag gi rgyu rkyen stong : lha rnams thams cad chu nang zla gzugs ltar: snang yang ma grub rnam rtog bral bar shes: ting 'dzin thams cad chu las chu bur ltar: rtog tshogs chos kyi dbyings su grol bar shes: ting 'dzin thams cad mig skyon mig yor ltar: ting 'dzin sna tshogs tha dad 'gyur bar shes: cho 'phrul thams cad sprul pa ltar shes pas: rgyun du brgyud mar byung yang rang bzhin med:

shes pa bcu yi dgongs pa don ldan pas: bsnyen sgrub mtshams la bzhugs nas ma thon bar: zag pa mis mthong 'grim pa'i lam mi gtong : gzhan gyi gos gyon grib 'jug g.yel la 'chor: zas bzang thal na nyon mongs dbang du 'gro: ngan na lus stobs nyams te bsrang mi tshugs: dam nyams rme yug sdom shor rkun ma sogs: nyams grib can dang gdon can zas mi za: sgrub pa kha 'byams bar chad mthar mi phyin: stan drod yal dang mal stan spo sogs kyis: drod rtags yal ba'i glo bur ye 'drog 'byung : dreg can gos dang lus khrus dngos grub yal: skra sen kha spu bregs pas sngags ngar nyams: phu btab mchil snabs dor na sngags sel 'jug: gzhan dang ngag tshig 'dres na'ang de dang mtshungs: lce sha mtsher pa zos na sngags nus nyams: byin gyis ma brlabs sha chang sgog tsong spang: spyad na nus pa nyams te slar skye dka': gzhan gyi srung skyob byas na nus pa nyams: mtshams khung chos bshad sgrub pa'i rtags mi thon: nyin par gnyid nyal nad gdon rkyen kun bskyed: gsang sngags rdo rje mkha' 'gro bzlas pa rnams: gsang thon klog na nus pa nyams pa dang: mi min phra'u skrag dang brgyal bar 'gyur: sgra chen gsang sgrog chung na 'bru mi gsal: myur bas sgra 'dres bul bas sgra gyer pa: yengs na rgyun chad bsgrims te dub pa spang : dag par shub shub gong pas tshor tsam bzlas: bzang ngan rkyen tshogs ci byung mtshams ma 'don: yeng ba'i nang nas smra ba mang ba thu: long gtam ldib ldib dge sbyor sad rkyen spang : smra bcad bzlas brjod byed pa mtshams kyi mchog: grub rtags gzhan la bshad na dngos grub nyams: spyir ni thog mar dka' thub la sogs pa: nyin mtshan thun brgyad bcu drug bzhi la sogs: cha bgo nyams len srang du bcur ba'i tshe: dam bca' phyir bsring ma shes dang po nas: yun ring byed ces bar gcod bdud kyis khyer: gzhan gyi rnyed bkur phyag mchod srung skyob sogs:

ngo srung bgyis nas dge sbyor bskyed 'phel gcod: brtan pa ma thob gdeng dang ma ldan par: gzhan don sems bskyed dngos su gnyen po spang : dam bca' zla bdun zla gcig zla phyed sogs: rim par lo bsring rab kyis lo bcu gsum: 'bring gis lo drug tha ma lo gsum gcig: yang tha zla drug dbyar re dgun re tsam: le lo snyoms las med par bsrang la bcur: mdor na sgrub pa tshugs nas ma thon bar: sgo gsum 'khrug rtsod zing ba'i las mi bya: rnam g.yeng spongs la lus bsrang ting 'dzin brtan: gang sgrub mthar dbyung sgrub rtags bzang ngan gyi: cho 'phrul ci byung blang dor med par bsring : sgrub pa thon nas gtang rag tshogs skong dang : me mchod la sogs ci 'grub 'bad pas bskyed: tho grol bzhag gi bar du mtshams rjes bsrung : grong yul mi 'grim dam gtsang grogs dang 'phrad: rang mal zhag gsum bar du gzhan mi nyal: sgrub rdzas dam tshig mi gcig mi mthong bsdus: sgrub rdzas mi ster dngos grub rdzas mi sbyin: rang gi longs spyod kun la gsang sngags gsang : rgyun bsnyen rab kyis chag med nyin rer khri: 'bring gis nyin stong mtshan stong tha ma yis: nyin mtshan lnga brgya re dang yang thas kyang : brgya rtsa re yi dam bca' mthar phyin bzung : rab kyis rtag tu smra ba bcad la bzlas: 'bring gis thun gyi mgo mjug 'khyol bar bskyal: tha mas bzlas brjod grangs thems bar du bcad: sgrib sbyong tshogs bsags bar chad sel ba dang : dngos grub rnam gnyis myur 'grub yid smon rnams: bskyed rdzogs bsnyen dang bsgrubs pas bde blag 'grub: ces gter gzhung rdo rje'i tshig rkang ma hā gu ru'i zhal chab drod rlangs thul le ba 'di ltar nyams su blang bar bya'o/ /o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa'i zab gter las khol du phyung ba'o// // nya)༄༅/ / thugs sgrub bder 'dus zhal gdams kyi skor las/ stod las man ngag chos drug gnad 'dus kyi khrid dus bzhi sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor bzhugs so/

/bde chen ye shes sangs rgyas padma skyes/ /rnam kun mchog ldan rgyal yum mkhar chen mtsho/ /dbyer med rig stong don gyi bla ma la/ /kun nas 'du 'bral med pas dad phyag 'tshal/ /gung thang la thog lha sras rje 'bangs la/ /zhus lan lung bstan man ngag 'di bzhag nas/ /'ja' tshon phung nger mi mngon dbyings rum du/ /bzhud pa'i tshul 'di bsam bzhin skyo ba 'phel/ /der byung man ngag bcu gsum mtshan bcas kyi/ /rdzogs rim rmi lam 'od gsal bar do sogs/ /gdan thog gcig tu nyams su len pa'i thabs/ /dus bzhi sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor 'di na spel/ /de'ang bla ma'i thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus kyi nang tshan/ zhal gdams bsam lhun le'u bcu gsum las/ stod las man ngag chos drug gnad 'dus dus bzhi sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor zhes bya ba 'di nyid 'chad pa la/ spyir dus drug dang 'brel ba'i nyams len spyi ltar bshad pa dang*/ dngos gzhi rdzogs rim nyams len bshad pa gnyis so/ /dang po ni/ lha sras rje dang mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal/ gnubs chen sangs rgyas ye shes sogs rje 'bangs grogs bcas la gnang ba'i zhal gdams las/ tho rangs skabs su bag med ma nyal bar: bde chen zhing sgrub gsal gdab gsol ba thob: nam langs ma yengs da lta'i dus la soms: chos skyong rgyal pos chos kyi bstan pa skyongs: nyi shar ma yengs snang ba rgya yis thob: kho bo srin yul bzhud sogs mi rtag sgoms: nyin phyed spyod lam rnam bzhis rjes thob sres: dngos su lung bstan tshes bcur dag snang mjal: phyed yol lnga brgya mar 'grib dus la soms: dug lnga lam khyer dug gsum chags med sbyongs: nyi thal 'byung bzhi 'dus pa bral la skyed: nga nyid sman lhar mos pas tshe 'phrang sgrol: nyi nub sgyu lus nad gcong drag pos zhig: nga nyid spyi bor snang mthar rlung sems sres: srod la bar do rnam pa drug la mos: bdag la gsol btab rigs drug 'khrul rgyun chod:

srod 'phros las dbang sdug bsngal smin srid snyam: bdag la gsol btab gnas ngan sgo kheg 'gyur: nam smad skye gnas bzhi la 'jig srid skye gnas bzhi'i bsdus pa'i rigs drug 'khor ba'i gnas ris gang du skyes kyang gnas skabs kyi 'jig pa dang mthar thug srid pa khams gsum gyi sdug bsngal las 'da' ba med pa'i tshul mchan/ sgoms: bdag la gsol btab sngon gyi 'phro mtha' sad: man ngag bcu gsum nyams len snying po bzhag: lha sras rje 'bangs ma 'ongs de ltar spyod: ces thugs sgrub bsam pa lhun 'grub ma'i le tshan bcu gsum las/ zhal gdams kyi skor don tshan gnyis par gsungs pa rnams/ 'dir mdor dril te nyams len dang sbyar na/ tho rangs skabs su bag med ma nyal bar: bde chen zhing sgrub gsal gdab gsol ba thob: zhes pa spyir bde chen zhing sgrub las/ rnal 'byor bzhi rim zhes/ tho rangs ye shes gsal gdab pa'i rnal 'byor/ nyin mo snang ba rgyas btab pa'i rnal 'byor/ dgong mo'i rig pa gzhi la sdud pa'i rnal 'byor/ nam phyed shes bya bum par 'jug pa'i rnal 'byor bzhi las/ skabs 'dir tho rangs kyi skabs su bde chen zhing sgrub ltar ye shes gsal gdab cing gsol ba thob la rig ngo skyongs zhes pas/ rang gi snying dbus padma dmar po la 'dab ma bzhi pa ze'u 'bru'i kha bye ba'i dbus su rang rig hrīḥyig dmar po rnam par bzhugs pa nyid/ dbu ma'i lam rgyud rgyang gyis thon nas mdun gyi nam mkhar nyi ma 'bum gyi mdangs bzhin lhan ner bzhugs pa las 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs dus zhing khams na bzhugs pa'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i thugs rgyud skul/ byin rlabs thams cad tshur bsdus gzi mdang lhag par rgyas par bsams la rig pa hrīḥl gtad/ shes pa gzengs bstod la rlung yig rig pa gcig tu dril la ci gnas su mnyam par bzhag go cha gnyis pa nam langs la thun mong ltar blo sbyong phyir/

sngar mkhan slob chos rgyal sogs dus 'dzoms nas chos skyong rgyal pos chos bstan dar zhing rgyas par gyur kyang*/ da lta ming gi lhag mar gyur pa sogs snyigs ma'i dus la bsam nas mi rtag pa dang skyo shas sogs/ blo ldog rnam bzhi'i nges 'byung rgyud la bskyed cing*/ smon 'jug sems bskyed sngon du 'gro bas bsag sbyang gi gnad la yang dag slob/ khyad par nyi shar nas nyin phyed bar nyin mo snang ba rgyas btab pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor la rtsal du bton zhing bla ma'i thugs dang rang sems dbyer med bsres la gnyug ma'i rang zhal skyong*/ gang snang ba thams cad chos nyid kyi rgyas thob la mnyam rjes nyin mtshan dbyer med sgyu ma dang rmi lam ltar nyams su len/ le lo byung na gu ru padma srin yul du bzhud pa sogs mi rtag pa bsgoms shing brtson 'grus lcag gis bskul/ nyin phyed nas phyi thun bar gsal brtan dag gsum dang ldan pa'i bskyed rim gyi rtsal sbyang zhing bsnyen sgrub chu bo'i rgyun gyi rnam 'byor la 'bad pa dang*/ thun mtshams kyi za 'chag nyal 'dug gi spyod lam rnam bzhi rjes thob sgyu ma ltar nyams su blangs pas dngos su lung bstan pa dang*/ skal ldan las 'phro can rnams la dus khyad par can tshes bcu sogs su dag snang dngos sam nyams dang rmi lam tshun du zhal mjal ba sogs dngos grub thob par 'gyur ro/ phyed yol nyi ma 'grib la nye ba'i dus/ lnga brgya tha ma mar 'grib kyi dus la bsam pa sogs mi rtag pa'i rgyud bskul la dus dang rnam pa kun tu nyon mongs pa'i gzhan dbang du mi btang par/ dug gsum dang rnam par rtog pa gang shar gang snang thams cad ma bkag par shar du bcug ste/ de la chags zhen dang spang blang med par 'dzin med gang shar rang grol du glod de/ spyod lam rgyun gyi lam khyer rdzogs rim mthar thug 'od gsal rdzogs pa chen po'i nyams len la 'bad pas/

dbang po'i rim pa dang sgrub tshugs la ltos pa'i rab dngos/ 'bring nyams/ tha ma rmi lam tshun la zhal mjal zhing lung bstan pa sogs mchog dang thun mong gyi dngos grub 'byung bar gsungs so/ /nyi thal gyi dus su 'byung bzhi'i 'du ba cha snyoms pa'i rgyu rkyen dang bral zhing*/ 'du ba 'khrugs pa las rlung mkhris bad kan sogs nad rigs sna tshogs bskyed c-ing sdug bsngal ba'i tshul la bsam zhing*/ o rgyan sman lhar mos pas tshe sgrub dang rlung sgrub sogs la 'bad pas tshe 'phrang bar chad las sgrol ba'i dgos pa yod do/ /nyi nub kyi skabs su sgyu lus g.yar po zhig cing 'chi nad drag pos gzer tshul la bsam zhing*/ da lta nyid nas rnam shes spyi bo'i snang mtha'i thugs kar 'phang la rlung sems bsres pa sogs 'pho ba sbyang*/ srod la bar do rnam pa drug la mos: bdag la gsol btab rigs drug 'khrul rgyun chod: ces gsungs pas spyir bar do drug gam bzhi dang skye 'chi bar do zhes gcig tu bsdus pa sogs spro bsdus dang dmigs rkang yang de bzhin snang mod/ mdor bsdus na/ sgyu lus g.yar po zhig pa'i bar do ru: 'khrul snang nying 'khrul sdug bsngal nyen pa na: yid gnyis? o rgyan dus gsum mkhyen pa'i thugs rje yis: 'khrul snang rang sar grol bar the tshom med: ces gsungs pa bzhin bar do'i sdug bsngal yid la bya zhing bla ma gu ru dbyer med la gsol 'debs sogs bar do lam du khyer/ srod 'khor la/ dgong mo rig pa gzhi la sdud pa'i rnal 'byor ni: gzhung las/ nyin snang thams cad rmi lam dang sgyu ma'i ngo bo ltar sbyong : tshe 'dis snang ba nub pa bzhin nyin mo'i snang ba thams cad mi snang bar gyur/ nyin snang la brten pa phal gyi byed las 'gag ste mig phyed btsums tsam nas sad pa'i snang ba logs nas mtshan snang la spyod/ glo bur nying 'khrul gyi rjes su 'brang ste med bzhin 'khrul snang bden bzung gis bde sdug tshor ba nyams su myong ba bzhin 'dir snang mi rtag pa'i tshul la bsam ste zhen pa'i 'khri ba bcad/

thog med las nyon dang phyi ma'i sdug bsngal gyi rgyur gyur pa gang dang*/ khyad par de ring nyin mo rang gi dam bca' dang 'gal ba gang byung brtags la stobs bzhis bshags sdom gtso bo bya/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor gsol ba drag tu btab ste rdzogs rim bsdu ba'i dmigs pa dang bcas rlung khug bdun nam nyi shu rtsa gcig sogs gang nus bzung ba ni rlung sems dbu mar thim zhing 'od gsal 'char ba'i dgos pa yod/ mthar phung po gzan du skyur ba ltar snang ba bshig la dmigs med kyi ngang ci gnas su bzhag /nam phyed shes bya bum par 'jug pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ skye gnas bzhi'i bsdus pa'i rigs drug 'khor ba'i sems can gyi sdug bsngal la bsam nas snying rje bskul zhing bsngo smon bya ba dang*/ nyal ba'i tshe rang gi snying dbus su padma dmar po 'dab ma bzhi pa ze'u 'bru kha bye ba'i dbus su hrīḥyig dmar po 'od zer nyi ma 'bum gyi mdangs 'phro ba la/ shes pa gtad bzhin gnyid log la rmi lam ngo shes par bya snyam pa'i 'phen pa btang*/ dngos gzhi 'od gsal ngo shes par bya'o/ gong gsal phyi ma gnyis po rmi lam dang 'od gsal gyi nyams len yin pas zhib par 'og tu ston no/ zhes thugs sgrub nyams len nyin zhag phrug gcig gi thams cad nyams su len tshul bsam lhun man ngag bcu gsum gdams ngag thor bur bzhugs pa rnams bsdus te las dang po pa dang zhib par nyams su len mi thub pa rnams la phan phyir bzhag la cung zad spros par nus pa rnams kyi gsham du bstan pa ltar bya'o/ /gnyis pa rdzogs rim dngos bstan pa la/ stod las byang chub sgrub pa'i zhal gdams kyi nang tshan/ o rgyan sman gyi lha la brten nas rdzogs rim kun gyi rtsa ba rlung sems gtum mo'i man ngag la bslab pa dang*/ o rgyan dus gsum mkhyen pa thod phreng rigs lnga la brten nas rmi lam dang*/ sgyu lus/ bar do/ 'od gsal sogs sbyang tshul bshad pa/

rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la brten nas ma rgyud 'pho ba nyams su len tshul sogs chos drug dod thub mdor bsdus bzhugs pa rnams las gab pa phyung ste sdebs pa la/ dang po ni/ rtsa ba rlung sems gtum mo'i man ngag la bslab tshul o rgyan sman lha dbyer med las/ phyi yi sman mchog nus ldan bzang drug gtso: nang gi sman mchog tshogs drug lhug par gtso: gsang ba'i sman mchog sgo drug rlung la sbyongs: zhes dang*/ gso ba'i sman mchog rdzas dang lag len sbyor: bskyed rim sman mchog lha sku'i stong ra sgoms: rdzogs rim sman mchog rang rig gtan la phob: 'di nyid rtogs pas nga nyid sman lha dngos: zhes gsungs pa bzhin/ thog mar rdo rje theg pa'i 'jug sgo dang po smin byed kyi rim pa song ste/ dbang srog dam tshig gis gzhi byas/ dbang gi nyams len phyi bskyed pa'i rim par 'jug pa man ngag bcu gsum dang dril sgrub rgyas bsdus gang rung gi bsnyen sgrub them par byas shing*/ khyad par o rgyan sman lha dbyer med nyams len dang sbyar/ ma nus na dril sgrub la sman lha'i bskyed bzlas kyi dmigs pa'i mdel so bsgyur ba zur gsal bzhin sbyar bas grub bo/ /de nas rdzogs rim gyi khyad par ni/ phyi sman sgrub rdzas dang lag len gi sbyor ba/ nang bskyed rim lha'i stong ra la bslab pa/ gsang ba rlung rig man ngag la bslab pa bcas gsum las/ dang po phyi'i sman mchog nus ldan bzang po drug sogs rtsa brgyad yan lag stong sbyar bdud rtsi sman mchog rdzas dang lag len gyi sbyor ba rnams skabs don min pas 'dir ma bshad la/ 'dir phyi ma gnyis bshad par bya ba la/ dang po gzhung las/ bskyed rim sman mchog lha sku'i stong ra sgoms: zhes pas rtsa ba o rgyan sman lha'i sgrub thabs dang sbyar ba yin yang*/ 'dir thugs sgrub bder 'dus bsam lhun spyi dril bsnyen sgrub sngon du song bas mtha' rten rdzogs rim gyi tshul du sbyar na/

thog mar sngon 'gro spyi dang khyad par bla ma'i rnal 'byor la gnad du bsnun zhing mos gus kyis mchi ma 'khrugs nus pa'i sgo nas gsol ba btab ste dbang bzhi blangs/ bla ma'i sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/ rang lus rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi ltem gyis gang ba'i bde stong gi ye shes rgyud la skyes par bsams la/ rtsa bral gyi shes pa gzhi med kyi ngang du sa le ye rer bzhag go /ji ltar sgom tshul yang*/ de nyid las/ bskyed rim khro nyams bdud kyi rgol ba 'joms: gsang ba'i gtum mo dpa' bo seng sgrog dang : ye shes rlung gis nyon mongs zil gyis gnon: zhes pa ltar phyi lus kyi stong ra gsang bdag seṅge sgra sgrogs phag mo yum dang bcas pa dar gyi gur phub pa ltar bsgoms pa'i sku'i dbus su/ nang rtsa'i stong ra rtsa dbu ma mtshan nyid bzhi ldan gyi mar sne lte 'og spu nag ma'i thad du 'gags pa/ yar sne tshang bug tu har re yod pa/ de'i g.yas su ro ma dkar mo/ g.yon du rkyang ma dmar mo gnyis yi ge cha'i 'phongs bzhin mar sne lte 'og nas dbu mar tshud la yar sne sna bug tu zug par bsgom pa dang*/ dbu ma'i gnas bzhir 'khor lo bzhi dang bcas pa gsal gdab bo/ gnyis pa/ gsang ba'i sman mchog sgo drug rlung la sbyang : zhes gsungs pa bzhin rlung sgrub dngos la/ rlung gnad ni/ thog mar rlung ro dgu phrug tu bsal te/ nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad sangs kyis dag par bsam mo/ /de nas bum chen sbyor ba bzhi ldan zhes dal bus nang du rngub pa dang*/ steng rlung mnan/ 'og rlung bskum/ bar rlung lte 'og tu bum pa bzhin dgang ba dang*/ mi thub pa'i tshe g.yas g.yon dbus gsum nang du gcus skor gsum re bcas gzhil ba dang*/ de nas bzung mi thub pa'i tshe dal bu'i ngang rim bzhin shugs bskyed la 'phang ba dang bcas bzhi'o/ dmigs pa tshur rngub pa'i tshe phyogs dus rgyal dang de sras drang srong rig 'dzin gyi byin rlabs dang*/

snod bcud 'byung bzhi'i dwangs bcud ma lus pa tshur nam mkha'i rlung gi rang bzhin sngo me re bar snang du 'khyil ba nyid sor bzhi'i mtshams sne gnyis su gyes pa spos dud bzhin sna bug gnyis nas yur bu'i chu 'dren pa bzhin na ra ra rngub la lte 'og tu bskyil ba ni/ kun la shis pa'i nam mkha'i rlung sbyor yin no/ gzhan du rlung mkhris bad kan gsum dang 'byung ba lnga sogs rang gi khams dang bstun nas nad la sman dang 'dra ba 'byung ba cha ma snyom pa mnyam par bya ba la/ khrag mkhris dang me khams shugs che bar chu rlung bsil zer bdud rtsi rnam pa can sgom pa'i mtshon/ de bzhin sa rlung ser po brtan pa'i rang bzhin/ me rlung dmar po dro ba'i rang bzhin/ rlung rlung ljang khu g.yo ba'i rang bzhin sogs 'byung ba rang rang gi byed las dang mtshungs par las la sbyor ba sogs 'gres shes par bya'o/ /gnyis pa gtum mo sgom pa ni/ sems can nyon mongs nad kyis zin pa na: dug lnga lam khyer sman gyi gdams ngag dgos: khyad par khro mo rdo rje tsaṇḍa lī: nang gi gtum mo sman 'dra'i nus pa bskyed: 'byung bzhi'i nad rnams tsha grang snyoms pas 'dul: zhes gsungs pa ltar lte 'og gi khro mo rdo rje gtum mo'i ngo bo bde stong tsaṇḍa lī la rnam pa a shad du gsal la bum can dal bus bzung bas lte ba'i a shad la phog de las gtum mo'i me 'bar ba dmigs 'gros dang mthun par 'khor lo bzhir rim bzhin song ba'i shugs kyis phyi nang nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad bsregs/ spyi bo'i rigs bdag sman gyi lha dang bla ma'i rang bzhin rnam pa ham̐ yig las 'od zer spros/ phyogs dus rgyal dang de sras drang srong rig 'dzin gyi byin rlabs dang*/ snod bcud 'byung bzhi'i dwangs bcud ma lus pa tshur bsdus te ham̐ yig la thim pas mgo rting hril gyis ldog bdud rtsi'i rgyun nar gyis drangs shing lugs 'byung du me dang bdud rtsi bros ded kyi rnam par spyi bo bde chen 'khor lo nas rim bzhin 'khor lo bzhir babs pas dga' bzhi bde stong gi ye shes nyams su myong*/

dbang bzhi thob/ sgrib bzhi dag sku bzhi'i go 'phang rgyud la skyes par bsam mo/ mthar bdud rtsi a shad la phog pas lcags sregs la snum khol phog pa bzhin tsheg sgra dang bcas me dang bdud rtsi gnyis med du 'khor lo lnga dang rtsa phran thams cad khyab/ don lnga snod drug la sogs lus kyi phyi nang thams cad cig car du khyab/ 'byung bzhi cha ma snyoms pa sbyangs shing tsha grang snyoms pas bzhi rgya rtsa bzhi nad rnams zhi bar byas/ dug lnga ye shes su gnas 'gyur/ 'bras bu sku bzhi lhun grub rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang mngon du byas pa'i mos pa bya'o/ /yang gzhung las/ rdzogs rim sman mchog rang rig gtan la phob: 'di nyid rtogs pas nga nyid sman lha dngos: zhes gsungs pa bzhin rtsol bcas bskyed bzlas kyi mtshon pas chos thams cad 'ja' tshon mkha' la yal ba bzhin mi dmigs pa'i ngang du mnyam par bzhag la sems 'das pa'i rnam rtog gi rjes mi gcod/ ma 'ongs rtog pa'i mdun mi bsu/ da lta'i rtog pa'i 'phro mi mthud par spros bral mnyam pa nyid kyi ngang du sa le hrig ge 'jog pa ni srid zhi'i zug rngu ma lus pa 'joms pa'i sman mchog dam pa nyid do/ /de dag ni bde stong tsaṇḍa lī'i rnal 'byor ro/ /gnyis pa o rgyan dus gsum mkhyen pa thod phreng rigs lnga la brten nas rmi lam dang*/ sgyu lus/ bar do/ 'od gsal sogs sbyang tshul bshad pa la/ rdo rje'i tshig rkang drangs pa'i sgo nas mdor bstan pa dang*/ man ngag gi sgo nas rgyas par bshad pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ gter gzhung zhal gdams las/ nyin snang thams cad sgyu mar sbyang ba'i tshe: rdo rje thod phreng me long ye shes ngang : rnam rtog bzang ngan phra rags ci shar yang : snang yang bdag 'dzin bral ba'i ngang la zhog: gzung 'dzin dag pa gsal stong lha skur grol: de nas mtshan mo'i rmi lam sbyong ba'i tshe: ratna thod phreng mnyam nyid ye shes ngang : nyin snang mtshan mo'i bag chags bying ba dang :

rna bar sgra sogs snyan dang mi snyan rigs: brag cha dang ni rmi lam lha mo bzhin: dbyangs dang rngam skad gcan gzan 'tshe ba sogs: gnyan la dgra sdang gang gis smra ba rnams: stong pa'i 'brug skad rlung sgra ci bzhin du: pi waṃ gdangs ltar rang bzhin stong par 'gro: de nas bar do'i kun rtog sbyong ba'i tshe: padma thod phreng sor rtog ye shes ngang : nang tshan bar do'i las mkhan rngam tshul dang : yid kyis rtog dpyod so sor gol ba'i dus: snang ba dgrar langs rtog pa rngo mi thogs: de tshe gnas pa gzhi la 'gyu ba'i lam: brtag dpyad gzhig bral cir yang 'char ba'i tshe: sngon bsu rjes gcod blo yis bcos mi gzhug: gang shar 'dzin med chos sku'i ngang du grol: ces dang*/ de nas bskyed rdzogs lam la sbyangs pa'i tshe: buddha thod phreng chos dbyings ye shes ngang : pad 'byung dus gsum mkhyen pa'i dus med rtogs: 'das pa'i rtog pa ye grol gdod nas dag: da lta'i rtog pa dran rig chos skur grol: ma 'ongs rtog pa glo bur byar med ngang : gnas skabs rtog pa shar grol mnyam rjes bral: dus bzhi dus kyi dus dang gnas skabs bral: dus gsum mkhyen pas phyi nang bral ba'i phyir: sngar 'das da lta phyis 'byung stong pa nyid: chos rnams ji snyed mi dmigs stong pa nyid: ngo bo rang bzhin thugs rje stong pa nyid: mthar 'das 'dor len med pa stong pa nyid: de bzhin rgyu dang mtshan ma stong pa nyid: de bzhin sgyu lus 'byung lnga stong pa nyid: ma skyes mi 'gag nam mkha'i 'khor lo can: bskyed rim snang stong lha sku sgyu ma'i bar: rdzogs rim gang shar ka dag gdod nas grol: de nas skye gnas rnam bzhi sbyong ba'i tshe: karma thod phreng bya grub ye shes ngang : bya spyod thams cad sgyu mar shes par bya: las kyi shugs las srid par 'jug pa'i tshe: gang du skye ba'i yul de rtag tu mthong : srid pa rigs drug pho mo 'khrig pa sogs:

reg bya'i yul la brtag mi thub par 'char: de tshe rang rig bla ma yi dam dang : rgyu 'bras bskul ba'i chos rnams la sogs pa: dag snang gus 'dun sbyang ba'i dus gcig go: bden pas bsu ba smon lam mtha' btsan pas: rigs ldan bram ze mtshan bzang rnyed par 'gyur: srid par gnas tshe mya ngan snang ba skye: cir snang dag pa longs sku'i zhing du sgoms: nam zhig las kyi rlung gis rab bskul bas: 'jig rten mi yul mthong nas bag tsha zhing : reg bya rtsub sogs sdug bsngal sdang ba'i tshe: snang stong grags stong gsal stong tshor stong dang : mi rtog ye shes gnas lugs ngang du zhog: 'di phyi'i bya spyod sgyu ma'i ngang du grol: ces rdo rje thod phreng la brten nas nyin snang thams cad sgyu mar sbyong zhing snang ba lus kyi bag chags dag cing sbyong bar byed pa/ de bzhin ratna thod phreng la brten nas mtshan snang rmi lam dang phyed snang ngag gi bag chags dag cing sbyong bar byed pa/ padma thod phreng la brten nas bar do'i kun rtog dang mi snang yid kyi bag chags dag cing sbyong bar byed pa/ karma thod phreng la brten nas bya spyod thams cad ma dag pa dang dag pa'i sgyu lus su sgom pa/ buddha thod phreng la brten nas ma rig gti mug 'khrul pa'i rtsa ba thams cad drung nas bcad de/ nyin mtshan 'od gsal gyi 'khor lor la bzla ba sogs/ mdor na dug lnga gnas su dag cing ye shes lnga mngon du byed pa'i thabs mchog rmad du byung ba rnams kyi don tshig gi spros pa dor la lag len smar bcang gi tshul du gsham du bstan par bya'o/ /gnyis pa man ngag gi dgongs pa dang sbyar nas nyams su len tshul bshad pa la/ sngon 'gro dang dngos gzhi gnyis las/ dang po ni/ tho rangs ldang ba'i rnal 'byor gsal gdab cing rlung ro bsal ba sogs sngon 'gro ltar bya/ de nas nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang la dgod pa'i ched/

sgrub pa zab mo lhur len par bya'o snyam pa'i 'dun pa dang ma bral bar/ mdun gyi nam mkhar ngo bo drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ rnam pa dpal o rgyan rdo rje 'chang yab yum phyogs dus zhing khams thams cad na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' skyabs gnas ma lus pa 'dus pa'i spyi gzugs su gsal btab nas gsol ba 'debs/ mi rtag pa'i rgyud drag tu bskul/ sems can thams cad pha mar shes pa'i snying rje bzod glags med pas yid drangs nas/ ci mdzad khyed shes kyis skyabs su 'gro/ sems can kun sdug bsngal las bsgral nas da lta nyid du sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang la 'god thub na ci ma rung snyam pa'i sems bskyed/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor la gnad du bsnun nas lus ba spu ldang zhing mig nas mchi ma 'khrugs nus pa'i gsol ba btab pas bla ma'i sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/ rang lus thod phreng rtsal du gsal ba'i rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi ltem gyis gang bas bde stong gi ye shes rgyud la skyes par bsams la/ gzhi med rtsa bral ngang du mnyam par bzhag par bya'o/ /gnyis pa la rmi lam dngos bshad pa/ zhar byung sgyu lus dang*/ 'od gsal/ bar do/ 'pho ba bcas nyams su len tshul bshad pa'o/ /dang po la'ang rmi lam bzung ba dang rmi lam sbyong ba gnyis/ dang po bzung ba la nyin mor dran pa yeng ba med par nyin snang thams cad rmi lam dang sgyu ma'i ngo bor bzung ba dang*/ mtshan mor man ngag btsan thabs kyis rmi lam bzung ba gnyis so/ /dang po ni/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor la gnad du bsnun rjes/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo/ bla ma rin po che mkhyen no/ /bdag gis rmi lam zin pa dang sgyu lus rmi lam 'byongs par mdzad du gsol/ ces gsol ba drag tu gdab/ rlung bum can rlung khug nyi shu rtsa gcig gam/ bdun nam/ gsum sogs ci rigs par bzung la mthar mnyam par 'jog de nas slar ldang ba'i tshe da lta'i snang ba 'di kun/

rang gi 'khrul snang tsam las rang ngos nas grub pa'am bden par grub pa rdul tsam med de/ snang yul chu gcig la rigs drug so so'i snang ba tha dad pa bzhin/ so so'i las snang las rang bzhin gcig tu ma grub pas mi bden no snyam la/ spyir bden med du blta/ sgos su 'di dag rmi lam du shes par byas nas nga gnyid du song 'dug snang ba 'di dag rmi lam gyi snang ba yin/ sgyu ma yin bsam pa'i dran 'dun yang yang bya/ de bzhin du spyod lam rnam bzhi gang gi dus su'ang 'chi ba dran pa dang*/ bla ma dran pa mi 'bral bar bya/ khyad par du rmi lam gyi 'dun pa drag tu btang mthar gtad yal du bskyangs te/ dmigs pa med pa'i ngang la mnyam par bzhag cing nyin snang thams cad rmi lam dang sgyu ma'i ngo bor sbyang bar bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ blo ldog rnam bzhi dang khyad par mi rtag pas rgyud bskul/ sngon 'gro bla ma'i rnal 'byor bar snga ma bzhin gtong rjes/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo/ bla ma rin po che mkhyen no/ /bdag gis rmi lam rmis pa dang*/ rmi lam rmi lam du ngo shes par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba drag tu gdab cing mthar mnyam par bzhag mgo bo byang phyogs su bstan nas seṅge'i nyal stabs kyis nyal/ spyod lam dal bu'i sgo nas rtsa rlung mi 'khrugs par bya/ de nas dmigs gnad ni/ rang lus gsal stong lha sku'i ngo bor gsal ba'i snying nang du/ padma dmar po 'dab ma bzhi pa'i ze'u 'bru'i steng hrīḥdamar po 'od zer lnga dang ldan pa nyi ma 'bum gyi mdangs phyung ba zhig bsgom la 'dun pa rtse gcig tu gtad/ 'od zer gyi snang bas phyi nang snod bcud kun la khyab pas phyi snang thams cad lan tshwa chur zhu ba ltar mer gyis zhu/ mthar 'ub kyis bsdus nas hrīḥdamar por thim pas de nyid 'od zer lhag par 'bar bar bsgom/ yang padma'i 'dab ma bzhir shar du oṃ/ lho ru trām̐/ nub tu āḥ byang du hūm̐ ste yi ge gsal bar bkod pa la 'dun pa gtad de mnyam par bzhag pas gang gnyid du 'gro la khad der thim rim gyi rnam pas cung zad nang du 'thib pa dang mnyam du shar gyi oṃ yig trām̐ la thim par bsgom/

had hob tsam la trām̐ āḥ rmi lam 'byung la khad par āḥhūm̐/ gnyid za zi tsam la ga ler dkar dmar 'phrad skabs gzugs kyi 'dun pa mi 'gul bar hūm̐ hrīḥl bstim zhing*/ hrīḥyig dri med 'od gsal gsal la 'dzin pa med par sems gtad de gnyid log pas rmi lam zin par 'gyur ro/ /gzhan du snying nang gi a yig dkar po nam mkha' dwangs par zla ba shar ba ltar sa ler snang ba la sems gtad de gnyid log pas rmi lam zin par gsungs pas/ 'di kho nas chog pa ma zad 'di nyid lag len bde la zab pa man ngag myong grub ma yin no/ /de ltar bgyis pas rmi lam ngos zin par 'gyur la zin tshul la 'jam zin dang rtsub zin gnyis las/ 'jam zin ni/ rmi lam du 'dug snyam pa gnyid thum 'phras mang po 'byung ba yin la/ rtsub zin ni/ g.yang la lhung ba/ khyis ded pa/ grib kyis non pa lta bu'i rmi lam 'jigs skrag can rmis pa dang rmi lam du 'dug snyam ste ngo shes par 'gyur ba de'o/ /gal te ngos ma zin na sad 'phral 'phen pa btang ste sngar bzhin gnyid log la bsgom/ dus ni tho rangs/ nam langs/ nyi shar sogs gnad yin la nam smad gnyid lhag cung yod pa'i skabs su sngar bzhin bzung bar bya'o/ /der ma zad nyin mo'i dus su rmi lam gyi dran 'dun rgyun chags su brten pa'i nus pas sad dus kyi snang ba rags pa 'di nub cing gnyid 'thug por ma song ba'i bar der/ rna bar sgra rong pa'am/ lus sbrid chil snyam pa/ thib thib kyis non zhing gnyid thum 'phras dang*/ smin mtshams sbrid sbrid pa lta bu'i nyams kyi rjes thog de ma thag par mi'am khang khyim sogs rtog pa gsal po min pa mog mog po rab rib tsam du 'byung ba de rmi lam gyi rgyu yin pas de ka ngos zin par byas na/ khab mig tu skud pa tshud pa bzhin rmi lam mu 'byor ba yin pas/ de dus mig mi 'byed par 'og rlung bskum la gang zin der gtad pas rim par 'byongs par 'gyur ro/

/gnyis pa la rmi lam spel bsgyur sbyang ba/ rmi lam sgyu mar sbyang ba/ zhar byung sgyu lus sogs gzhan bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rmi lam ngos zin nas brtan pa thob phyir mtha' gcig tu zhen pa'i gnyen por spel bsgyur bya ba ni/ sngon 'gro nas bla ma'i rnal 'byor bar snga ma bzhin gtong*/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo/ bla ma rin po che mkhyen no/ /bdag gi rmi lam 'byongs par mdzad du gsol/ ces gsol ba drag tu gdab/ mthar nyin snang 'di kun rmi lam dngos yin/ rmi lam gyi snang ba bden par ma grub pas cir yang bsgyur du btub snyam du bsams nas/ rang lus yi dam la bsgyur ba dang*/ de'ang gcig nas mang por spel ba nam mkha' gang ba phar spro ba dang*/ mang po rnams gcig tu tshur bsdu ba sogs dang*/ de bzhin bem po srog ldan du bsgyur ba/ srog ldan bem por bsgyur ba/ me chur bsgyur ba/ chu mer bsgyur ba/ 'dre yi dam la bsgyur ba sogs ji tsam 'dod par spel zhing gang 'dod du bsgyur bar bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo/ bla ma rin po che mkhyen no/ /bdag gi rmi lam sgyu ma lta bu 'char bar mdzad du gsol/ /ces gsol ba drag tu btab/ nyin par rmi lam bzung ba'i dran 'dun gyi thog rmi lam ngo shes pa tsam gyis mi phan/ lha sku sgyu ma lta bur dran 'dun yang yang bya la/ nyal dus 'jigs skrag gi snang ba lta bu'i rkyen byas nas lha sku rtsol med du bsgyur nus na des chog de ltar ma thub bar du bskyar la bsgyur nas bsgom/ de ka la rmi lam sgyu ma lta bu'i 'dun pas sbyangs te/ lha sku de'ang me long nang gi gzugs brnyan bzhin snang stong zhen med du bsgoms pas/ mtshan mo'ang rmi lam du skrag snang lta bu'i rkyen byas nas lha sku gsal stong 'dzin med sgyu ma lta bu rang shar bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas lha sku sna tshogs pa rtsol med du sprul zhing mang por spel nas/

cir yang bsgyur ba sogs kyis snang ba thams cad lha sku gsal stong du 'char zhing 'phel bar 'gyur ro/ de ltar rmi lam gyi snang ba sgyu mar gtan la phab/ slar de nyid snang ba la bsres nas bsgom pa yin la/ de yang dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo/ bla ma rin po che mkhyen no/ /bdag gi rmi lam sgyu mar sbyangs par mdzad du gsol/ ces gsol ba drag tu gdab/ de la me chu gcan gzan sogs 'jigs skrag gi snang ba yid la byed cing thog brdzis byed pa ni/ nga gnyid du song 'dug lus 'di rmi lam bag chags kyi lus dang*/ snang ba 'di'ang rmi lam gyi snang ba yin la rmi lam nang mes 'tshig pa/ chus khyer ba/ g.yang la lhung rgyu sogs ni med snyam nas me chu g.yang du mchong la rmi lam sgyu ma'i dran 'dun bya/ 'di rnams sems kyi 'khrul snang yin/ sems ni dus gsum rgyal bas kyang gzigs su med cing*/ stong pa nyid yin bsam pa dang de nyid rang sems dang bsres la mnyam par bzhag go /zhar byung sgyu lus dang*/ 'od gsal/ bar do sogs gcig tu nyams su len tshul bshad pa'o/ /dang po la'ang ma dag pa dang dag pa'i sgyu lus sbyong ba la gnyis las/ dang po ni/ de yang spyir sgyu lus zhes pa 'di sgyu ma'i dpe brgyad dang sbyar ba sogs mang yang bsdu na ma dag pa dang dag pa gnyis la 'du bas/ thog mar dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo/ bla ma rin po che mkhyen no/ /bdag gi rmi lam ma dag sgyu lus su sbyangs par mdzad du gsol/ ces gsol ba drag tu gdab/ rang lus me long du shar bcug la/ de la bstod smad byas kyang dga' sdug sogs e skye blta'o/ /de bzhin du lus sgyu ma dang*/ ngag brag cha/ sems smig sgyu lta bur bzang ngan bde sdug re dogs sogs rang bzhin gyis ma grub par sgyu ma dang rmi lam ltar bsgoms la mnyam pa nyid kyi ngang du bzhag par bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo/

bla ma rin po che mkhyen no/ /bdag gi rmi lam dag pa sgyu lus su sbyangs par mdzad du gsol/ ces gsol ba drag tu gdab/ 'dir sgyu ma lta bu'i bskyed rim bsgom dgos pas de'i tshul gsham du'ang gsal bar 'gyur la/ spyir mtshan mo'i rmi lam zin pa dang gang yang bsgyur du btub snyam pa'i sgo nas rang lus dngos sam lhar mos shing*/ yar nam mkhar 'phur nas padma 'od dang bde ba can sogs rang bzhin dag pa'i zhing khams nyul ba/ sangs rgyas mchod cing chos nyan pa dang*/ de bzhin du bla ma mjal zhing chos thos par bsam pa dang*/ lha yul sogs mtho ris srid pa'i khams nyul ba/ ma dag pa'i zhing dmyal ba sogs ngan song gsum dang srid pa'i gnas ris nyul la gzhan don sgrub pa'i 'dun mos bzang po bya/ de bzhin mtshan dus su'ang de ltar nus pa 'byung zhing*/ de'ang dang po 'ol spyi tsam dang*/ rim bzhin je gsal du 'gyur bas mthar ji lta ba bzhin shes par 'gyur ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo/ bla ma rin po che mkhyen no/ /bdag gi 'od gsal zin par mdzad du gsol/ 'od gsal la zung 'jug gi lha sku 'char bar mdzad du gsol/ ces gsol ba drag tu gdab/ mthar nyin dus sgyu ma rmi lam gyi 'dun pa'i steng*/ do nub 'od gsal ngos zin par byas te de las lha skur ldang bar bya'o snyam pa'i dran 'dun bya/ da lta lha dang tha mal sogs gang du snang rung*/ snang ba de dang gang snang mkhan gyi sems la bltas pas sgyu mar snang ba tsam gyis 'dzin pa'ang rang dag pa'i ngang der gtad med du bzhag pas/ sems 'od gsal la thim ste gsal stong rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes rang shugs su 'char ro/ /yang de ga'i ngang la chu las nya ldang ba bzhin gsal stong zhen bral gyi lha skur ldang ba la sbyang zhing*/ mtshan mo nyal ba'i dus su snying kha'i hrīḥ'am āḥyig dkar po phra zhing 'bar ba zhig gsal la/ de 'dzin med kyi ngang du mnyam par bzhag cing yengs med du bsgom/

gnyid dang rmi lam gyi bar la rtog pa ma zhugs par bya zhing āḥdakar la sems gtad pas tha mal ba'i gnyid mun 'thib pa ltar 'gro rgyu zhig yod pa de/ 'od gsal gyis zin pa rnams la dbyings dwangs par nyi ma'i mdangs shar ba bzhin/ gsal la rtog pa med pa bde la zhen pa med par 'char ro/ /de'ang srab mo'i 'od gsal zin pa na/ gnyid dang lhan cig gsal stong la blos 'dzin pa cung zad dang bcas pa'i nyams 'char ro/ /'thug po'i 'od gsal zin na/ gsal stong nam mkha' lta bu la 'dzin med du gnas pas brtan nyams 'byung ngo*/ /de la spel bsgyur sogs sngar bzhin nyin mtshan gyi man ngag gis sbyangs na/ lha sku nam mkha' gang ba phan tshun mi sgrib par 'char zhing snang la rang bzhin med pa/ gsal la rtog pa med pa/ bde la zhen pa med pa ste mtshan nyid gsum ldan du 'char ro/ /gsum pa bar do ni/ zhal gdams kyi le tshan las/ bzang ngan las dbang rkyen gyi rtar bskyon nas: bar do gnyis snang 'jigs skrag shar ba'i tshe: thams cad sgyu mar shes pa'i dpa' gdeng bskyed: ces gsungs pa ltar/ snang ba thams cad sgyu ma lta bu'am mtshan snang rmi lam gyi snang ba la brten nas bar do la bar do ru ngo shes par bya'o snyam du 'dun pa sngon du btang*/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo/ bla ma rin po che mkhyen no/ /bdag gi bar do ngo shes dang sku gsum du 'char bar mdzad du gsol/ ces gsol ba drag tu gdab/ rmi lam zin pa dang 'di bar do'i snang ba yin 'dug /bdag gis bar do'i man ngag rnams mngon du bya'o snyam du dran par byas la/ bar do'i man ngag rnams yid la gsal btab cing bsgoms pas/ rmi lam du ma 'chor bar dran cing zin na bar do zin par 'gyur ro/ /de la 'dir dbang po 'bring rnams kyis 'chi kha bar dor 'chi ltas byung ba dang*/ 'chi ba 'od gsal chos sku mngon du byas la/ de las bar do zung 'jug sgyu ma'i skur langs te sems can gyi don bya ba'i 'phen pa sngon du btang*/

sad dus kyi snang ba 'di'ang bar do yin snyam ste yang yang 'dun pas bzung*/ gnyid dang rmi lam du'ang bar do ru 'dug snyam du gdams ngag bsgoms pas/ nam zhig 'chi ba'i tshe 'od gsal ma bu 'dres pa'i ye shes 'chi sems bde stong 'od gsal du gnas 'gyur ba las/ bar do'i dod du zung 'jug gi lha sku rang shar nas grol bar 'gyur ro/ /dbang po tha ma la'ang gsum du phye bas rab ni sad rmi'i dus thams cad du sgyu lus rmi lam bar do gsum dbyer med du bsgoms pas gom pa na/ mthar 'chi ba'i dus su mig sogs dbang po lnga'i rlung nang du thim pa'i gzugs sogs tshogs drug yul gyi snang ba nub pa/ snang ba thim pa'i rim pa dang*/ sa chu la thim pas lus zung shor/ chu me la thim pas kha sna skam/ me rlung la thim pas drod yal/ rlung rnam shes la thim pas phyi dbugs chad pa'i bar rags pa'i 'byung ba thim rim dang*/ skabs 'dir dkar nag gi las stobs che ba rnams la ye shes mkha' 'gro ma dang*/ gshin rje'i bsun ma 'byung bar bshad/ phra ba rtog pa'i thim rim ni/ phyi dbugs gnas pa'i dang po rtog pa thim pa'i rim pa bzhin phyi rtags su zla ba shar ba/ nang rtags su du ba lta bu snang ba'i skabs de mched pa la thim/ zhe sdang gi rtog pa so gsum 'gags/ phyi rtags su nyi ma shar ba/ nang rtags su me khyer lta bu mched pa'i skabs de nyer thob la thim/ 'dod chags kyi rtog pa bzhi bcu 'gags/ phyi rtags su nag lam sgra gcan gyi snang ba/ nang rtags su mun srod pa lta bu snang ba nyer thob de 'od gsal la thim/ gti mug gi rtog pa bdun 'gags pa'i bar phra ba thim pa/ 'od gsal gyi skabs 'chi srid kyi dngos gzhi dang bar do mgo rtsom pa yin pas/ phyi rtags su skya rengs shar ba/ nang rtags su ston gnam g.ya' dag pa lta bu nyams len pa rnams kyi gzhi gnas ma'i 'od gsal zhes rang shar ba nyid/ nyams len lam gyi 'od gsal gyis ngo shes nas rig pa 'od gsal ma bu ngo 'phrod/

skye med 'od gsal chos sku ru shar/ de las rol pa 'gag med longs sku rang shar lhun grub tu shar bas sprul sku phrin las kyi rang rtsal gyis sems can rnams smin cing grol bar mdzad pa yin no/ /'bring ni/ snang ba gsum ma dag cing sgyu ma lta bu'i rang bzhin du ma shes pas/ 'od gsal las/ snang gsum 'byung bzhi dang bcas pa lugs ldog tu langs nas 'byung bzhi phra ba las bar do'i lus len la/ de'ang 'od gsal ngo ma shes pas/ gti mug gi rtog pa bdun langs/ snang ba nyer thob shar/ stong pa chen po/ 'dod chags kyi rtog pa bzhi bcu langs/ mched pa shar/ shin tu stong pa/ zhe sdang gi rtog pa so gsum langs/ snang ba shar/ stong pa zhes bya ba slar khyab byed kyi rlung gis 'du byas te rnam shes sgo dgu'i lam gang rung nas 'phos te bar do'i srid pa grub la/ de yang srid pa bar do ni/ gzhung las/ dbang po kun tshang thogs med rgyu: sha gzugs bag chags 'brel ba'i lus: 'dzin chags bar do'i nang tshan mthong : tshe 'di'i snang ba nyin snang 'dra: bag chags ma gtogs nub par gyur: ci phyir tshogs drug don la 'khrul: zhes gsungs pa ltar/ bar do'i sems can de dbang po kun tshang zhing*/ ma yi mngal ma gtogs gang la'ang thogs med du rgyu nus pa'i rdzu 'phrul can/ bar dor ci tsam gnas pa'i dus phyed gang du skye 'gyur gyi sha tshugs can/ phyed snga ma'i bag chags 'brel ba'i lus gzugs la 'dzin chags dbang btsan pa'i rigs mthun bar do'i nang tshan mthong ba yin la/ thog mar ngos ma zin par tshe 'di'i snang ba kho na 'char/ de nas shi ba ngo shes nas 'jigs skrag mya ngan che ba 'byung*/ de dus gdams ngag dran dgos pa'i dus yin la de yang dus ni/ sngon byung srid pa'i bag chags sha gzugs la: ma chags ma zhen sgyu mar shes par gyis: nga nyid dus gsum mkhyen pa'i ngo bor sgoms: rang nyid bskyed rdzogs zung ldan gsal stong ngang :

zhes gsungs pa bzhin/ da lta nas lam 'khyer la slob pa gal che bas bar do'i snang ba 'char ba'i dran 'dun dang skyo shas drag po bskyed de/ bar do longs skur grol bar gsol ba btab la/ rang dang snang ba gang shar thams cad la cer re bltas te nga shi 'dug snang ba 'di thams cad bar do'i snang bar 'dug pas bar do la bar do ru ngo shes par byas la sbyang bar bya'o snyam pas/ bar do yid kyi lus 'od gsal du bcug ste 'di las zung 'jug sgyu ma'i lha sku ru gnas 'gyur/ longs skur ldang bar bya'o snyam pa'i 'phen pas longs skur rang shar du 'char la/ mthar thug lugs ldog tu snang ba gsum gyis rgyu byas te 'bras bu rdo rje 'chang du 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ro/ /tha ma ni/ gong gsal bar do gnyis par lam ma chod na/ sgra 'od zer gsum gyi snang ba shar te/ de tshe sgras dngangs so/ /'od kyis 'jigs so/ /zer gyis skrag go /sku yi bkod pa rnams ma shes nas brgyal lo/ /de tshe 'jigs skrag thams cad sgyu mar shes pa dang*/ snang ba thams cad rang snang du ngo shes na grol bar 'gyur ro/ /de tshe skye gnas la sred pa skye zhing chags sdang ldang ba'i dus yin pas gang la yang chags sdang spong ba gal che la/ nga shi 'dug snyam pa'i skrag par mi bya zhing*/ kye ma chags sdang gis skye ba len pa 'di shin tu sdug bsngal na/ da ni dag pa'i zhing du 'gro bar bya'o snyam pa'i bar do sprul pa'i skur grol bar gsol ba btab la/ skye gnas kyi 'jug sgo rnams rab stong nyid rtogs pa'i lta bas dgag 'bring bar do'i snang ba thams cad rang snang*/ rang snang thams cad bden med sgyu ma lta bu'i rtsal snang gis snang grags rig gsum lha sngags ting 'dzin du lam khyer gyis dgag tha ma tshangs spyod dang skyabs 'gro la sogs pa'i skye gnas ngan pa bkag nas dag pa'i zhing du 'gro bar bya'o snyam pa'i dran 'dun drag pos 'pho ba'i gdams pa dang*/

smon lam gyi 'phen pa rnams kyis bar do nas 'phos te rang bzhin sprul pa'i zhing rnams su skyes nas grol bar 'gyur ro/ /de ltar nyams su blangs pas mthong ba'i chos la zung 'jug sgyu ma'i sku 'grub par 'gyur la/ gal te de ltar ma 'grub na'ang bla mar mos gus dang snod bcud zhing khams su bsgyur ba'i dag snang*/ bden med sgyu mar 'dun pa rnams da lta nyin mtshan kun tu yang yang nyams su blangs pa de/ sa bon gyi tshul du song nas dbang po rab 'bring tha ma'i khyad par gyis bar do gsum gang rung du grol bar gsungs pa bzhin nyams su len par mdzad 'tshal lo/ /bzhi pa 'pho ba bsdus te bstan pa ni/ de ltar rdzogs pa'i rim pa rnams ma thob pa'am/ thob kyang goms 'dris chung ba dag la phan pa'i phyir/ gzhung las/ nyi nub sgyu lus gnad gcod drag pos zhig: nga nyid spyi bor snang mthar rlung sems bsres: zhes dang*/ zhal gdams las/ nam zhig tshe yi 'phen pa zad pa'i tshe: rtsa gsum 'khor lo drug rnams rim par bsdu: snang mched thob gsum shar nas lus sems bral: rnam shes myu gu'i me tog yal ba'i tshe: nga nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor zab lam bsgom: dran rig 'od lus āḥyig chos skur 'pho: rang nyid rnam snang chos bdun khregs ser bzhag: ces gsungs pa bzhin 'pho ba'i dmigs pa ma rgyud 'pho ba ka dag ye grol gyi khrid yig kho bos byas pa zur gsal ltar/ da lta nyid du 'pho ba'i man ngag brgyud ldan bla ma'i zhal las nos te gzhung las gsungs pa bzhin/ nyin bdun nam gsum sogs rtags tshad lon par sbyang ba dang*/ dus la bab tshe las la sbyor chog gi gra sgrigs shig med na zhus lo thob lo tsam gyis mi yong ste dgra ngan thog tu slebs tshe go mtshon yod pa tsam gyis mi phan la/ snun rtsal gyi lag len byang chub pa zhig dgos pa bzhin no/ /de dag gis mtshan bcas rdzogs pa'i rim pa cung zad bkral ba re zhig rdzogs so/

/de ltar brtsams pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa'i zab gter thugs sgrub bder 'dus kyi cha lag bsam lhun gyi sgrub thabs zhal gdams le'u bcu gsum las rdzogs rim gyi khrid skor phyogs bsdus dus bzhi sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor zhes bya ba 'di'ang*/ ring mo zhig nas gcung sman pa bla ma chos kyi blo gros dang da lta rang lugs chos drug de 'dra yod med dri ba dris lan gyi skabs su/ khong gis da yod rdzogs rim khrid rkang de dag la khrid yig re med na rang skya 'pher thabs mi 'dug la/ da phyin ci nas kyang rdzogs rim gyi skor la 'grel pa dang khrid yig re 'bri thub rgyu ci nas kyang gal che bar 'dug de lugs bzhin gus chos tshogs dang bcas pas gsol ba 'debs pa yin pas/ cis kyang thugs la 'dogs par zhu zhes nan bskul yang yang byung ba yid 'jog khar/ lo der bar do'i khrid kyi skor nyams zhib dang 'brel rang gzhung man ngag blta bsdur skabs gdams zab rnams phyogs gcig tu nyams su len thabs shig byung na shin tu dge bar mthong ste/ gter gzhung khrid yig la rigs mthun gzhung dang bla ma'i man ngag gis brgyan cing*/ rang gis nyams su len phyir nges pa'i gnad rnams yi ge'i lam du bkod par byas pa las/ slar rab byung bcu bdun pa me phag lo/ cho 'phrul chen po'i dus kyi zla ba nya gang ba'i tshe/ gnam lcags kyi zab gter dpe bskrun byas pa yongs kyi mtha' rten zab pa khrid kyi skor rnams phyogs bsgrigs skabs grub par bgyis pa'i skabs phri snon cung zad bcas yi ge pa ni 'phen sprul gyis bgyis pa 'dis kyang*/ bstan pa 'di nyid la sri zhu dang drin can bla ma rnams kyi thugs bzhed bskang phyir smon yang*/ lar rang nyid chos drug sogs la nyams rgyus zhan zhing gter gzhung kha 'thor che ba'i rkyen gyis dgongs pa gnad du ma khel cing*/ ma rtogs log rtog gi dri ma'i nyes pa mchis na rtsa gsum rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i spyan sngar 'chags shing*/
dge bas snying po'i ring lugs 'di nyid mi nyams yun du gnas pa'i rgyur gyur cig

ces sgo chen rgyal ba'i skye phreng du 'bod pa gnam lcags bstan 'dzin ming can gyis gu ru'i sgrub gnas a su ra'i rdo rje ke'u tshang dang 'dabs 'brel/ mkha' spyod ḍākki'i tshogs khang g.yu lo bkod rje btsun gling du grub par bgyis pa'o// // ta) ༄༅/ /zhi khro na rag dong sprugs kyi/ bar do'i rtsa khrid thos pa rang grol zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /ram̐ng rig gdod ma'i gnas lugs kyi/ /ram̐ng ngo rig nas gshis thog tu/ /ram̐ng grol kun tu bzang po zhes/ /ram̐ng byung sangs rgyas de la 'dud/ /ye gzhi ma rtogs 'khrul gzhir gol/ /de las 'khrul snang 'khor ba ni/ /thog mtha' bar med 'gal me bzhin/ /'khor nas gzhi thog ma grol bar/ /bar do chen por yongs su grub/ /dbye na bar do drug gsum bzhi/ /gcig sogs 'dod pa tha dad kyang*/ /don gyi 'jog so gcig pa'i phyir/ /man ngag lugs bzhin 'dir bshad bya/ /de'ang gter chen rtsa gsum gling pa'i zab gter zhi khro na rag dong sprugs zhes pa/ mthong thos dran reg gi 'brel tshad kun rang sar grol ba'i thabs mchog ma bsgoms par 'tshang rgya ba'i gdams pa zab mo 'di nyid nyung ngu tshig gis cung zad dgrol ba la/ chos bdag mkha' 'gro chos skyong rnams kyis bka' yi gnang ba mdzad du gsol lo/ /de la thog mar bar do'i ngo bo ni/ gzhi dbyings ka dag las gzhan du snang ba thams cad yin te/ gzhi dbyings las ni bskyod/ slar gzhi snang ka dag gi gzhi thog tu ma ldog pa'i bar du yod pas na thams cad bar dor gcig go /de'ang gzhi las gzhi snang du shar ba'i sku dang ye shes kyi snang cha ni/ dag pa chos nyid kyi bar do/ 'gro drug tu snang ba'i 'khrul snang gi chos thams cad ma dag 'khrul pa'i bar do ste gnyis su'ang 'du'o/ /yang rang bzhin skye gnas/ 'chi kha sdug bsngal/ chos nyid srid pa ste bar do gsum du'ang gsungs mod/ phal che ba'i dbang du byas na rang bzhin skye gnas kyi bar do/

'chi kha sdug bsngal gyi bar do/ chos nyid 'od gsal gyi bar do/ srid pa las kyi bar do ste bzhi ru brjod do/ /de bzhin du zhi khro dgongs pa rang grol bar do'i thos grol chen mo ru skye gnas bar do/ rmi lam bar do/ bsam gtan bar do/ 'chi kha bar do/ chos nyid bar do/ srid pa bar do dang drug tu gsungs la/ rang lugs rtsa ba'i gter gzhung thos grol gyi rtsa tshig kyang de dang mtshungs shing*/ de ltar bzhed lugs mang mod kyang*/ don gyi dgongs pa gcig tu bab pas 'dir go bde don gsal gyi dbang du byas te/ rang bzhin skye gnas kyi bar do/ 'chi kha sdug bsngal gyi bar do/ chos nyid 'od gsal gyi bar do/ 'khrul snang srid pa'i bar do ste bzhi ru bsdus te bshad par bya la/ de'ang skye gnas kyi nang gses su rmi lam bar do dang*/ bsam gtan bar do gnyis su phyes te man ngag bzhin brjod par bya zhing*/ de dag re re la'ang ngo bo ngos bzung ba/ 'char tshul rgyas par bshad pa/ gdams ngag lam du bya ba dang gsum gsum gyis bshad par bya ba las/ ༈ dang po rang bzhin skye gnas kyi bar do bshad pa la gsum las/ dang po ngo bo ngos bzung ba ni/ rang bzhin skye gnas kyi bar do zhes thog mar ma'i mngal las skyes pa nas 'chi nad drag pos ma thebs bar du'o/ /gnyis pa 'char tshul rgyas par bshad pa ni/ spyir 'gro ba drug po las snang tsam yin par mtshungs kyang*/ snang yul gcig la rigs drug gi 'gro bar snang ba tha dad par 'char la/ de bzhin gang zag la mtshon na'ang dbang po mchog dman gyi khyad par las snang tshul gcig tu ma nges te/ lam rnal 'byor pa'i ngor snang grags rig gsum lha sngags ye shes kyi 'khor lor ye nas yin par rtogs la/ snod bcud kun dkyil 'khor du lhun gyis grub cing*/ rtog tshogs chos nyid kyi rol par dngos su shar cing de'i ngang du grol ba'i phyir/ tshul 'di la zung 'jug sku bzhi'i bar do zhes gsungs pa'ang yod la/

ting 'dzin bsam gtan gyi bar do'ang 'di las logs su med pa ma zad/ de rnams skye gnas bar do las gzhan du'ang ma yin no/ /de ltar ma rtogs pa'i gang zag tha mal pa rnams ni/ skyes nas 'chi nad kyis ma thebs pa'i bar rtag tu bag chags ngan goms 'khrul snang a 'thas kyi rjes su 'brangs te/ mi bden pa la bden par 'dzin/ mi rtag pa la rtag tu re/ sdug bsngal la bde bar 'khrul cing zhen pas/ dgra 'dul zhing gnyen skyong ba sogs chags sdang*/ bsags bsrung spel gsum sogs chos brgyad 'khrul zhen gyi bya ba'i ngang mi tshe yud tsam pa de don med stong zad du gtong ba skye 'gro phal mo che'i snang tshul gyi chos nyid yin pas/ de'ang skye gnas bar do'i rang bzhin las ma 'das so/ /de bzhin du mtshan mo'ang man ngag gi gnad kyis ma zin pa'i dud 'gro bzhin gti mug ro nyal byas pas/ bag chags nying 'khrul rmi lam gyi snang ba sna tshogs pa bskyed cing chags sdang sdug bsngal zad pa med par nyams su myong ba 'di la rmi lam gyi bar do brjod cing*/ de'ang skye gnas bar do'i rang bzhin las ma 'das so/ /mdor na skye gnas bar do'i nang kha cig gis gnas lugs rtogs nas nyin mtshan 'od gsal gyi 'khor lo nyams su blangs pas grol bar 'gyur ba dang*/ gzhan nyin mtshan 'khrul snang khor mo yug tu bskyod cing 'khor ba mtha' med par 'khyam par 'gyur ba'i phyir na/ spyir skye gnas bar dor/ nang gses su nying 'khrul rmi lam gyi bar do/ ting 'dzin bsam gtan gyi bar do zhes so sor yod pa'i cha nas dbye ba'ang ches 'thad pas na de bzhin brjod par bya'o/ /gsum pa gdams ngag lam du bya ba la'ang*/ spyi dang bye brag gnyis kyi dang po ni/ spyir rang bzhin skye gnas kyi bar do la thi bya tshang la 'jug pa lta bu'i man ngag la bslab par gsungs te/ de la thi byas sngon la gang gi gnod pa yong min legs par brtags la btsan sa bzung nas tshang bcas pa la slad the tshom med par 'jug pa bzhin tshe 'dir nyams len la 'bad pa gal che ste/

gter gzhung zhi khro bar do drug gi rtsa tho las/ kye maḥ bdag la skye gnas bar do 'char dus 'dir: tshe la long med dal 'byor mi lus 'di: rab rib ngang las snang ba yud kyis zad: shin tu rnyed dka' thob pa'i dus 'di ru: rin chen gling nas stong log ma 'khyams par: brtson 'grus zab mo'i rgyud bskul snying po longs: thos bsam sgom gsum lung rigs zab mo'i chos: bskyed rdzogs gnyis te 'dus pa'i gnad 'di la: long yod dud 'gro lta bur ma nyal bar: da lta nyid du 'bad pa drag po yis: mi rtag 'chi ba sgom pa'i lcag gis bskul: long med blo sna stung ba'i dus gcig pu: zhes gsungs pa bzhin da res shin tu rnyed par dka' ba yid bzhin gyi nor bu las kyang lhag pa'i dal 'byor gyi mi lus lan gcig thob pa'i skabs 'dir/ snying po dam pa'i lha chos shig ma 'grub na/ rin chen gling du slebs nas lag stong du phyin pa bzhin 'gyur bas na rten bzang chud zos su ma song bar brtson 'grus zab mos rgyud bskul cing*/ blo ldog rnam pa bzhis rang rgyud legs par sbyangs/ bla ma dam pa mtshan nyid dang ldan pa btsal la/ de nyid mnyes pa gsum gyis legs par mnyes par byas nas/ mdo sngags kyi gzhung la thos bsam phyogs med du bya zhing lung rigs kyis brdar sha gcod pa gal che/ 'on kyang ha cang thos pa la zhen cing 'byams na tha snyad kyi tshig mthar 'khor nas don gyi snying po mi lon pas/ gang thos rang gi rgyud la bkal nas bsam pas gtan la dbab/ de'ang bla ma'i man ngag las zhun thar bcad cing sngon 'gro bsags sbyang nas brtsam/ chos dang rang rgyud 'dres nges pa zhig ma byas na/ lad mo byas pa tsam gyis gar yang mi phyin/ dngos gzhi dbang gi don ni rang rgyud smin par bya ba yin na/ dbang don ngo 'phrod dgos kyi bum pa mgo la bzhag pa tsam gyis dbang bskur gyi don gang yang mi 'byung ba'ang shes dgos so/

/de bzhin du dbang gi srog dam tshig la rag las pas de ma nyams par bsrung ba gal che la/ mgo bo chad na slar gso mi rung ba bzhin rtsa ba'i dam tshig nyams na bar do med par na rag chen por mar gyi zang thal du skye bar gsar rnying gi rgyud sde kun na gsal lo/ khyad par du bar do 'og ma thams cad kyi skabs su grol thabs sku gsum lam khyer sogs man ngag mang du bzhugs kyang*/ gnad 'gag ni skye gnas bar do'i skabs 'dir rag las te/ nyams len gyi goms shugs dang ldan par ma gyur na glo bur 'chi rkyen gyi 'gag la thug tshe bag chags kyi gzhan dbang btsan po'i dbang du mi 'gyur ba ni dka' bar snang ste/ dper na 'phrul mda' khyad par can dang ldan yang bsnun rtsal gyi lag len la byang ma chub cing rgol thabs mi shes na/ pha rol dgra rgod thog rgyag tu slebs tshe ci bya gtol med du 'gyur ba bzhin lags so/ /des na grol byed kyi lam thams cad bskyed rdzogs rdzogs chen gsum la 'du zhing skye 'chi bar do'i lam 'khyer yang der ma 'dus pa med do/ /gnyis pa ni/ de nas grol byed kyi gdams pa dngos la'ang zhus lo dang thob lo tsam gyis rang rgyud grol ba lta zhog nyon mongs dang bdag 'dzin cung zad kha bri ba tsam yang shin tu dka' ba bdag dang bdag lta bur mthun snang du mngon sum gyis grub phyir/ da lta rang dbang rang la yod pa'i dus 'dir bskyed rdzogs rdzogs chen sogs gang la nyams len byed pa de nyid kyi lam rtags rnams tshul bzhin du shar thub pa zhig dang*/ tha na'ang tshig don la nges pa rnyed pa'i thabs la nan tan du bya ba ni spyir gces pa dang*/ bskyed rim la mtshon na nyams lnga mthar son nas yul gsum gyad du gyur pa de 'dra ma gyur kyang*/ bskyed rim gyi go don slong zhing cung zad goms 'dris brtan pa gal che/ mtshan bcas rdzogs rim gyi dbang du byas na/ gtum mo lam gyi gzhung shing la nyams len brtson 'grus drag pos 'bad de gnas pa rtsa/

g.yo ba rlung*/ bkod pa byang chub sems kyi nyams len la rtsal sbyangs te/ sgo gnyis gang la bsten pa'i thabs lam dpe'i ye shes la brten nas/ zag med lhan skyes kyi ye shes bde stong zung 'jug don gyi ye shes ngos zin par byas la gnad du bsnun pa dang*/ mtshan med 'od gsal phyag rgya chen po'i nyams len rgyun gyi rnal 'byor la bslab pa dang*/ mtshan mo'i char rmi lam dang 'od gsal/ thun mtshams thams cad du sgyu lus dang bar do/ thun gyi mgo mjug rnams su bla ma yi dam gyi bskyed bzlas gsol 'debs bsngo smon la sogs pas tshe 'dir nyams 'og tu chud par byas nas bar do longs skur grol ba'i gdeng thob pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ khyad par du rdzogs pa chen po ka dag khregs chod dang*/ lhun grub thod rgal gy-i nyams len la rang byan tshud par byas la bar do sogs grol byed kyi lam gzhan la ltos mi dgos par/ rab phung po lhag med du grol ba dang*/ 'bring myur du 'tshang rgya ba'i rtags su 'od dang*/ sgra dang*/ gdung dang*/ ring bsrel bcas 'chi srid chos skur grol ba la 'bad dgos/ mdor na skye gnas kyi bar do'i nang du/ nyin snang 'khrul pa'i snang ba dang*/ mtshan snang nying 'khrul zhes rmi lam gyi snang ba dang*/ de gnyis las ldog pa'i sems ting nge 'dzin bsam gtan la gnas pa sogs ji ltar byas kyang de dag skye gnas kyi bar do las gzhan du ma yin mod/ 'on kyang de dag nyams su len tshul gyi thabs so sor gsungs pa bzhin sngar brjod la slar yang brjod par bya'o/ /nang gses su rmi lam dang bsam gtan gyi bar do gnyis bshad par bya ba la/ dang po rmi lam bar do bshad pa la'ang gsum las/ dang po ngo bo ngos bzung ba ni/ gnyid nas ma sad kyi bar du rmi lam gyi snang ba nyams su myong ba'au/ /gnyis pa 'char tshul rgyas par bshad pa ni/ rmi lam bar do zhes nyin mor 'khrul snang la bden par bzung nas chags sdang rang rgyud du shar ba'i stobs kyis/

bag chags la goms pas mtshan mor yang rmi lam du shar te nying 'khrul gyi dbang du song nas/ nyin mtshan bar med du 'khrul pa'i 'khor lo ru kha 'phyan pa yin no/ /gsum pa gdams ngag lam du bya ba dngos brjod pa ni/ gter gzhung zhi khro bar do drug gi rtsa tho las/ kye maḥ bdag la rmi lam bar do shar ba'i tshe: nyin snang thams cad bden med stong pa nyid: mtshan mo bag chags yid lus phya phyo la: bdag 'dzin bral ba'i shes pa so mar lhod: 'khrul snang bag med sbyang ba'i dus gcig pu: rtsa khams bar do rmi lam longs sku'i zhing : yid lus stong gzugs sgyu mar don rtogs nas: rjes shes bag yod ting 'dzin 'char bar shog: ces gsungs pa bzhin du rmi lam sbyang ba la gsum las/ dang po nyin snang sbyang ba ni/ nyin snang thams cad rmi lam yin snyam pa dang*/ gang snang ba 'di thams cad rang bzhin gyis ma grub pas sgyu mar sbyang ba dang*/ snang yang bden par ma grub snyam pas bden med stong pa nyid du ngo shes par bya'o/ /gnyis pa mtshan snang rmi lam sbyang ba ni/ nyal khar bla ma la gsol ba 'debs/ rmi lam la rmi lam du ngo shes par bya'o snyam pa'i dran 'dun bya/ lus seṅge'i nyal stabs byas la rang lus lha sku gsal stong du bsgom zhing*/ snying ga'i a yig dkar po la sems bzung ste gnyid log pas rmi lam mang la gsal bar rmis shing rmi lam ngos zin par 'gyur ro/ /gsum pa sprul bsgyur sbyang ba ni/ de ltar rmi lam ngos zin pa dang*/ sad du mi 'jug par 'dod na mang du spel zhing*/ sad par 'dod na sad du 'jug pa dang*/ yang rmi lam sprul bsgyur zhes rang gi gang 'dod du bsgyur ba/ ngan pa bzang por bsgyur ba dang*/ rgyal 'gong yi dam la bsgyur ba dang*/ klu khyung la bsgyur ba lta bu sprul bsgyur 'gyed pa sogs la rtsal sbyang ba dang*/ rmi lam du me chu g.yang sa sogs rmis te dngangs skrag skyes na/ 'di rmi lam yin/

rmi lam ni bden med sgyu ma lta bu yin pas mes mi tshig chu dang g.yang la lhung ba med snyam nas thog brdzis kyis mchong ba la sgyu lus su bsre ba dang*/ de'ang bdag med 'dzin bral blo 'das kyi ngang du shes pa so mar lhod kyis glod la/ nyin mtshan 'od gsal du la bzla bar bya'o/ /de'i don zhib par 'dod na kho bos byas pa'i bde 'dus rmi lam gyi khrid las shes par bya'o/ /de ltar byas pas rtsa khams gdan gsum gyi dkyil 'khor du smin/ ma dag pa'i rlung sems rang sar dag cing*/ dbang rab tshe 'dir grol ba la bar do'i gdams pa mi dgos shing*/ dbang 'bring rnams 'chi ltas byung ba dang 'chi srid chos sku mngon du byas nas/ de las bar dor zung 'jug sgyu ma'i skur rang shar nas longs skur grol ba dang*/ tha ma'ang srid pa bar do ru sprul skur grol tshul sogs 'og tu 'chad par 'gyur ro/ /gnyis pa bsam gtan bar do la'ang gsum las/ dang po ngo bo ngos bzung ba ni/ sems ting nge 'dzin la gnas nas ma sad pa'i bar ro/ /gnyis pa 'char tshul rgyas par bshad pa ni/ bla ma mchog la bsten nas man ngag bdar sha chod par byas la/ sgo gsum tha mal du ma shor cing*/ snang grags rig gsum lha sngags ye shes kyi 'khor lor shar ba'i bskyed rim dang*/ thos bsam sgom pa las byung ba'i nyams myong ltar so so'i rgyud tshod la dpags nas/ chen po gsum gyi lta dgongs dang go myong rtogs pa'i sgo nas rang rgyud la sbyar zhing*/ 'khrul snang gzhan dbang du ma song bar dngos gzhi zhi lhag zung 'jug gi don nyams su len pa'o/ /gsum pa gdams ngag lam 'khyer la bslab pa ni/ gter gzhung bar do drug gi rtsa tho las/ kye maḥ bdag la bsam gtan bar do shar ba'i tshe: sgo gsum mtha' bral lta ba brtan pa'i ngang : tshogs drug lam du shar ba'i 'gyu ba kun: der 'dzin bshig la ma bcos so mar zhog: dgag sgrub spang blang bral dgos dus gcig pu:

ting 'dzin ma yengs bsam gtan sgom pa'i tshe: nyon mongs 'khrul pas nam yang mi bslu zhing : dran rig gnyug ma'i gshis lugs rtogs par shog: ces gsungs pa bzhin man ngag gis bdar sha chod par byas la/ dngos gzhi nyams su len skabs rdzogs chen rang lugs ltar na/ thog mar mi med kyi lung stong du lus ngag yid gsum gyi bya ba dgu phrugs su btang zhing*/ sgo gsum ru shan 'byed pa sogs sngon 'gro sems kyi khang bu bshig pa'i man ngag gis mtha' bral gyi lta ba'i nges shes brtan par byas la/ dngos gzhir rig pa rang thog tu ngo sprod pa/ gcig thog tu thag gcod pa/ grol thog tu gdeng 'cha' ba gsum gyis ka dag gnas lugs kyi lta ba gtan la phab nas/ da lta'i tshogs drug gi yul rkyen snang grags rtog tshogs 'gyu ba phra rags gang shar gang skyes thams cad/ der 'dzin med par shig gis bshig la 'dzin med rang grol gyi ngang du ma bcos rig pa rjen pa'i rang so 'dzin pa tsam las/ ched du sgom rgyu ci yang med pa la dgag sgrub spang blang gi lhan pa ma btab par/ yeng med kyi ngang la 'dzin med 'od gsal 'khor yug tu nyams su myong zhing thod rgal gyi gnad gcun pas/ lhun grub sku dang ye shes kyi rang bzhin snang bzhi'i lam rtsal rdzogs nas/ tshe 'dir mi 'jigs rig pas btsan sa zin te lus thog 'dir bar do med par kun bzang chos sku'i go 'phang mngon du 'gyur zhing*/ 'di la gang zag dbang po'i rim pa sogs la ltos nas grol lugs mi 'dra ba 'byung ste/ dpe sbrul mdud nam mkhar grol ba ltar gdams pa thob pa dang grol ba dus mnyam pa rig 'dzin chen po dga' rab rdo rje lta bu/ dpe mtsho la kha ba babs pa ltar gang shar chos nyid du thim nas grol ba bi ma la dang pad 'byung la sogs pa 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku brnyes pa rnams dang*/ dpe 'khyag rom chur zhu ba bzhin gdams pa nyams len la yun du 'bad pas/
