tsha drod rgyas pa/ skyug mer langs pa/ rtsa 'jag dal gyis zug pa sogs 'byung ngo*/ /skabs 'gar mgo 'khor ba dang*/ nag 'thom 'thom dran pa mi zin pa dang*/ dran med brgyal ba sogs byung na sbyangs 'phro bzhag la spyi bor lag pas brdung zhing kaḥyis yang yang phab/ tshe sgrub sogs la nan tan bya'o/ /yang de nyid las/ rtags byung tshe bco lngar sbyang ba ma chag tsam bya: dper na yur tshang wa kha shor ba ltar slar gso bas rang mal du legs par blta: zhes rtags byung na rjes su zla re bzhin tshes bco lnga nam byung la ma chag par bya zhing*/ de yang yur bu kha 'tshang ba dus su gsos pas rang mal tshud pa bzhin no/ /yang sbyong mi rung ba'i dus ni/ gter gzhung las/ 'pho ba sbyong mi rung ba'i dus ni chang 'thung ba: shes rgyud 'khrugs pa dang: ma nyes pa'i kha yog byung skabs rnam shes 'khrugs pa'i rkyen dogs 'ga' rer spang bar bya'o: zhes gsungs pa bzhin rtsod 'dzings sogs khong khros shes rgyud drag tu 'khrugs pa dang*/ ma nyes pa'i kha yog sogs rnam shes 'khrugs pa'i skabs su mi sbyong*/ gzhan yang 'pho ba sbyong ba'i skabs sha chang sogs grib rkyen gyi rigs spang bar gdams so/ /gnyis pa las la sbyor ba ni/ de la las la sbyor ba'i dus ni rang nyid nam zhig 'chi ba'i dus la bab cing cis kyang mi ldog pa'i 'chi ltas 'byung ba thim sdud kyi rim pa 'byung zhing*/ snang mched thim rim rtsom pa'i skabs te mdor na lam la goms 'dris chung ba dag 'pho ba'i las la sbyor ba'i dus ni thim rim shar mgo tshugs pa'i skabs yin no/ /de dag gi tshul rgyas par gzigs 'dod na kho bos byas pa'i bar do'i khrid yig dang bsdu na gter gzhung rang la gzigs par zhu'o/ / ༈ rtsa ba'i gnyis pa gzhan don gshin po rjes 'dzin thugs rje'i 'pho ba la'ang gdab mi dgos pa/ gdab tu med pa/ gdab kyang mi 'jug pa/ 'pho ba 'debs pa'i yul/ nam gdab pa'i dus/

gdab pa'i gdams pa bcas drug go /dang po ni/ gter gzhung las/ gdab mi dgos pa ni nyams len gyi gzhi tshugs: rtogs pa'i gting lon pa: lta ba'i phu thag chod pa rnams so: zhes so/ /gnyis pa ni/ gter gzhung las/ gdab tu med pa gnyis ni: rab rtogs pa mngon du gyur pa rnams dang : rnal 'byor pa lus zhig nas sangs rgyas zhes pas gdab tu med: tha ma sdig po che las ngan rnams kyi phyi dbugs chad nang dbugs ma bral bar dmyal ba'i snang ba 'char te: khrag gi char pa 'bebs pa khrag mtshor byings snyam 'byung ba dang : me lcags gdab pa'i yun gyis dmyal ba'i lus thob pa'o: zhes pa'i dang po gang zag rab kyi skabs sngar nas bshad zin la/ tha ma gdab tu med par gsungs pa ni/ de'ang rgyud las/ nyin bzhin bram ze gsod pa dang*/ /mtshams med lnga po byed pa yang*/ /gdams pa 'di dang phrad gyur na/ /grol 'gyur 'di la the tshom med/ /ces spyir mtshams med lnga bsags pa'i las ngan sdig chen ji ltar yin rung mar gyi zang thal du 'gro nges kyang*/ ngan song gi skye sgo 'gags nas gnas dag par 'pho ba gsungs la/ 'on kyang sngags su zhugs nas rdo rje slob dpon la log par bltas pas mtshon rtsa ba'i dam tshig nyams na gso ba'i yul med par mar gyi zang thal du 'gro bar gsungs par sems so/ /'o na rdo rje theg pa'i skabs nyams pa bdun ldan dag kyang bsgral nas rnam shes rgyal ba'i thugs kar spar tshul ma gsungs sam zer na/ de ni yin te thabs kyis 'dul bar ma nus pa rnams phrin las khyad par can mngon spyod drag pos tshar gcod rjes su 'dzin pa'i thun min gyi phrin las yin pas thabs mi mtshungs so/ /gsum pa ni/ gter gzhung las/ gdab kyang mi 'jug pa bzhi'am lnga'o: snying la mda' thebs pa dang gcig: chur bying ba dang gnyis: g.yang sar lhung ba dang gsum: gangs rud sa rud kyis mnan pa sogs bzhi: de dag rim pa'i thim rim ma rdzogs pa dang :

dbang med du 'pho rigs rnams gdab pa'i go skabs ma mchis so: zhes so/ /de'i dgongs don ni/ rten can thim rim rim can du ma rdzogs par gong gsal rkyen ngan drag po'i dbang du shor ba dag la rang nyid kyis gsal gdab pa'i go skabs ma mchis shing tha na shi ba ngo shes pa yang dka' la/ gzhan gyis gdab pa'i dus sogs go skabs gsal bar ma dmigs pas dman pa la dgag sgra sbyor ba yin gyi gtan nas mi 'jug pa ni min te/ deng dus dam pa rnams kyis gshin po kun la 'pho 'debs mdzad gnang ba ma zad/ dngos su 'pho rtags bzang po dag thon pa las kyang shes par 'gyur ro/ /bzhi pa ni/ gang la 'pho ba gdab pa'i yul gshin po'i phung po dngos su yod pa'am med kyang yid lam du bkod pa ste/ gter gzhung las/ gshin po yid lam du bkod pa: ming nas 'bod pa: zhes so/ /lnga pa ni/ phyi dbugs chad/ nang dbugs ma bral ba'i skabs te/ gter gzhung las/ gdab pa'i yul ni phyi dbugs chad cing nang dbugs ma bral skabs su: zhes gsungs so/ /drug pa ni/ sngar bshad pa bzhin snying rje chen pos kun nas bslangs te/ sngon 'gro tshogs zhing gsal btab/ skyabs su 'gro ba dang byang chub sems bskyed spyi ltar bya/ rang yul du lugs 'gar bgegs gtor btang la gshed dang phral/ thos grol sogs chos bshad sngon du btang nas 'pho bye sogs btab/ spyi bo'i skra nas 'then pa sogs mdzad srol yang snang zhing*/ de ltar byed na mi 'gal ba ma tshad legs pa'i yan lag tu snang ngo*/ /dngos gzhi dmigs rten mkha' spyod mkha' 'gro phyi nang gsang ba'i stong ra dang bcas bsgom tshul ngag 'don ltar la/ spyi bor rigs lnga sku gsum bla ma brgyud pa dang bcas gzhung bzhin gsal btab cing gsol ba btab pa'i mthar/ phaṭaḥbyas pas rnam par shes pa'i thig le rlung gis bteg nas mda' 'phangs pa bzhin thon te rigs bdag bla ma'i thugs kar thim/ rdo rje phag mo'am rnal 'byor ma nyid kyang bla ma he ru ka la thim/

dbu ma gyen du ldog nas 'ja' yal ba bzhin gyen rdzogs yum chen gyi thugs gnyis chu la chu thim pa ltar dbyer med du bsres te ka dag gi ngang la yun du bzhag la mthar bsngo smon sogs phyir mi ldog pa'i rgya yis btab bo/ /slar smras pa/ mam̐ hā gu ru'i zhal gsung yin gyi sgra tshig mkhas pa'i bstan bcos min/ /mam̐ gcig mtsho rgyal snyan brgyud yin gyi za zi nyams ky-i ri mo min/ /mam̐ brgyud mkha' 'gro'i gsang tshig yin gyi man ngag tha thor bsdus pa min/ /mam̐ bsgoms sangs rgyas 'pho ba'i man ngag 'di ko de phyir rmad du byung*/ /dem̐ lta na yang ka dag ye grol gshis lugs rtogs la 'di mi dgos/ /dem̐ bzhin bskyed rdzogs gdeng chen thob la 'di yi dgos pa ma dmigs kyang*/ /dem̐ don thos la mos skal ldan yang lam mthar ma son gang zag 'gar/ /dem̐ 'dra lam gyi bsun ma yin pas med thabs med pa'i gdams ngag lags/ /don chung las la mgo bo 'khom̐r 'khom̐r nas/ /don chen gtan gyi 'dun ma bsam̐m bsam̐m med/ /mi tshe 'bad brgyas zas nor bsam̐gs bsam̐gs kyang*/ /tha ma 'chi dus thams cad lusam̐ lusam̐ 'dra/ kha bshad chom̐s la byang yang chom̐s brgyad 'dres/ /rang rgyud chom̐s la rengs kyang chom̐s par rlom/ /bdag 'dra'i chom̐s gzugs bzung ba'i chom̐s dred rnams/ /nyams len chom̐s la nges shes rnyed par shog /de skad thos bsam sgom pa'i khyad nor gyis/ /phyug pa'i gcung po gnam lcags mkhan po nas/ /lha reg dri med rin chen gnyis pa yi/ /skyes bcas nan tan bskul ngo ma ldog par/ /gter gzhung rtsa ba'i tshig dang dgongs 'brel dang*/ /bla ma'i man ngag dag las rang gi blos/ /gang dpog cung zad 'bri ba'i tshul byas kyang*/ /'gal nor gyur na chos bdag mkha' 'gror bshags/ /dge bas 'gro kun ma bsgoms sangs rgyas chos/ /myur lam zab mo 'pho ba'i gseng lam nas/ /mkha' spyod gnas dang bde chen zhing khams su/

/bgrod de phyir mi ldog pa'i sa thob shog /ces ma bsgoms sangs rgyas 'pho ba'i man ngag ma rgyud 'pho ba ka dag ye grol zhes bya ba 'di nyid la da lta'i 'pho ba'i chog khrigs 'ga' zhig 'dug pa phal mo che grong sngags cho gar mi mkhas pa du mas rang bzo dang*/ brgyud rim rnams kyang ris med yin tshul gyis sa dge bka' brgyud sogs 'brel med du ma gsar bcug ci rigs snang bas dpyad par mi bzod pa dang*/ nyams su len dka' bar gzigs nas 'di la 'pho khrid cig mdzad rogs zhes gnam lcags mkhan po ngag dbang dge legs mchog nas lha reg dri med srid na ring ba dang*/ a sgor 25 bcas nan tan bskul ngor/ sngar 'khor lo'i mgon po ga grwa bla ma nyi ma 'od zer rin po che mchog nas gnam lcags zab gter yongs rdzogs kyi smin grol dang 'brel/ zab lam 'pho ba'i khrid lung bstsal skabs rang re tshang mar 'pho ba thebs rtags rtswa ku sha zug pa sogs ya mtshan du gyur kyang dngos su sbyang rgyu ma byung*/ de rjes/ rang mgo ma thon ro mgor ca co sgrog /ces gsungs pa ltar gshin don 'pho 'debs sogs yang yang byed dgos pa byung bas/ gnam lcags bla ma yab rgan bkra shis drung nas slob sbyong phran bu byas pa'i skor yid la gang 'jags dang*/ khyad par gter gzhung rtsa tshig dang dgongs 'grel bcas la zhib brtags kyis/ e wam̐ padma mkha' 'gro'i gling du rab byung bcu bdun pa/ sa glang lo'i ston zla tha chung gi dkar phyogs dga' ba gsum pa'i dus tshes la grub par bgyis pa 'dis kyang 'gro ba mtha' yas pa thar pa'i grong du skye ba'i rgyur gyur cig/ //

na)༄༅/ /bla ma drag po padma khrag 'thung las: gtum mo'i don khrid rlung sems rang grol gsal byed kyis brgyan pa bzhugs so: zag med bde chen he ru ka la 'dud: sa ma ya: gsang sngags snying po gu ru'i thugs sgrub las: gsang dbang don khrid steng sgo'i chos drug bstan: gtum mo sgyu lus rmi lam 'od gsal dang : grong 'jug 'pho ba rnam grol mchog gi lam: skal ldan tshe gcig byang chub sgrub pa'i thabs: gu ru'i gsungs bzhin mtsho rgyal bdag gis 'god: gab 'khrugs sbas dang bcings pa 'di la med: dmar khrid zhun tig kun gyi nying khu 'di: las can shes rab ldan dang 'phrad par shog: bka' rgya bswe yi lha mo mched bzhir bcol: sa ma ya: bla ma drag po'i gsang dbang don khrid nang gses la/ gtum mo dang*/ sgyu lus/ rmi lam/ 'od gsal/ grong 'jug 'pho ba sogs rnam pa drug yod pa las/ dang po/ gtum mo ni/ nang gi ma dag pa'i rtsa rlung thig le 'dag pa'i phyir: las rlung sbyong zhing dbu ma'i mdud 'khrol ni: 'bar 'dzag zhu bdes drangs pa'i bde stong lhan skyes ye shes kyis: 'khrul snang zad nas longs sku'i nyams rtsal rdzogs: rtsa gegs mdud grol rlung gegs nyon mongs las kyi rlung gi rgyu ba 'gro 'ong chad: thig le 'dzag med 'ching ste rnam kun mchog: ldan gyi stong nyid dang*/ mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba skye ba'i thabs steng sgo rnam grol gyi lam rang lus thabs ldan dang dgos pa khyad par can de lta bu myur du 'byin pa'i thabs 'og sgo bde ba chen po'i lam gzhan lus thabs ldan gyi man ngag pho mo'i rlung bsres pas: zhes las rgya'i gnad la brten nas dbab ldog 'dren dgram sogs 'byung ldog dga' ba bcu drug gi sgo nas nyams su myong ba'i bde stong nyams 'bar ye shes stobs rtsal rdzogs:

nas sa bcu rgyun mtha'i gtsug tor rtse mo'i sa mchog mngon du byas nas 'khor lo tshogs chen gyi sa la grol bar 'gyur la/ gnas skabs kyang nyams rtogs rtsal 'bar phyogs med mkhyen pa rgyas: pa sogs yon tan mtha' yas so/ nga nyid longs skur zhes bla ma rlung sems dbyer med du sgrub pa'i gdams pa yin: jo mo mtsho rgyal ma yi snying la 'phur: bde chen nang sgrub le'u gnyis pa'o: de la gtum mo'i me khrid ni: dben par rlung ra legs par btsal/ mthun rkyen yo byad 'bebs gdan dang ang rag sgom thag sogs bsags: khrus dang chu drod 'jam gyis lus bkrus nas mar nag byugs la bsku mnye bya/ lus stobs bskyed pa'i sman rdzas sogs: che ba rgyal po lta bu'i chos: yin phyir drod dang bcud ldan bza' btung longs spyod sogs: thig le rgyas pa'i sman sbyor 'bad: rlung ra gsar pa yin na thog mar bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro ba'i dkar gtor btang zhing sa slong bya/ bgegs la gtor ma bsngo ba dang mtshams gcod srung 'khor bsgom pa rnams gzhung chen mo ltar bya ba'o/ /rgyun du ni mi dgos/ mchan/ rtsa ba srog rtsol gtum mo ni: srog ces ro rkyang g.yas g.yon las kyi rlung : rtsol thig le ba'i gnad kyi lam bkag ste: ye shes srog rlung ro rkyang gi rlung dbu mar gzhug: gnas thim pa'i ye rlung du gnas 'gyur ba'i thabs la 'bad dgos/ de la bde ba'i 'bebs gdan steng : thog mar sngon 'gro spyi dang bla ma'i rnal 'byor gnad du bsnun la dbang bzhi blang bar nan tan bya/ lus gnad rnam snang chos bdun grim cha can bca' ba'am/ gzhung gsal ltar me thab 'khor lo drug chings bca' la/ de'i dgos pa'ang*/ nam mkha'i rlung ni dbu ma ru: 'jug phyir lus kyi cha bsrangs te: chu yi rlung

dbu mar 'dzud phyir la lce rkan sbyar: me rlung mgrin pa cung zad dgug: rlung gi rlung la tsog pu ru: sgom thag bcing ba nywa bzhi rkang pa'i nywa dang lag pa gnyis bsnol la dpung mgor bzhag bsgrim: sa rlung pus mo gnyis bslang la sgom thag gi 'dzings 'khyud bsdam: ye shes rlung la rkang pa bsnol: ngag gnad rlung ro g.yas g.yon res mos bdun bdun du 'bud la mthar ha zhes phyir bsal la mnyam par bzhag dug gsum rlung ro phyin phyin 'bud: sems gnad stong ra gsum las/ phyi lus kyi stong ra sgom pa ni/ hūm̐: stong pa'i ngang las rlung lnga bsnol ba'i dal: nyi zla padma g.yung drung ljang gsal steng : ye shes mkha' 'gro ljang 'od mdangs ldan ma: zhal gcig phyag gnyis gar stabs 'gying tshul ldan: zhal 'dzum mdzes shing ratnas dbu la brgyan: thor tshugs dar dpyangs zar bus sku rgyab khebs: rus pa'i rgyan 'phyangs nu ma bha ga rgyas: phyag g.yas rlung zhags g.yon pas tshe bum 'dzin: phyag gdub zhabs gdub rin chen se mo do: gcer mo 'gying stabs bde stong lhang nger gsal: de nas bde stong 'bar 'dzag la: nang rtsa yi stong ra la/ sku dbus stong sang gur phub pa lta bu'i dbus su rtsa dbu ma ka ba btsugs pa ltar/ zung 'jug dbu ma mtshan nyid bzhi ldan ni/ chu shing gi ldem bu ltar drang ba/ padma'i 'dab ma ltar srab pa/ mthing zhun gyi dwangs ma ltar sngo ba/ til gyi mar me ltar gsal ba'o/ / ni: yar mar sne mo spyi bo dang gsang gnas kyi spu nag ma'i mtshams su thug: g.yas su thabs kyi ro ma dkar mo dang : g.yon du shes rab rkyang ma dmar mo ni: yar sne sna bug gnyis su zug: mar sne lte 'og yi ge cha yi 'phongs ltar dbu mar 'brel: bud med ro rkyang g.yas g.yon ldog: bud med g.yas rkyang ma dmar mo/ g.yon ro ma dkar mo gsal ba ni/ khams dang nyon mongs sogs khyad 'byung ba'i phyir ro/

/de nas 'khor lo drug ni/ 'dir rgyud sde so sor rtsa 'dab sogs mi 'dra ba mang du bzhugs la/ dper na/ kun bzang dgongs 'dus las/ rtse mo rnam dag bkod pa na: rtsa 'dab sum brgya drug cu ste: mgrin pa ro 'dus bcu drug go: sny-ing khar sum cu rtsa gnyis so: skyed byed drug cu rtsa bzhi ste: gsang bar nyi shu rtsa brgyad gnas: de rnams 'khor lo bzhin du bsgom: gsungs la/ de bzhin 'dir yang cung mi 'dra ba bzhugs la phal che bar snying khar rtsa 'dab brgyad dang/ mgrin pa ru rtsa 'dab bcu drug dpral par rtsa 'dab sum cu rtsa gnyis/ lte bar drug cu rtsa bzhi/ gsang bar nyi shu rtsa brgyad bshad kyang rang lugs ni/ gsang bar rtsa 'dab sum cu gnyis: lte bar drug cu rtsa brgyad dang : snying khar brgyad dang mgrin pa ru: sum cu rtsa gnyis dpral pa la: bcu drug gtsug tor rtsa bzhi ste: gyes pa'i rtsa phran bsam mi khyab: ba spu'i grangs dang mnyam par gnas: byang sems rgyu ba'i mchog dngos 'grub: kun kyang mtshan nyid bzhi ldan pa: rtsa srog dbu ma'i ngo bo nyid: rlung srog bum pa can du bsgom: zhes brjod la nyams len gyi gsang gnad ni/ de ltar rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi dang ldan pa mar sne lte 'og sor bzhi'i 'og spu nag ma'i mtshams su zug pa gsal la/ rluung bum chen sbyor ba bzhi ldan du bsgom pa man ngag dang*/ de'ang bum chen sbyor ba bzhi ni/ sna bug dal bus brngubs nas lte 'og tu chil gyis gnon pa dang*/ lto bar dgang*/ stod du ma shor bar ci nus bzung ba dang/ mi thub tshe g.yas g.yon du gzhil ba zhes lte ba nang du 'then pas bcag cing g.yas bskor gsum dang g.yon bskor gsum gyis dkrugs la cung zad bzung*/ slar yang rngub chung dang bcas mi thub tshe dal bus shugs kyis 'phangs la cung zad bzhag slar yang sngar ltar byas pas chog rngub dang gcig dgang gnyis gzhil gsum

bcag cing dkrugs: slar der rngub chung re re brtsegs: sgom tshe gang thub yang yang bzung la bskyil bas chog: spyir rlung ro 'bud tshe g.yas 'bud nang du rngub tshe g.yon nas rngub pa'i dgos pa ni/ nyon mongs rlung g.yas nas rgyu zhing ye shes rlung g.yon nas 'byung ba'i phyir ro/ de ltar bar med khor yug bslab: dang por sgom tshe rtsa rlung thig le'i zug: rngu drag po na tsha sogs/ slong tshe sdug bsran snying rus bskyed: par bya'o/ bar du zug yal nas skabs 'gar bde nyams dang skabs su zug rngu ldang la sdug: pa res mos 'byung tshe/ le lor mi btang bar brtson 'grus drag pos bar med bsgom: par bya'o/ tha ma bde drod sogs nyams dang thun min yon tan gyi stobs 'bar tshe: de la chags zhen dang mngon rlom sogs 'dod sred bdud kyi dbang du mi gtang: zhing*/ thig le phyir mi 'pho bar nor bu'i rtsa bar 'dzin pa dang lug ldog tu gyen du 'khor lo bzhir 'dren zhing rtsa mig tu bkram pa sogs dmigs pa'i gnad la bslab: skabs su khams dub pa bsang ba dang gnyid dang zas bcud can gyi 'tsho ba bsten: zhing gegs sel bya ba'i dus ma gtogs rgyun chad med pa zla ba gcig dang zhag brgya la sogs pa ru: 'bad pas sgrub par bya la/ gzhan du zla drug lo gcig gnyis gsum bar: 'bad pa'i rtsa yi 'ching mdud grol/ thig le las su rung*/ las rlung rang sar dag nas rnam grol: zhi ba chen po gtsug tor 'khor lo tshogs chen gyi go 'phang la mngon du gyur pa'i dgos pa yod do/ (ka) gtum mo'i me dmigs ni/ rang lus padma ḍākki ni: khro gtum rgyan rdzogs lcags sreg ltar: tsha ngar ldan pa zhag gsum bsgom:

zhes pa las phyag mtshan sogs ma bshad kyang*/ go cha las/ lte bar mkha' 'gro sde lnga ni: mdangs lnga gri gug thod khrag 'dzin: zhes gsungs pas padma mkha' 'gro sku mdog dmar po padma rā ga'i mdog can/ sku gcer bu rus pa'i rgyan dang ldan pa/ zhabs dor stabs kyis phyag g.yas gri gug dang g.yon thod pa khrag gi bkang ba bsnam pa/ khro gtum gyi nyams ldan/ lcags sreg ltar tsha ngar 'bar zhing me'i tshwa tshwa 'phro ba zhig bsgom/ de nas lte 'og me yi dal: gru gsum a thung tsha rngam can: gnam lcags thog 'dra mtho gang bar: rtse gcig sems gtad zhag gsum bsgom: rang nyid padma mkha' 'gror gsal ba'i lte 'og tu a shad me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum phur pa'i dbal rtse bcad pa lta bu gnam lcags thog rgod 'bum gyi tsha ngar ldan zhing*/ me'i zi ra 'khyugs pa zhig bsgom nas de la sems rtse gcig tu gtad de nyin gsum sogs la 'bad par bya'o/ ༈ dang po rtsa rlung gsol 'debs ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐: ka dag rdor 'chang chos sku 'od mi 'gyur: gsol ba 'debs so rtsa rlung bde drod skyed: gtum mo ye shes me dpung sbar du gsol: 'ja' lus chos sku 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: longs sku'i rtsal snang ston pa rdo rje sems: gsol ba 'debs so rtsa rlung bde drod skyed: gtum mo ye shes me dpung sbar du gsol: 'ja' lus chos sku 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: sprul sku 'chi med rig 'dzin padma 'byung : gsol ba 'debs so rtsa rlung bde drod skyed: gtum mo ye shes me dpung sbar du gsol: 'ja' lus chos sku 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: rtsa gsum gar dbang mkha' 'gro mtsho rgyal ma: gsol ba 'debs so rtsa rlung bde drod skyed: gtum mo ye shes me dpung sbar du gsol: 'ja' lus chos sku 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: nus rtsal brtul zhugs sangs rgyas ye shes rtsal: gsol ba 'debs so rtsa rlung bde drod skyed:

gtum mo ye shes me dpung sbar du gsol: 'ja' lus chos sku 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: las 'phro gter 'byin karma las 'brel gling : gsol ba 'debs so rtsa rlung bde drod skyed: gtum mo ye shes me dpung sbar du gsol: 'ja' lus chos sku 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: sprul sku rig 'dzin rdo rje bdud 'dul rtsal: gsol ba 'debs so rtsa rlung bde drod skyed: gtum mo ye shes me dpung sbar du gsol: 'ja' lus chos sku 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: grub brgya'i spyi mes thugs mchog rdo rje la/ /gsol ba 'debs so rtsa rlung bde drod skyed: gtum mo ye shes me dpung sbar du gsol: 'ja' lus chos sku 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: rlung sems dbang thob dri med gling pa la/ /gsol ba 'debs so rtsa rlung bde drod skyed: gtum mo ye shes me dpung sbar du gsol: 'ja' lus chos sku 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: 'gro 'dul kong smyon kra ti sngags 'chang la/ /gsol ba 'debs so rtsa rlung bde drod skyed: gtum mo ye shes me dpung sbar du gsol: 'ja' lus chos sku 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: lung zin sgam po bzang po rdo rje la/ /gsol ba 'debs so rtsa rlung bde drod skyed: gtum mo ye shes me dpung sbar du gsol: 'ja' lus chos sku 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: o rgyan 'gro 'dul phrin las dbang phyug la/ /gsol ba 'debs so rtsa rlung bde drod skyed: gtum mo ye shes me dpung sbar du gsol: 'ja' lus chos sku 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: bka' drin mtshungs med rtsa ba'i bla ma la: gsol ba 'debs so rtsa rlung bde drod skyed: gtum mo ye shes me dpung sbar du gsol: 'ja' lus chos sku 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: rten 'brel mnga' bsgyur zab rgya'i gter srung la: gsol ba 'debs so rtsa rlung bde drod skyed: gtum mo ye shes me dpung sbar du gsol:

'ja' lus chos sku 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: tshe gcig sangs rgyas 'grub par by-in gyis rlobs: mchog thun dngos grub 'byung bar byin gyis rlobs: zhes gsol ba drag tu btab pas/ dbu ma'i nang bzhugs brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams mas rim bzhin rtsa ba'i bla mar thim/ de yang thig dmar a shad can dang gnyis med du gyur par mos la/ de nas a shad dmar la tsha: de'ang ngo bo bde ba/ reg bya tsha ba/ rnam pa gsal ba/ rtse mo shes rab kyi rang bzhin rno la 'khyugs pa sbrul gyi lce lta bu lte ba'i rtsa 'khor nas 'khor lo rnams su zhugs/ rim gyis tshwa tshwas snying kha'i man: de nas mgrin pa spyi bo dang : lus kyi nang khengs ba spu'i sgor: tshwa tshwa'i zhun ma rab tu khol: ye shes ḍākki dmar nag gtum: me dpung 'ur 'ur bdud tshogs bsreg: (kha) gtum mo'i me dmigs ni/ rtsa gsum 'dus mdor lte ba'i mar snar gnam zhal yum gyi rang bzhin a shad zur gsum phur pa'i dbal so ltar dang*/ spyi bor yab he ru ka yi rang bzhin haṃ yig mgo gyen bstan du yod pa gsal la/ rlung gnad bum pa can nam 'jam rlung bzung*/ de'ang ro rkyang brgyud rlung dal bur brngubs shing lte 'og tu chil gyis mnan pa'i dbu ma'i mar snar a shad la phog pas me lhab kyis 'bar cing*/ lte ba nas snying kha mgrin pa bar 'khor lo rnams rim par khyab/ sgo gsum gyi las dang sgrib bzhi bag chags bcas pa bsregs/ rtsa yi mdud pa dkrol/ dpral par slebs pa dang ham̐ yig mgo thur du ldog bde ba chen po bdud rtsi'i rgyun bab pas me dang bdud rtsi bros ded kyi rnam par yas dbab dga' bzhi nyams su myong/ mthar bdud rtsi a shad la phog pas snum tsha lcags sreg la phog pa bzhin/ rab tu 'bar ba'i me dang bdud rtsi gnyis med dkar dmar khams kyi rang bzhin zhu bdes lus kun gtams pas bde drod skyes par bsam/

gsang ba sems kyi stong ra ni/ (ga) dbu ma'i mar sner thig le'i srog ni lte 'og rtsa gsum 'dus pa'i sum mdor a: shad yum gyi ngo bo dang*/ yar sna dpral ba'i tshang bug steng bar snang du yab he ru ka'i ngo bo haṃ yig dngul chu ltar: dwang la dkar 'tsher mgo bo gyen bstan du bsgom/ rlung gnad 'jam rlung ro rkyang brgyud: dbu mar 'bar zhing 'khor lo rnams: rim par mdud dkrol bde rgyun dbab: dkar dmar zhu bdes lus kun gtams: (nga) de ltar dkar dmar stobs rgyas pa'i: ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas: me yi ḍākki gar stabs 'khyugs: bde drod nyams 'bar me dpung mched: snod kyi 'jig rten me yi dal: bcud kyi sems can ḍākki ma: sgra skad thams cad me dpung 'ur: tshig ni ha ri ni sa'i sgra: stong ra che ba nam mkha'i mtha': chung ba rta rnga tsam la bsdu: spro bsdu rig pa'i rang rtsal sbyang : a haṃ snyoms 'jug bde ba'i ngang : gnas skabs bdun gsum nyer gcig 'bad: rlung sems zin pas drod tshad rnyed: de tshe dbu ma che bskyed chung bskyed ni/ de ltar dkar dmar byang chub sems kyi stobs rgyas pa'i thabs la 'bad cing/ mthar rlung khug pa gcig bzung ba dang/ lgang bu la phus brgyangs pa ltar gsang ba rtsa 'khor rtsa 'dab dang bcas pa nar gyis gsal ba'i mar snar a shad snga ma bzhin sgom pa'i lus kyi rtsa 'dab ba spu bu ga tshun thams cad nas me stag zi ri ri 'khrugs shing*/ me yi ḍākki gar stabs 'khyugs par dmigs/ yang bde drod nyams 'bar zhing me dpung phyir mched pas/ phyi snod kyi 'jig rten thams cad me yi dal du gyur/ nang bcud kyi sems can thams cad me yi ḍākki ma dang/ sgra skad thams cad me dpung 'ur 'ur tshig tshig dang ni ha ri ni sa'i rang sgra sgrog par bsam/ yang rang lus dbu ma dang bcas pa cher bskyed pa'i stong ra che ba nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam par bskyed/

yang shin du chung ba rta rnga cha bgos pa tsam la bsdu ba sogs spro bsdu rig pa'i rang rtsal sbyang*/ a haṃ snyoms 'jug bde ba'i ngang bskyangs la/ mthar ka dag ngang la bzla bar bya'o/ / (ca) phyi 'dzin nang 'dzin spel ma ru: brdab chung brgya dang brgyad du bya: mgo dang sked bskor dpung pa gcu: lag pa brkyang shad bskum dang brdeg: ha ring ha thung 'bebs chung brdab: zhag bdun nam ni bcu bzhir 'bad: lus drod me ltar 'bar bar 'gyur: de nas 'khrul 'khor rnam pa lnga: mgo bo dgye bsgur mjing pa shad: lag pa brkyang bskum bzhag sha brdab: ro stod drag skor g.yas g.yon bskor: sked pa g.yas g.yon 'khor lor bskor: rkang pa phra shad brkyang bskum bya: drag 'bebs ha sprug lhab lheb bya: de nas 'byung bzhi 'khrul 'khor ni: mda' 'gengs lag bsnol rkang bsnol 'bebs: gzhi 'phra mi khri sgril log bya: 'bebs shing rtsal sprug drag po bya: ka dag ngang du lhan ne bzhag: zhes gsungs pa bzhin gter gzhung 'khrul 'khor rnam pa lnga dang*/ 'byung bzhi'i 'khrul 'khor gegs sel sogs phyag rgyun ma bzhugs pas man ngag snying thig chen mo'i phyag bzhes ltar gegs sel 'khrul 'khor tsam 'dir sbyar na/ rlung gi 'khrul 'khor yan lag lnga sbyong ni/ dang po/ khu tshur bskor brgyangs mchan rdeb lan gsum sngon du 'gro ba'i mgo bo gzengs bstod skyil krung dang*/ gnyis pa/ mig nas rim par dpral thod mgo bo'i mdun rgyab dang sked pa bskor la g.yas g.yon mdun rgyab rkang pa yan 'phur la bsku mnye bya/ gsum pa/ a zhes sor bsnol brang la brdab/ yang ka zhes kha phyir bstan du brgyangs/ yang tsa zhes nang bstan du brgyangs/ ṭa zhes sor bsnol brang la brdab/ yang ya zhes kha phyir bstan du brgyangs/ yang sha zhes nang bstan du brgyangs/ mthar a ka tsa ṭa ta pa ya sha a ham̐ zhes khu tshur brla thog 'jog bzhi pa/ dpung pa g.yas g.yon gcu zhing phrag pus sprad pa res mos gsum/

lnga pa/ skyil krung dang bcas lag pa rgyab tu brkyangs la bya rgod 'phur stangs ltar shad kyis brgyangs la tshur bskum pa dang mdun du 'phur stangs lan gsum song ba'i rjes bar 'bebs gsum ha ring dang bcas 'ba' dkrugs gsum/ mjug tu 'bebs chung brgya dang brgyad sogs ci nus bya/ zhag bdun dang bcu bzhi'am nyer gcig sogs 'bad par bya'o/ /de nas 'khrul 'khor rnam pa lnga dang 'byung bzhi 'khrul 'khor sogs ni lag len gyi rgyun da lta mi snang zhing*/ kho bo chung ngu'i dus 'khrul 'khor dpe ris zhib gsal zhig mthong yang slad rig gsar skabs gdod ma'i dbyings su phebs par gda'o/ /gong gsal gtum mo 'bar 'dzag gi nyams len gnad du chud nas thig le'i man ngag dbab ldog 'dzin 'grems sogs la bslabs shing*/ gnad kyi 'gag dam hūm̐ gis spyi bor 'dren: phyir 'dzin ngang nas phri lir khyab par bkram: seṅge rnam rol rba rlabs gnad dang thim: bkram rtags lus bde dub cing gsal stong 'char: de yang 'bar 'dzag gis bzhus pas thig le bde chen 'khor lo nas rim bzhin 'khor lo bzhir dbab pa'i thabs lam gnad kyi lugs 'byung dga' ba bzhi nyams su myong ba dang*/ nor bu'i rtsa bar rma bya'i stangs kyi bzung nas bde stong la sems 'dzin pa dang*/ mthar rlung gi gnad 'og rlung gyen du 'then zhing rgyu na lugs ldag zhabs rgal par sbyar*/ mig gyen du ldog sor mo drag tu bskum pa sogs gnad gyi 'gag dam por gcun pa'i thabs dang*/ ngag hūm̐ gis sgra dang bcas thig le spyi bor 'dren pa'am 'khor lo rnam la rim bzhin lugs ldog gi drangs la mthar rlung phyir 'dzin ngang nas dga' bzhi khyad par can nyams su myong ba dang*/ bkram pa'i khrul 'khor gyi lus kyi stod smad bar gsum phri lir khyab par bkram pa dang*/ de nas seṅge rnam rol dang rba rlabs gyi 'khrul 'khor gyi gnad la brten nas snang mched thob gsum dang thim pa'i rim pas rjes gzhigs 'od gsal chen po ngo sprad pa sogs man ngag gnad khrol bar bya'o/

bkram rtags lus bde dub cing gsal stong 'char: sogs gi rlung zin pa'i phan yon dang log pa'i nyes pa bshad pa/ de yang gsang bar rlung sems zin pa dang : lhan du bde nyams 'char zhing kha zas kyi sred pa dag: de bzhin du rlung log na thig le 'dzag pa dang : 'dod chags sogs mi bzod nad kun bskyed: lte bar zin na drod 'bar zhing : kha zas 'ju la lus stobs bskyed: log na pho ba'i nad kun bskyed: la/ snying khar zin na shes rab rgyas pa dang : rtogs pa 'i ye shes bskyed cing rlung log na: smyo 'bog sogs yid mi bde ba 'byung : mgrin par zin na ngag snyan zhing : rtsom mkhas tshigs bcad mang po brdol: log na rims nad mang du 'byung : dpral par zin na 'od gsal 'char: rims sogs tshad pa'i nad kun sel: log na grang nad tha dag bskyed: spyi bor slebs pas rtogs pa dang : nam mkha' lta bu'i nyams 'char te: snang ba thams cad gtad med grol: log na mgo bo na sogs 'byung : khe nyan che bas man ngag myong bas ma zin bar gang byung du 'ol tshod mi bgyi ba gal che'o/ thig le lug 'byung ldog gi 'khor lo lngar rim par bslab pa'i dgos pa ni/ de nas gong gsal ltar gtum mo 'bar 'dzag sgom pa'i yas dbab kyis: skabs/ haṃ yig zhu ba'i bdud rtsi dpral bar bde chen gyi 'khor lor babs pas rtsa khams bdud rtsis gang*/ rtsa gnas kyi lha tshogs bde stong bdud rtsi'i mnyes par byas/ dga' ba 'i ye shes rgyud la bskyed: bdud bzhi las lha bu'i bdud bcom yul snang gi zhen pa dag: par mos/ de bzhin du mgrin par babs pas mchog dga' bskyed: la/ nyon mongs bdud bcom zhing zhen 'dzin dag: snying khar babs pas lhan skyes dga': ba skye/ phung po'i bdud bcom gnyis zhen dag:

lte bar babs pas dga' bral myong: 'chi bdag bdud bcom gang la'ang : zhen pa med cing bde stong gi ye shes rgyud la skye bas srid pa'i 'ching ba las grol: de nas slar yang lug ldog gi tshul du mas brtan dga' ba bzhi: ni/ thig le gsang gnas nor bu'i rtse nas ldog dka' la phyir 'phros 'khor ba'i rgyu: ste/ dper na nor bu dgra la shor dang mtshungs: des na rtsa bar rma bya'i stangs kyis bzungs la rlung gi gzhu la rig pa'i nyag phran dang sbyar te hūm̐ gi sgra dang bcas gsang ba nas lte bar ldog pas lug ldog gis dga' ba bzhi rim par nyams su myong*/ lam lnga rim par bgrod pa las/ dang po dga' ba nyams su myong*/ tshogs lam mngon du byas/ 'bras bu sprul skur thob: de bzhin du snying khar slebs pas mchog dga' dang sbyor ba'i lam las longs skur thob: mgrin par slebs pas khyad par dga' ba dang mthong lam chos skur thob: dpral par slebs pas lhan skyes dga' ba nyams su myong zhing sgom lam mthar phyin zhing 'bras bu ngo bo nyid: kyi sku mngon du byas/ mthar spyi bor gtsug tor nam mkha'i 'khor lo la thim pa'am slebs pas sa bcu rgyun gyi tha ma mi slob zung 'jug bde chen sku: sangs rgyas sku lnga'i bdag nyid can: mngon du gyur nas 'khor lo tshogs chen gyi go 'phang thob par 'gyur ro/ gzhan yang mngon par shes pa phyogs med 'char: ba dang*/ rdzu 'phrul ya ma zung ston nus: pa sogs thun mong gi yon tan rtags bcu yon tan brgyad sogs dang khyad par du rtsa gegs 'khor lo drug gi mdud rgya las grol: rlung gegs las kyi rlung dbugs kyi 'gro 'ong chad: las ye rlung du gnas 'gyur/ 'pho bcas thig le 'pho med zag pa med par

sdom par 'gyur: la/ de'i tshe las rlung zad nas sgom pa ni: nyin mtshan dbyer med du 'dres na rmi lam dbyings su 'gag: de tshe mi rtog pa rmongs pa thom yor lta bu ma yin pa brgyad gnyis dga' ba'i ye shes dang stong pa bcu drug zung du 'jug pa'i bde stong 'od gsal: chen po mngon du 'gyur ba dang*/ 'phos tshe yang sku gsum zhing khams gang 'dod bgrod: nus shing*/ gnas skabs kyang rlung sems gang du gtad pa der: 'jug par nus shing 'byung ba la rang dbang thob: pa sogs yon tan mtha' yas so/ zhes gsungs pa'o/ / sa ma ya: da ni mtha' rten gi gegs sel man ngag bshad pa la/ thog mar/ stong ra zhes rang gi lus kyi nang khong stong sangs nge ba dper na sgong lkog ltar: ram dar dmar gyi gur phub pa lta bu zhig bsgom/ 'byung ba'i snyigs ma 'am dug lnga'i rang bzhin pho smad na: dud sprin nam 'ja' tshon lta bu'i mag mog lang long du yod par bsam: yang ngag tu hūm̐ zhes brjod la rlung nang du rngub cing lte 'og tu bskyil la dgang ba dang phyir 'phang ba de yis: tshe rlung dug thams cad dud khung du ba thon pa bzhin spyi bor nas phyur phyur thon par dmigs la: hūm̐ ring por brjod pa dang rlung khong 'dren gyi rlung ro phyir lcog tshad 'phang : la de lta bu yang yang 'bad pa'i thog mar sman stobs chen bsten pa'i tshe nad gting nas slong ba bzhin dug slong rtags ste: 'dar sprug stod gzer ram rmi lam 'khrugs: pa/ mgo sbrid snyam pa sogs nyams snang sna tshogs 'byung : ba la snying rus bskyed la 'bad pa'i mthar dug phyin pa'i rtags su spyi bor rlangs

pa sngo dmar: sgra 'od dang bcas thon par 'gyur: ro/ 'ga' zhig la zhag bdun tsam na shes pa za zi 'phyo: ba sogs rlung rtags sna tshogs 'byung la/ gzhan du dri med nyin phyed dam de'i sum cha tsam: mam 'ga' zhig la zan ni za yun tsam du 'byung : la/ de rjes mgo yang dug thon pas: tshar tshad kyi yon tan spyi dang nyams len la bogs chen po thon par gdon mi za'o/ da ni mtha' rten 'byung ba lnga la brten pa'i zad par sa yi ting 'dzin sogs bsgoms pa'i tshul dang de dag so so yi yon tan 'char: ba'i tshul bshad pa la/ bde stong rlung rdzogs las/ de las 'byung bzhi zad par gyiḥ skye mched bsgom na spyi bo yiḥ thig le dkar las 'od zer 'phrosaḥ snang srid thams cad chu'i dwangs maḥ dkar po 'od zhu thig le dang ཿ ro gcig 'dres la mnyam par bzhagaḥ zad par chu yi skye mched 'grubaḥ de bzhin mgrin pa lte ba dang ཿ gsang gnas rnams kyi thig le niḥ dmar po me dang ser po saḥ ljang gu rlung du shes byas nasaḥ zhes gsungs pa bzhin zad par sa yi skye mched bsgom na/ lte bar thig le ser po las 'od zer 'phros snang srid thams cad sa'i dwangs ma ser po ru 'od du zhu/ thig le dang ro gcig tu 'dres la mnyam par bzhag pas zad sa'i skye mched grub la/ de bzhin du spyi bor chu'i thig le dkar po/ mgrin par me'i thig le dmar po/ gsang gnas rlung gi thig le ljang gu/ snying gar nam mkha'i thig le mthing ga sogs gzhan la'ang 'gres shes par bya'o/ /de ltar bsgom pas sa yis ting 'dzin 'bral mi phod: chu yis mdog snum kha dog dwangs: me yis bde drod bkrag mdangs che: rlung gis shugs chen zo mdog bde: nam mkhas bde gsal mi rtog pa'i: snang ba rang sar grol bar 'gyur: zhes gsungs so/ ji ltar kha zas dug 'dres bzhin:

zas bcud mi mngon nad ro bslang : nyon mongs dug dang bcas kyi bar: skyon dang yon tan 'dres mar 'char: dug bral kha zas sman 'gyur bzhin: dug phyin yon tan ci bzhin mngon: sa ma ya: gzhan yang 'byung ba'i yon tan mngon du ma gyur pa de srid du skyon dang bcas par 'gyur la/ skyon dang bral na zag med kyi yon tan mngon du 'char bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs so/ /mtha' rten rtsa rlung thig le nyams su len pa la brten nas: bde stong ye shes bskyed par bya ba'i phyir ji ltar 'bad pa'i tshul mdor bsdus su brjod pa la/ thog mar lus gnad drang por bsrang bas: rtsa drang rtsa drang na rlung drang rlung drang na de la brten pa'i thig sems sogs bde lugs su rgyu bas rlung sems dbu mar tshud: pa'am 'dzud pa dang*/ gtum mo'i nyams len thig le 'bar 'dzag rang bzhin bsgom pa sogs la med du mi rung bar gyur: pas gnad che'o/ /des na bde ba

dang stong pa'i bdag nyid mngon gsum 'char ba'i rdzogs rim zab mo bsgom pa la lus gnad bsrangs: phyi lus lha'i stong ra sgong lkog ltar: bsgoms pa'i rtsa zug dang mi 'byung zhing: rlung gegs zhi phyir rlung ro phyir drag par 'bud cing nang du dal bus rngub: la nang du bskyil ba dang*/ dal bus gzhil la nas 'bru bzhin dal bu nas shugs bskyed de lhag ma med par phar btang bas mthar na ra ra lhod de bzhag pas rlung zug sogs gegs med: par 'gyur ba'i dgos pa yod do/ /de bzhin du thog mar rtsa rlung ma sbyang ba'i snga rol tu lus dreg drod 'jam chu yis bkru bar bya zhing: zhun chen mar rnying ngam til mar gyi mar khu dang dzā ti sbyar ba'i snum byug byas la bsku mnye bya: dngos gzhi gtum mo'i skabs me dang nyi ma spang byar gsungs shing de bzhin du lan tshwa dang rtsub pa'i zas rigs spang*/ skyes pa dang bud med lhan du nyal po byed pa dang: ngal dub kyi las dang sngo ngad rjen rigs dang tshwa sgog spang : gzhan yang rta rgyug pa dang dbugs las shugs che ba'i dung 'bud pa dang*/ ljid chen pang 'degs sogs: rtsa rgyud chad nyams 'gyur ba'i rigs dang / rngul thon drag las rnams spang: de yis thig ler zug mi 'byung: ba'i dgos pa yod do/ de bzhin du rang nyid la tsha ba'i nad rigs la haṃ bsil dbab: pa dang*/ grang ba'i nad la gtum mo drod me sbar: ba dang*/ spyir ni phyi nang stod smad sogs gang du na sar stong nyid bsgom: pa'am yang na stong nyid kyi ngang nas nad phar btsal ba sogs ci bder sbyar/ khyad par du rmi lam dang sgyu lus sbyangs te sgyu ma'i rnal 'byor nyams su len/

skabs su 'jam rlung bzung zhing: nyams len rjes thob dang bsre la sba bzhi'i nyams la 'jug sba ba bzhi ni/ thig le rtsa yi nang du sbaḥ rnam rtog ye shes dbyings su sbaḥ bde ba 'od gsal klong du sbaḥ 'od gsal 'dzin med ngang du sba: zhes gsungs bzhin rgyun du 'od gsal 'dzin med ngang la bzhag: par byas pas lam gyi gegs grol la rkyen rnams dag cing yon tan ngang gis rdzogs: par 'gyur ro/ de bzhin du g.yas su rgyu ba las kyi rlung: g.yon du rgyu ba ye shes rlung: mnyam pa byang chub sems rlung ste: g.yon nas bzung zhing g.yas nas 'bud: dug lnga skyes tshe g.yas nas btang: dad mos bzang por g.yon nas rngub: ces pa'i bar go sla la/ skyes pa dang bud med la zhe sdang dang 'dod chags gtso che chung gis ro rkyang gi rtsa ni go ldog pa yin la 'on kyang las rlung dang ye rlung rgyu phyogs la dbye ba med ces gsungs par 'dug go: 'od gsal ngang nas 'jam rlung ni: bar ma chad par rtag tu bsten: skyon dag yon tan shugs la rdzogs: myur du sangs rgyas thob par 'gyur: de dag gis rtsa rlung gtum mo'i rim pa mchan bu bkod pa pa re zhig rdzogs so/ sa ma ya: 'pho ba sku gsum klong grol bstanaḥ de la rab 'bring tha gsum las: rab ni chos sku rten med du: yid la ci yang mi bya bar: 'od gsal sgom pa'i ngang la bzhag: 'pho dang grol ba dus mnyam 'byung : 'bring ni longs sku'i zhing khams lnga: gang 'dod mdog gsal 'od zer gyi: thag pa mig g.yon nas zug par: brgyud de zhing khams der bgrod dmigs: gnyis su med pa'i buddha 'o: tha mar sprul sku'i 'pho ba la: rtsal sbyong drang srong tsog pu'i ngang : sku dbus dbu ma sba lcag tsam: mar sna gsang bar sgong mthil ltar: rtse mor spyi bor gdengs kha che: gsang bar rlung gi yaṃ sngo skya:

sny-ing khar g.yung drung dmar po'i steng : rnam shes hūm̐ mthing rno ngar ldan: spyi bor kṣaḥyig nag pos bkag: steng rlung kha nas ma shor bar: hūm̐ sgra'i tshul gyis sna nas bus: phyir 'dzin ngang du ci thub bzhag: ma thub gong bzhin yang yang bskyar: mig btsums spyi bor rtse gcig spar: yaṃ yig rlung gi shugs ldan pa'i: g.yung drung 'khor cing hūm̐ btegs te: kṣaḥyig yar la rgyang rgyang gyur: 'byongs rtags spyi bo'i rtsa yang 'phar: tshangs bug 'phar dang chu ser rdol: khrag thon lus 'dar 'khyor 'gyel sogs: byung tshe 'phro bcad slad nas kyang: bco lnga nam byung tshar re spar: des ni nam dgos don 'grub 'gyur: thal na kṣaḥs bkag steng rlung mnan: 'og lhod yaṃ rlung zhi bar bsam: rlung bcos bya zh-ing rkang mthil brdung : nam zhig 'chi rtags tshang ba'i tshe: tshe 'di'i zhen chags rbad kyis bcad: rigs drug 'khor ba'i mngal sgo bkag: smon lam rnam par dag pa gdab: bar chad med par skad cig 'grub: rlung sems dbyer med drag tu bsdu: gang 'dod gnas su 'pho bar nus: hūm̐ yig bla ma'i thugs kar bstim: gnyis med mngon par byang chub gces: tshangs bug 'phar dang chu ser brdol: sa g.yo 'ja' zug nam mkha' dwangs: 'phos ma thag tu myang 'das kyi: sa zin sku gsum klong du grol: phyir dmigs 'dun blo spu tsam yang : skyes na 'grub pa ma yin no: gzhan la gdab na sgo dgu bkag: dmyal ba gshang lam yi dwags chu: dud 'gro kha dang mi yi sna: lha min rna ba lha yi mig: hūm̐ yig mthing nag re res bkag: gong ltar rtsa gsum thugs kar 'pho: je mtho je mthor dbyings su bstim: bsngo ba smon lam rgya yis gdab: ngan song sgo khegs lam sna zin: ma bsgoms sangs rgyas gdams pa'o: sa ma ya: e maḥ zab gsang gnad kyi mar byang 'phreng : ma hā gu ru'i bka' lung bzhin: bud med mtsho rgyal bdag gis bkod: phyi rabs don du gter du sbas:

las can bu dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gnyan rgya: gtad rgya: dam rgya: kho bo o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtshos me sprel lor/ 'bri gung gzho stod ti sgro'i brag nas gdan drangs shing chu glang lor shog ser las dag par phab pa'o// // ༈ rtsa gsum gling pa nas kra ti sngags 'chang dang*/ dwags po gter ston rje sgam po bzang po rdo rje sogs nas gnam sprul gsum pa o rgyan 'gro 'dul phrin las bar dang des khams bla ma padma rgyal mtshan gyis thob pa'o/ /des gsang dbang*/ sher dbang*/ le tshan gnyis las/ sgyu lus rmi lam 'od gsal grong 'jug sogs le phran gzhan dor nas rlung khrid rkyang pa khul bsdu mdzad par mngon/ slar yang 'dir go rim 'khrugs pa dang chad 'dzud mchan bu dkyus su shor ba sogs mang bar 'dug pa dag tshig don la dpyad nas gtsang zhus byas/ slar phur gling sgrub sde'i nyams bzhes ched sa bcad dang skabs don mchan bu gsar du btab nas zhu dag byas khul lags kyang nor ba 'dug na mkhyen dpyod ldan pa rnams kyis bzod par mdzad du gsol zhes/ sgo sprul du sgro btags pa'i gnam lcags gu hya'i ming gis bgyis pa'o// // na)༄༅/ /bla ma drag po padma khrag 'thung las: gtum mo'i don khrid rlung sems rang grol gsal byed kyis brgyan pa bzhugs so: zag med bde chen he ru ka la 'dud: sa ma ya: gsang sngags snying po gu ru'i thugs sgrub las: gsang dbang don khrid steng sgo'i chos drug bstan: gtum mo sgyu lus rmi lam 'od gsal dang : grong 'jug 'pho ba rnam grol mchog gi lam: skal ldan tshe gcig byang chub sgrub pa'i thabs: gu ru'i gsungs bzhin mtsho rgyal bdag gis 'god: gab 'khrugs sbas dang bcings pa 'di la med: dmar khrid zhun tig kun gyi nying khu 'di: las can shes rab ldan dang 'phrad par shog: bka' rgya bswe yi lha mo mched bzhir bcol:

sa ma ya: bla ma drag po'i gsang dbang don khrid nang gses la/ gtum mo dang*/ sgyu lus/ rmi lam/ 'od gsal/ grong 'jug 'pho ba sogs rnam pa drug yod pa las/ dang po/ gtum mo ni/ nang gi ma dag pa'i rtsa rlung thig le 'dag pa'i phyir: las rlung sbyong zhing dbu ma'i mdud 'khrol ni: 'bar 'dzag zhu bdes drangs pa'i bde stong lhan skyes ye shes kyis: 'khrul snang zad nas longs sku'i nyams rtsal rdzogs: rtsa gegs mdud grol rlung gegs nyon mongs las kyi rlung gi rgyu ba 'gro 'ong chad: thig le 'dzag med 'ching ste rnam kun mchog: ldan gyi stong nyid dang*/ mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba skye ba'i thabs steng sgo rnam grol gyi lam rang lus thabs ldan dang dgos pa khyad par can de lta bu myur du 'byin pa'i thabs 'og sgo bde ba chen po'i lam gzhan lus thabs ldan gyi man ngag pho mo'i rlung bsres pas: zhes las rgya'i gnad la brten nas dbab ldog 'dren dgram sogs 'byung ldog dga' ba bcu drug gi sgo nas nyams su myong ba'i bde stong nyams 'bar ye shes stobs rtsal rdzogs: nas sa bcu rgyun mtha'i gtsug tor rtse mo'i sa mchog mngon du byas nas 'khor lo tshogs chen gyi sa la grol bar 'gyur la/ gnas skabs kyang nyams rtogs rtsal 'bar phyogs med mkhyen pa rgyas: pa sogs yon tan mtha' yas so/ nga nyid longs skur zhes bla ma rlung sems dbyer med du sgrub pa'i gdams pa yin: jo mo mtsho rgyal ma yi snying la 'phur: bde chen nang sgrub le'u gnyis pa'o: de la gtum mo'i me khrid ni: dben par rlung ra legs par btsal/ mthun rkyen yo byad 'bebs gdan dang ang rag sgom thag sogs bsags: khrus dang chu drod 'jam gyis lus bkrus nas mar nag byugs la

bsku mnye stobs bskyed sogs: che ba rgyal po lta bu'i chos: yin phyir drod dang bcud ldan bza' btung longs spyod sogs: thig le rgyas pa'i sman sbyor 'bad: rlung ra gsar pa yin na thog mar bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro ba'i dkar gtor btang zhing sa slong bya/ bgegs la gtor ma bsngo ba dang mtshams gcod srung 'khor bsgom pa rnams gzhung chen mo ltar bya ba'o/ /rgyun du ni mi dgos/ mchan/ rtsa ba srog rtsol gtum mo ni: srog ces ro rkyang g.yas g.yon las kyi rlung : rtsol ba'i gnad kyi lam bkag ste: ye shes srog rlung dbu mar gzhug: de la bde ba'i 'bebs gdan steng : thog mar sngon 'gro spyi dang bla ma'i rnal 'byor gnad du bsnun la dbang bzhi blang bar nan tan bya/ lus gnad rnam snang chos bdun grim cha can bca' ba'am/ gzhung gsal ltar me thab 'khor lo drug chings bca' la/ de'i dgos pa'ang*/ nam mkha'i rlung ni dbu ma ru: 'jug phyir lus kyi cha bsrangs te: chu yi rlung la lce rkan sbyar: me rlung mgrin pa cung zad dgug: rlung gi rlung la tsog pu ru: sgom thag bcing ba nywa bzhi bsgrim: sa rlung pus mo 'dzings 'khyud bsdam: ye shes rlung la rkang pa bsnol: ngag gnad rlung ro g.yas g.yon res mos bdun bdun du 'bud la mthar ha zhes phyir bsal la mnyam par bzhag dug gsum rlung ro phyin phyin 'bud: sems gnad stong ra gsum las/ phyi lus kyi stong ra sgom pa ni/ hūm̐: stong pa'i ngang las rlung lnga bsnol ba'i dal: nyi zla padma g.yung drung ljang gsal steng : ye shes mkha' 'gro ljang 'od mdangs ldan ma: zhal gcig phyag gnyis gar stabs 'gying tshul ldan: zhal 'dzum mdzes shing ratnas dbu la brgyan: thor tshugs dar dpyangs zar bus sku rgyab khebs: rus pa'i rgyan 'phyangs nu ma bha ga rgyas: phyag g.yas rlung zhags g.yon pas tshe bum 'dzin:

phyag gdub zhabs gdub rin chen se mo do: gcer mo 'gying stabs bde stong lhang nger gsal: de nas bde stong 'bar 'dzag la: nang rtsa yi stong ra la/ sku dbus stong sang gur phub pa lta bu'i dbus su rtsa dbu ma ka ba btsugs pa ltar/ zung 'jug dbu ma mtshan nyid bzhi ldan ni/ chu shing gi ldem bu ltar drang ba/ padma'i 'dab ma ltar srab pa/ mthing zhun gyi dwangs ma ltar sngo ba/ til gyi mar me ltar gsal ba'o/ / ni: yar mar sne mo spyi gsang thug: g.yas su thabs kyi ro ma dkar mo dang : g.yon du shes rab rkyang ma dmar mo ni: yar sne sna bug gnyis su zug: mar sne lte 'og yi ge cha yi 'phongs ltar dbu mar 'brel: bud med ro rkyang g.yas g.yon ldog: bud med g.yas rkyang ma dmar mo/ g.yon ro ma dkar mo gsal ba ni/ khams dang nyon mongs sogs khyad 'byung ba'i phyir ro/ /de nas 'khor lo drug ni/ 'dir rgyud sde so sor rtsa 'dab sogs mi 'dra ba mang du bzhugs la/ dper na/ kun bzang dgongs 'dus las/ rtse mo rnam dag bkod pa na: rtsa 'dab sum brgya drug cu ste: mgrin pa ro 'dus bcu drug go: sny-ing khar sum cu rtsa gnyis so: skyed byed drug cu rtsa bzhi ste: gsang bar nyi shu rtsa brgyad gnas: de rnams 'khor lo bzhin du bsgom: gsungs la/ de bzhin 'dir yang cung mi 'dra ba bzhugs la phal che bar snying khar rtsa 'dab brgyad dang/ mgrin pa ru rtsa 'dab bcu drug dpral par rtsa 'dab sum cu rtsa gnyis/ lte bar drug cu rtsa bzhi/ gsang bar nyi shu rtsa brgyad bshad kyang rang lugs ni/ gsang bar rtsa 'dab sum cu gnyis: lte bar drug cu rtsa brgyad dang : snying khar brgyad dang mgrin pa ru: sum cu rtsa gnyis dpral pa la: bcu drug gtsug tor rtsa bzhi ste: gyes pa'i rtsa phran bsam mi khyab: ba spu'i grangs dang mnyam par gnas: byang sems rgyu ba'i mchog dngos 'grub:

kun kyang mtshan nyid bzhi ldan pa: rtsa srog dbu ma'i ngo bo nyid: rlung srog bum pa can du bsgom: zhes brjod la nyams len gyi gsang gnad ni/ de ltar rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi dang ldan pa mar sne lte 'og sor bzhi'i 'og spu nag ma'i mtshams su zug pa gsal la/ rluung bum chen sbyor ba bzhi ldan du bsgom pa man ngag dang*/ de'ang bum chen sbyor ba bzhi ni/ sna bug dal bus brngubs nas lte 'og tu chil gyis gnon pa dang*/ lto bar dgang*/ stod du ma shor bar ci nus bzung ba dang/ mi thub tshe g.yas g.yon du gzhil ba gsum re dang*/ bcag cing dkrugs la ma thub tshe dal bus shugs kyis 'phangs la cung zad bzhag slar yang sngar ltar byas pas chog rngub dang dgang gzhil bcag cing dkrugs: slar der rngub chung re re brtsegs: sgom tshe gang thub bskyil bas chog: g.yas 'bud g.yon rngub khor yug bslab: dang por sgom tshe rtsa rlung thig le'i zug: rngu drag po na tsha sogs/ slong tshe sdug bsran snying rus bskyed: par bya'o/ bar du zug yal bde la sdug: pa res mos 'byung tshe/ le lor mi btang bar med bsgom: par bya'o/

tha ma bde drod stobs 'bar tshe: 'dod sred bdud kyi dbang du mi gtang: zhing*/ thig le 'dzin 'dren bkram pa'i gnad la bslab: khams dub pa bsang ba dang gnyid dang zas bcud 'tsho ba bsten: pa'i dus ma gtogs rgyun chad med pa ru: zla drug lo gcig gnyis gsum bar: 'bad pa'i rtsa thig rlung dag grol: (kha) gtum mo'i me dmigs ni/ rtsa gsum 'dus mdor lte ba'i mar snar gnam zhal yum gyi rang bzhin a shad zur gsum phur pa'i dbal so gyen bstan ltar dang*/ spyi bor yab he ru ka yi rang bzhin haṃ yig mgo gyen bstan du yod pa gsal la/ rlung gnad bum pa can nam 'jam rlung bzung*/ de'ang ro rkyang brgyud rlung dal bur brngubs shing lte 'og tu chil gyis mnan pa'i dbu ma'i mar snar a shad la phog pas me lhab kyis 'bar cing*/ lte ba nas snying kha mgrin pa bar 'khor lo rnams rim par khyab/ sgo gsum gyi las dang sgrib bzhi bag chags bcas pa bsregs/ rtsa yi mdud pa dkrol/ dpral par slebs pa dang ham̐ yig mgo thur du ldog bde ba chen po bdud rtsi'i rgyun bab pas me dang bdud rtsi bros ded kyi rnam par yas dbab dga' bzhi nyams su myong/ mthar bdud rtsi a shad la phog pas snum tsha lcags sreg la phog pa bzhin/ rab tu 'bar ba'i me dang bdud rtsi gnyis med dkar dmar khams kyi rang bzhin zhu bdes lus kun gtams pas bde drod skyes par bsam/ gsang ba sems kyi stong ra ni/ (nga) thig le'i srog ni sum mdor a: dpral bar haṃ yig dngul chu ltar: rlung gnad 'jam rlung ro rkyang brgyud: dbu mar 'bar zhing 'khor lo rnams: rim par mdud dkrol bde rgyun dbab: dkar dmar zhu bdes lus kun gtams: de tshe dbu ma che bskyed chung bskyed ni/ de ltar dkar dmar byang chub sems kyi stobs rgyas pa'i thabs la 'bad cing/ mthar rlung khug pa gcig bzung ba dang/

lgang bu la phus brgyangs pa ltar gsang ba rtsa 'khor rtsa 'dab dang bcas pa nar gyis gsal ba'i mar snar a shad snga ma bzhin sgom pa'i lus kyi rtsa 'dab ba spu bu ga tshun thams cad nas me stag zi ri ri 'khrugs shing/ me yi ḍākki gar stabs 'khyugs par dmigs/ yang bde drod nyams 'bar zhing me dpung phyir mched pas/ phyi snod kyi 'jig rten thams cad me yi dal du gyur/ nang bcud kyi sems can thams cad me yi ḍākki ma dang/ sgra skad thams cad me dpung 'ur 'ur tshig tshig dang ni ha ri ni sa'i rang sgra sgrog par bsam/ yang rang lus dbu ma dang bcas pa cher bskyed pa'i stong ra che ba nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam par bskyed/ yang shin du chung ba rta rnga cha bgos pa tsam la bsdu ba sogs spro bsdu rig pa'i rang rtsal sbyang*/ a haṃ snyoms 'jug bde ba'i ngang bskyangs la/ mthar ka dag ngang la bzla bar bya'o/ / (ca)de ltar dkar dmar stobs rgyas pa'i: ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas: me yi ḍākki gar stabs 'khyugs: bde drod nyams 'bar me dpung mched: snod kyi 'jig rten me yi dal: bcud kyi sems can ḍākki ma: sgra skad thams cad me dpung 'ur: tshig ni ha ri ni sa'i sgra: stong ra che ba nam mkha'i mtha': chung ba rta rnga tsam la bsdu: spro bsdu rig pa'i rang rtsal sbyang : a haṃ snyoms 'jug bde ba'i ngang : gnas skabs bdun gsum nyer gcig 'bad: rlung sems zin pas drod tshad rnyed: gtum mo'i me dmigs ni/ (ka) rang lus padma ḍākki ni: khro gtum rgyan rdzogs lcags sreg ltar: tsha ngar ldan pa zhag gsum bsgom: de nas lte 'og me yi dal: gru gsum a thung tsha rngam can: gnam lcags thog 'dra mtho gang bar: rtse gcig sems gtad zhag gsum bsgom: ༈ dang po rtsa rlung gsol 'debs ni: om̐ āḥhūm̐: ka dag rdor 'chang chos sku 'od mi 'gyur: gsol ba 'debs so rtsa rlung bde drod skyed: gtum mo ye shes me dpung sbar du gsol:

'ja' lus chos sku 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: longs sku'i rtsal snang ston pa rdo rje sems: gsol ba 'debs so rtsa rlung bde drod skyed: gtum mo ye shes me dpung sbar du gsol: 'ja' lus chos sku 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: sprul sku 'chi med rig 'dzin padma 'byung : gsol ba 'debs so rtsa rlung bde drod skyed: gtum mo ye shes me dpung sbar du gsol: 'ja' lus chos sku 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: rtsa gsum gar dbang mkha' 'gro mtsho rgyal ma: gsol ba 'debs so rtsa rlung bde drod skyed: gtum mo ye shes me dpung sbar du gsol: 'ja' lus chos sku 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: nus rtsal brtul zhugs sangs rgyas ye shes rtsal: gsol ba 'debs so rtsa rlung bde drod skyed: gtum mo ye shes me dpung sbar du gsol: 'ja' lus chos sku 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: las 'phro gter 'byin karma las 'brel gling : gsol ba 'debs so rtsa rlung bde drod skyed: gtum mo ye shes me dpung sbar du gsol: 'ja' lus chos sku 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: sprul sku rig 'dzin rdo rje bdud 'dul rtsal: gsol ba 'debs so rtsa rlung bde drod skyed: gtum mo ye shes me dpung sbar du gsol: 'ja' lus chos sku 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: grub brgya'i spyi mes thugs mchog rdo rje la/ /gsol ba 'debs so rtsa rlung bde drod skyed: gtum mo ye shes me dpung sbar du gsol: 'ja' lus chos sku 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: rlung sems dbang thob dri med gling pa la/ /gsol ba 'debs so rtsa rlung bde drod skyed: gtum mo ye shes me dpung sbar du gsol: 'ja' lus chos sku 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: 'gro 'dul kong smyon kra ti sngags 'chang la/ /gsol ba 'debs so rtsa rlung bde drod skyed: gtum mo ye shes me dpung sbar du gsol:

'ja' lus chos sku 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: lung zin sgam po bzang po rdo rje la/ /gsol ba 'debs so rtsa rlung bde drod skyed: gtum mo ye shes me dpung sbar du gsol: 'ja' lus chos sku 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: o rgyan 'gro 'dul phrin las dbang phyug la/ /gsol ba 'debs so rtsa rlung bde drod skyed: gtum mo ye shes me dpung sbar du gsol: 'ja' lus chos sku 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: bka' drin mtshungs med rtsa ba'i bla ma la: gsol ba 'debs so rtsa rlung bde drod skyed: gtum mo ye shes me dpung sbar du gsol: 'ja' lus chos sku 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: rten 'brel mnga' bsgyur zab rgya'i gter srung la: gsol ba 'debs so rtsa rlung bde drod skyed: gtum mo ye shes me dpung sbar du gsol: 'ja' lus chos sku 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: tshe gcig sangs rgyas 'grub par by-in gyis rlobs: mchog thun dngos grub 'byung bar byin gyis rlobs: zhes gsol ba drag tu btab pas/ dbu ma'i nang bzhugs brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams mas rim bzhin rtsa ba'i bla mar thim/ de yang thig dmar a shad can dang gnyis med du gyur par mos la/ de nas a shad dmar la tsha: de'ang ngo bo bde ba/ reg bya tsha ba/ rnam pa gsal ba/ rtse mo shes rab kyi rang bzhin rno la 'khyugs pa sbrul gyi lce lta bu lte ba'i rtsa 'khor nas 'khor lo rnams su zhugs/ rim gyis tshwa tshwas snying kha'i man: de nas mgrin pa spyi bo dang : lus kyi nang khengs ba spu'i sgor: tshwa tshwa'i zhun ma rab tu khol: ye shes ḍākki dmar nag gtum: me dpung 'ur 'ur bdud tshogs bsreg:(ga) phyi 'dzin nang 'dzin spel ma ru: brdab chung brgya dang brgyad du bya: gegs sel 'khrul 'khor yan lag lnga sbyong ni/ dang po/ khu tshur bskor brgyangs mchan rdeb lan gsum sngon du 'gro ba'i mgo bo gzengs bstod skyil krung dang*/

gnyis pa/ mig nas rim par dpral thod mgo bo'i mdun rgyab dang sked pa bskor la g.yas g.yon mdun rgyab rkang pa yan 'phur la bsku mnye bya/ gsum pa/ a zhes sor bsnol brang la brdab/ yang ka zhes kha phyir bstan du brgyangs/ yang tsa zhes nang bstan du brgyangs/ ṭa zhes sor bsnol brang la brdab/ yang ya zhes kha phyir bstan du brgyangs/ yang sha zhes nang bstan du brgyangs/ mthar a ka tsa ṭa ta pa ya sha a ham̐ zhes khu tshur brla thog 'jog bzhi pa/ dpung pa g.yas g.yon gcu zhing phrag pus sprad pa res mos gsum/ lnga pa/ skyil krung dang bcas lag pa rgyab du brkyangs la bya rgod 'phur stangs ltar shad kyis brgyangs la tshur bskum pa dang mdun du 'phur stangs lan gsum song ba'i rjes bar 'bebs gsum ha ring dang bcas 'ba' dkrugs gsum/ mjug tu 'bebs chung brgya dang brgyad sogs ci nus bya/ zhag bdun dang bcu bzhi'am nyer gcig sogs 'bad par bya'o/ /de nas 'khrul 'khor rnam pa lnga dang 'byung bzhi 'khrul 'khor sogs ni lag len gyi rgyun da lta mi snang zhing*/ kho bo chung ngu'i dus 'phrul 'khor dpe ris zhib gsal zhig mthong yang slad rig gsar skabs gdod ma'i dbyings su phebs par gda'o/ mgo dang sked bskor dpung pa gcu: lag pa brkyang shad bskum dang brdeg: ha ring ha thung 'bebs chung brdab: zhag bdun nam ni bcu bzhir 'bad: lus drod me ltar 'bar bar 'gyur: de nas 'khrul 'khor rnam pa lnga: mgo bo dgye bsgur mjing pa shad: lag pa brkyang bskum bzhag sha brdab: ro stod drag skor g.yas g.yon bskor: sked pa g.yas g.yon 'khor lor bskor: rkang pa phra shad brkyang bskum bya: drag 'bebs ha sprug lhab lheb bya: de nas 'byung bzhi 'khrul 'khor ni: mda' 'gengs lag bsnol rkang bsnol 'bebs: gzhi 'phra mi khri sgril log bya: 'bebs shing rtsal sprug drag po bya: ka dag ngang du lhan ne bzhag: 'dren 'dzin 'grems gnad ni/

gnad kyi 'gag dam hūm̐ gis spyi bor 'dren: phyir 'dzin ngang nas phri lir khyab par bkram: seṅge rnam rol rba rlabs gnad dang thim: bkram rtags lus bde dub cing gsal stong 'char: zin pa'i rtags dang log pa'i nyes pa bshad pa/ gsang bar rlung sems zin pa dang : bde nyams kha zas sred pa dag: rlung log thig le 'dzag pa dang : 'dod chags mi bzod nad kun bskyed: lte bar zin na drod 'bar zhing : kha zas 'ju la lus stobs bskyed: log na pho ba'i nad kun bskyed: snying khar zin na shes rab dang : rtogs pa bskyed cing rlung log la: smyo 'bog yid mi bde ba 'byung : mgrin par zin na ngag snyan zhing : rtsom mkhas tshigs bcad mang po brdol: log na rims nad mang du 'byung : dpral par zin na 'od gsal 'char: rims sogs tshad pa'i nad kun sel: log na grang nad tha dag bskyed: spyi bor slebs pas rtogs pa dang : nam mkha' lta bu'i nyams 'char te: snang ba thams cad gtad med grol: log na mgo bo na sogs 'byung : thig le lugs 'byung ldog gi 'khor lo lngar rim par bslab pa ni/ de nas 'bar 'dzag yas dbab kyis: dpral par babs pas dga' ba bskyed: lha bu'i bdud bcom yul snang dag: mgrin par babs pas mchog dga' bskyed: nyon mongs bdud bcom zhen 'dzin dag: snying khar babs pas lhan skyes dga': phung po'i bdud bcom gnyis zhen dag: lte bar babs pas dga' bral myong: 'chi bdag bdud bcom gang la'ang: zhen pa med cing bde stong grol: de nas mas brtan dga' ba bzhi: gsang gnas phyir 'phros 'khor ba'i rgyu: nor bu dgra la shor dang mtshungs: lte bar ldog pas sprul skur thob: snying khar slebs pas longs skur thob: mgrin par slebs pas chos skur thob: dpral par slebs pas ngo bo nyid: spyi bor slebs pas bde chen sku: sangs rgyas sku lnga'i bdag nyid can: mngon par shes pas phyogs med 'char: rdzu 'phrul ya ma zung ston nus:

rtsa gegs 'khor lo drug mdud grol: rlung gegs dbugs kyi 'gro 'ong chad: thig le zag pa med par 'gyur: las rlung zad nas sgom pa ni: nyin mtshan 'dres na rmi lam 'gag: rmongs pa ma yin bde stong gsal: 'phos tshe sku gsum zhing khams bgrod: rlung sems gang du gtad pa der: 'jug par nus shing rang dbang thob: sa ma ya: stong ra lus nang sgong lkog ltar: 'byung ba'i dug lnga pho smad na: 'ja' tshon lta bu'i lang long bsam: hūm̐ zhes rngub cing bskyil ba yis: spyi bor phyur phyur thon dmigs la: hūm̐ ring khong 'dren lcog tshad 'phang: yang yang 'bad pa'i dug slong ste: 'dar sprug stod gzer rmi lam 'khrugs: mgo sbrid nyams snang sna tshogs 'byung: dug phyin spyi bor rlangs sngo dmar: sgra 'od dang bcas thon par 'gyur: zhag bdun tsam na za zi 'phyo: dri med nyin phyed sum cha tsam: zan ni za yun tsam du 'byung: de rjes mgo yang dug thon pas: 'byung ba lnga las zad par sa yi ting 'dzin sogs bsgoms pas so so yi yon tan 'char: sa yis ting 'dzin 'bral mi phod: chu yis mdog snum kha dog dwangs: me yis bde drod bkrag mdangs che: rlung gis shugs chen zo mdog bde: nam mkhas bde gsal mi rtog pa'i: snang ba rang sar grol bar 'gyur: ji ltar kha zas dug 'dres bzhin: zas bcud mi mngon nad ro bslang : nyon mongs dug dang bcas kyi bar: skyon dang yon tan 'dres mar 'char: dug bral kha zas sman 'gyur bzhin: dug phyin yon tan ci bzhin mngon: sa ma ya: gegs sel gdams pa/ rtsa rlung thig le la brten nas: ye shes bskyed phyir lus drang bas: rtsa drang rlung drang dbu mar tshud: thig le 'bar 'dzag rang bzhin gyur: bde ba 'char ba'i lus gnad bsrangs: lus lha'i stong ra sgong lkog ltar: bsgoms pa'i rtsa zug mi 'byung zhing: drag par 'bud cing dal bus rngub: dal bus btang bas rlung zug med: lus dreg chu yis bkru bya zhing:

zhun chen mar rnying bsku mnye bya: me dang lan tshwa bud med dang: ngal dub sngo rigs tshwa sgog spang : rta rgyug dung 'bud pang 'degs sogs: rtsa chad rngul thon las rnams spang: de yis thig ler zug mi 'byung: tsha ba'i nad la haṃ bsil dbab: grang ba'i nad la gtum mo sbar: spyir ni na sar stong nyid bsgom: sgyu lus sbyangs te rlung bzung zhing: rgyun du 'od gsal ngang la bzhag: gegs grol rkyen dag yon tan rdzogs: g.yas su rgyu ba las kyi rlung: g.yon du rgyu ba ye shes rlung: mnyam pa byang chub sems rlung ste: g.yon nas bzung zhing g.yas nas 'bud: dug lnga skyes tshe g.yas nas btang: dad mos bzang por g.yon nas rngub: bud med la ni go ldog go: 'od gsal ngang nas 'jam rlung ni: bar ma chad par rtag tu bsten: skyon dag yon tan shugs la rdzogs: myur du sangs rgyas thob par 'gyur: sa ma ya: 'pho ba sku gsum klong grol bstanaḥ de la rab 'bring tha gsum las: rab ni chos sku rten med du: yid la ci yang mi bya bar: 'od gsal sgom pa'i ngang la bzhag: 'pho dang grol ba dus mnyam 'byung : 'bring ni longs sku'i zhing khams lnga: gang 'dod mdog gsal 'od zer gyi: thag pa mig g.yon nas zug par: brgyud de zhing khams der bgrod dmigs: gnyis su med pa'i buddha 'o: tha mar sprul sku'i 'pho ba la: rtsal sbyong drang srong tsog pu'i ngang : sku dbus dbu ma sba lcag tsam: mar sna gsang bar sgong mthil ltar: rtse mor spyi bor gdengs kha che: gsang bar rlung gi yaṃ sngo skya: sny-ing khar g.yung drung dmar po'i steng : rnam shes hūm̐ mthing rno ngar ldan: spyi bor kṣaḥyig nag pos bkag: steng rlung kha nas ma shor bar: hūm̐ sgra'i tshul gyis sna nas bus: phyir 'dzin ngang du ci thub bzhag: ma thub gong bzhin yang yang bskyar: mig btsums spyi bor rtse gcig spar: yaṃ yig rlung gi shugs ldan pa'i: g.yung drung 'khor cing hūm̐ btegs te:

kṣaḥyig yar la rgyang rgyang gyur: 'byongs rtags spyi bo'i rtsa yang 'phar: tshangs bug 'phar dang chu ser rdol: khrag thon lus 'dar 'khyor 'gyel sogs: byung tshe 'phro bcad slad nas kyang: bco lnga nam byung tshar re spar: des ni nam dgos don 'grub 'gyur: thal na kṣaḥs bkag steng rlung mnan: 'og lhod yaṃ rlung zhi bar bsam: rlung bcos bya zh-ing rkang mthil brdung : nam zhig 'chi rtags tshang ba'i tshe: tshe 'di'i zhen chags rbad kyis bcad: rigs drug 'khor ba'i mngal sgo bkag: smon lam rnam par dag pa gdab: bar chad med par skad cig 'grub: rlung sems dbyer med drag tu bsdu: gang 'dod gnas su 'pho bar nus: hūm̐ yig bla ma'i thugs kar bstim: gnyis med mngon par byang chub gces: tshangs bug 'phar dang chu ser brdol: sa g.yo 'ja' zug nam mkha' dwangs: 'phos ma thag tu myang 'das kyi: sa zin sku gsum klong du grol: phyir dmigs 'dun blo spu tsam yang : skyes na 'grub pa ma yin no: gzhan la gdab na sgo dgu bkag: dmyal ba gshang lam yi dwags chu: dud 'gro kha dang mi yi sna: lha min rna ba lha yi mig: hūm̐ yig mthing nag re res bkag: gong ltar rtsa gsum thugs kar 'pho: je mtho je mthor dbyings su bstim: bsngo ba smon lam rgya yis gdab: ngan song sgo khegs lam sna zin: ma bsgoms sangs rgyas gdams pa'o: sa ma ya: e maḥ zab gsang gnad kyi mar byang 'phreng : ma hā gu ru'i bka' lung bzhin: bud med mtsho rgyal bdag gis bkod: phyi rabs don du gter du sbas: las can bu dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gnyan rgya: gtad rgya: dam rgya: kho bo o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtshos me sprel lor/ 'bri gung gzho stod ti sgro'i brag nas gdan drangs shing chu glang lor shog ser las dag par phab pa'o// // ༈ rtsa gsum gling pa nas kra ti sngags 'chang dang*/ dwags po gter ston rje sgam po bzang po rdo rje sogs nas gnam sprul gsum pa o rgyan 'gro 'dul phrin las bar dang des khams bla ma padma rgyal mtshan gyis thob pa'o/

/des gsang dbang*/ sher dbang*/ le tshan gnyis las/ sgyu lus rmi lam 'od gsal grong 'jug sogs le phran gzhan dor nas rlung khrid rkyang pa khul bsdu mdzad par mngon/ slar yang 'dir go rim 'khrugs pa dang chad 'dzud mchan bu dkyus su shor ba sogs mang bar 'dug pa dag tshig don la dpyad nas gtsang zhus byas/ slar phur gling sgrub sde'i nyams bzhes ched sa bcad mchan bu kha shas gsar du btab nas zhu dag byas khul lags kyang nor ba 'dug na mkhyen dpyod ldan pa rnams kyis bzod par mdzad du gsol zhes/ sgo sprul du sgro btags pa'i gnam lcags gu hya'i ming gis bgyis pa'o// //

pa)༄༅/ /bla ma drag po padma khrag 'thung gi rdzogs chen rtsal dbang don khrid kyi dgongs 'grel 'khor 'das rang grol zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / ngo bo ka dag gdod nas spros pa'i mtshan ma kun bral thog ma'i mgon/ /rang bzhin lhun grub sku dang ye shes yon tan lhun rdzogs snying rje'i gter/ /thugs rjes kun khyab gang 'dul der ston sangs rgyas padma skyes stangs dpyal/ /dbyer med rang rig don gyi bla mar rang ngo shes pa'i phyag gis 'dud/ /bod yul sa 'og kun gyi gter gcig ma/ /yang zab bla ma drag po khyung zhon gyi/ /rdzogs chen tshig dang rtsal dbang don khrid kyi/ /dgongs 'grel 'khor 'das rang grol 'di na dbye/ /de'ang o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa'i zab gter bla ma drag po padma khrag 'thung gi rdzogs pa chen po'i tshig dbang dang rtsal dbang*/ don khrid rdo rje'i tshig rkang gi dgongs pa cung zad 'grel pa 'khor 'das rang grol zhes bya ba la/ sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ dang po/ de la thog mar gang zhig las dang skal ba ldan pa'i gang zag dbang rnon/ tshe gcig lus gcig gis zung 'jug 'od gsal rdo rje rtse mo'i gsang lam mngon du byas nas/ 'bras bu phyi dus la re mi dgos par stan thog gcig tu grol bar 'dod pa dag dang po nyid nas lam gyi rtsa ba bla slob phan tshun legs par brtags la rten 'brel ma nor bar byed pa gal che tshul la'ang*/ slob dpon ma brtags g.yang mchong 'dra/ /slob ma ma brtags dug 'thung 'dra/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ bla ma dang slob ma gnyis las/ dang po/ slob mas kyang bla ma brtag dgos tshul ni/ gter gzhung rdo rje'i tshig rkang las/ skal ldan tshe gcig byang chub sgrub pa la: bcud mchog khungs btsun brgyud ldan bla ma bsten: zhes gsungs pa ltar/ dang po/ bsten bya'i bla ma ni/ brgyud pa'i khungs btsun zhing dam tshig la sel med pa/ thos pa che zhing lag len la mkhas pa/ bskyed rdzogs dang lta dgongs kyi drod thob pa/

rang nyid sgrub la brtson zhing gzhan 'khrid pa la mkhas pa/ brgyud pa'i byin rlabs yod cing thugs rgyud byang chub sems kyis gang ba/ de 'dra'i bla ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa ni bsten bya'o/ /gnyis pa spang bya'i mtshan nyid kyang*/ gu ru'i zhal nas/ thos rgya chung la nga rgyal che ba/ blun rmongs tshig la sred cing khengs sems che ba/ shes rab chung zhing don la rmongs pa/ bskyed rdzogs kyi don la mi mkhas shing lag len rdugs pa/ bdag 'dzin che la snying rje'i dpyang thag chad pa/ zhes gsungs pa ltar de 'dra'i rigs su 'dug na brtag la ring du gnas par bya dgos te/ ci'i phyir zhe na/ slob ma'i rgyud chud zon par byed cing byin rlabs mi 'go dngos grub phyir bsring zhing lam log par bsgyur ba'i tshul/ gter gzhung rdo rje'i tshig rkang las/ bla ma log na gdams ngag byin rlabs nor: dngos grub skal chad chos byed ngan sngags bsgrub: de phyir rtogs dgongs gdeng ldan bla ma btsal: gsungs pa bzhin bla ma brtags shing mtshan nyid dang ldan pa btsal la/ de'ang mnyes pa gsum gyis legs par bsnyen nas dgongs spyod tshul bzhin du bslab par bya'o/ /gnyis pa/ bla mas kyang slob ma snod dang ldan min brtag pa la gnyis las/ dang po/ spang bya slob ma'i mtshan nyid bstan pa ni/ rdo rje'i tshig rkang las/ snod kyi slob ma skal med nyams pa'i gzhi: the tshom g.yo sgyu che dang dad gus chung : thabs kyis chos len man ngag zong du 'tshong : nyams su mi len brgyud pa'i srol mi 'dzin: mos gus nges shes med pas bcud mi thub: yig res dpe char song ste 'chal nas 'gro: zhes log lta dang g.yo sgyu che la dad gus chung ba/ yon tan la mi blta zhing skyon la rtog pa/ bla mar gsang zhing gdams ngag rku 'khyer byed pa/ rang gi che ba 'don zhing man ngag zab mo nor rdzas kyi phyir 'tshong zhing*/ brtson 'grus chung bas rang gis nyams su mi len pa dang*/

dad pa'i snod zhan pas byin rlabs kyi bcud mi thub la/ gdams ngag dpe thog dang rang rgyud tha mal du lus pa de 'dra ni spang bya slob ma'i mtshan nyid do/ /gnyis pa/ bsten bya slob ma'i mtshan nyid bstan pa ni/ de'ang rdo rje'i tshig rkang las/ chos zab 'tsho shes slob ma legs par brtags: bla ma sangs rgyas mthong ba'i mos gus che: gdams ngag bdud rtsir mthong ba'i nges shes skyes: the tshom bral ba'i bka' lung nor bu mthong : 'khor ba dug ltar mthong bas phyi don bsgrub: dgos med blo sna thung zhing sdug sran che: bya blo khe grags 'gran sems skyon med pa: rgyal ba'i sras mchog snod ldan bu yin pas: a ti bla med bcud mchog sbyin pa'i yul: zhes gsungs pa bzhin bla ma la sangs rgyas dngos su mthong bas dad pa dang mos gus che ba/ gdams ngag bdud rtsir mthong bas nges shes yid ches che ba/ rang sems the tshom bral bas bla ma'i bka' lung la yid bzhin nor bu ltar mthong bas dag snang che ba/ 'khor ba'i bya ba thams cad dug ltar mthong bas nges 'byung che ba/ phyi ma'i don sgrub pa la don med kyi bya ba mang po dgos med kyi blo sna thung zhing*/ chos phyir dka' spyad dang du len nus pas sdug sran che ba/ bya ba'i blo khe grags 'gran sems sogs 'jig rten chos brgyad kyi skyon med pa dang*/ gzhan phan snying rje'i blo kha gting nas 'byongs pas ci byed gzhan don kho na la bsam pa'i rgyal ba'i sras byang chub spyod mchog la gzhol bas snying stobs che ba de 'dra ni snod ldan snying gi bu bya ba yin pas/ de la lam rim gyis slob tu bcug la/ mthar a ti rdzogs pa chen po'i bla med bcud mchog sbyin par bya'o zhes snod ldan bstan la/ de ltar brtags nas rten 'brel kun gyi rtsa ba bla slob bsten tshul gzhi ma 'chug pa gal che tshul yang*/ gong gi 'phror/ de ltar snod bcud ldan pa'i dben pa ru:

tshogs gtor yo byad mthun rkyen ma lus bsags: gsungs pas gang zhig slob ma dad pa'i snod dang ldan pa/ slob dpon byin rlabs kyi bcud dang ldan pa 'dzoms nas gnas dus yo byad grogs sogs mthun rkyen tshogs dgos pas/ de la gnas kyi mtshan nyid ni/ spyir rgyal bas byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas ni byin rlabs che/ lung stong du dge sbyor 'phel/ ri'i rtser shes pa gsal/ dur khrod du skyo shas che/ dben par nyams len 'phel/ dwangs shing mtho ba ni dbyings rig gsal ba'o/ /ci'i phyir na/ de lta bu'i gnas su nyams len byas na bogs 'don gzhan las che bas/ gnas skabs dge sbyor ngang gis 'phel ba dang mthar thug dbyings rig la myur du brtan pa thob pa'i dgaus pa yod do/ /dus kyang*/ dbyar ma ston dang dgun tha chung*/ dpyid kyi dus sogs na bun dang*/ 'tshub ma dang*/ bser bu med cing nam mkha' g.ya' dag pa'i dus su sgom na dbyings rig gsal la/ ngo sprod pa'i dus ni zer gnyis kyi dus shin du gsal ba'o/ /tshes ni yar mar gyi tshes bcu sogs dus chen rnams so/ /yo byad ni/ gu ru'i zhal nas/ gdams pa khyad par can zhu ba la yo byad tshang dgos te/ de ma tshang na mkha' 'gro'i bka' chad 'byung bar gsungs pas na/ de'ang bla ma la 'bul ba'i phyag rten/ dbang yon/ tshogs kyi yo byad/ rang la mkho ba'i nyer spyod/ gdams pa khyad par can zhu ba la rin chen dang po'i maṇḍal 'bul dgos par gsungs pas 'byor na rten 'brel bzang la/ lag stong pas ni zhu mi rung bas ci 'byor ba'i yo byad kyis bla ma mnyes par bya'o/ /dgos pa ni/ gsang sngags kyi che ba mi nyams par byed pa dang*/ rang gis gnas skabs gdams ngag lon zhing tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa'i rkyen du 'gro/ mthar thug dngos grub thams cad myur du thob pa'i dgos pa yod do/ /grogs kyang klong gsal las/ dam tshig gtsang ldan dag pa'i snang ba che/ /dug lnga shugs chung blo brtan khog yangs pa/

/ngang rgyud ring zhing brtse ba'i grogs dang 'grogs/ /zhes de 'dra'i grogs dang ldan na dam tshig la sel mi 'byung zhing byang chub myur du thob pa'i dgos pa yod do/ /'jug pa'i rgyu rnams bstan z-in to/ /de nas phyag dang yan lag bdun pa sngon du 'gro ba'i maṇḍal 'bul zhing gnang bar gsol ba 'debs la/ bla mas kyang zhal gyis bzhes nas gnyis kas tshogs gtor yo byad mthun rkyen ma lus pa bsags shing thog mar dbang gis smin par byas/ de nas rim gyis grol byed gdams pa'i gnad kyis gzhi bting dgos pa rnams brgyud pa'i phyag len yin mod kyang*/ phal cher stor la nye zhing*/ deng sang rdzogs chen khrom bsgrags zhes srang mdo rnams su 'bel gtam du sgrog pa dag bstan pa 'di nyid nyams pa'i ltas su lung bstan pa thog tu bab par gda'o/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i khrid la sngon 'gro dang dngos gzhi gnyis/ dang po la'ang thun mong dang thun min gnyis las/ dang po thun mong ni/ gter gzhung rdo rje'i tshig rkang las/ sngon 'gro dal 'byor rnyed dka' tshe mi rtag: las 'bras 'khor ba'i duḥkha thar pa yi: rgyal ba'i yon tan rnams la legs par bsam: 'khor bar yid dbyung chos la nges shes bskyed: ces gsungs pa bzhin thun mong sngon 'gro la blo sbyong ba ni/ chos la blo 'jug pa'i rgyu dal 'byor rnyed par dka' ba'i khrid/ brtson 'grus kyi lcag 'debs pa tshe mi rtag pa'i khrid/ blang dor gyi gnas la 'jug ldog byed pa las rgyu 'bras kyi khrid/ srid pa sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin du shes pa 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs kyi khrid de blo ldog rnam pa bzhi dang*/ thar pa'i yon tan bsam pa rnams zhib thon par bshad cing*/ de'ang go lo thos lo tsam du ma bzhag par re re bzhin thos don legs par bsam zhing*/ dpyad 'jog spel ma'i tshul gyis nyams su blangs nas kha tsam ma yin par 'khor bar yid dbyung dang*/ chos la nges shes gting nas rnyed pa'i blo sbyong rgyud thog tu 'khel nges pa zhig bya dgos pa shin tu nas gal che la/

de'i tshul kho bos byas pa'i phyi'i sngon 'gro'i lag khrid gdab pa man ngag gnad kyi gzer bu'i skabs ltar shes par bya'o/ /gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa nang gi sngon 'gro ni/ gter gzhung rdo rje'i tshig rkang las/ de las skyob thabs skyabs su 'gro ba'i khrid: gzhan don theg chen byang chub mchog sems bskyed: las nyon sdig sgrib sbyong ba rdor sems bzlas: tshogs gnyis gter chen bsags pa maṇḍal dang : byin rlabs cig car 'jug pa'i gsol 'debs te: zhes bsags sbyang lnga ni/ rgyas pa rig 'dzin thugs mchog rdo rjes mdzad pa'i sngon 'gro'i khrid zab don rin po che'i sgron me ltar nyams su len pa yin pas der blta bar bya'o/ /sngon 'gro'i dgos pa spyi ni/ rdo rje'i tshig rkang las/ de ltar sngon du 'gro ba'i dgos ched ni: bla mas zin cing gdams pa thob pa dang : nges pa'i chos dran lam mchog rnyed pa dang : theg pa kun gyi nyams len byang chub mngon: sgrib dag tshogs gnyis rdzogs nas grol rkyen 'gyur: dge sbyor kun gyi phyogs 'drong srol du tshud: bar chad kun bsal nyams myong yon tan 'phel: zhes dang*/ khyad par ni/ gter gzhung rdo rje'i tshig rkang las/ dbang bzhis rgyud smin ye shes khong nas rdol: rang rig mngon du gyur na rdzogs sangs rgyas: rjes thob nyams bskyangs byin rlabs cig car 'bebs: sgrib dag bar chad bsal zhing dngos grub thob: rtogs pa btsan thabs 'bar zhing srol la tshud: ces dang*/ de yang mos gus kho na la rag las tshul ni/ gter gzhung rdo rje'i tshig rkang las/ brgyud pa'i phreng ba bgrangs mi 'tshal: dad gus med pa'i gsol 'debs de: brgyud pa dgu phrugs bzlos gyur kyang : drang don tshig gi na yam yin: rtogs pa nang nas 'bar tsa na: bla ma phyi nas btsal mi dgos: rtsa gsum phyi nas sgrub pa ni: drang don dag snang blo 'dren tsam: bla mar mos gus so mar shar:

yi dam bsnyen sgrub rgyun mi chad: mkha' 'gro dam can rtag tu mchod: dam tshig gtsang mar gnas kyi bar: gnas skabs thun mong byin rlabs 'byung : zhes dang*/ yang mos gus med na byin rlabs 'byung ba'i thabs gzhan med de/ rdo rje'i tshig rkang las/ bla mar mi gus mnyam 'grogs shor: yi dam bsnyen sgrub bskyed rim g.yel: mkha' 'gro dam can gsol mchod chag: dam tshig nyams na rtsa gsum gyis: mar 'dren byed cing bdud du 'bab: rang rig sku gsum ma rtogs bar: tha dad byin rlabs gzhan ltos skyon: zhes sogs rtsa gzhung gi tshig go sla bas ma spros so/ /gang ltar yang kun mkhyen gnyis pas/ don dam lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes ni/ /tshogs bsags sgrib pa dag pa'i lag rjes dang*/ /rtogs ldan bla ma'i byin rlabs kho na las/ /thabs gzhan rmongs pa yin pas shes par gyis/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin no/ /des na mthar thug gi byin rlabs rtogs pa'i ye shes btsan thabs su skye ba dang*/ gegs sel bogs 'don la 'di kho na gal che ba'i tshul/ rdo rje'i tshig rkang las/ rtsa gsum rang rig bla mar rtogs: chos kun sems nyid ngang du rdzogs: bar chad thams cad dngos grub 'gyur: rkyen ngan thams cad grogs su 'char: rang gzhan don gnyis lhun grub 'byung : nyams myong lag khrid gnad du bsnun: tshig khrid go bas 'di mi 'byin: thugs rgyud rtogs pa 'pho nges pas: don brgyud dgongs pa gnad du phyin: zhes gsungs pa bzhin mos gus rtsal du bton nas dbang bzhi yang yang blang zhing*/ thugs yid bsre ba ni byin rlabs 'jug pa la med du mi rung ba'i gnad kyi dam pa yin no/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi 'od gsal rdzogs pa chen po'i zab khrid dngos 'chad pa la/ brtson 'grus rab tshe 'dir sangs rgya ba/ 'bring rnams bar dor grol ba/ tha ma rang bzhin sprul sku'i zhing du dbugs dbyung ba dang gsum ste/ de'ang rtsa ba rdo rje'i tshig rkang las/

brtson 'grus rab rnams tshe gcig sangs rgyas la: 'bring rnams bar do 'od gsal klong grol ba: tha ma sprul sku'i zhing du dbugs dbyung ngo : zhes gsungs pa ltar gsum gyi dang po brtson 'grus can rab rnams tshe gcig sangs rgyas par byed pa la/ ka dag khregs chod dang*/ lhun grub thod rgal gyi gdams pa bshad pa la/ rtsa ba rdo rje'i tshig rkang las/ dang po la yang sngon 'gro rnal dbab dang : dngos gzhi nyams su blang ba'i rim pa yi: zhes gsungs pa bzhin sngon 'gro dang dngos gzhi gnyis su yod pa las/ dang po la'ang*/ sgo gsum 'khor 'das ru shan dbye ba dang*/ lus ngag yid gsum sbyang ba'o/ /dang po ru shan la'ang phyi nang gnyis las/ phyi ltar 'khor 'das ru shan dbye ba la'ang gsum ste/ bstan bu las/ sngon du lus ngag yid gsum gyi/ /mngon par zhen pa ldog pa'i phyir/ /sngon du spyod pa brtsam par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin dben par song la gnas gzhi'i bdag po la gtor ma phul te/ bdag sogs 'gro kun sangs rgyas 'thob phyir/ 'khor 'das ru shan gyi bya ba brtsams nas slar 'khor bar mi ldog pa bgyi yi/ de la bar chad ma byed par rogs dan gyis shig ces phrin las bcol/ sngon 'gro spyi dang khyad par bla ma'i rnal 'byor la gnad du bsnun cing gsol ba btab/ thugs yid bsres mthar/ da de ring nas bzung 'khor 'das ru shan phyes te slad 'khor bar mi ldog pa zhig bya'o snyam zhing*/ lus ngag yid gsum 'khor 'das ru shan phrugs gcig tu dbye ba yin pas/ de la lus kyi ru shan dbye tshul yang rtsa rgyud las/ lus ni 'gro dang 'dug pa dang*/ /gcud cing 'khrul 'khor sna tshogs dang*/ /yan lag 'phen cing sdud pa dang*/ /bya byed rnam pa sna tshogs bstan/ /dran pa'i sems kyis mngon bslangs te/ /'gro drug gzugs kyi spyod pa rnams/ /sems kyis blangs te lus kyis bya/ /zhes dang*/ ngag gis kyang*/ thal 'gyur las/

mdor na 'gro ba drug gi skad/ /sems kyis dran bsam ngag gis brjod/ /ces dang*/ sems kyis kyang*/ sras gcig las/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug dang*/ /dge dang mi dge la sogs pa'i/ /bsam spyod rnam pa sna tshogs bya/ /zhes pa ltar lus gcer bur phyung la mchong rgyug 'gro 'dug sogs rigs drug gzugs kyi rnam 'gyur gang dran thams cad lus kyis bya la/ de bzhin du thol byung gi sgra skad yid kyis gang dran blang dor med par ngag gis brjod pa dang*/ yid kyi dran bsam dge dang mi dge'i 'phro 'du gang dang gang yin yang rung*/ mdor na sgo gsum gyi bya ba gang la'ang re dogs dang bzang ngan blang dor med par btsan thabs su bslangs par byas la/ snyems thag chod pa dang rjes shes kyi ngo bor blta zhing ngal gso bar bya'o/ /de bzhin du yang de nyid las/ dkon mchog gsum gyi spyod pa'ang spyad/ /ces pas/ lus lha yi stangs stabs/ ngag sngags dang kha ton/ sems byams dang snying rje bskyed rdzogs sogs ci dran byas la rjes shes kyi ngo bor blta zhing ngal gso/ de ltar nyin bdun nam bcu bzhi nyer gcig sogs la 'bad par bya'o/ /de ltar byas pa'i dgos pa yang gnas skabs tshe 'dir zhen pa rang log cing byang chub sgrub pa'i blo ngam ngam shugs la skye/ 'khor bar gnas pa'i sems can rnams la snying rje rang bzhin du 'byung*/ mthar thug chos thams cad sems kyi cho 'phrul du go sems 'dzin med blo 'das su thag chod pas phyin chad 'khor bar mi ldog ste/ dbang nye bar rtog pa las/ ru shan gang gis phye ba nyid/ khams gsum ldog pa ma yin no/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gnyis pa ru shan nang ltar dbye ba ni/ 'das rjes las/ lus 'di ma rig rgyus bskyed phyir/ /rigs drug sa bon nyid du gnas/ /rig pa sku gsum dngos yin phyir/ /sku gsum yi ge gsum du shar/ /yi ges rtsal sbyangs ru shan dbye/ /zhes pa ltar sbyang gzhi spyi bor lha'i sa bon a dkar po/

mgrin par lha min sa bon su ljang ser/ snying gar mi yi sa bon nṛ sngo skya/ lte bar dud 'gro'i sa bon tri dmar nag gsang bar yi dwags sa bon pre thal skya/ rkang mthil du dmyal ba'i sa bon du dud kha rnams kyi rnam par gnas pa/ sbyong byed sangs rgyas thams cad dang gnyis su med pa'i rig pa'i ye shes/ rdo rje gsum gyi rang bzhin yi ge'i rnam par shar ba spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ snying gar hūm̐ mthing ga rnams bkrag mdangs dang gzi byin 'bar bzhin par gsal la/ 'bru gsum bzlas pa'i rkyen gyis de las 'od zer byung*/ des rigs drug gi sa bon bag chags dang bcas pa dngos med du sreg par bsam bzhin du/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ sbyang gzhi'i sa bon re la 'bum re dang*/ kha skong 'bum gcig bcas 'bum bdun dang*/ 'aḥ.aḥshaḥsaḥmaḥhaḥ bcas bzla'o/ /des ru shan phyi nang gnyis song*/ gnyis pa la'ang lus ngag yid gsum sbyang ba dang sgo gsum rnal du dbab pa gnyis so/ /de'i dang po la'ang rtsa ba rdo rje'i tshig rkang las/ sngon 'gro la yang lus ngag yid gsum las:
