zhes rlung rig mi 'gul bar dal ba la bslabs pas/ nang chos nyid rang gnas kyi 'od gsal ma bu dbyer med du 'dres shing*/ 'od gsal gyi snang ba 'gag med du shar ba la/ gzung 'dzin gyis ma bslad par rang shar rang grol du bskyangs pas snang gzhi'i 'char sgo je gsal je brtan du 'gyur ro/ /rtsa ba rdo rje'i tshig rkang las/ de ltar mi 'gul gsum don rlung gnad de: bying na gyen la rlung 'then ha drag brjod: rgod na rlung ni lte 'og thur du mnan: snang ba 'phel ba zad par byed pa la: rtsa rlung nang du mi bzhag ha dang hikaḥ sgra cher dbyung zhing phyir 'phur rab tu bsdam: de bzhin 'khrul 'khor brkyang bskum dor la sogs: rlung bzung rtsa rlung gnad du bsnun pa gces: de la dang po nyams su blang pa'i dus: zhes de ltar nyams su len pa'i dus su bying na rlung gyen du 'then la ha zhes drag tu brjod/ rgod na rlung lte 'og tu mnan pa gnad do/ /de'i tshe snang ba 'phel kha zad phyir rlung nang du mi bzhag par/ kha nas drangs te ha dang hika gi sgra chen po 'byin zhing phyir 'phul/ las rlung zad pa'i gnad la/ nang du 'gengs pa dang dal bus rab tu bsdams shing*/ phyir 'phangs skabs su hu sgra drag po 'thon par bya bar gsungs so/ /dbyings lu gu rgyud du bzung ba'i gnad ni rlung kha nas 'dren/ mig ar la gtad/ lus 'dug stangs dang bstun/ shes pa yas su bcug pas zin par 'gyur ro/ /de'ang dbyings rig la gtad pas skabs 'gar sems 'phro la sgom mi btub pa ni/ dang po rlung ma 'ching ba'i dus su 'ong ste/ sems yas su bcug pas rang zin du 'gro/ de bzhin du skabs 'gar bying 'thib ma sel tshe sgom 'phro bor la/ lus kyi 'khrul 'khor dang brkyang bskum dor ba la sogs bya zhing drag rlung bzung ba sogs byas pas khams seng bar 'gyur ro/ /gnyis pa sdod pa gsum gyi tshad bzung ba ni/ rtsa ba rdo rje'i tshig rkang las/

gnyis pa de ltar bgyis pa'i sdod gsum 'byung : phyi snang sdod pas rkyen ngan grogs su 'char: nang gi rlung sdod 'khrul pa'i bya ba bral: gsang ba rlung sems sdod pas rnam rtog med: 'di ni gong 'phel dus su gtso che 'o: zhes sdod pa gsum 'byung ste/ phyi'i snang ba skyod byed kyi rlung zad de dbyings rig 'gro 'ong med par sdod pas rkyen ngan grogs su 'char/ nang gi phung po skyod byed kyi rlung zad/ lus g.yo 'gul med par sdod pas 'khrul pa'i bya ba bral/ gsang ba rtog pa skyod byed kyi rlung zad de rnam rtog 'gyu mi srid par sdod pa'o/ /de'i tshe tshad rmi lam gyis bzung ba dang*/ rtags lus ngag yid la 'char ba gnyis las/ rtsa ba rdo rje'i tshig rkang las/ 'di'i skabs tshad ni rmi lam gyis bzung gi: rtags ni lus ngag yid la 'char ba las: zhes pas dang po ni/ rtsa ba rdo rje'i tshig rkang las/ brtson 'grus rab la rmi lam gtan nas 'gag: nyin mtshan bar med ka dag ma bu 'dre: 'bring gi rmi lam ngo shes 'od gsal 'char: tha mar rmi lam rmis tshad bzang por 'char: zhes pa ltar brtson 'grus rab las dang bag chags kyi rgyun chad nas tshe 'dir 'tshang rgya ba'i rtags la rmi lam dbyings su dag nas nyin mtshan 'od gsal du 'dres/ 'bring gis rmi lam ngo shes pas sprul bsgyur nus par byung ba ni bar dor grol ba'i rtags/ tha mas bag chags ngan pa'i rmi lam rgyun chad nas/ rmis tshad bzang por 'char ba ni rang bzhin sprul sku'i zhing du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /gnyis pa/ rtags ni sgo lus ngag yid gsum la 'char zhing*/ de'ang snang ba bzhi re re la rtags gsum gsum ste bcu gnyis su 'char ba las/ dang po ni/ rtsa ba rdo rje'i tshig rkang las/ de yang dang po chos nyid mngon sum dus: lus ni rus sbal 'khar gzhong nang bcug ltar: 'dug stangs gsum las mi 'gul 'bral mi phod: ngag ni lkugs pa lta bur brjod du med:

sems ni 'dab chags rnyi la tshud pa ltar: 'phro bar snang yang gzhi las ma g.yos gnas: zhes chos nyid mngon sum gyi dus su/ phyi rtags ni/ lus rus sbal 'khar gzhong 'jam po'i nang du bcug pa ltar/ 'dug stangs gsum las mi g.yo mi 'gul mi 'bral bar sdod du tshugs/ ngag ni lkugs pa lta bur brjod mi 'dod/ sems ni 'dab chags rnyi la zin pa ltar gzhi las g.yo mi nus pas gar gtad du gnas par 'gyur ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ rtsa ba rdo rje'i tshig rkang las/ gong 'phel dus su lus ni nad gdung ltar: rgyan dang byi dor ngo tsha'i 'du shes bral: ngag ni zang thal brjod med smyon pa ltar: sems ni rtsi dug zos ltar 'phro rgod chad: ces gong du 'phel ba'i dus su lus ni skyes bu nad kyis gdung ba ltar/ rgyan dang byi dor sgeg chos ngo tsha sogs kyi 'du shes dang bral/ ngag ni zang thal brjod med smyon pa ltar byung rgyal du smra/ sems ni rtsi dug gis lan bdun myos pa'i shes pa ltar/ 'phro rgod chad nas blo gzhan la mi 'jug pa'o/ /gsum pa ni/ rtsa ba rdo rje'i tshig rkang las/ tshad phebs dus su lus ni glang po che: 'dam du byings ltar ri brag thogs med bgrod: ngag ni grul bum phru gu lta bur snyan: sems ni rims nad byang ba'i skyes bu ltar: dran bsam dbyings dag rig pa rang gsal lo: zhes tshad la phebs dus su lus ni glang po che 'dam du byings kyang gzhan la mi ltos pa rang stobs kyis thon pa ltar ri brag sogs 'byung lnga la thogs pa med par bgrod nus/ ngag ni grul bum gyi phru gus glu blangs pa ltar ci smras gzhan gyi rna bar snyan cing phan thogs/ sems ni 'brum nad byang ba'i skyes bu la slar mi 'byung ba ltar phyin chad 'khor bar mi 'jug pa'i gdeng thob/ dran bsam dbyings su dag nas rig pa rang gsal la 'pho 'gyur med do/ /bzhi pa ni/ rtsa ba rdo rje'i tshig rkang las/ chos zad dus su lus ni dur khrod kyi:

ro ltar dgag sgrub 'khrul pa dbyings su dag: ngag ni brag cha lta bur gzhan rjes zlos: sems ni rnyi mdas zin pas dran bsam chad: ces chos nyid zad pa'i dus su lus ni dur khrod kyi ro ltar gshed ma brgyas bskor kyang bag tsha ba med par dgag sgrub kyi 'khrul pa dbyings su dag ngag ni brag cha lta bur gzhan rjes su zlos/ sems ni skyes bu'i snying la rnyi mdas zin pa'i rnam shes skad cig la thon pa ltar dran bsam chad nas skad cig gcig gis bye brag phyed cing*/ gdod ma'i sa la na bun yal ba ltar song nas skad cig gis 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ro/ /gsum pa la gnyis las/ dang po/ thob pa gsum gyis gzer gdab pa la/ spyi dang*/ khyad par gyi rang dbang thob tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ rtsa ba rdo rje'i tshig rkang las/ gsum pa thob pa gsum gyis gzer gdab pa: phyi snang dbang thob snang rkyen zhing khams bgrod: nang du dbang thob sgyu lus 'od skur grol: gsang ba dbyings rig dbang thob 'khrul rtog 'gag: ces dang po spyir thob pa gsum gyis gzer gdab pa ni/ phyi snang ba la dbang thob pas rkyen snang zhing khams su 'char/ nang sgyu lus la dbang thob pas gdos bcas 'od skur grol/ gsang ba dbyings rig la dbang thob pas 'khrul rtog dbyings su 'gag khrid gzhan du gsang ba rlung sems la dbang thob pas mtshams med lnga dang ldan pa'i rnam par shes pa'ang rig pa gtad pas 'drong ngo zhes snang*/ de'ang khrid yig ye shes bla ma sogs yongs grags phal mo cher thob pa gsum gong gsal ltar bi ma'i dgongs pa bzhin snang la/ mkha' 'gro snying thig dang rdzogs chen ma rig mun sel sogs padma'i bka' srol ltar thob pa gsum ni/ skye ba la rang dbang thob pa dang*/ 'jug pa la rang dbang thob pa dang*/ rlung sems la rang dbang thob pa'o/ /zhes gsungs te 'dir ni spyi dang bye brag gi tshul du bzhag pas slob dpon rnam gnyis kyi dgongs pa gcig tu bsdus par mngon no/

/de'ang rtsa ba rdo rje'i tshig rkang las/ khyad par skye 'jug gnyis la rang dbang thob: ces skye ba la dbang thob pa dang 'jug pa la dbang thob pa gnyis las/ dang po skye ba la dbang thob pa ni/ rtsa ba rdo rje'i tshig rkang las/ chos zad phung po gdos bcas snang ba 'gag: 'od kyi nang na lus kyang lag sor ltar: snang tshe skye 'jug gnyis kyi so mtshams yod: skye la dbang thob sems can don byed na: lag sor snang ba cha la gtad dgos pas: zad snang tshur log sil skad rang sgra bcas: 'pho ba chen po'i sku 'grub 'jig rten du: ji srid gnas kyang skye 'chi rgyun chad nas: srid mtha'i bar du 'gro don spyod par 'gyur: snang ba gang la gtad par 'jug nus shing : bem por rig pa bcug kyang 'gul ba dang : skad 'byin pa dang de yi don byed nus: mi lus sum stong dag la rig pa bcug: 'byung ba rang gnas de nyid sangs rgyas 'gyur: don dam las la bzang ngan ma grub phyir: rig pa gang bcug sangs rgyas the tshom med: de ni skye la rang dbang thob pa 'o: zhes dang*/ de bzhin du sras gcig gi rgyud las/ rang lus zad pa'i sar phyin tshe/ /sor mo la sogs de bzhin snang*/ /'di gtad 'byung ba rang dengs su/ /skye dang 'jug pa'i khyad par gyis/ /chos kun zad pa'i rang sa la/ /cir yang 'dzin pa med pa ni/ /gnas pa yin no sprul pa'i sku/ /'di ni 'jug par shugs kyi dbang*/ /skye ba'i rang dbang sus thob pa/ /de yang de la gtad nas ni/ /yang dus 'di ltar byas pa na/ /snang ba'i rang sgra sil skad de/ /mngon du log nas 'khrul par snang*/ /'dis ni sems can don kun byed/ /rig pa mnyam par gcig pa'i phyir/ /stong phrag gsum rnams sems can gyi/ /'pho ba chen po 'dis 'grub bo/ /de bzhin rim dang gcig char gyi/ /lus ni 'di yis 'grub pa yin/ /de kun lus zad tshad las grol/ /'di kun nges pa'i 'bras bu ni/ /sa mchog dkyil 'khor chen po 'grub/

/ces chos nyid zad pa'i dus su phung po gdos bcas 'od du dwangs/ nyon mongs dwangs pas dran pa dang dran gzhi wal po rjes med du song*/ snang ba dwangs pas 'gro 'dug dang sa rdo ri brag nyi zla'i snang ba la sogs pa rang yal rjes med du song nas/ 'di ltar yin no tsam du'ang ma grub pas gzugs snang thams cad mya ngan las 'da' ba zhes so/ /de'i dus su thob pa gnyis 'byung ba ni 'di lta ste/ skye ba la dbang thob pas 'pho ba chen po'i skur bzhengs nas lus kyi rnam pa'i rten des sems can gyi don byed par 'dod na/ snang ba rnams rim gyis zad pa lag sor lnga 'od kyis dkrigs par bkra lam mer snang ba la shes pa gtad pas/ zad snang tshur log pas sil skad 'ur shol dang 'byung ba'i rang sgra bcas snang ba rang log ste/ snod bcud rten dang brten pa thams cad sngar gyi 'khrul snang a 'thas ltar ma yin par/ chu zla dang rmi lam ltar mthong la rang lus kyang me long nang gi gzugs brnyan ltar snang la rang bzhin med pa zang thal le ba/ rang gis mthong la gzhan mig ma dag pas de ltar mi mthong ba'i tshul/ mu khri btsad po'i phyag gis slob dpon la btud pas gdan la reg pa'i lo rgyus bzhin no/ /de ltar snang byed chu zla lta bu'i 'pho ba chen po'i sku grub nas/ 'jig rten ji srid gnas kyi bar du skye 'chi rgyun chad nas srid mtha'i bar du 'gro don spyod nus pa 'byung bar gsungs te/ snang ba gang la gtad par 'jug nus shing*/ de'i tshe phyi snod kyi ljaun pa dang nor bu lta bu bem po gang la rig pa bcug kyang 'gul ba dang*/ chos kyi sgra 'byin pa dang*/ des phul du byung ba'i don byed nus pa sogs dngos dang brgyud nas rigs drug so so'i gnas su don byed cing*/ khyad par mi'i 'gro ba smon lam mthun pa sum stong dag la rig pa gtad pas zag bcas mi snang bar lhag med du grol bar mdzad la/

mi la sogs pa sems can gzhan tshe 'phos pa'i tshe rig pa bcug na mtshams med lnga byas pa'ang 'di nyid la 'byung ba rang sar dag nas 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur te/ rig pa rang byung gi ye shes gzhi la gnas pa'i gnad dang don dam par las la bzang ngan ma grub pa'i phyir rig pa gang gtad cing*/ de nyid du grol bar mdzad de 'pho ba chen po'i skur bzhengs pa pad 'byung dang bi ma la lta bu yin no/ /de ni skye la rang dbang thob pa'o/ /'jug par dbang thob pa ni/ rtsa ba rdo rje'i tshig rkang las/ 'jug par dbang thob gzhi dbyings nang bsdu ni: lus snang dmigs gtad med par nyams blangs pas: ngo bo ka dag klong du je thim 'gyur: lus kyang res snang res mi snang ba tsam: zag bcas mi snang mkha' la 'ja' yal bzhin: sku gnyis sems can 'gro ba'i don byed do: zhes 'jug par dbang thob pa ni/ sku'i rnam pa de nyid kyi dus su gzhan don rlabs po che mi mdzad na/ sems can sum stong dag la rig pa gtad pa'i mod la/ las bzang ngan med par grol bar mdzad cing*/ srin 'bu rnams kyang 'od du yal nas ngo bo ka dag gi klong du je thim du gyur te lag sor gyis 'od la ma gtad par/ skad cig gis na bun mkha' la dengs pa bzhin lus kyang res snang res mi snang ba tsam nas mthar zag bcas mi snang bar mkha' la 'ja' yal ba ltar/ phyi snang gi 'od lus de'ang nang dbyings su yal te ka dag gi sa la lhun grub kyis bzhugs nas/ sku dang ye shes 'du 'bral med pa'i phrin las kyis 'khor ba ma stongs kyi bar du gzhan don mdzad pa'i tshul nang gsal thim la ma rmugs pa'i gdangs phyi gsal du snang ba lhun grub stug po bkod pa'i zhing khams nas/ byad dang me long gi rnam pa 'char ba/ phyed sprul longs sku la sogs dang sku gsung thugs mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i chos nyid las/ gdul bya so so'i khams dbang dang mthun pa'i bzo dang*/ skye ba sogs sku gnyis kyi sprul pas 'gro khams dang mthun pa'i don mdzad par 'gyur ro/

/gsum pa rlung sems la dbang thob pa ni/ rtsa ba rdo rje'i tshig rkang las/ rlung la dbang thob 'byung lnga dbang bsgyur nus: sems la dbang thob 'gro don phrin las rdzogs: zhes de'i skabs su rlung sems las su rung bas rlung gi yon tan thams cad 'byung la/ de'ang 'byung ba bzhi la thogs pa med par bgrod cing*/ nam mkha' la bya bzhin lding ba/ lus las me 'bar ba/ chu 'khrug pa/ lus 'dod rgur bsgyur nas skye bo gzhan la ston nus pa/ mngon shes thogs med du 'char ba rnams so/ /de ltar lus rdul phran du dengs/ 'od du gsal bas skye 'jug sogs la rang dbang thob pa rnams thod rgal kho na'i khyad chos yin la khregs chod du lus rdul phran du dengs/ sems chos nyid du dengs nas ka dag gi sar grol ba tsam las med pa'i phyir ro/ /'dir bshad pa'i skye 'jug gnyis sam thob pa gsum sogs bzhag srol cung mi 'dra bar snang ste/ sa bcad 'jog stangs kyang bi ma'i bka' srol du/ snang bzhi 'char tshul chos zad kyi gnas skabs su sbyar la/ mkha' 'gro snying thig sogs padma'i bka' srol ltar mtha' rten man ngag thob pa gsum du bzhag par mdzad pas/ gang ltar yang chos zad kyi lam snang yin pas khyad par med la/ 'di ga'i gter gzhung ni phyi ma ltar yin pa shes par bya'o/ /bzhi pa gdeng bzhi'i drod tshad bstan pa la/ rin chen spungs pa las/ mi 'gyur lta ba'i gdeng chen bzhis/ /mi ldog ye shes tshad kyang bzung*/ /zhes dang*/ mu tig phreng ba las/ tshad ni gdeng bzhi'i rnal 'byor nyid/ /gsungs pa ltar/ rtsa ba rdo rje'i tshig rkang las/ bzhi pa gdeng bzhi yar mar gnyis gnyis te: sangs rgyas mi re rang sems ye sangs rgyas: yon tan mi smon rang la rdzogs pa 'o: ngan song mi dogs rang grol yin pa'i phyir: sdug bsngal mi skrag rang snang ngo bor grol: zhes pas gdeng bzhi bstan pa las/ yar gyi gdeng gnyis ni/ rang rig ye nas sangs rgyas su shes pas sangs rgyas gzhan la mi re ba dang*/

sangs rgyas kyi yon tan thos kyang de thob 'dod kyi re ba dang*/ mi thob kyi dogs pa med de yon tan mi smon rang la rdzogs pa'i gdeng rnyed pa'o/ /mar gyi gdeng gnyis ni/ 'khor ba dang ngan song gi sdug bsngal thos kyang der mi lhung ba'i re ba dang lhung gi dogs pa med de/ rang rig ye nas 'khrul ba med pas 'khor bar 'khyams mkhan med la/ sdug bsngal yang gzhi grub ma myong ba'i phyir dang*/ rang snang rang bzhin med par shes pa'i gdeng rnyed pas rang grol bar 'gyur ro/ /mtha' rten man ngag de dag gi dgos pa ni/ klong gsal las/ mtha' rten dag gi man ngag gis/ /gong ma'i yon tan mtha' ru phyin/ /zhes dang*/ rtsa ba rdo rje'i tshig rkang las/ 'di dus nyin mtshan bde sdug 'khor 'das dang : rtag chad 'gro 'ong mtha' 'das sems kyang zad: rig pa rang bzhin gdod nas dag pa'i phyir: dngos po'i gnas lugs ji bzhin la gnas so: snang ba zil gnon lhun grub ye shes lam: tshe gcig phung po 'od lus grol ba'i gnad: ces so/ /de ltar nyams su blangs pas nyin mtshan 'od gsal khor yug tu gyur/ bde sdug gi gzhi rtsa stong*/ 'khor 'das kyi bar lag 'gyel/ rtag chad dang 'gro 'ong gi mtha' las 'das/ phyi 'khrul pa'i snang ba nub/ nang dran 'dzin gyi shes pa stor/ dbyings dang rig pa 'dres/ rang bzhin gdod ma'i gzhi dbyings su mngon par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ro/ /de la rab kyis tshe 'dir snang bzhi mthar phyin te 'byung lus kyi gdos bcas dag nas/ skra sen gyi snyigs ma tsam ma gtogs phung po lhag ma med par yang dag par 'tshang rgya la/ 'bring gis tshe 'dir sa lam rim gyis bgrod nas phung po lhag ma dang bcas pa ste/ 'od dang sgra dang gdung dang sku dang sa g.yo ba sogs kyi sgo nas mngon par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ba yin no/ /de dag ni dang po brtson 'grus can rab rnams tshe gcig sangs rgyas par byed pa ka dag khregs chod dang*/

lhun grub thod rgal gyi gdams pa bstan pas dngos gzhi rdzogs so/ /rtsa ba rdo rje'i tshig rkang las/ brtson 'grus rab rnams tshe gcig 'tshang rgya la: 'bring rnams bar dor longs skur grol ba dang : tha ma sprul sku'i zhing du dbugs dbyung ngo : zhes gsum du bzhugs pa'i nang tshan rtsa ba'i sa bcad gnyis pa/ brtson 'grus 'bring gis bar do ru grol bar byed pa'i gdams pa ni/ gzhi dbyings ka dag las gzhi snang du shar ba thams cad bar do-yin la/ thog mar gzhi dbyings ka dag nas ni g.yos/ slar gzhi snang gzhi la ma ldog pa'i bar na yod pa thams cad bar do gcig yin la/ de'ang gzhi snang sku dang ye shes kyi snang cha ni dag pa chos nyid kyi bar do/ 'gro drug tu snang ba'i 'khrul snang gi chos thams cad ma dag 'khrul pa'i bar do gnyis dang*/ thal 'gyur las/ dbye na rnam pa bzhi dag las/ /zhes skye gnas bar do dang*/ 'chi ka bar do/ chos nyid bar do/ srid pa bar do bcas bzhi'o/ /de dag so so'i skabs lam du khyer tshul yang dpe don gnyis kyis ston te/ dper na skye gnas bar do thi bya tshang la 'jug pa lta bu'i don/ bla ma dam par bsten nas de'i rjes su gdams pa'i man ngag gi don la thos bsam sgom pas nan tan lhur blangs te sgro 'dogs gcod par byed pa'o/ /de bzhin du 'chi ka'i bar do sgeg mos me long la blta ba lta bu ni/ gdams pa'i man ngag rnams dus thog tu gsal thebs pa'o/ /chos nyid kyi bar do rang snang ngo shes pas ma pang la bu 'jug pa lta bu ni/ gdams pa'i don nyams 'og tu tshud pas chos nyid kyi snang ba ci shar yang 'jigs pa med par rang snang ye shes su rol pa'i gdeng tshud pa'o/ /srid pa bar do las kyi 'phro mthud pa yur bu rkang chad la wa 'dzugs pa lta bu ni/ 'khrul snang 'jigs skrag ji ltar shar yang sngar goms pa dang*/ 'chad par 'gyur ba'i gdams pa'i gnad dag pa'i skye srid bdams shing lam du 'jug pa'o/

/gsum pa brtson 'grus tha mas rang bzhin sprul sku'i zhing du dbugs 'byin pa'i gdams ngag ni/ zhus ma thag pa ltar/ tshe 'dir grol ba dang bar dor grol ba'i man ngag thob kyang brtson 'grus zhan pas der grol ba'i gdeng dang mi ldan pas/ chos nyid bar do shar kyang ngos ma zin/ srid pa bar do rmi lam gyi cha tsam shar tshe shi ba ngo shes/ bla ma dang gdams ngag rjes su dran pa'i mthus/ da ni rang bzhin sprul sku'i zhing du 'gro bar bya snyam du bde ba can sogs zhing khams kyi 'dun pa yid la byas pas/ de dang der skye ba blangs nas de bzhin gshegs pa'i zhal mthong*/ dbang bskur zhing lung nod/ dbugs dbyung ba thob nas lam gyi lhag ma rnams rim gyis rdzogs par byas te/ mthar thug 'ching ba las grol nas gdod ma'i gzhi la rang don chos kyi sku thob pas dgongs pa 'pho 'gyur med pa'i dbyings su ma g.yos bzhin/ gzugs sku gnyis kyis 'gro ba'i don 'khor ba ji srid du mdzad pa ni yid bzhin gyi nor bu dang*/ dpag bsam gyi shing ltar 'bad med lhun grub tu 'byung zhing rgyun mi 'chad pa yin no/ /de ltar rab 'bring tha ma'i grol tshul gsum la 'tshang rgya lugs gnyis te/ tshe 'dir lhag med du grol na rang gi snang ba gdod ma la spyod cing mi gzhan gyis rtags mi mthong bas yang dag par rdzogs pa'i 'tshang rgya ba zhes bya'o/ /bar do rang snang gi chos nyid las grol nas gdod mar 'tshang rgya ba ni/ sngar gyi lus 'dor dus sgra 'od dang sa g.yo sogs gzhan la snang ba'i phyir mngon par 'tshang rgya ba zhes bya'o/ /de'ang phung po bsreg na rus pa las sku dang gdung dang ring bsrel la sogs pa 'byung ngo*/ /zhi sku byung na snang ba 'gag ma thag brtan pa thob nas sprul pa mi 'byin/ khro sku byung na de nyid la brtan pa thob nas zhag nyer gnyis nas sprul sku 'byin nus so/ /'od khyim gyi tshul du byung na zhag lnga dang*/

sgra 'ur thim pa byung na zhag bdun/ thugs khrol byung na zhag bcu bzhi la 'tshang rgya'o/ /gdung kha dog lnga gang byung ba rigs so so dang*/ thams cad byung na sku lnga'i sa la lhun gyis grub bo/ /gong gsal gyi grol tshul sa bcad tha ma gnyis kyi rtsa ba'i tshig rkang dngos ni/ a mo gha ardha badzra nas bsgrigs chog gnang skabs/ brtson 'grus rab rnams tshe gcig sangs rgyas la: 'bring rnams bar do 'od gsal klong grol ba: tha ma sprul sku'i zhing du dbugs dbyung ngo : zhes sa bcad rang sor bzhag pa tsam las khrid dngos kha phral la rdzogs chen khrid gzhung kho na zur bton gnang 'dug pas gter gzhung rtsa ba rdo rje'i tshig rkang las khrid rkang 'og ma gnyis kyi rtsa tshig ma rnyed pa a kha kha/ shin tu phangs kyang ci bya bral/ slad rnyed par 'gyur du re nas re zhig 'di tsam du bzhag par byas so/ /de nas rjes kyi bya ba la bzhi ste/ brgyud pa'i che ba brjod pa/ gang la gtad pa'i yul dang ji ltar bsten tshul/ de las 'phros pa'i nyams len gzhan bstan pa/ mtha' rten gtad rgya smon lam dang bcas bstan pa'o/ /dang po/ rtsa ba rdo rje'i tshig rkang las/ kun bzang rigs lnga rdor 'chang dgongs pa'i brgyud: rdo rje sems dpa' dga' rab brda don tshig: bdag nyid padmas yongs rdzogs snyan brgyud dril: thugs sras lnga dang mtsho rgyal ma la gdams: zhes gang las brgyud pa'i man ngag gi khungs dngos bstan la/ gdod ma'i gzhi dbyings su kun bzang yab yum lhun grub ye shes kyi skur bzhengs nas rdo rje sems dpa' sogs/ rang dang mi gnyis pa'i 'khor rgyal ba rigs lnga dang*/ rigs drug pa'i bdag nyid rdo rje 'chang sogs la sgra tshig bya rtsol las 'das par dus gsum mnyam nyid chen por gsungs/ de nas rdo rje sems dpas 'og min gyi zhing mtha' dbus med par rang las rnam par 'phrul ba'i rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro rang snang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa la/

sku dang ye shes 'du 'bral med pa'i don 'gag med rang shar rgyal ba nyid kyis nyid las brgyud pa'i dbang du byas pas dgongs pa'i brgyud do/ /des sprul pa'i sku dga' rab rdo rje la/ chos nyid bya rtsol las 'das pa tshig gi sdeb sbyor legs pas bshad la bka'i bsdu ba po'ang de'o/ /des shrī singha la mngon sum rang thog tu phab nas bshad/ des bdag nyid chen po padma 'byung gnas la gnas lugs yid dpyod dang bral ba brda dang brda'i sgo nas brgyud/ des gzho stod ti sgro'i brag dkar du mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal la lnga ldan ye shes snying po rang gsal mngon sum du gtan la phab nas gsungs shing*/ slob dpon yab yum gyis gnubs sangs rgyas ye shes sogs thugs sras snying gi bu lnga la byin rlabs 'pho ba smon lam dbang bskur gyis rgyas btab ste/ dgongs pa brda dang yongs rdzogs snyan brgyud dril nas gtad pas gnubs chen de nyid sku mi snang ba 'od lus su yal lo/ /de las dpe brgyud rnams mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal gyis shog ser tshig brgyud du gtan la phab nas/ gnas mchog de nyid du smon lam gyi gtad rgya dang bcas sbas par mdzad pas dus la bab pa'i tshe/ o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa la mkha' 'gro'i brdas bskul bas rig pa brtul zhugs kyi spyod pas ti sgro'i tshogs khang chen mo'i bar snang du phebs pa'i tshe/ nam mkha' thams cad 'ja' dang 'od kyis khengs/ sku dang sku'i cha thams cad nas 'ja' dang 'od zer gyi rnam pa dpag tu med pa snang bar mdzad/ mthong grol sku tshab dang dam rdzas shog ser bcas su dri bzang gi ngad dang*/ sgra snyan pa'i dbyangs sogs ngo mtshar bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang bcas dngos su gdan drangs pa ni zab mo gter gyi brgyud pa yin la/ de'i nub mor dag pa'i snang bar zangs mdog dpal rir phebs te/ padma 'od kyi pho brang gi rim gsum du gu ru yab yum gyis dbang bzhi rim par bstsal/

de nas rtse tog nyi zla kha sbyor gyi rnam par 'od phung bltar mi mngon pa'i dbus su kun bzang yab yum/ dga' rab rdo rje sogs kyi zhal bstan nas dgongs pa'i drod gtad pa'i sgo nas rig pa rtsal gyi dbang chen thob pas dgongs pa nam mkha' dang mnyam par gyur to/ /de nas zab gsang chos kyi bdag po o rgyan rog rje gling pa dang*/ kong smyon kra ti sngags 'chang*/ rwa ston stobs ldan rdo rje/ dwags po gter chen nam sgam po ba bzang po rdo rje sogs nas rim gyis dbang lung man ngag brgyud pa ste brgyud pa dgu ldan gyi tshul du babs pa yin no/ /gnyis pa gang la gtad pa'i yul dang ji ltar bsten tshul ni/ rtsa ba rdo rje'i tshig rkang las/ tshogs gtor brgya rtsas mkha' 'gro dam can mchod: kun la gsang zhing chig brgyud bu la byin: des kyang snying rus sgrub pa mthar phyin pas: padma nga yi srol brgyud zin par gyis: snyan brgyud yig nag dpe la mi 'god pas: bka' srung dpang por gsol te mna' rgyas gdab: spyir ni kho bo'i srog sgrub 'di dag kun: dpe bsgyur zab don rtsa ba'i mdo 'dzin tsam: snyan brgyud lag khrid man ngag nges pa'i don: don brgyud dgongs pa'i byin rlabs rgyud la 'pho: khong grol gzhir rdzogs skad cig nyid la grol: de phyir zab lam gtso bo ma lus yin: lam gyi sna kha bsgyur ba snyan brgyud de: dpe brgyud bstan pa mi nub rin chen btsas: zhes gtsigs che bar bstan pa ste go sla'o/ /gsum pa de las 'phros pa'i nyams len gzhan bstan pa ni/ rtsa ba rdo rje'i tshig rkang las/ 'di las gyes pa'i bskyed rdzogs gdams pa rnams: shes rab ting 'dzin rtsol ba che chung gis: tshe gcig skye ba med pa'i sa thob 'gyur: blo gros can gyis chos nyid de bzhin nyid: lam du khyer bas chos sku mngon du byed: 'dod chags can gyis bde ba lam du khyer: theg chen bla med sa thob longs skur grol:

zhe sdang can gyis sgrol ba lam du khyer: 'khor lo tshogs chen sa thob gzugs sku thob: mtshan ma can gyis lha la sems sbyangs shing : lam du khyer bas dag pa'i sgyu lus 'byongs: de ltar lam 'khyer rnam pa bzhi po yang : 'bras bu gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i mthus: bzang ngan las dang rkyen bar mi ltos par: tshe gcig 'khor ba'i nad dang bral byas nas: rig 'dzin sa thob sku gsum lhun grub 'gyur: 'di dang su 'phrad gdod ma'i dbyings su grol: zhes pas dbang rab blo gros can gyis chos nyid de bzhin nyid lam du khyer bas tshe 'dir chos sku mngon du byed de skye ba med pa'i sa thob par 'gyur ro/ /de las 'phros pa'i nyams len gzhan bstan pa'ang 'dod chags can gyis bde ba lam du khyer thabs/ lam gsang sher gyi nyams len la bsten nas theg chen bla med kyi sa thob nas longs skur grol ba dang*/ zhe sdang can gyis sgrol ba lam du khyer bas 'khor lo tshogs chen gyi sar non te gzugs sku thob/ mtshan ma can gyis lha la sems sbyangs shing lam du khyer bas dag pa'i sgyu lus 'byongs/ de ltar lam 'khyer rnam pa bzhi po la sogs pa 'bras bu gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i lam zab 'thus ka 'di lta bur brten nas bzang ngan las dang rkyen bar la mi ltos par/ tshe gcig 'khor ba'i gcong nad dang bral bar byas nas rig 'dzin rnam bzhi'i sa thob ste/ sku gsum lhun grub tu mngon par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur la/ 'di dang su 'phrad gdod ma'i dbyings su grol bar gdon mi za'o/ /bzhi pa mtha' rten gtad rgya smon lam dang bcas bstan pa ni/ rtsa ba rdo rje'i tshig rkang las/ gsum ldan don brgyud bka' yi tha ram 'di: bka' srung dam can rnams kyis thub par srungs: ma nor chos bdag bu dang 'phrad par shog: dam nyams bdud rigs rnams kyi dbang po snubs: rtsa tri dam sri dmar pos ma rig rgya:

zhes gtad rgya dang bcas rjes kyi rim pa rdzogs so/ /de ltar rtsa gsum gling pas bal phu yar 'brog mtsho nas spyan drangs pa'i zab gter bka' brgyad gsang ba zil gnon dang zhi khro na rag dong sprugs sogs/ zab chos yongs rdzogs kyi rgyab chos rdzogs chen yang gsang bla med kyi skor dang*/ gser gling nor bu'i bang mdzod nas spyan drangs pa'i rdzogs chen 'khor 'das rang grol dang bcas ches zab rgyas bzhugs pa dang*/ gzhan chos tshan phal che bar rgyab chos rdzogs rim dang rdzogs chen ji snyed cig bzhugs pa rnams/ dus 'khrug gi rlung dmar drag pos khyer nas shul med du gyur la/ de bzhin du drag po khyung zhon gyi rdzogs chen tshig dbang dang rtsal dbang don khrid gter gzhung ngo mtshar can dngos kyang gong mtshungs su 'thor brlag tu song nas ma phyi cha tshang lag tu ma son la/ 'di ni chos bdag kong smyon kra ti sngags 'chang la bka' babs shing rim bzhin dwags po gter chen sogs nas brgyud/ o rgyan 'gro 'dul phrin las dang padma dhwa dza nas rim bzhin brgyud de gnam lcags rdo rje'i gar dbang zlos gar rim byon gyis gter gzhung la nyams bzhes gnang srol byung 'dug pa ltar/ sngags ming dha na a mo gha ardha badzra nas gter gzhung sngon 'gro zhal mthong dang rdzogs chen khrid gzhung cha tshang la/ gsal mun rdzogs chen gyi gzhung las cung zad kha skong dang bcas sgrig chog gnang ba zhes pa zhig rtsa ba kho na dum dum du bcad nas/ bar skabs kyi mtshams sbyar sogs ci yang med par bsgrigs la skabs 'gar mchan re btab pa zhig 'byor ba de'ang ma phyi'i dpe 'thor nas 'tshol sgrig gi dus su dbu mjug sogs ma tshang ba dang 'khrugs par gyur la/ gsar bris skabs ldeb 'khrugs dang mchan bu 'dra min rnams dkyus su shor bas rtsa mchan dang gzhung kha skong sogs dbye bsal dka' zhing*/ gzhung don yang go 'khrugs pa dang nor 'byams su shor nas dpyad mi bzod pa mang bar 'dug par/

'di la cis kyang dag bcos dang sa bcad gtan 'bebs gnang rogs zhes/ gsang sngags phur pa gling gi lo gsum sgrub sde dang po'i skabs zab gter 'di nyid la/ mi 'phrog pa'i dad pa brtan pa'i 'brong smad ri dgon spyis mngag gtong gnang ba'i sgrub bla karma longs spyod sogs nas sku gsung thugs kyi rten bcas yang yang bskul ba'i ngor/ rtsa ba'i dgongs don zhib mor dpyad khul gyis rtsa ba gter gzhung gi tshigs bcad kho na lhur bsgrigs shing*/ sa bcad gsar 'debs bcas byas kyang ma phyi bor brlags sogs kyis rkyen pas yun ring 'gor lus su gyur/ slar yang sgrub thengs gnyis pa'i skabs ci nas kyang grub par gyis zhes sngar gyi bskul ba po nyid dang*/ sgrub sde thengs gnyis pa'i sgrub bla 'brong pa rdo shul gangs leb dgon gyi nges pa don gyi rdzogs chen pa bla ma kun dga'i gsung sras su gyur pa gi li o rgyan gsang sngags 'gro 'dul sogs rdo rje'i mched zung nas nan bskul gyi rkyen dang*/ sngar 'khor lo'i mgon po gu ru nyi ma 'od zer nas 'di ga'i smin grol yongs rdzogs bka' drin bstsal ba dang*/ phyis lan gcig mjal skabs zhal snga nas nga la sngon gnam sprul bzod pa rab brtan nas gnam lcags kyi bstan pa 'di da khyod la gtad pa yin zhes gsungs la/ ngas khyed sprul sku rnams la ma lus pa phul yod/ yin na'ang zhes tshad med par bshums nas mthar da phyin ming ma bor tsam e yong gi re ba de khyod la byas yod/ nga dang da e thug mi shes/ shi na kha chems dang gson na'ang kha ta yin/ de ma brjed gsungs pa'i don 'di min nam snyam ste bla ma'i dgongs rdzogs dang bstan pa'i zhabs tog la dmigs nas bris pa'i khul lags shing*/ don gyi cha la sangs rgyas padma'i rgyal tshab 'jigs med mkhyen rtse'i 'od zer dang nges pa don gyi rdzogs chen pa/ o rgyan che mchog 'dus pa rtsal sogs dam pa du ma'i zhal snga nas bka' drin legs par thob pa'i man ngag gis zur brgyan/

gzhan yang kun mkhyen yab sras kyi gzhung ya bzhi/ mdzod bdun/ ye shes bla ma sogs snying thig gong 'og dang*/ lce btsun snying thig kun bzang dgongs pa zang thal sogs bka' gter rdzogs chen man ngag snying po'i yang bcud rnams kyi byin rlabs kyi babs so chu bo gcig 'dres su gyur par snyam la/ de bzhin tshig don gyi cha nas man ngag gzhan dang yang bstun cing*/ dka' ba'i gnad rnams rdo rje'i mched po skyabs chen sprul sku rin po che mchog la yang bka' bsdur zhus shing*/ 'khrugs bsdebs cung zad dang bcas rang blos ci dpog zhu dag sogs 'bad pa byas kyang*/ skyes sbyangs yon tan dang nyams myong gi nar ma son pa byis pa'i lag bris su song*/ nor 'khrul chu gnyer bzhin mtha' med pa yod par nges pas/ bstan 'dir lhag bsam gyis don gnyer can rnams kyis dag bcos gnang bar snying nas gsol ba 'debs pa lags so/ /zhes o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa'i zab gter rdzogs chen don khrid kyi 'grel pa 'khor 'das rang grol zhes bya ba 'di yang*/ gter chen gnam lcags rdo rje'i zab chos la mi 'phrog pa'i dad pa'i nor ldan sngags 'chang gnam lcags gsang sngags bstan 'dzin du 'bod pa rang lo 51 son pas rab byung bcu bdun pa'i chu lug dbo nya ba'i dga' ba dang por/ gu ru'i sgrub gnas a su ra'i mi 'gyur rdo rje'i ke'u tshang dang 'dabs 'brel rang byung myur ma dpa' mo'i dgyes zhal re khā bkra ba'i 'gram/ g.yu lo bkod gandho lar dbu tshugs shing sa ga zla ba'i tshes bco lnga'i dus khyad par can du a ri nub phyogs a shes lan du grub par bgyis pa 'dis kyang*/ 'khor lo'i mgon po ṛg 'dzin bla ma nyi ma 'od zer thugs kyi dgongs pa zag med chos dbyings su rdzogs pa dang snying po'i bstan pa 'di nyid mi nyams yun du gnas pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ // pha)༈ bskyed rdzogs dris len long bas spar snyobs zhes bya ba bzhugs so/

gsang sngags phur pa gling gi sgrub sde sogs mtshams sgrub skabs kyi dri ba glog klad drwa ba'i rgyud phar tshur btang bas thol byung dris lan gyi skor la/ ༈ 'khor zil longs sku'i sgrub thabs kyi bsnyen sgrub dris len bzhugs so/ ji phebs bzhin/ hrīḥlas 'jig rten dbang phyug spyan ras gzigs: sku mdog dkar gsal zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa: rin chen thor tshugs longs sku'i dbu rgyan la: sna tshogs dar gyi cod pan dbyings la bskyod: zhi 'dzum mdzes ldan thugs rjes phyogs bcur gzigs: g.yas g.yon dang po shel phreng pad dkar 'dzin: 'og ma gnyis kyis nor bu thal mo sbyar: sku stod lha rdzas dar sngon rgyan gyis bklubs: sku smad dar dmar mdzes pa'i ang rag gsol: rin chen sna tshogs rgyan gyis legs par spras: rdo rje skyil krung mngon rdzogs rgyal po'i tshul: snang stong 'ja' lus sgrib med gsal bar bsgom: zhes yab rkyang las yum ma gsal yang*/ bsnyen dmigs las/ rang nyid thugs rje chen po yab yum gyi/ thugs kar hrīḥdang tāṃ yig gsal ba'i mthar: zhes yum yod pa dngos su gsal la de bzhin thugs rje chen po de'i phyogs bzhir kha sar pa ni dang sa snying nam mkha' rgyal po/ 'khor bsgyur bzhi dang*/ yang gter gzhung las/ mtshams bzhi pad 'dab tshom bu'i gdan steng du: rgyal yum sgrol ma dkar ser dmar ljang mthing : mtshams bzhi'i pad 'dab la sgrol ma bzhi yod par dngos su gsal/ rgyal yum sgrol ma dkar ser dmar ljang mthing zhes pa'i gnas gsal bar ma bstan yang sgrol ma lnga yod par bstan pa bzhin 'dir dbus su sangs rgyas rigs kyi sgrol ma mthing ka yod par nges te/ de rnams thams cad g.yas mchog sbyin dang g.yon skyabs sbyin zhabs 'greng stabs su yod par gsungs par dpyad pas/ gtso bo'i g.yon phyogs su bzhengs par mngon/ bsnyen pa'i skabs yang*/ thugs kar hrīḥdang tāṃ yig gsal ba'i mthar:

sngags phreng zer thag lu gu rgyud sbrel ltar: g.yas g.yon 'khor bas phyi nang sdig sgrib dag: ces pa dang*/ sngags phreng rnams rgyud ltar pho g.yas mo g.yon du 'khor bar bsam: yab yum so sor gsal la rang rang thugs kar hrīḥdang tāṃ yig gsal ba'i mthar sngags phreng zer thag lu gu rgyud sbrel ltar yab g.yas yum g.yon du 'khor ba yin/ yang bla med kyi lugs ltar na spros par mos na gzhung chen mo dang kun nas mtshung par bstan pa ltar las byang bzhin gtso bo yab yum 'khril sbyor gyi rnam par sbyar yang rung bar snang ste/ sngags kyi skabs bya spyod kyi rgyud ltar sbyar ba dang rnal 'byor bla med ltar sbyar tshul gnyis su gsungs pa'i phyir dang*/ gang zag rab 'bring gi dbang po dang bstun te bsgrub par bya: gsungs pas shes mod/ 'dir gzhung dngos bstan ltar bgyis na stabs bde bas gzhan du ma bkral lo/ /dngos bstan ltar na yab yum so sor gsal ba'i thugs kar pad zla'i steng yab la hrīḥdang yum la tāṃ yig gsal ba'i mthar/ sngags phreng gsal zhing rtsa sngags bzlas pa'i de las 'od zer nyi ma'i zer thag lu gu rgyud sbrel ltar yab la g.yas su 'khor zhing yum la g.yon du 'khor bas lus phyi nang gi nad gdon sdig sgrib ma lus pa dag /mchog thun dngos gruub thob/ slar 'phros phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems mchod/ 'od zer tshur 'dus bdag la thim pas byin rlabs gzi brjid mchog tu 'bar/ mar khams gsum sems can la phog pa'i snang grags snod bcud thams cad 'phags pa'i gsang ba gsum gyi dkyil 'khor du sad par byas la/ bdag gzhan mi dmigs pa snang stong 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku ru gyur pa'i mos pa dang bcas/ yid bzlas dang rlung bzlas ci nus 'od gsal spros pa dang bral ba'i ngang la mnyam par bzhag la skyo tshe ngag bzlas la 'jug /bsnyen pa rtsa sngags/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ hrīḥ

kho na'i chog la 'di gtso 'khor yongs rdzogs 'dus pa'i phyir ro/ gsham du yum sngags cung zad sbrel bas kyang chog go /mthar yig brgya dbyangs gsal rten snying sogs kyi lhag chad kha skong*/ mchod stod sogs rjes chog mtha' dbyung bar bya'o/ bsnyen tshad 'bum bcu gcig grub nas dngos grub blang ba dang kha skong me mchod dang gtang rag tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i mnyes par bya ba sogs bsnyeng rkyang spyi 'gros la 'di kho nas chog go / slar yang sgrub pa bya bar spro na mdun bskyed dbang gzhi gsham bkod sogs sta gon byas la dngos gzhi skabs bstod pa'i rjes dzap khang dbye la bdag mdun 'jug pa gcig gi gsal gdab la bsnyen pa cung zad dang gtso bo gcig dril sgrub sngags ni: oṃ lo ki shwa ra tāṃ tu tā re hūm̐ phaṭḥ 'bum bcu gcig kha skong bcas las sbyor las bzhi dmigs pa'i kha bsgyur gzhung las gsal ba ltar sbyar la dngos grub blang ba snga ma dang 'dra mod/ da lam rang re nyin bdun gyi bsnyen pa'i 'brel 'jog tsam yin tsang gtso bo bsnyen rkyang kho na la nyin tha ma gnyis kyi bsnyen thun tha ma'i mthar sgrub sngags chig stong dang las bzhi sham bu gdag pa bcu re tsam sbyar ba'i 'thus la gzhan gong gsal bsnyen rkyang kho na ltar dang*/ dngos grub blang ba dang kha skong me mchod dang gtang rag tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i mnyes par bya ba sogs spyi 'gros dang 'dra'o/ /bka' lan zhib rgyas gsal kha yod pa gcig gsungs kyang nga ni long med ltar snang gzhan don zol ma'i rnam g.yengs kyis brel la/ khyed sang zhogs nyams len dbu 'dzugs dgos par sgrub pas brel la brel stabs kyi ngang nas lag pa'i mdzub gnon gyi 'degs 'jog rgan mo'i slog hrul chu rdung byas pa bzhin chu tshod mang po'i dus son zhing de ma thag btang bas na nor 'khrul 'dug na bzod gsol o ming pas dris lan hyas mgyogs bris byas nas phul/

༈ bka' brgyad dris len/ ji phebs bzhin rtsa ba gnyis pa yi dam yongs rdzogs skor la spyi bye gnyis las/ dang po bka' brgyad gsang ba zil gnon dpal dgu so so la gzhal yas khang re bskyed dgos kyi red dam/ gang yin zhus na/ 'don bya nang du shar phyogs pho brang zla gam dang lho phyogs pho brang zla gam sogs bstan 'dug /zhes par/ de ga rang red pho brang dgu sbrags zhes phyi gzhal yas khang gcig gi nang du dpal dgu so sor gzhal yas khang bskyed dgos kyi red/ bsnyen pa'i skor la ji ltar bgyi ba'i tshul ni/ spyir da res rang re dus bsnyen nyin nyer gcig gi bsnyen 'brel tsam yin tsang*/ des na thun bzhis snga thun la las byang 'bring po ltar byas shing*/ bzlas pa'i skabs zhi bsnyen gsum phreng skor re re dang mthar stong tshig brjod la nang mchod stobs/ de nas khro sgrub la 'jug /do la'i dmigs gnad dang bcas gtso bo yab yum rtsa sngags ru lu sbrel ma 'di kho nar thun gyi sum cha gnyis 'gro nges par bya/ sum cha gcig spyi dril ltar byas la mthar stong tshig brjod de nang mchod stobs thun bsdu tshul spyi dang mtshungs/ gzhan thor thun/ phyi thun/ srod thun gsum la rgyun khyer phyi ma a nu ltar snying po brjod pa'i skad cig rten dang brten pa wal gyi bskyed/ lha rnams kyang lus dkyil gzhung ltar bsnyen sgrub spyi dril 'di kho na byas pa'i 'thus/ yang a ti ltar skad cig la krong gi bskyed de sngags kyang gtso bo yab yum gyi srog sngags tsam mam shin tu spros med hūm̐ kho na la tshang bar gzhung nas gsungs so/ /bdun phrag tha ma'i nyin lnga tsam thun mthar las sbyor dmigs pa dang 'brel spyi dril la las bzhi sngags sham sbyar/ gzhan gyi dmigs gnad sogs zhib par zhu bar dus tshod kyi ma lcog pas/ spro bar mos na bka' brgyad man ngag gzhan la gzigs par zhu/ zhes rdo shul gyi ban dkar o ming pas dris len khyung po'i sngags nag gu hyas phul/

༈ rje gcig mtshungs med bla ma'i drung du/ phur pa'i skor dri ba/ yang dag dpal chen he ru kaḥ nyer gcig dbu la zhe gnyis phyag: zhes pa 'di yang dag yin nam/ lan/ 'di dngos snang che mchog phyag rgya rgyas pa ltar yin la 'gar che mchog yang dag gcig par bzhag pa'ang snang bas 'di'i dgongs pa'ang de yin par snang ste/ las byang 'bring por/ che mchog yang dag he ru kaḥ dbu dgu g.yas dkar g.yon dmar khro: zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ gtso bo che mchog la bzhag pa ni/ che mchog nyid phur pa'i sprul gzhi'am yab yin par gsungs la/ phur pa myang 'das chen po'i rgyud las/ rdo rje gzhon nu'i yab ni che mchog he ru kaḥdang yum gnam zhal dbyings phyug ma yin par gsungs pa dang*/ rang gzhung las/ dpal chen yab kyi thugs ka ru: padma nyi zla 'bar ba'i steng : 'jigs byed rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku: zhes gzhung nas gsungs pas rgyud kyi don la'ang 'byor snyam/ dri ba/ de yi thugs kar nyi zla'i steng : gsal byed rdo rje he ru kaḥ mthing nag zhal gsum phyag drug pa: zhes pa'i mtshan gzhan nas ma mthong ba'i lha'i ngo bo su yin nam/ lan/ gsal byed ces pa yang dag khro bor ngos bzungs na'ang 'thad par skyabs sprul nas gsungs la gang ltar yang dag khro bo yin par snang*/ dri ba/ de yi thugs kar 'ja' 'od klong : yang dag rdo rje sku mdog mthing : lan/ zhes pa 'di yang dag zhi ba rdor sems yin te las byang 'bring po las/ ting 'dzin gsum gyi sems dpa' che: yi ge hūm̐ gi rgyu nyid las: rdo rje rab tu 'bar ba'i mchog: sems dpa' rdo rje'i sku la bstod: zhes gsungs pas phyir ro/ dang po bsnyen pa ni/ bsnyen dmigs dang po/ de yi thugs kar pad nyi'-i steng*/ /gnam lcags sogs ni/ bkod bzlas yin pas lha sngags la sems 'dzin gyi yid bzlas tsam las bsnyen pa ngag 'don mi dgos/ slar yang de las 'od zer ni?sogs mthar yang phur rtsa bsnyen bzlas/

gnyis pa sgrub pa ni/ slar yang thugs srog sngags phreng las/ /sngags phreng lu?sogs bdag mdun thams cad la dmigs shing bskor ba phur pa'i rgyud las lha dang sbyar nas bzla ba mgal me klad skor lta bu'i dgongs pa'i don ni/ bdag nyid rtsa ba sems dpa' sum brtsegs sogs nas bsnyen sgrub chig sgril gtso bor bya la zhes pas/ bsnyen sngags gong ltar la/ lha dang sbyar nas bzla ba mgal me klad bskor lta bu'i dgongs pa'o/ /gsum pa las sbyor ni/ slar yang thugs ka'i sa bon las/ /sngags phreng mgar gyi me tshw sogs ngan sngags dang sbyar nas bzla ba mgar gyi tshwa tshwa lta bu zhes gsungs pa ni/ slar yang bdag mdun dkyil 'khor gsum gyi lha tshogs dang bcas pas? las sbyor bsnyen pa phur pa spyi mtshungs kī li ki la ya 'bru bcu drug pa la rang lugs trig nan bsnan pa 'di nyid yin la oṃ badzra kī li kī la ya sarba bighnān trig nan baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ yang phur pa'i bsnyen yig kha 'thor las/ dzaḥ

dngos grub 'gugs pa hūm̐ dngos grub thams cad bdag la sdud pa āḥ dngos grub thams cad bdag la 'bebs pa/ zhes sngags 'grel dang bcas te bshad pa ltar na/ dngos grub kyi 'phyongs yin par snang bas las sbyor tha ma dngos grub zhu ba'i snga nur ram dngos grub bsdu ba'i phyir nyin shas sbyar na legs par mngon/ bsnyen sgrub 'brel 'jog tsam la lha sngags so so rnams ma byas kyang chad skyon med/ bsnyen chen lta bu spros pa'i skabs sgrub pa'i skabs dang sbyar la long khom dang bstun te cung zad re bzlas/ hūm̐ sgrub ni snying po dril bzlas tshul du gang gi skabs su'ang sbyar bar bya'o/ /ji phebs bzhin/ las byang 'bring po bsnyen rkyang skabs rtsa bsnyen dang phur bsnyen gnyis cung zad bsags rjes spyi dril gyi sngags la gtso bos grangs bzung*/ las sbyor las bzhi ru sbyar tshul bshad pa de dus nyin res dus bzhir las bzhi kha phral ba dang*/ nyin rer las re sbyar ba lugs gnyis las phyi ma ltar byas na bde'o// // ༈ mkha' 'gro gsang ba ye shes dka' gnad skor/ rang nyid mkha' 'gror gsal ba'i sku dbus rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi dang bcas gsal ba'i spyi bo ru rigs bdag padma thod phreng gsal btab la mos gus drag pos thugs rgyud bskul ba'i mod/ sku las bde stong ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs spyi bo bde chen 'khor lo nas rim bzhin bab pas mgrin pa sogs rtsa 'khor rnams su rim par zhugs/ rdo rje/ padma/ sangs rgyas/ rin chen rigs kyi rnal 'byor ma dang dpa' bo yab yum 'khor rigs kyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs/ til gyi gong bu kha bye ba ltar bzhugs pa rnams la mchod pa phul/ bde stong ye shes chen pos mnyes par byas/ dbang bzhi thob/ dga' bzhi'i ye shes nyams su myong*/ sgrib pa bzhi dag /sku bzhi go 'phang thob par bsam zhing bsnyen sngags bzlas/ yang rang srog sngags phreng dang bcas pa la phog pas g.yon bskor du drag tu 'khor 'od zer cher spros/

bdag dang mdun rten gtsos pa'i 'od kyis srid zhi'i khams thams cad khyab/ rang gzhan don gnyis byas/ tshur 'dus pas gzi byin lhag par du 'bar/ gtso 'khor ma lus pa thams cad bde chen ye shes nyams 'ur bas kun gyi zhal nas rdo rje'i glu dbyangs 'ur 'ur/ /dga' bzhi'i bro rdung khrigs khrig /rtsa khams ba spu tshun chad bde dang stong par phril phril song bas dug lnga dbyings su sangs sang*/ dbang bzhi byin rlabs bde stong bdud rtsi'i rgyun na ra ra bab pas/ snang ba sku dang 'ja' 'od zer dang zer phreng du yal yal/ sgra grags 'byin 'jug thams cad rlung sngags su dir dir/ dran rtog thams cad chos sku'i yo langs su song bas/ /'gro ba'i ma rig nyon mongs ka nas dag te /'ja' lus zang thal chen paus ngang du 'khor 'das gyi rtsal snang thams cad mkha' 'gro'i dā lar rdzogs par bsam la sgrub sngags ci nus su bzla'o/ /skabs su bar rlung dang sbrag 'byin 'jug sngags su slob/ thun gyi cha bgos te phyed rang gzhung du bshad pa ltar rlung sgrub la 'bad cing bde stong gi ye shes bskyed pa'i thabs la 'bad/ las sbyor nor sgrub/ dbang sdud/ phrin las kun sgrub sogs gang dgos mos pa dang bstun/ spyi ltar 'di nyid padma'i rigs can yin par song las sbyor gtso bo dbang sdud la bgyis na 'thad/ dmigs pa rang nyid mkha' 'gro'i thugs srog las bde ba chen po'i rang rtsal zhing khams rab 'byams thams cad khyab rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i thugs rgyud skul/ tshur 'dus pa'i de thams cad gyi nus stobs rdzogs par byas/ slar 'od dmar lcags kyu'i dbyibs can srid zhi khams thams cad gang bar 'phros pa'i lha 'dre mi gsum skye 'gro pho mo tham cad dbang du bsdus la ci bsgo ba'i phrin las thog med du sgrub par bsam la dbang sdud sngags bzlas/ 'di rnams phrin las kyi rtsa ba mkha' 'gro yin pas gal che'o/

/ ༈ yang o ḍi dris len/ dang po/ de nas seng gdong ma bsnyen 'brel zhag bdun las med tsang bsnyen rkyang byas na 'thus sam/ nyin lnga bsnyen rkyang dang tha ma gnyis bsnyen rkyang dngos grub gtor ma las rdzas sogs gzhan dgos sam/ de ni bsnyen khag gsum 'dug dmigs gnad man ngag gang yod gnang rogs zhu/ bsnyen pa'i bzlas dmigs ni/ thugs kar nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor la hūm̐ mthing nag gi mthar sngags phreng mthing la gting mdangs dmar ba'i ngad chags pa sgra gdangs di ri ri sgrog pa g.yon du 'khor ba las 'od zer dpag tu med pa cher 'phros pas nang gi gnas yul gyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro thams cad bskul/ de thams cad las kyang 'od zer ches cher 'bar zhing mched pas las nyon sdig sgrib pha rol gyi byad grib sogs nyes ltung thams cad dag ste sku mdog mthing 'od bkrag mdangs gzi brjid cher 'bar bas/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba rab 'byams gnas gsum gyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dam can chos skyong lha 'dre mi gsum zas nor longs spyod 'byung lnga'i bcud thams cad shugs kyis bsdus te 'khor 'das kun na 'gran zla dang bral khyab bdag dpa' mo chen mor nga rgyal bskyed la/ om̐ baṃ ḍākki siṃ ha mu kha hūm̐ bhyoḥ zhes rtsa sngags dang*/ bsnyen pa 'di kho na yin/ sgrub pa bdag mdun dus gcig tu bskyed la bdag bskyed thugs srog phreng las sngags phreng 'od lnga'i zer thag dang bcas pa dpag tu med pa 'phros mdun bskyed mkha' 'gro sde lnga dang bcas pa'i thugs dam rgyud bskul/ rang rang gi thugs srog sngags phreng dang bcas pa las 'od zer sna tshogs nam mkha' gang bar 'phros pa'i rgyal ba mchod/ 'gro ba'i don byas tshur rang la thim pa'i mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa thob par bsam/ om̐ badzra ratna padma karma buddha ya ha ri ni sa ḍākki sa ma ya hūm̐ bhyoḥ zhes las sngags bzlas pa'i tshe khyad par gdong can lnga la sogs pa'i spro bsdus las bzhi mchog dang bcas pa bsgrub pa'i ting 'dzin gang 'dod du bsgyur shes par bya'o/

las sbyor gtso bo yang bzlog ni/ rang nyid bdud 'dul drag mos spyi bor aḥkaḥ mgrin par saḥmaḥ snying khar raḥtsaḥ lte bar shaḥdaḥgasang gnas raḥsaḥ/ brla gnyis g.yas maḥraḥ/ brla g.yon yaḥphaṭḥ ces yang bzlog drag sngags bcu bzhi pa lus kyi gnas drug tu bkod pa'i ye shes dang 'jig rten gyi mkha' 'gro phra men shugs 'gro thams cad kyi srog snying drag tu bskul ba'i shugs kyis/ sngags 'bru rnams las 'od zer me'i tshwa tshwa drag tu khol zhing phyur ba las srid gsum thams cad drag sngags thog rgod kyi char phab pas pha rol byad ma lha srung dang bcas pa bsregs bcom rjes shul med par brlag /slar yang thugs rje'i shugs las bskal ba'i 'thor rlung g.yos pas 'dzin snang bag chags dang bcas pa dbyings su gtor te sbyangs/ snang srid thams cad khro mo'i sprin rab tu 'khrigs pa'i rta bros gzir bas dgra bgegs byad gdon log 'dren thams cad nam yang ldang med thugs rjes dbyings su rgyas btab par mos la/ yang bzlog go ldog sngags ni/ phaṭḥyaḥraḥmaḥsaḥraḥdaḥshaḥtsaḥraḥmaḥsaḥkaḥ.aḥ de yang bsnyen sgrub gong ltar dang*/ las sbyor skabs drag sngags bcu bzhi/ mthar yang bzlog sngags dang thal gdab bar bya ba'i chog ste spro na srung zlog bsad sngags rnams bya ba yin mod 'dir bsnyen sgrub kho nar bya ba la dgos pa chung phyir de tsam gyi 'thus so/ ༈ rlung zhags skor la/ bu au ḍī'i mkhas pa'i 'dri ba la/ pha blun po gu hyas ma shes nas/ mgo phur phur byed bzhin byung rgyal lan/ cung ldon la yin min gzig par zhu/ /rang nyid mkha' 'gro'i skur gsal ba'i/ gtsug tor nam mkha'i 'khor lo ru zhes thig rlung sems gsum gyen du ldog rtsa yi mching mdud grol/ sa lam ma lus pa bgrod nas 'khor lo tshogs chen gyi sa thob par bshad la 'dir gtsug tor nam mkha'i 'khor lo ru thim pa yang zer 'khor lo drug pa ru bshad pa'ang yod/

/rigs bdag padma thod phreng rtsal he ru ka pa'i chas can/ sku mdog dmar po phyag rdor dril bsnol thabs can/ yum mtsho rgyal dmar skya gri thod 'dzin pa dang sbyor ba/ 'khor lo lnga zhes pa dbu ma spyi bo bde chen 'khor lo rtsa 'dab so gnyis dbus su rdo rje mkha' 'gro dkar mo g.yas rang rtags kyi yu ba can gyi gri gug dang g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pa/ yab mi bskyod dpa' bo dkar po g.yas rang rtags kyi phyag mtshan rdo rje dang*/ g.yon dril bu 'dzin zhing mnyam par sbyor zhing zhabs skyil krung pad nyi'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ de bzhin mgrin pa longs spyod 'khor lo'i rtsa 'dab bcu drug gi dbus su padma mkha' 'gro snang mtha' dpa' bo yab yum dmar po/ snying kha chos kyi 'khor lo rtsa 'dab brgyad kyi dbus su sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro rnam snang dpa' bo yab yum mthing kha/ lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo rtsa 'dab drug cu rtsa bzhi'i dbus su rin chen mkha' 'gro rin 'byung dpa' bo yab yum ser po/ gsang gnas 'khor lo rtsa 'dab chig brgya nyi shu tham pa'i dbus su las kyi mkha' 'gro don 'grub dpa' bo yab yum ljang khu bcas yum rnams g.yas rang rtags kyi yu ba can gyi gri gug dang g.yon thod khrag /yab rnams g.yas rang rtags/ g.yon de yi yu ba byas pa'i dril bu can/ yum yab 'khril sbyor can/ thugs srog rim bzhin rdo rje mkha' 'gro la ha dang gzhan ni baṃ ri sa sogs gsal ba'i/ mtha' mar rang mdog rtsa sngags 'dis bskor bar bsam/ de bzhin du 'khor lo so so'i rtsa 'khor grangs dang mnyam pa'i rang 'dra dpa' bo dpa' mo rnams bzhengs stabs can/ rtsa phran ba spu grangs mtshungs rtsa khams ba spu'i grong khyer du/ 'bum phrag yangs pa'i mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bcas/ til gyi gang bu lta bur bzhugs par bsam/ spyi bo'i bla ma yab yum la gsol ba btab pa'i mod/ thugs ka'i oṃ yig sngags phreng dang bcas pa las/

bde stong ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgyun bab/ sbyor mtshams nas byung spyi bo'i rtsa 'khor gang*/ gtso bo rdo rje mkha' 'gro yab yum dang bde chen 'khor lo'i rtsa gnas mkha' 'gro tshogs dang bcas par mnyes mchod 'bul/ sdig sgrib nyams chag thams cad bshags/ dga' ba'i ye shes khyad par can rgyud la skyes/ byin rlabs dbang dang dngos grub thams cad thob par bsam/ de bzhin gnas bzhi rim gyi son nas 'khor lo lnga'i mkha' 'gro ma rnams la mchod pa sogs gong ltar 'gres shes par bya'o/ mthar lus kyi nang thams cad ltem gyis gang rtsa khams ba spu'i tshun chad du bzhugs pa'i 'bum phrag yangs pa'i mkha' 'gro til gong ltar bzhugs pa rnams la mnyes par byas/ rang srog ha ni baṃ ri sa sogs sngags phreng la phog pas g.yon bskor drag tu 'khor/ 'od kyis srid zhi khyab/ don gnyis byas/ tshur 'dus pas gzi byin lhag par 'bar bzhin yar 'phros pas rigs bdag nas bzung gtso 'khor thams cad bde stong gi mchod pas dgyes shing nyams 'ur bas/ kun gyi zhal nas sngags kyi sgra dang glu dbyangs sgrogs bzhin/ gar stabs sna tshogs bsgyur zhing dga' bzhi'i bro rdung bas/ rtsa khams ba spu tshun chad bde bas khyab/ dug lnga'i rtog pa 'gags/ dbang bzhi thob/ dga' bzhi ye shes khyad par can rgyud la skyes/ snang grags rig gsum ye shes mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor du shes pas nyams len la brtson par bya'o/ /sgrub pa'i bsnyen dmigs zur du gsal la/ las sbyor gyi khyad par bdag mdun dkyil 'khor thugs ka nas 'od dmar lcags kyu'i dbyibs can grangs med pa 'phros/ 'khor 'das srid zhi'i dwangs bcud skye 'gro lha 'dre mi gsum gyi rlung sems snang ba thams cad khab len rdo'i lcags phye blangs pa bzhin dbang du bsdus phrin las 'bad med du 'byung bar bsams la/ gzhan yang las sbyor phrin las bzhi dang bye brag gang la bya ba spyi ltar la sngags gzhung ltar byas pas chog go/

// ༈ sgrub brtson btsun ma 'jam dbyangs gzhon nu'i phrin lan khag gnyis/ thos bsam gyi nor ldan snying gi ni bu mor/ zol med ky-i mchid lan tshig gsum zhig zhu'o/ lus ngag dang yid gsum ltos med du 'bul zhus/ phrin skyes de legs song dad mos dang dag snang*/ bcos min gi tshul de gsar byung ni ma lags/ sngon smon gyi pha bu 'brel ba zhig nges so/ de lta'ang da dung brtson pa ni ma lhod/ rgyang 'bod kyi 'o dod byas yul la ma re/ mos gus ky-is byin rlabs pha bu yi sems yid/ snying dbus su 'dres nges nyams len la rem 'tshal/ the tshom gyi sgro 'dogs gcod dus zhig lags pa'i/ go yul la rtogs pa'i gdeng tshad du ma rlom/ re dogs dang bag tsha 'jig rten pa'i bkur sti/ bsti stangs des ci byed go myong dang rtogs tshul/ snying gtam gyi snying po dmar rjen du phyung shog lung rig gi bshad yams yid dpyod ky-is sbun pas/ rang zhal de ma 'geb tha mal gyi shes pa/ bzo bcos dang bral ba rig pa yi gshis lugs/ rjen bcar de skyong rgyu'i mthar thug de yin skad/ yengs med ky-i ngang la sgom rgyu ni ma dmigs/ gtad so dang bral ba dgongs rgyud kyis pha phog /bu mo yi snying la 'bab pa zhig smon no/ byung rgyal gyi gtam la snying po ni dben yang*/ rdza rnga la lcag gi brabs pas ni sgra bzhin/ mdo med ky-i rgad pos ngag sgo las shor thal/ zhes rigs ldan snying gi bu mo sgrub brtson btsun ma 'jam dbyangs gzhon nu'i phrin lan du gnam lcags bstan 'dzin nas 2008 phyi zla 10 tshes 4 sku gsum mkha' 'gro'i gling gi sgrub sde'i thun mtshams la phul ba guhye rgya/ shes rab can gyi bu mo gson/ nga rig pa'i ngang la gnas pa'i tshe/ phar gyi ri la bltas tsa na/ ri snang bkra la sa ler snang*/ rig pa'i ngo bor tshur bltas na/ ri 'dzin shes pa rdul tsam med/ med kyang chu nang zla ba bzhin/ dbang po'i sgo ru sa ler snang*/

rig pa'i gshis la tshur bltas tshe/ 'dzin med sa le seng nge ba/ ye shes rig pa rjen pa mthong/ de bzhin ri snang dung sgra sogs/ du mar snang rung 'dzin med na/ snang stong mnyam nyid chen por gnas/ skabs 'gar thol skyes shes pa yis/ mi 'o snyam pa'i skad gcig mar/ rig pa rtsal la 'phos pa na/ de ma thag tu rig pa yis/ ngos zin rig rtsal rig pa'i klong*/ chu rlabs chu ru 'gyur ba bzhin/ dbyer med rang thim rang grol 'gyur/ ma grol rtsal las kun rtog mched/ 'khrul pa'i rjes 'brangs tha mal shor/ 'khrul rtog ngo shes rjes ma mthud/ rig klong dag na ye shes su/ gnas 'gyur ci snang chos skur 'char/ gzhi med rtsa bral gdod ma'i gshis/ ma bcos ka dag e ma mtshar/ 2008 10 14 btsun ma 'jam dbyangs nas 'dri ba gnang bar lan 'debs tshul du rang ngor gang shar las gzhan la ma ltos par yig ger btab bo/ ༈ ye shes bla ma'i skabs/ mtshams pa dbang dbang phyug lags nas 'dri lan/ khyed gnas bde chen pho brang la lo gsum nang sgrub pa byas pa dang thod rgal zla ba gsum bltas lugs sogs la bltas na brtson 'grus brtsam yod tshod 'dug 'on kyang khyod thod rgal shar tshul/ khyed kyis 'bul yig la zhib par bltas pa'i/ shes rab rang byung gi sgron ma gser gyi a long 'khyil ba'i nang*/ sku rang byung du shar ba zhes pa dang/ rgyang zhag chu yi sgron ma kha dog me tog tshal rgyas pa sogs gsung tshul thod rgal gyi sgron ma bzhi phal cher thig le dang lug rgyud lta bu phyi snang kho nar go tshul la brtags tshe khyod rang bla ma nas man ngag gdar sha yag po ma bcad pa'i rtags shig snang la/ de dka' ngal gyi rgyu rkyen dang po yin par bsam/ de bzhin lug rgyud la 'dzin pa zhugs nas lug rgyud dngos por gol ba'i skyon zhes dam pa du ma'i gsungs la/ dpal sprul rin po che'i zhal nas kyang*/ gzung 'dzin can gyi thod rgal byed re shi/ zhes zhal gdams su gsal ba bzhin gzung 'dzin rang rgyud du shor na gol sar 'phyan nyen yod la/

rgan mo'i rang lus stag la sgom pa'i dngos su snang ba bzhin yin no/ yang khyod la sku dang zhing khams shar tshul sogs lam rtags yin min mtha' rten man ngag kho nas tshad bzung dgos te/ tshad rmi lam gyi bzung*/ rtags spyod pas ston/ zhes gsung*/ yang khyod kyi mgo bo'i nang lha tshogs thog reg rnam par tshogs pa dang*/ skad cha shod pa lung bstan pa mgo nas rkang pa'i bar du/ sgra sgrogs nas yam yom byed pa sogs lam rtags kyi yon tan mi 'dra/ nyams kyi bye brag e yin snyam/ 'phel 'grib nyams kyi rtags ni/ rlung sems 'dus tshul gyi rkyen las yid rton mi rung ba'i ting 'dzin glo bur du skye ba dang*/ nam mkhar lha sku dang 'od snang 'khrigs pa sogs ma nges pa 'byung tshul ye shes bla ma sogs rdzogs chen rgyud lung rnams su gsungs la/ rang shar las mkha' 'gro ma dag lung bstan pa sogs byung na nyams blta ba yin pas dgongs pa gtad do/ zhes gsungs pa ltar gang shar la bdag 'dzin ma byed/ gtso bo khregs chod la gyis/ nyams la bzang ngan gnyis yod/ nyams bzang ngan gang yin yang 'dra te zhen na bar chad dang gol sa yin/ de dag la re dogs dang bdag 'dzin med par bzhag nas gnyug ma'i ngang skyong ba rang zab la/ gu ru'i zhal nas/ 'di ltar mig gi yul du snang ba yi: phyi nang snod bcud dngos po thams cad kun: snang yang bdag 'dzin med pa'i ngang la zhog: gzung 'dzin dag pa gsal stong lha yi sku: 'dod chags rang grol gyi bla ma la gsol? o rgyan? 'di ltar rna ba'i yul du grags pa yi: snyan dang mi snyan 'dzin pa'i sgra rnams kun: grags stong bsam mno bral ba'i ngang la zhog: grags stong skye 'gag med pa rgyal ba'i gsung : grags stong rgyal ba'i gsung la gsol? o rgyan? 'di ltar yid kyi yul du 'gyu ba yi: nyon mongs dug lnga'i rtog pa ci shar yang : sngon bsu rjes dpyod blo yis bcos mi gzhug: 'gyu ba rang sar bzhag pas chos skur grol:

rig pa rang grol gyi bla ma la gsol? o rgyan? phyi ltar gzung ba'i yul snang dag pa dang : nang ltar 'dzin pa'i sems nyid grol ba dang : bar du 'od gsal rang ngo shes pa ru: dus gsum bde gshegs rnams kyi thugs rje yis: bdag 'dra'i rang rgyud grol bar byin gyis rlobs: zhes pa thugs la zhog ngas kyang smon lam rgyab yong zhes sprul ming gsang sngags nas phul/

mtshams pa o ḍī ming gis dris lan/ nyan thos byang sems khro bo'i lta stangs rnams thun gcig gi nang du cha bgo dgos pa dang*/ nyin gsum rer so sor byed dgos sam/ srol gnyis ka snang mod phyi ma bog thon che bar sems so/ /sems gtsad gcod pa mtshangs btsal ba rnams da sngon du song zin na/ khregs chod dngos gzhi la dang po gzhi lta ba gtan la phab pa ngo rang thog du sprod pa/ thag gcig thog tu gcod pa/ gdengs grol thog tu bca' ba sngar zhib zhus ltar lus mkhyen mod/ don gyi 'gag rtsa ni sems 'das pa'i rnam rtog gi rjes ma gcod/ ma 'ongs rtog pa'i ma dun ma bsu/ da lta'i shes pa blo'i bcos ma zhugs par dus gsum rtog pa dang bral ba'i bzhi pa'i cha da lta tha mal gyi shes pa skad cig ma'am/ rig pa rjen pa de'i thog ngo blta ched 'dzin sogs ched du sgom rgyu spu tsam med kyang ma yengs tsam gyi ngang*/ sa le ye re hrig ge 'jog pa yin te/ kho bo'i bla ma mkhan chen karma tshe brtan nas/ aḥ tha mal shes pa gnyugs ma'i gshis/ /ma yengs rang bab ngang la zhog /'dzin med gtad so bral ba yi/ /gang shar rig stong rjen pa skyongs/ zhes kho bo la thugs brtse ba'i gdams pa'o/ khyed nas kyang de bzhin dgongs mnga' yod pa zhu/ ༈ yang phran pas da cha rnam rtog ngo shes kyi mi 'dug zer bar/ lan/ rnam rtog ngo mi shes rgyu ci yang med/ dus gsum gyi rnam rtog yang bskor bskyar bskor mi dran dgu dran rtag tu dran pa 'di yin/ 'di rnam rtog red/ dran mi nyan bsam rnam rtog ngo shes pa tsam la dgos pa ci yang med/ da cha yul der bla chen du ma'i zhal las skyes pa'i slob ma lo mang por dka' thub byas par grags pa'i phyi gling pa 'gas/ sgom byed dus lag tu phreng ba zhig khyer nas rnam rtog gcig dran na phreng ba gcig bcad nas mthar thun gcig la rnam rtog grangs su bgrang nas re dogs dang 'dor len byed pa ni rdzogs chen gyi man ngag yin no zer ba'i bdud kyi gsang tshig sgrogs pa dag kyang snang ngo*/

'o na ji ltar yin zer na 'das pa'i rnam rtog kyi rjes mi gcod/ ma 'ongs rtog pa'i mdun mi bsu/ da lta'i rtog pa 'phro mi mthud/ blo'i bcos mi zhugs par gang shar rang grol shar grol rjes med du dag pa 'di gal che'o/ yang 'dri ba/ ka dag dang rig pa zhes pa de gnyis dbar khyad par ga 'dra yod red dam/ zhes par ka dag dang ye dag rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong nyid/ gdod nas spros bral ye gzhi bde gshegs snying po sogs ming ji ltar btags kyang don gzhi thog nas kun tu bzang po sangs rgyas kyang ngo bo la bzang rgyu med/ 'khor ba'i sems can dmyal bar skyes kyang cung zad sdug tu ma song pa ye nas 'khrul ma myong grol ma myong*/ skye ma myong*/ 'chi ma myong/ yod ma myong*/ med ma myong ba'i gzhi ma bcos pa de la/ 'o/ ye dag zer/ ka dag zer/ ye grol zer/ sangs rgyas mkhas pa'i ma bcos/ sems can sgrin pas ma bslad pa'i tha mal gyi shes pa'am/ gnyug ma rang babs kyi shes pa dang da lta'i shes pa skad cig ma zer ba yin/ des na gzhi la khyad par med kyang rang ngo rig pa dang ma rig pa la brten nas sangs rgyas dang sems can byung ba yin pas/ des na gzhi rang ngo shes pa la rig pa zer ba yin/ rnam rtog gi cha la sems zer/ sems nyid dam sems kyi ngo bo la ni rig pa yang zer/ mdor na rang bzhin dang gnas lugs sam/ bab bam ngo bo'i gshis la bzo bcos spu tsam ma phog pa'i/ dus gsum gyi rtog pa dang bral ba'i gdod ma'i gnas lugs bzhi cha sum bral/ ma bcos rig pa rjen pa zhes gzhi rtsa bral du ye re/ gdangs 'gag med du tha le/ rtsal chos nyid du wa le/ sku gsum lhun grub gdod ma'i mgon po kun tu bzang po zhes rang la bzhugs pa de ka la/ gtad 'dzin dang ched du bsgom rgyu spu tsam med mod ma bor rang ngo la bzhag pa tsam mo/ de las gzhan du rtog dpyod kyi yar btsal mar btsal bskal ba'i bar du btsal yang blun po'i rang rtags ngom pa las rnyed rgyu ci yang med do/

des na chu ma rnyog na dwangs/ sems ma rnyog na gsal gsungs pas rnam rtog mgo ma rgod par blo rtse bla ma la gtod/ nyams len byar med la gyis/ bogs 'don mos gus rang zab/ de las ma chog na ngas shes re kan/ yang cog bzhag bzhi ldan zhes nyams su len rgyu red dam/ yang na tshad gzhi 'dra red dam/ ga re red/ zhes par lta sgom spyod 'bras bzhir bzhag pa yin la der 'dra ba'i dpe'i sgo nas bstan pa'i tshad kyang yin/ de'i skor sngar don 'grel sogs su bstan zin la 'dir slar bri ba'i longs mi 'dug pas dgos na gzhan du gzig par zhu/ /kwa ye mdor na 'di la 'dril/ /gzung ba yul gyi ma gos shing*/ /'dzin pa rtog pas ma bslad par/ /gzung 'dzin dang bral na lta ba zer/ /lta ba lta ba zhes bya ba/ /lta bya dang blta byed ci yang med/ /dmigs bya yod na lta ba min/ /gtad so yod na lta ba min/ /mtshan ma'i dmigs gtad bor la thongs/ /sgom pa sgom pa zhes bya ba/ /sgom bya dang sgom byed ci yang med/ /sgom 'dzin yod na sgom pa min/ /rtsol bas zin na sgom pa min/ /blos byas kyi sgom pa bor la thongs/ /spyod pa spyod pa zhes bya ba/ /spyod bya dang spyod byed ci yang med/ /bzang ngan yod na spyod pa min/ /blang dor yod na spyod pa min/ /'dzin rtsol gyi spyod pa bor la thongs/ /byas pa'i chos kyi sangs mi rgya/ /byar med ngang du yengs med zhog /blo yi blo 'das don mi mthong*/ /yid dpyod dang phrol la rjen ner zhog /'bras bu drod rtags re bas phung*/ /re dogs kyi 'dzin pa yul la phud/ /nyams gang shar bshig la khris se bor/ /bzang ngan gyi rnam rtog ci shar yang*/ /rang grol gyi rig pa'i ngang du klod/ /ye grol gyi chos sku'i rgyal sa zungs/ /de don thugs la 'dogs par zhu/ /tshig kha spob mtho snyams ngo nongs kyang*/ /don bla ma'i man ngag gces nor lags/ /nga sgom pa'i nyams myong med mod kyang*/

/don sgro 'dogs gcod pa'i re dogs bud/ /bu zhen 'dzin gi mkhar bu sgo med nang*/ /rnam rtog gi glang bu tshud pa bzhin/ /re dogs kyi ku co ma ldir bar/ /gu yangs kyi mal du blo bder bzhugs/ /de bag mem̐d du nyal ba'i khyi rgan la/ /las mem̐d byis pa'i dbyugs rdung byas/ /dbang mem̐d kyi skad cor shor nas thal/ /don mem̐d du ma bzhag mkhyen ldan kyai/ /de las bri tshod mi gda' thugs nyams longs/ e go/ the ban rgyal sa the pe zhes pa rgya pho rnams nas phyag rgya rug rug /rgya mo rnams nas gus 'dzum shig shig /shog chag dmar po char pa 'beb 'bebs byed sa nas/ rgya bla gsang sngags pas 'phral du bris te phul ba'o// // ba)༄༅/ /bla ma'i thugs kyi snying po ka dag phyag rgya chen po'i khrid yig gi zin bris/ shes rab gsum gyis gtan la phab pa snang gsal sgron me zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /dmigs pa med pa'i thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa skyabs gnas kun 'dus kyi ngo bo drin can bla ma dam pa'i zhabs kyi padmo dri ma dang bral ba la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ ye nas rnam dag kun tu bzang po'i thugs/ /rgya chad phyogs lhung bral te 'gro kun gyi/ /rgyud la gnas kyang ma rig gsum gyis bsgribs/ /de yi gsal byed snang gsal sgron me 'degs/ /de la 'dir bka' gter dag snang chu bo gcig 'dres kyi gdams pa/ sku gsum bla ma'i thugs kyi snying po/ ka dag rdzogs pa chen po'i khrid yig la rgyas bshad tshig gi na yam spangs te smar rkyang du 'chad par byed pa la sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so/ /dang po la gsum ste/ thun mong*/ thun mong ma yin pa/ khyad par gyi sngon 'gro'o/ /dang po ni rtsa bar/ thun mong dal 'byor rnyed dka' tshe mi rtag /las 'bras dran zhing 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bsam/ /zhes pas/ dang po dal 'byor rnyed dka' la bsam pa ni/ slob ma mdun du 'khod pa la 'di skad ces gdams so/

/kyai rigs kyi bu/ de'ang dam pa'i chos gsha' ma zhig byed pa la snod dam rten phun sum tshogs pa zhig dgos/ rten phuun sum tshogs pa de gang yin zhe na/ dal 'byor gyi mi lus rin po che kho na las gzhan ci yang ma yin/ da lam 'di lta bu'i mi lus rin po che rnyed pa ni khyed rang gis skye ba mang por tshogs bsags shing*/ mi dge ba bcu srog dang brdos nas spangs/ dge ba bcu le lo spangs pa'i sgo nas dang du blangs pa'i mthu kho nas byung ba ma gtogs/ stabs ka legs nyes kyis 'khor sa legs pa rnyed pa lta bu ni ma yin pas rgyu'i sgo nas kyang rnyed par shin tu dka'/ de'ang gyang logs la sran ma gtor ba chags pa srid mtha' ma bkag pa tsam ma gtogs shin tu dkon pa de bzhin du dpe'i sgo nas kyang rnyed par dka'/ de bzhin du ngan song gsum gyi sems can ni sa chen po'i rdul tsam yod/ mi lus tsam po ba ni sen mo'i steng gi rdul tsam/ dal 'byor tshang ba'i mi lus rin po che thob pa ni nyin mo'i skar ma tsam/ de'ang phal cher las mtha' log pa 'ba' zhig gis ngan song gi rgyu kho na sgrub pa ma gtogs chos bzhin du spyod pa ni ches dkon pas grangs kyi sgo nas kyang rnyed par dka'/ 'o na mi 'di tsam mang po 'dug snyam na/ spyir mi lus thob tshad dal ldan ma yin zhing*/ khyad par du ngan 'gro la ltos na mi lus thob srid pa'i tshod du gda' ste/ rdo leb gcig gi grog sbur dang*/ mi gcig gi lus kyi nang na gnas pa'i srin 'bu bzhag nas/ phyi'i lus la gnas pa'i lj-i shig gcig po'i grangs la brtag bcug pas kyang shes la/ des na 'di lta bu'i rnyed pa phun sum tshogs pa zhig legs par rnyed dus mi tshe stong zad du brgal na shin tu phangs pas/ da lta phan chad du don med ngan song gi rgyu kho na bsgrubs nas mi tshe zad 'dug pa 'di a re 'gyod/ nga re 'jigs/ zhes ngag tu'ang brjod la/

blo sna thung sbud sbud du ma song bar bsam mo/ /gnyis pa chos kyi snying po mi rtag pa sgom pa ni/ kye kye/ rigs kyi bu de lta bu'i dal 'byor de rnyed par dka' zhing rnyed kyang shin tu mi rtag ste 'chi dgos shing*/ 'chi ba la snga phyi dang go rim rgan gzhon sogs ma nges te de ring dang do nub tsam yang mi 'chi ba'i nges pa ci yod/ spyir nam zla dus bzhi'i 'gyur ldog sogs dang*/ dgos su da nangs zhogs pa gnyid sad pa nas da lta tshun gyi bya byed dang dus tshod nyi ma'i grib so sogs phyi dus kyi 'gyur ldog dang*/ nang bcud kyi sems can bsams nas na ning nas da lo'i bar du rang gis mthong thos su gyur pa'i mi rgan gzhon ma nges pa ji tsam shi song*/ de dag rnams kyi ro de med par bzos zin pa dang*/ de rnams gar song cha med khron pa gting ring du rdo 'phangs pa bzhin du ma song ngam/ tshe ji ltar ring yang lo brgya rtsa las mi thub/ de yang deng sang ni nyi shu kha dar gyi mar mtha' la thug pas rang re'i tshe phal mo che ni song tshar bas 'chi ba'i dus la gtugs par byas 'dug da de la phan pa ni dam pa'i chos kho na las gzhan med/ snga phan rang cag gis tshe 'di'i 'dun ma kho na bsgrubs pa ni smyon pa thal can yin 'dug cing*/ tshe 'di'i gtam khe grags/ rgyu shed shugs/ dpa' rtsal sogs kyis shi tsa na mi phan par rang nyid gcig pu mar gyi khrod nas spu bton pa bzhin du las dang bag chags kyi rjes su 'brangs shing 'grogs te 'gro dgos par 'dug a tsa ma/ nyi ma de ring nas bzung ste rgyun ring du sdod grabs dang chos brgyad kyi dbang du gtong na nga las snying rul ba med pas/ ci nas kyang tshe phyi mar phan pa'i don zhig mi bsgrub re/ zhais tshig phyi ma ngag tu yang brjod cing*/ bshas rar bcug pa'i sems can gsod la khad pa lta bu'i sdug bsngal blo la blangs te 'dar yer yer sgom la blo sna thung sbud de gtong ngo*/

/gsum pa las 'bras la bsam pa ni/ kyai rigs kyi bu/ de ltar shi nas gcer bu rgyang 'phain pa'i lugs bzhin du sgron me shi ba ltar sems kyang shi bar 'dod pa'am/ 'di nas shi 'phos te 'di ru 'gro ba zhes rang dbang gi 'du ba zhig yin du zin na de kas chog kyang*/ de ltar min par rang nyid ni las bzang ngan thams cad kyi phyi bzhin du 'brang bas las kyi dbang gis skye ba ma nges pa len dgos la/ de'ang zhe sdang gis kun nas bslangs pa'i sgo nas srog gcod pa'i las kyi mtshon spyir mi dge ba bcu spyad pa dang*/ bye brag tu yul khyad par can la 'gran sems kyi sgo nas las ngan bsags pas dmyal bar skye/ 'dod chags kyis kun nas bslangs te las ngan bsags pas yi dwags su skye/ gti mug gis kun nas bslangs tai sdig pa bsags pas dud 'gror skye/ zag bcas kyi dge ba bsod nams cha mthun bsags pas mtho ris su skye/ de'i phyir na rang gis byas la ma bsags pa'am/ bsags la ma byas pa'i las kyi 'bras bu gang yin pa de thams cad bar ma dor chud mi za bar rgyu rkyen rnams tshogs shing dus la bab pa'i tshe gzhan sus kyang mi myong bar rang thog kho nar gnam thig drang por btab pa bzhin 'chug pa med par 'bab pa las 'os med pas/ de las rtag par rang gis lus ngag yid gsum gyi dge skyon la brtag bcug pas/ dge bar gyur pa zhig 'dug na thar pa'i rgyur bsams nas dga' ba bsgom zhing*/ de chud mi za bar byed pa'i phyir lung ma bstan du mi 'jog par sems can thams cad kyi don du dmigs pa med pa'i bsngo bas rgyas gdab par bya dgos/ mi dge ba rnams la gnong 'gyod drag po'i sgo nas bshags par 'os pa'i rigs kun bshags shing sdom par 'os pa sdom la/ mdor na a ti shas ji skad gsungs pa ltar sdig ltung dang zhag gcig kyang mi 'grog par phyir bcos la 'bad pa gal che/ de nas bzung mi dge ba'i bsam pa nam skyes pa de nyid 'bur 'joms khungs med du btang nas nyes byas kyi dbang du gtong re snyam ste/

zhe dam shugs drag po bca' zhing las 'bras kyi cha phra mo'ang rtsis gdab med par mi bya'o/ /bzhi pa 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs la bsam pa ni/ kyai rigs kyi bu de ltar las 'bras kyi 'phen sdud shin tu btsan pas zag bcas nyer len gyi phung po 'di blangs phyin chad da lta'i sduug bsngal la spyod cing phyi ma'i sdug bsngal gyi gnas la 'dren pa las 'os med/ de'ang ngan song du skyes na tsha dmyal brgyad/ grang dmyal brgyad/ nyi tshe nye 'khor gnyis te rnam grangs bco brgyad yod pas de dag gi sdug bsngal dngos su so so'i lus thog tu 'byung na lta ci/ da lta de dag gi gzugs brnyan ri mor bris pa mthong na'ang snying rtse shum shum yong bzhin mi gda'am/ tsha dmyal la skyes na khro chu khol ma nang du blugs nas nang khrol thams cad bsreg pa dang*/ zangs chen gyi nang du 'tshod pa/ sta re dang sog le 'bar bas lus tshal bar gtubs pa sogs kyi sdug bsngal bzod thabs ji ltar yod/ da lta rang gi yan lag gi steng du tsher ma zug pa dang so na ba tsam la na tsha zug zer ci 'dra 'dug grang dmyal du skyes na gangs stong dang 'khyag sbug char rlung sogs shin tu mi bzod pa'i zabs su tshud nas lus dum bur gas pa sogs tshad bzung du med pa'i sdug bsngal yod na/ da lta zhogs pa'i chu brgal ba tsam la'ang rkang pa gas song snyam pa'i zug rngu mi 'dug gam/ yi dwags su skyes na mi'-ii zla ba la zhag tu rtsis pa'i lo lnga brgya'i bar la chu thigs tsam yang 'thung rgyu med pa'i skabs kyang yod la/ gal te chu cung byung yang mgrin par mi thar ba dang*/ thar yang nang khrol nang du mer gyur nas bsregs pa/ rkang pas lus po mi theg pa sogs kyi sdug bsngal yod na/ da lta rang rer lto snga phyi tsam la'ang ltogs snang ji 'dra 'dug dud 'gror skyes na ni dud 'gro rigs gnyis su yod pa'i byings la gnas pa phyi'i rgya mtsho na yod cing de dag gcig gis gcig za ba'i sdug bsngal gyis gzir ba dang*/

kha thor ni lha dang mi'i yul du gnas shing de dag rnams kyang gcig gis gcig za ba dang*/ khal 'gel ba/ rmod rmo ba/ sna 'bigs cing sha gcod pa/ zas gos kyi ched du srog gcod pa sogs mdor na nam mkhar rgyu ba'i bya byi'u/ sa la 'dzul ba'i srog chags yan chad kyang dbang che bas chung ba gsod pa dang*/ mi sogs mthong tshad gshed ma khong lag can du mthong nas bsad kyis dogs/ bzung gis dogs/ brdung gis dogs pa sogs kyi sdug bsngal ni mi las brgya 'gyur gyis che bar bshad la/ de bzhin du lha la 'pho ltung gi sdug bsngal/ lha m-in la 'thab rtsod kyi sdug bsngal/ mi la skye rga na 'chi'i sdug bsngal gyis nyin mtshan khor mo yug tu mnar ba kun gyi mthun snang du grub pa sogs mdor na tshangs pa dang brgya byin/ 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal por skyes kyang gnas skabs kyi bde ba dang sdug bsngal 'dres ma zhig cung zad myangs nas slar ldog ste/ 'khor ba'i yang bran du 'gyur ba'i phyir na de dag gi sdug bsngal rnams re re nas bsams te/ dper na me 'obs sam/ btson dong ngam/ bshang gci'i 'dam du tshud pa 'di las da lta nyid du 'thon na snyam pa'i zhe dam drag po rang rgyud la 'dres nges par sgoms shig ces gdams so/ /gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro ni/ rtsa bar/ thun min skyabs sems rdor sems sgom bzlas dang*/ /maṇḍal bla ma'i rnal 'byor yang dag sgom/ /zhes pas/ dang po skyabs sems ni/ kyai rigs kyi bu/ de lta bu'i 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal skyob pa'i thugs rje dang nus pa mnga' ba ni dkon mchog gsum kho na yin te/ sangs rgyas la ston pa/ chos la lam/ dge 'dun la lam gyi grogs su bzung nas 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho nas sgrol dgos pas so/ /de'ang skyabs kyi mthar thug ni sangs rgyas kho na las gzhan ma yin te sangs rgyas ni sku gsum kun 'dus yin no/ /de bzhin du dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyang o rgyan rin po che kho na la hril gyis 'du bas 'di nyid kyi yon tan la dad pa/

'khor ba'i sdug bsngal la 'jigs pa/ sdug bsngal gyis mnar ba'i sems can la snying brtse ba gsum gyi sgo nas skyabs su 'gro dgos/ kun slong de dang lhan cig par sems can thams cad bdag gi pha ma ma byas pa ni gcig kyang med pas/ de'i drin lan du 'di dag thams cad sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang la sbyor ba'i ched/ sngon byang chub sems dpas bskal pa grangs med pa gsum du tshogs sbyor mthong sgom mi slob lam gyis bsdus pa'i thugs bskyed smon lam sogs kyi sgo nas tshogs gnyis rgya mtsho lta bu rdzaugs par mdzad de/ sems can thams cad kyi don mdzad pa bzhin du bdag gis kyang byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la bslab par bya'o snyam pa'i sems bskyed nas/ mdun gyi nam mkhar 'ja' 'od thig le'i gur khyim gsal 'tsher dwangs pa'i dbus su/ padma'i sdong po 'dab ma stong ldan ze'u 'bru dang bcas pa'i steng du nyi zla'i gdan la dus gsum sangs rgyas kun 'dus/ kun las lhag pa'i thugs rje'i mnga' bdag o rgyan gyi slob dpon chen po gu ru snang srid zil gnon zhi 'dzum chags nyams can lta bas chog mi shes shing dran pa tsam gyis tshe 'di'i snang ba 'gag par nus pa/ mthong ba tsam gyis mos gus dang dad pas mchi ma rang dbang med par shor ba/ gsal 'tsher dwangs pa nyi ma stong gi gzi byin dang ldan pa/ 'ja' dang 'od kyi phung por zer phreng shig ge ye re/ 'khyil ler bzhugs pa bdag dang sems can thams cad la thugs rjes gzigs pa g.yel med du 'jug par bsam zhing*/ bdag gi g.yas g.yon du pha mas gtsos pa'i sems can thams cad 'khod nas 'dun pa gcig gyur kyis skyabs su 'gro bar mos la/ de nas thal mo snying khar sbyar te 'di ltar slob dpon chen po ni sangs rgyas kun 'dus/ dam chos kun 'dus/ dge 'dun kun 'dus/ rtsa gsum kun 'dus/ skyabs gnas kun 'dus kyi ngo bor yin par mos pa'i blo thag rbad kyis bcad nas rang nyid kyis sna drangs te thams cad kyis 'ur dir 'don par bsams la yid khyed shes kyi dad pas/

na mo sku gsum rje btsun o rgyan rje/ /bdag sogs 'gro kun gus pas skyabs su mchi/ /dus 'di nas bzung byang chub snying po'i bar/ /ma gyur 'gro rnams bsgral bar sems bskyed do/ /zhes grangs med brjod cing*/ mthar thun bsdu ba ni/ skyabs yul gyi thugs kar rang nyid phar 'pho la khad khad/ skyabs yul rang la dgyes pas tshur thim la khad khad kyi ngang du gnas tshe mos gus shugs drag por bskyed pas bla ma 'od du ltem gyis zhu nas rang dang dbyer med du 'dres par bsam la/ de'i ngang du sems bcos bslad ci yang med par rang babs la ci gnas su bzhag go /gnyis pa rdor sems sgom bzlas ni/ kyai/ rigs kyi bu mngon mtho dang nges legs gnyis ka'i lam gyi gegs che shos ni sdig sgrib kho na las gzhan ma yin la/ de sbyong ba'i gnyen po'i gtso bo'am thabs gcig chog ni rdor sems sgom bzlas 'di kho na yin pas/ khyed rang tha mal du gnas pa'i spyi bor ngo bo pan chen bi ma mi tra la rnam pa rdo rje sems dpa'i cha lugs/ dkar gsal zhi 'dzum phyed skyil can/ zhi rgyan bcu gsum gyis mdzes shing phyag gnyis rdor dril 'dzin cing 'gying ba'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa de'i thugs ka'i zla steng du hūm̐ḥyig sngon po'i mtha' bskor la yang snying yig 'bru bcu gnyis pa hril gyis 'khor bar bsams/ de'i 'od zer las bdud rtsi'i rgyun dpag tu med pa babs shing rang gi spyi bo tshangs pa'i bu ga nas zhugs te nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad nag 'dur gyis ded nas 'og sgor brgyud cing sa rim pa dgu'i 'og tu song ba dang*/ rang lus shel sgong dri ma med pa lta bur gyur par bsam zhing ngag nas/ hūm̐/ bdag nyid tha mal spyi gtsug pad zla'i steng*/ /ngo bo bi ma rnam pa rdo rje sems/ /dkar gsal zhi 'dzum zhi rgyan bcu gsum mdzes/ /phyed skyil rdo rje dril 'dzin 'gying stabs bzhugs/

/thugs kar zla steng hūm̐ mthar yang snying bskor/ /de las 'od zer 'phro 'dus bdud rtsi babs/ /nad gdon sdig sgrib nyams chag ma lus kun/ /chu snas sbur ma 'ded ltar sangs kyis dag /ces brjod la stobs bzhi'i gnad dang ldan pas/ oṃ gu ru badzra sa twa sa ma ya hūm̐ ā: zhes sdig pa dag pa'i rtags ma byung gi bar du bzla zhing*/ thun mtshams su/ bdag ni ma gus mi shes rmongs pa yis/ /zhes pa la sogs pas bshags sdaum byas pa de bzhin du zhal gyis bzhes par bsams la/ mthar rdor sems 'od du zhu nas rang nyid la thim par mos pa'i ngang la bcos bslad med par bzhag go /gsum pa maṇḍal ni/ kyai rigs kyi bu/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang brnyes pa la tshogs rlabs po che bsag dgos zhing*/ tshogs bsags pa'i rgyu ni maṇḍal 'bul ba las stobs che ba med pas/ rgyu de'ang phun sum tshogs pa ma 'grub na'ang rdo khod snyoms la 'jam pa khru gang las mi chung ba zhig gi steng du 'bru gtsang mas tshom bu so bdun nam/ nyer bdun nam/ lnga la sogs pa rang rang gi cho ga bzhin du bkod la/ nam mkha'i khyon thams cad tshogs zhing gis go mtshams med par gtams shing*/ dmigs 'don zung du chud pas/ na mo/ sku gsum bde gshegs 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor du/ /ri rab gling bzhi gser ri rol mtsho bdun/ /nyi zla lha mi'i dpal 'byor longs spyod bcas/ /'bul lo bzhes la mchog thun dngos grub stsol/ /oṃ gu ru maṇḍal pū dza ho: zhes grangs ji tsam mang bar bsag go /bzhi pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi gzhung rtsa ba rin po che rgya can ltar dmigs khrid phab cing mos gus la rtsal 'don byed dgos so/ /gsum pa khyad par gyi sngon 'gro ni/ rtsa bar/ khyad par sngon 'gro rlung sbyor kho na nyid/ /ces pas skabs 'dir rlung sbyor bde drod rab 'bar 'khor lo'i rgya can gyi dmigs khrid phob/ de'ang thun mig chung la goms 'dris che bar babs pa las har mchong gang che mi mdzad pa gces/

rig pa btsan thabs su ngo sprod pa la 'di las gnad zab pa med/ de ci'i phyir snyam na/ rgyud dang man ngag rnams nas rlung rta rgod dang 'dra/ sems mi 'phye bo dang 'dra/ rtsa srang kha dang 'dra/ zhes 'dra dpe gsum gsungs nas de nyid byed pa bcings pa'i gnas la brten pa'i gnyug ma mngon sum du mthong ba khyad chos yin te/ rje mi las kyang dwags po lha rje la/ nga'i gtum mo a thung gi srog rtsol 'di sgoms dang*/ da bzod sems kyi ngo bo mthong nas yong gi 'dug ces gsungs pa ltar dang*/ 'di dag grub mtha'i rang rkang ma tshugs par gang 'dod kyi rjes su zhugs pa'ang ma yin te/ snga 'gyur gyi bka' gter rnams zab la 'jug sgo'i rnam grangs mang ba'i phyir gsar ma'i sbyor drug dang lam 'bras/ rim lnga sogs kyi man ngag dang khyad par rdul tsam med pa'i lam khrid kyang yod pa'i phyir na mtha' gcig tu 'gal ba'am/ yang rdzogs chen gyi man ngag khyad par ba rnams kyang 'di dag dang bsnol bshad byed pa ni thos pa chung ba'i skyon yin no/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la lnga/ g.yo nyams la mtshang btsal ba/ thob nyams la ngo sprod cing brdar sha gcod pa/ goms nyams la bogs 'don byed pa/ brtan nyams la gol sa gcod pa/ mthar phyin la gzhi rtsa chod nas la bzla ba'o/ /dang po ni/ rtsa bar/ de la g.yo nyams rig rig tur tur 'char/ /byung gnas 'gro gsum sems kyi mtshang btsal te/ /zhes pas sngar rlung sbyor la bslabs pa'i thun mtshams thams cad du dmigs rkang re re rdzogs pa'i rjes su rlung bzung bzhin pa'i ngang nas 'das par mi mno/ da lta bar mi dpyad/ ma 'ongs pa mi 'gug pa'i ngang du lhod de bzhag pas/ rnam rtog gcig gi steng la gcig phreng ma chad par rgyu ba shugs drag la blos tshad bzung med pa zhig skye/ de'i tshe da bsgoms nas rnam rtog mang du 'gro thang*/ sgom gyi las 'phro med las che snyam pa 'byung ste/ de ni nyams dang po ri gzar gyi 'bab chu 'dra ba zhes pa de yin pas snga phan brtag dpyad ma btang bar btang snyoms lung ma bstan du song nas rnam rtog gi rgyu ba ma rig pa yin no/
