/de'i tshe 'di ltar gdams so/ /kyai rigs kyi bu/ khyod kyi sems de lhan ne bcos med du bzhag pa'i tshe ji 'dra ba zhig 'dug snang bar 'dug gam stong par 'dug snang bar 'dug na gzo dbyibs kha dog che chung snang tshul ji 'dra zhig 'dug stong par 'dug na stong pa cang med dran pa rig rig tur tur na tsha bde sdug sogs gang la 'char zhes pa sogs dris pa'i lan gnad du thebs pa'i ngang nas gsal stong gi mtshang ma rig gi bar du brdar sha gcod/ de nas pho tshod dang stong nyams sogs ma yin par cung zad stong pa'i ngang las rig pa'i rtsal 'char bar go ba'i tshe 'di ltar gdams so/ /kyai rigs kyi bu/ 'o na de lta bu'i sems ngos bzung med la gsal gyis shar nas yal gyis stong pa rjes med du 'gro snyam mkhan de dang po gang nas byung*/ snang ba'i cha sa rdo ri brag chu klung rtsi shing gang las byung*/ stong pa'i cha nam mkha'i phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad steng 'og gang nas byung*/ gal te byung khungs rnyed na bzo dbyibs kha dog kyang med par mi srid pas ji ltar 'dug bar du gang na gnas/ phyi snang ba la gnas sam nang phung po la gnas/ phyi snang ba la gnas na sa rdo ri brag kyang g.yo 'gul 'gro ldog byed cing mthar 'chi thang*/ nang phung po la gnas na spyi gtsug nas rkang mthil gyi bar gang na gnas/ mthar gang du 'gro/ lus shi ba dang mnyam du sems kyang shi'am/ zhes pa sogs so sor dpyad pa byed du bcug nas gtad med khungs med du ma song bar rgyun bskyang ngo*/ /gnyis pa ni rtsa bar/ thob nyams rang ngo rang shes rig pa la/ /gnas 'gyu rig gsum sems kyi brdar sha gcod/ /ces pas/ yang sngar ltar lus gnad dang bcas dpyad pa gang yang ma byas pas rig tsam du bcos bslad med par bzhag tu bcug pas/ rnam rtog gcig steng la gnyis phraing bar ma chad par rgyu 'phro la ma tshor bar rnam rtog zhi lam mer song snyam pa yang byed/ wa le sdod 'dug snyam pa byed pas 'phro la rtog pa bstud mar rgyu zhing res yud tsam gnas pa 'byung ste/

de ni thob pa'i nyams gnyis pa rong khung dog po'i chu 'dra ba zhes pa de yin la de'i tshe 'di ltar gdams so/ /kyai rigs kyi buu/ de lta bu'i sems res 'ga' gnas snyam pa byed/ res 'ga' 'gyu snyam pa byed/ de gnyis ka rig mkhan gyi shes pa ngos bzung med pa dang gsum gcig gam tha dad/ gcig na gnas dang 'gyu ba'i mkhan po so sor ga la yod/ mi gcig na rnam grangs gsum du yod pa c-i yin zhes dris pas gnas 'gyu rig gsum pa ngo bo gcig cing*/ de'ang mtha' las 'das pa'i brjod bral dpes mtshon du med pa/ snang dus nas stong*/ stong dus nas gsal/ gsal dus nas gzhi med rtsa bral du bun ne/ chal le/ wal le/ hrig ge bar thag chod pa'i tshe/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi dmigs khrid mthar chags su bgyis rjes cung zad mnyam par bzhag tu bcug de'i ngang la phaṭa drag po zhig brgyab pas/ byung tshor gyi rnam rtog dang gnyen po'i sgrib pa med pas shes pa rang gsal rgya yan gtad med ye grol rgya chad phyogs lhung dang bral ba zhig mi 'char ba'i dbang med pas/ de nyid tha mal rang babs kyi bsam gtan yin par ngo sprod/ khrid yig phal cher du 'das pa'i rnam rtog dang*/ ma 'ongs pa'i rnam rtog gi bar na yod pa'i shes pa gsal le hrig ge zhes dran pas tshir gyis bzung ba la ngo sprod byed pa cung mi legs so/ /de bzhin du snang ba sems/ sems stong pa/ stong pa zung 'jug zung 'jug spros bral zhes ngo sprod byed pa'i gdams ngag mang po rlung ltar grags kyang rdzogs pa chen po ka dag gi skabs 'dir de dag yid dpyod pa'i lta sgom dang 'dres pa'i nyes pa mi kheg pas/ kun mkhyen klong chen pas man ngag sde'i dgongs pa mthar thug 'chad pa'i skabs su 'di dag la bka' bkyon mdzad pa'ang thugs shin tu mad do/ /'di yan chad dmigs thun rim par phab nas sems ngo sprod pa'i thabs yin la/ 'di nas mar dben pa brten/

gnad thog tu sgom rung ngo rim bzhin sprod pa las thog ma nas bshad yam dang*/ dpe la blta ba sogs kyi bya shor na go nyams dred por shor ba mang ngo*/ /gsum pa ni/ rtsa bar/ goms nyams zhi lhag gnyis kyi bden pa 'char/ /nyams dang rtogs pa gnyis kyi bogs 'don byed/ /ces pas/ de ltar sngon du 'phrod pa'i rjes thog tu dben pa brten pa'i tshe/ 'di la zhen pa'i blo ris mang po mtshams rbad kyis bcad nas rtse gcig tu sgom/ de'ang gnas 'gyu la 'dam ka mi byed cing rtog pa lam du byed pa khyad chos yin kyang*/ re zhig gnas pa gtan la ma phebs par de ltar byed na lhag mthong gi rtsal ma thon pas rtog pa nag po kha 'byams su 'gro/ las rlung gi mgo ma non pas gnas pa ngo mi shes/ ci yin 'di yin med par mi tshe zad pa yong gi 'dug par snang bas/ des na las dang po'i rigs can gyis rnam rtog gang shar la ce re bltas/ res de'i ngang nas rnam rtog de'i rjes su 'brang ba dang spang ba sogs gang yang ma byas par ngo shes mkhan de ga'i thog tu rang tshod zin nas sdod pa la thun yun thung grangs mang la sbyangs pa'i mthar/ ci zhig na rnam rtog rgyu 'phro chad nas mthar lkugs pa ltar mi rtog par 'gro/ 'di la nyams gsum pa phu gsum gyi rdzing chu 'dra ba zhes zer/ don du 'di zhi gnas sgrub pa'i rgyu tsam las rkyen mi thub cing shes pa'i dwangs cha ma shar bas zhi gnas tshad ldan ma yin la/ 'on kyang gang zag sbyangs pa can cig car ba re zung tsam gyis ni tshul 'di la mi ltos kyang*/ rim gyis pa yin phyin chad skas dang po ma 'dzegs par gnyis pa'i thog tu mi sleb pa ltar 'di mi 'byung ba'i dbang med pas skabs 'dir de la skyon du'ang lta mi dgos la (gang dang )/ 'di'i tshe gnas nyams thaum yo re ba de la sgom go mi gcod par shes pa la ngar btegs te gzengs bstod nas bla gab med pa dang bsil bu yod pa sogs su sgom pas/

sems nyon mongs pa dang mtshan 'dzin/ rnam g.yeng gi spros pa phal cher nyil gyis zhi/ shes pa bying rgod dang bral bar dwangs seng nger gnas/ 'bad rtsol grim po la mi ltos par skyong sla la gu yangs cha le/ spyod lam bskyang dus kyang skor re sdod pa/ yul snang gi 'dzin pa bkrag med bun long nger song nas bde gsal mi rtog pa'i nyams ci rigs pa dang*/ stong gzugs kyi snang ba nges par 'char zhing mngon shes kyang 'char bar bshad pa rtsa gzugs kyi khyad par yod par go /de ltar yang 'di lta bu'i zhi gnas ni mchog gi zhi gnas sam/ yon tan thams cad skye ba'i rgyu yin/ de'i tshe bde gsal mi rtog pa'i nyams ji 'dra zhig skyes kyang ma chags ma zhen par bskyangs pas lhag mthong gi rtsal thon nas gnas 'gyu mnyam grol du 'gro ba yin no/ /sgom gyi mtshang 'di na yod pa yin pas bde nyams dga' brod can dang*/ gsal nyams yid khar 'ong ba dang*/ mi rtog pa'i gshis mi g.yo ba sogs la chags na/ bde bas 'dod khams/ gsal bas gzugs khams/ mi rtog pas gzugs med khams su skye ba'i rgyu'am sa bon las byang chub kyi lam du mi 'gro/ de bzhin du lhag mthong gi rtsal thon pa'i skabs su'ang snang ba sems las ma 'das snyam pa'i rgyas 'debs/ snang sems dbyer med do snyam pa'i gshis shor/ stong pa nyid yin snyam pa'i go yul/ shes byas gtan la phab pa'i go dred dang*/ lhag don du rnam rtog ngo shes na sgom yin skad pa mkhas pa mang po'i yi ge la grags kyang*/ des cung mi 'ong bar 'dug ngo shes thog tu ngos bzung med par grol ba zhig ma byung na rjes thob tsam las rnam rtog chos skur 'gro ba dka' bas 'di'ang gnad gal po che zhig yin/ gzhan yang lhag mthong de'i rtsal las shar ba'i mos gus la chags pa/ snying rje la chags pa/ stong nyid kyi rtsi la chags pa/ so sor rtog pa'i shes rab kyi ral kha phye ba sogs la chags pa rnams ni/

de dag lam du ma longs pa yin pas thams cad mkhyen pa'i rgyur mi 'gro'o/ /mdor na gnas pa la ma chags/ 'gyu ba la ma zhen/ yul dang yul can gyi zhen pa khong grol du song ba de la zhi lhag zung 'jug gi bden pa mthong ba zhes zer ro/ /spyir mdo dang bstan bcos chen po rnams nas zhi lhag so so'i ngos 'dzin dang rnam grangs mang po zhig gsungs yod kyang spong ba bsam gtan pas rang rang gi rgyud thog tu 'gel dus bshad ma thag pa kho na las gzhan mi dgos shing*/ gnad thams cad 'di kho nar 'du ba yin no/ /mdor na sgom bdag po'i lag tu 'phrod nas rnam kun mchog ldan gyi sar 'gro ba la sgrub rkyen bzhi dang ldan dgos/ mi rtag pas rgyud bskul nas 'khor ba'i chos la zhen pa gting nas log cing tshe 'di'i bya ba phra mo dang rgyu nor khab dang skud pa tsam gyi rjes su'ang ma chags ma zhen par gnas dben par 'phongs 'grigs pa bzhin du sdod tshugs pa zhig dgos pa ni rgyu'i rkyen/ bdud kyi bshes gnyen gyis ma bslus par mdo rgyud nas gsungs pa'i mtshan nyid thams cad tshang ba'am/ min na'ang legs pa'i yon tan shas che ba/ brgyud pa'i byin rlabs dang ldan zhing gdams ngag gi gnad lon pa'i bla ma dam pa mig bzhin du bsten dgos pa ni bdag po'i rkyen/ bla ma des tshul bzhin du ngo sprod pa'i gdams pa'i don gzhi bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po gdod ma'i gnas lugs 'khor 'das gang du'ang ma reg la yongs su khyab cing*/ gcig dang du ma'i mtha' las 'das pa da lta'i shes pa wal le hrig ge zang thal le ba rang babs bcos bslad thams cad dang bral ba'i bsgom bya ma 'khrul ba ni dmigs pa'i rkyen/ de'ang bcos med rang babs zhen 'dzin dang bral ba de ga'i rgyun skyong ba la mi'i tshe la tshad btsugs nas snying rus bskyed pa ma gtogs/ bdag gis sgom byed do/ /bya'o/ /byas so/ /nyams rtogs skyes na legs so/

/ma skyes na mi legs so/ /grub pa e thob/ grub rtags e thon snyam pa lta bu'i re dogs kyi mtshan ma til gyi shun pa tsam yang mi byed par ma yengs mi bsgom gyi gshis la gnas pa de ma thag pa'i rkyen du nges par bya/ sgrub rkyen bzhi po 'di dang ldan phyin chad nyams rtogs kyi rtsal chen rdzogs par gdon mi za bar nyid do/ /bzhi pa ni/ rtsa bar/ brtan pa'i nyams la chos nyid mngon sum rtogs/ /rtse gcig spros bral lam gyi gol sa chod/ /ces pas/ de lta bu'i 'gyu ba gzhi thog tu thim nas gnas 'gyu dbyer med du 'dres pa'i rgyun la brtan pa thob pa'i btang 'gro bzhag sdod kyi shes pa rtse gcig tu gnas pa de nyid kyi ngo bo'i 'dzin stangs rnam par mi rtog pa'i gshis de gtad yal la song nas nam mkha' lta bur spros pa dang bral bas khams gsum du skye ba'i gol sa chod/ de yang yid dpyod 'dzin pa dag stong pa skye med mtha' bral blos sgrub pa zhig la spros bral du 'dod nas/ spros bral las lhag pa'i lta ba yod na spros pa can yin zhes blo 'das kyi spros bral sun 'byin pa bod 'dir mang du byung mod kyi/ rgyan stug po bkod pa'i mdo las/ stong pa nyid kyi lta thos kyang*/ /de nyid lta ba ma zhig na/ /gsor mi rung ba'i lta can te/ /sman pas btang ba'i nad pa bzhin/ /zhes gsungs pa las ma 'das mod/ des na de lta bu'i blos dpyad dang pho tshod go nyams sogs ma yin par dran 'dzin gyi gnyen po dang*/ nyams rtogs kyi shubs nas don pa'i gnas lugs gdod nas rnam dag ngang nas rang shar ba yin na/ 'di nyid sangs rgyas kyi bden mthong yin pas sa dang po non par mkhas grub tshad ldan thams cad zhal 'cham mod/ 'o na rjes thob kyi yon tan brgya phrag bcu gnyis med pas so zhe na/ khyung dang bya phran gnyis sgo nga'i sbubs su rtsal rdzogs lugs mi gcig pa'i nges pa 'dren rgyu yod la/

des na rtog ge ba dag ci red red du chug 'di lta bu'i spros bral nam mkha' lta bu rtogs kyang bral thob gnyis ka yod pas da dung pho tshugs bskyed dgos/ ji srid dag pa'i sa gsum la ma slebs bar snang rig gnyis kas sgom chen bslus nas ldog pa la tshegs cung zad kyang med pa'i phyir dang/ de yang tha mal gyi shes pa gcig pu lhing rang gis babs la 'khor 'das dang blang dor ka nas dag pa yin pas sa lam gyi rnam pa bzhag tu med kyang*/ gnas lugs ji bzhin pa'i gshis la brtan pa thob je cher song ba 'di nas kyang ro gcig sgom med la sogs pa rnal 'byor du btags nas sa lam gyi ded dpon brtsi tsam sngon byon grub thob rnams kyi mdzad mod/ don du rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i ngang sgom blo 'das kha yan lta sgom gyi zhen pa khong grol du song ba zhig gi rgyun la gnas na shes bya'i sgrib pa rang dag la 'gro ba yin/ 'di dus bzang rtog ngan rtog nyon mongs snang stong gnas 'gyu gang yin yang de ga'i shes rgyud rjen pa spu ma brjes/ mdog ma 'gyur/ gra ma chag gru ma nyams pa de kha zang thal kha yan du lam khyer byed pas bzang zhen dang nyon mongs ma spangs rang grol cham skyuur chen por song nas gol sa dang shor sa'i ming yang med do/ /'di dag gi tshe rdzogs pa chen po'i rgyud dang man ngag rnams nas thun mong dang/ thun mong ma yin pa'i phyogs las rnam rgyal gyi spyod pa la sogs pas bogs 'don par gsungs kyang*/ snang ba brid mkhas/ rig pa col chung*/ gnyen po stobs zhan pas 'phyam 'phyam mang po 'di yang rnal 'byor pa ldog pa'i 'phrang gcig tu gda' bas/ sde dgon nyams grib 'du 'dzi can ma yin pa/ mchod bsham dang thab chas 'dod yon don du mi gnyer ba'i sgo nas lhan ne sdod tshugs pa kho na bogs che zhing grub rtags kyi rgyal po yin par shes par bya'o/ /lnga pa ni/ rtsa bar/ mthar phyin nyams la rtogs pa'i gzhi rtsa chod/

/go myong rtogs pa gsum gyi gzhi sbyang la/ /go yul shes sgrib dbang du ma song bar/ /nam mkha' rab 'byams dgongs pa zang thal klong*/ /nyams len gnad du bsnun cig skal ldan grogs/ /zhes pas/ rang nyid kyi rtogs pa'i steng nas cung zad ming tshig gis drangs te bzhag na/ de lta bu'i phung po lnga bral gyi mnyam bzhag tshogs brgyad kyi dri mas ma gos pa'i rjes shes/ mnyam rjes kyi bden zhen las bral ba'i tha mal rang byung gi shes pa/ zang kha rgya yan cog bzhag chen por la bzlas pas sgom byed kyi shes pa gtad med khungs med du song ba la sgom pa ma rnyed de/ gang shar snang rig gang skyes gnyug ma/ gang byas ye shes kyi 'khor lo/ spang bya dang gzung 'dzin gdod nas dag pa zh-ig lags so/ /lta ba ji ltar mtho yang rnam rtog rnam rtog ji ltar bzang yang 'khor ba/ 'khor ba sgyu mar go yang 'khrul pa las ma 'das pas/ gdod nas rnam dag gi ye shes rjen par mthong ba zhig lags so/ /bsgoms kyang blos byas/ rtogs kyang pho tshod/ thos kyang tshig ro/ dran kyang gzung 'dzin/ bsams kyang zug rngu/ rgya yan lhun 'byams kyi klong nas gar yang ma 'khrul cing ci yang mi byed pa ngo mtshar/ a la la/ gnad yin te go ba dka'/ 'khor ba dang lag gdangs sbrel ba'i rnal 'byor ba la rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i 'brel ba zhig kwa ye/ tshe rabs mang por tshogs gnyis bsags pa zhig lags so/ /bla ma'i dgongs pa mal du blangs pa zhig lags so/ /rgyud pa'i ye shes snying la phebs pa zhig lags so/ /mngon pa'i nga rgyal gyis smras pa ni ma lags so/ /snang ba gtad med kyi mdangs phyi gsal du zang thal le song ngo*/ /sgro skur mno na ni khyod rang gi las su shes pa gyis shig ma ma ko ling sa manta/ gsum pa/ rjes 'bras bu'i rim pa bstan pa ni/ de lta bu'i gnas skabs kyi gzhi snang blo 'das phyogs lhung dang bral ba de nyid lam du sku gsum gyi rtsal chen yongs su rdzogs nas bum nang gi nam mkha' bum pa chags pa dang mnyam du stong pa chen po dang 'dres pa bzhin/

gdod ma'i gzhi dbyings dang 'dres nas chos sku ka dag gsang ba'i sbubs/ dag pa gnyis ldan mthar phyin lhun grub kyi sa la grol/ de yang ka dag gi sa de chos sku bya rtsol las 'das pa yin pas/ dngos su sprul pa mi 'gyed kyang de'i yon tan lhun gyis grub pa'i thugs rjes ji srid 'khor ba ma stongs bar du sems can gyi don 'bad med du 'byung ba theg pa 'di'i khyad par yin no/ /e ma ho: rgyud lung dpang bzhag rgyas bshad tshig ro dor/ /snyan brgyud gnad dang nyams myong zung du bsdebs/ /rdo rje'i tshig dkrol bcus dkrugs gab pa bsal/ /'di ni man ngag khrid kyi gsang mdzod yin/ /smin grol lam gyi shes rgyud ma dul zhing*/ /'dod pa'i mda' lngas rang gzhan gsod pa yi/ /dregs ldan skye bo'i lag tu btang srid na/ /rdo rje grags ldan gnyer la bkod pa rdzun/ /thugs rgyud man ngag dwangs shel gtsang ma la/ /dam sel ha yis ma btab snyan brgyud 'dis/ /las can 'gro ba grangs med kun bzang gi /dgongs klong tshe gcig grol bar smon lam 'debs/ /zhes pa'ang gter chen bla ma mchog gi dgongs pa gtad cing bka' rgya dkrol ba'i tshe/ lam 'di la mos pa'i mi phyed pa'i dad pa can rgyang rtse grub chen o rgyan bstan 'dzin lags kyis dran gso mdzad pa las/ theg pa mchog gi lam gyi sgrub pa po mkhyen brtse'i 'od zer gyis dpal ri gsang sngags pho brang du zin bris su bgyis pa'o// // mkhyen ldan rnams la zhu rgyur/ gter chen rtsa gsum gling pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi sras dang*/ khyad par du 'od gsal thugs rgyud bka' bab thugs thig mi nub par 'dzin pa'i rgyal tshab gcig pur mnga' gsol ba ni/ rig 'dzin thugs mchog rdo rje 'di nyid yin la/ rje rang nyid la'ang zab gter gyi bka' babs mang du bzhugs la/ 'on kyang bla ma thugs kyi snying po 'di nyid spel ba'i lung bstan dus rtags ma 'grig stabs/

slar 'dab gter du sbas la dgongs pa chos dbyings su thim rjes/ rig 'dzin dri med gling pa la 'od gsal gyi skus rjes su bzung nas 'das rjes kyis tshul du babs/ des kun mkhyen 'jigs med gling pa la bka' rgya dkrol cing gtad rgya mdzad pa bzhin/ sbas don zab khrid ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba 'di dag mdzad pa yin pas/ rang re gnam lcags pa'i chos rjes 'brang ba rnams kyis snying dang mig las gces pa'i zab gnad 'di 'dra bzhugs bzhin/ nor bu dor nas mching bu ma btsal bar yid bzhin nor bu 'di nyid thos bsam sgom pa'i nyams bzhes mdzad pa snying nas gsol ba 'debs pa lags so/

zhes sgo chen sprul ming gsang sngags nas so// // ma)ma)༈ e wam̐ sgrub sde'i lo gsum mtshams kyi dus tshigs ngo sprod kun gsal me long bzhugs so/ /kun gzigs 'khor lo'i mgon mchog bka' drin can/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam gyi kha lo ba/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtsho sgrol ba'i gnyen gcig pu/ /srid pa gsum du khyod las skyabs gzhan su/ /de phyir gang la btud nas lo gsum gyi/ /nyams len lam gyi yi ge 'di zung la/ /srid pa'i mtsho sgrol zhi ba'i bsti gnas su/ /ma chags thar mchog grong du yid gtad 'tshal/ /de la gang zhig lo gsum sgrub la zhugs pa'i thog mar sna sel dang*/ phyi nang gsang mtshams bsdam tshul dgongs rgyan ltar song nas/ mtshams khong bar chad sel byed yang phur zhag bdun/ nyams chag sbyang phyir rdor sems zhag bdun bcas bcu bzhi sna sel gyi khongs su 'du la/ de nas dngos gzhi blo sbyong thog mar kun slong bcos pa la zhag gsum/ de nas thun mong phyi'i sngon 'gro'i skor la/ dang po/ dal 'byor rnyed dka' la bsam nas blo sbyong ba la/ thog mar ngo bo dal ba la zhag gsum/ khyad par chos kyi 'byor ba rang 'byor lnga la zhag gnyis/ gzhan 'byor lnga la zhag gnyis/ rnyed dka'i dpe la zhag gcig /grangs kyi sgo nas zhag gcig /'phral res gnyis la zhag re bcas zhag bcu gcig /gnyis pa tshe mi rtag pa bsam nas blo sbyong ba bdun las/ phyi snod 'jig rten la bsam nas mi rtag pa bsam pa zhag gcig /nang bcud sems can la bsam nas mi rtag pa bsam pa zhag gsum/ dam pa'i skyes bu la bsam nas mi rtag pa bsam pa zhag gcig /skye rgu'i bdag po la bsam nas mi rtag pa bsam pa zhag gcig /dpe don sna tshogs la bsam nas mi rtag pa bsam pa zhag gsum/ 'chi rkyen nges med la bsam nas mi rtag pa bsam pa zhag gcig /'dun pa drag po la bsam nas mi rtag pa bsam pa zhag gcig bcas zhag bcu gcig /gsum pa 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal la bsam ste blo sbyong ba la/

'khor ba spyi'i sdug bsngal la bsam pa la zhag gsum/ bye brag rigs drug so so'i sdug bsngal bsam pa ni/ ngan song gi gnas dang po dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal la bsam nas blo sbyong ba la/ tsha dmyal brgyad kyi sdug bsngal bsam pa la zhag gcig /grang dmyal brgyad kyi sdug bsngal bsam pa la zhag gcig /nyi tshe nye 'khor gyi sdug bsngal bsam pa la zhag gcig bcas dang*/ ngan song gi gnas gnyis pa yi dwags kyi sdug bsngal bsam pa ni/ bying la gnas pa'i yi dwags kyi sdug bsngal bsam pa la zhag gcig /mkha' la rgyu ba'i yi dwags kyi sdug bsngal bsam pa la zhag gcig bcas so/ ngan song gi gnas gsum pa dud 'gro'i sdug bsngal bsam pa ni/ dud 'gro bying gnas kyi sdug bsngal bsam pa la zhag gcig kha 'thor ba'i sdug bsngal bsam pa la zhag gcig bcas kyis ngan song gi sdug bsngal song nas/ de nas mtho ris kyi sdug bsngal bsam nas blo sbyong ba ni/ mtho ris kyi gnas dang po mi'i sdug bsngal bsam pa la/ rtsa ba'i sdug bsngal gsum las/ sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal bsam pa la zhag gcig /'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal bsam pa la zhag gcig /khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal bsam pa la zhag gcig /skye rga na 'chi'i sdug bsngal bzhi la zhag re re/ dgrar sdang ba dang 'phrad pa'i sdug bsngal bsam pa la zhag gcig /gnyen byams pa dang bral ba'i sdug bsngal bsam pa la zhag gcig /mi 'dod pa thog tu bab par bsam pa'i sdug bsngal bsam pa la zhag gcig /'dod pa thog tu mi khel ba'i sdug bsngal bsam pa la zhag gcig bcas mi'i sdug bsngal song*/ mtho ris kyi gnas gnyis pa lha min 'thab rtsod kyi sdug bsngal bsam pa la zhag gcig /mtho ris kyi gnas gsum pa lha 'pho ltung gi sdug bsngal bsam pa la zhag gcig bcas 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal bsam nas blo sbyong ba grub/ de nas blo sbyong bzhi pa las 'bras bslu med la bsam nas blo sbyong ba ni/ spang bya mi dge bcu bsam pa la zhag gsum/

sgrub bya dge ba'i las bsam pa la zhag gsum/ thams cad las kyi rang bzhin bsam pa la zhag gsum bcas las rgyu 'bras la bsam pa'i blo sbyong song*/ blo sbyong lnga pa thar pa'i phan yon bsam pa la zhag gcig bcas so/ blo sbyong drug pa dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten tshul bslab pa la zhag gsum dang*/ gong gsal thun de dag gi sum cha phyi ma la skyabs 'gro grangs ci sogs kyi gong 'og sdom 'bum ther lon par bya/ ༈ gnyis pa sems bskyed kyi skor la/ smon pa sems bskyed kyi bslab bya ni/ btang snyoms tshad med la zhag gsum/ byams pa tshad med la zhag gsum/ snying rje tshad med la zhag gsum/ dga' ba tshad med la zhag gsum/ sems bskyed kyi ngo bo dbye ba bcas la zhag gsum/ bdag gzhan mnyam pa la zhag gsum/ bdag gzhan brje ba la zhag gsum/ bdag bas gzhan gces bsgom pa la zhag gsum byas nas/ dpyad sgom dang 'jog sgom spel mas nyams su len/ skabs su rlung phyi nang gi 'gro 'ong dang bstun nas gtong len bsgom/ de nas 'jug pa sems bskyed phar phyin drug la'ang sngar ltar blo sbyang ba/ phar phyin drug la zhag gsum re dang*/ thun tshad snga ma dang mtshungs par thun gyi cha bgos te sum cha gcig la sems bskyed grangs bsags/ grangs ka yang khri bzhi las mi nyung bar bya/ de la'ang bsam gtan dang shes rab gnyis las snga ma ni sems gnas kyi zhi gnas dang*/ phyi ma ni lhag mthong bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab gtso che la des na snga ma 'jog sgom dang*/ phyi ma ni dpyad shes kyis gtan la dbab cing*/ dpyad 'jog spel mas nyams su myong bar byed dgos pa bcas sems bskyed yan blo sbyong zhag brgya dang gsum gyis grub bo/ /de rjes sems sbyong bdun ma rgyab snon gyi tshul du zhus la sems sbyong snga ma drug la zhag re re/ sems sbyong bdun gyi tha ma bde stong gsal stong mi rtog pa gsum la/ zhag gsum re las mi nyung bar bsgoms la myong ba thob pa ci nas kyang bya/

de nas nang gi sngon 'gro bsags sbyang gi skor ni/ 'gal rkyen sdig sgrib sbyong byed rdo rje sems dpa' la zhag bzhi bcu/ mthun rkyen tshogs gnyis rdzogs byed maṇḍal la zhag sum cu/ snying thig yin na/ yan lag bdun par brkyang phyag sbrags pa la zhag lnga bcu bya/ gnam lcags la yan lag bdun pa med pas bla rnal gsol 'debs dang badzra gu ru bsags/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor badzra gu ru 'bum bcu gnyis kha skong dang bcas la zhag bzhi bcu/ bcas bsdom nyin zhag nyis brgya don brgyad grub bo// // ༈ lo gnyis par dngos gzhi bskyed rim ma hā yo ga'i nyams len gyi skor ni/ dngos gzhi btsun ma'i sgrub sde'i/ thog mar bla ma rig 'dzin 'dus pa bsnyen pa zhag sum cu/ sgrub pa la zhag nyer bdun/ tshe sgrub zhag gsum tshar nas tho rangs dngos grub blang zhing bsnyen sgrub kyi kha skong sbyin sreg nyin gsum tsam gyis grub pa dang*/ de nas yi dam thugs sgrub dpal chen 'dus pa'i bsnyen pa 'bru gsum zhag sum cu/ sgrub pa gu ru shrī la zhag sum cu/ sgrub chen badzra tsaṇḍa zhag nyi shu/ las sbyor yaksha kro ta sarba zhag bcu dang*/ sbyin sreg nyin gsum bcas bsdom zhag dgu bcu go gsum song*/ de nas mkha' 'gro bde chen rgyal mo'i rtsa sgrub la 'jug par bya ste bsnyen pa zhag sum cu/ lus dkyil zhag sum cu/ nang sgrub sgrol ma nyi shu la zhag re re/ tshe sgrub zhag gsum/ gsang sgrub seng gdong mar zhag bdun/ sbyin sreg nyin gsum bcas bsdom zhag dgu bcu go gsum/ thugs sgrub bsam lhun bsam lhun las byang tshar re snga thun dang*/ thun gzhan la bsam lhun dril sgrub byas pa'i bsnyen pa bsnyen pa zhag bco lnga/ sgrub pa zhag bcu/ las sbyor zhag lnga dang sbyin sreg nyin gcig bcas bsdom zhag sum cu so gcig /padma khrag 'thung gsang sgrub bsnyen pa zhag bco lnga/ sgrub pa artsig zhag bcu/

las sbyor zhag lnga dang sbyin sreg nyin gcig bcas bsdom zhag so gcig /gsang ba ye shes bsnyen pa zhag bco lnga/ sgrub pa zhag bcu/ las sbyor zhag lnga/ sbyin sreg nyin gcig bcas bsdom zhag sum cu so gcig song*/ lo rim gnyis pa'i rtsa gsum bsnyen sgrub kyi rim pa nyin zhag sum brgya zhe gnyis kyis grub bo/ / ༈ gnam lcags sgrub sde phur pa gling du cha mtshon na/ dang po bla ma'i thugs sgrub rtsa gsum bka' 'dus spyi dril bsam lhun las byang tshar re snga thun dang*/ thun gzhan la bsam lhun dril sgrub byas pa'i bsnyen pa siddhi 'bru 'bum kha skong dang bcas pa zhag sum cu/ sgrub pa thod phreng rtsal la zhag bco lnga/ las sbyor hri ma ha ri ni sa bcas zhag bdun/ sbyin sreg nyin gsum/ bcas grangs bsnyen la zhag nga lnga/ gnyis pa bla ma drag po padma khrag 'thung gsang sgrub bzhin bsnyen pa badzra tsaṇḍa zhag bco lnga/ sgrub pa artsig zhag bdun/ phrin las bzhi'i las sbyor zhag gsum bcas zhag nyer lnga/ gsum pa bla ma'i nor sgrub padma rgyal po bsnyen pa zhag bcu/ sgrub pa zhag bdun/ las sbyor zhag gsum bcas zhag nyer gcig/ / ༈ yi dam gyi skor la/ dang po bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon gyi las byang 'bring po ltar/ zhi ba bsnyen pa la rigs brgya'i rtsa sngags zhag bdun/ khro bo sgrub pa la gtso bo yab yum gyi gsal snang ma zin gyi bar yab yum spyi sngags dang*/ de nas khro bo'i spyi sngags bcas sum brgya las mi nyung bar bzlas rjes/ gtso bo bsnyen sgrub spyi dril drag sngags so lnga zhag bcu gcig /las sbyor thun bzhir dmigs pa so sor byas pas zhag gsum bcas zhag nyer gcig /gnyis pa yang phur las byang rgyas pa snga thun dang*/ bsnyen pa la ma hā kro ta zhag sum cu dang*/ sgrub pa zhag sum cu las badzra kī li la zhag nyer gcig tsam song nas des phyin thun mthar sras mchog la dmigs nas hūm̐ sgrub dang*/

khro bcu yan la grangs brgya re/ dbang phyug dam can rnams la grangs nyer gcig re byas te sgrub pa song*/ las sbyor badzra kī li la 'phyongs sngags btags pa dang*/ thun mthar khyad par gyi las sbyor srung zlog bsad gsum las/ thun snga ma gnyis la srung dmigs dang phyi thun la bsad pa srod thun la zlog dmigs gtso bor bya/ thun gzhan la phrin las 'bring po bya zhing bsnyen sgrub las gsum go rim bzhin dang*/ sbyin sreg nyin gsum bcas phur pa zhag re brgyad/ gsum pa gshin rje dug ri me 'bar bsnyen pa zhag bdun dang*/ de nas dzap khang dbye zhing sgrub pa zhag bdun gyi tha ma nyin gsum la las sbyor rbad bsad kyi sngags sbyar ba khyad par ro/ rta mgrin la zhag bdun la bsnyen rkyang kho na'o/ ༈ mkha' 'gro'i skor la/ dang po gsang ba ye shes bsnyen pa zla ba gcig /sgrub pa zhag nyer gcig ring*/ thun gyi snga cha la sgrub pa dang phyi char rlung sgrub sngags dang rlung 'dzin pa gzhung gsal ltar bya/ las sbyor gyi sngags gsum nyin gnyis re dang*/ sbyin sreg nyin gsum bcas zhag re gcig /gnyis pa bdud 'dul drag mo zhag bdun ring bsnyen rkyang*/ gsum pa rlung zhags mkha' 'gro'i sgrub thabs bsnyen pa zhag bcu bzhi/ sgrub pa zhag bdun las tha ma nyin gsum ring las sbyor sham bu btags pa bcas zhag nyer gcig /tshe sgrub lcags kyi rgya mdud bsnyen pa zhag bcu gcig /sgrub pa zhi ba zhag lnga/ khro bo zhag lnga bcas zhag nyer gcig /rig 'dzin 'dus par bsnyen pa zhag bcu sgrub pa zhag bcu tshe sgrub zhag gcig bcas zhag nyer gcig /bcas nyin zhag sum brgya zhe gnyis kyis grub bo/ / ༈ lo tha ma gsang sher gyi nyams len lung a nu yo ga dang 'brel ba'i mtshan bcas rdzogs rim gyi skor la/ rtsa rlung zhib khrid zhus rjes/ thog mar bde stong rlung gi rdzogs rim ltar rlung bum pa can bzung ba zhag bdun/ de nas rlung bum can dang rlung gi 'khrul 'khor yan lag lnga sbyong sbrel ma zhag bdun/

de rjes khrid rim bzhin gtum mo 'bar 'dzag dang*/ gtum mo'i 'khrul 'khor brgyad dang*/ thig le'i 'khrul 'khor lnga/ gegs sel bogs 'don gyi 'khrul 'khor bcas zhag nyer gsum gyi khongs su byang chub par bya dgos/ de phyin zhag bdun cu tham pa'i b.ragatso bo rlung bum can dang gtum mo la gnad du bsnun te nyin re bzhin 'khrul 'khor kyang ma chad par bya'o/ des rtsa rlung nyin zhag brgya dang bdun gyis grub bo/ /de nas thugs sgrub bde 'dus dang*/ rmi lam sgyu lus/ bar do bcas dang*/ 'pho ba sogs zla ba gcig /yang gsang bla sgrub nyin bdun/ de nas rdzogs pa chen po'i nyams len la/ khrid ye shes bla ma zung 'brel byas nas 'khor 'das ru shan skabs phyi'i ru shan lus ngag yid gsum gcig tu zhag bcu bzhi/ nang gi ru shan rigs drug sa bon sbyong ba'i dmigs pa dang sbrags 'bru gsum bzlas pa 'bum bdun zhag bcu la tshar rgyu/ lus sbyong la zhag bdun/ ngag sbyong rgyas gdab la zhag bdun/ rtsal sbyang ba la zhag bdun/ gnyen btsal la zhag gsum/ lam gzhug la zhag gsum/ sems sbyong la byung gnas 'gro gsum brtag pa zhag bco lnga/ rnal dbab la zhag bcu bzhi/ sor zhugs la zhag gsum/ bcas bsdoms zhag brgya dang nyi shu tham pa/ khregs chod zhag brgya la nyams len dang*/ de nas thod rgal la'ang zhag brgya'i bar rdzogs rim rdzogs chen bsdom nyin zhag bzhi brgya zhe gsum bar ro/ gzhan lo gsar tshar gsum la nyin dgu dang*/ de nas bskyed rim dang rtsa rlung bar/ bar gseng nyin gsum/ gzhan dgu gtor nyin bzhi brtsis pa'i bcu gnyis/ sa zla'i bco lngar tshe sgrub nyin re brtsis nyin gsum/ klong chen 'das mchod lo snga ma gnyis dang*/ mjug tshogs skong gsol kha rgyas spros la zhag bdun bcas bsdom nyin zhag chig stong brgyad cu tham pa song*/ mdor na lo gsum nang sngon 'gro/ rtsa gsum bsnyen sgrub/ rdzogs rim rtsa rlung 'khrul 'khor/

rdzogs chen khregs chod thod rgal bar rnal 'byor chen po yo ga gsum gyi nyams len gdan thog gcig tu grub par bgyis nas/ gtang rag tshogs skong rgyas spros dang gsol kha bcas nyin bdun bar byas te mtshams rgya bkrol tshul mkhyen brtse'i dgongs rgyan ltar bya ba yin no/ /slar smras pa/ mkhas pa shrī rgyal po'i zhal snga nas/ dag dran med pa'i rnga brdung 'ur chems dang*/ /bskyed rdzogs med pa'i bzlas brjod 'bag 'bug des/ /thar pa'i lam du phyogs tsam phyin re kan/ /gsungs pa'i don la som zhing nyams len mdzod/ /sgrub lugs ma shes sgrub par rlom pa mtshar/ /bskyed rim med pa'i ne tso'i ma ṇi dang*/ /rdzogs rim mi shes a 'thas lha sgom gnyis/ /yang dag lam du 'gyur ba cang srid dam/ /de phyir gzugs brnyan mtshams pa'i ming stong la/ /ma re rig 'dzin gong ma byon pa'i shul/ /bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug lam bzang de zung la/ /dka' spyad snying rus dam bca' brtan par mdzod/ /chos kyi 'jug sgo skyo shas nges 'byung dang*/ /chos kyi rtsa ba gzhan don byang sems mchog /chos kyi snying po mos gus brtson 'grus gsum/ /chos par med thabs med pa'i snying nor yin/ /bskyed dang rdzogs pa'i gshog zung rab rkyongs la/ /theg mchog snying po'i lha lam myur bcad de/ /'od gsal gdod ma'i grong mchog ma zin bar/ /sgrub la brtson pa mes pos rnam thar yin/ /pha gcig rje btsun bla mas de ltar mdzad/ /rjes su 'jug rnams de bzhin gnang bar bskul/ /bdag dang bdag 'dra'i g.yeng ba'i mdo med la/ /ma gzigs dam pa'i dgongs spyod slob gcig gu/ /zhes pa'ang 'jigs med mkhyen brtse'i 'od zer gyi slob 'bangs yongs kyi tha gral du 'khod pa gsang sngags bstan 'dzin pas smras so// //
